paras.en: In the mouse experiments, researchers administered the gerozyme inhibitor twice a week for four weeks after injury. The treatment dramatically reduced the likelihood that the animals would develop osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 在小鼠实验中，研究人员在受伤后每周两次施用 Gerozyme 抑制剂，持续四个星期。这种治疗极大地降低了动物患骨关节炎的可能性。

paras.en: Mice that received a control drug had 15-PGDH levels twice those of animals whose knees had not been injured, and they developed osteoarthritis within four weeks.
paras.zh: 接受对照药物的小鼠的 15-PGDH 水平是膝盖未受伤动物的两倍，并且它们在 4 周内出现骨关节炎。

paras.en: The treated mice also moved more normally and placed more weight on the paw attached to the injured leg than untreated animals did.
paras.zh: 与未经治疗的小鼠相比，接受治疗的小鼠的活动也更加正常，并且在连接受伤腿的爪子上施加了更多的重量。

paras.en: "Interestingly, prostaglandin E2 has been implicated in inflammation and pain," Blau said. "But this research shows that, at normal biological levels, small increases in prostaglandin E2 can promote regeneration."
paras.zh: “有趣的是，前列腺素 E2 与炎症和疼痛有关，”Blau 说。 “但这项研究表明，在正常生物水平下，前列腺素 E2 的小幅增加可以促进再生。”

paras.en: To understand what was happening inside the joint, the researchers took a closer look at chondrocytes from young and old mice.
paras.zh: 为了了解关节内部发生的情况，研究人员仔细观察了年轻和年老小鼠的软骨细胞。

paras.en: Older cartilage cells showed more activity in genes associated with inflammation and with the unwanted conversion of hyaline cartilage into bone. At the same time, genes involved in normal cartilage development were less active.
paras.zh: 较老的软骨细胞在与炎症和透明软骨转化为骨骼相关的基因中表现出更多的活性。与此同时，参与正常软骨发育的基因活性较低。

paras.en: One population of old chondrocytes that produced 15-PGDH and expressed genes associated with cartilage degradation dropped from 8% of cells to 3%.
paras.zh: 一组产生 15-PGDH 并表达与软骨退化相关基因的老软骨细胞从细胞的 8% 下降到 3%。

paras.en: A second population, which did not produce 15-PGDH but expressed genes linked to fibrocartilage formation, fell from 16% to 8%.
paras.zh: 第二个群体不产生 15-PGDH，但表达与纤维软骨形成相关的基因，其比例从 16% 下降到 8%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a third group moved sharply in the opposite direction. These cells did not produce 15-PGDH and expressed genes involved in forming hyaline cartilage and maintaining the extracellular matrix needed for healthy cartilage function. Their share increased from 22% to 42%.
paras.zh: 与此同时，第三组人急剧朝相反方向移动。这些细胞不产生 15-PGDH，并表达参与形成透明软骨和维持健康软骨功能所需的细胞外基质的基因。他们的份额从 22% 增加到 42%。

paras.en: The extracellular matrix is the network of proteins and other molecules that surrounds cells and gives tissues their structure. In cartilage, it is especially important because it helps the tissue withstand pressure while maintaining the smooth surface joints need for movement.
paras.zh: 细胞外基质是围绕细胞并赋予组织结构的蛋白质和其他分子的网络。对于软骨来说，它尤其重要，因为它有助于组织承受压力，同时保持关节运动所需的光滑表面。

paras.en: Overall, the treatment appeared to push cartilage toward a younger biological state without recruiting stem or progenitor cells.
paras.zh: 总体而言，这种治疗似乎可以将软骨推向更年轻的生物状态，而无需招募干细胞或祖细胞。

paras.en: The researchers then examined cartilage taken from people with osteoarthritis who were undergoing total knee replacement surgery.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了从接受全膝关节置换手术的骨关节炎患者身上取出的软骨。

paras.en: After one week of treatment with the 15-PGDH inhibitor, the human tissue contained fewer chondrocytes expressing 15-PGDH. Activity in genes associated with cartilage degradation and fibrocartilage also declined compared with untreated tissue.
paras.zh: 用 15-PGDH 抑制剂治疗一周后，人体组织中表达 15-PGDH 的软骨细胞减少。与未经处理的组织相比，与软骨退化和纤维软骨相关的基因活性也有所下降。

paras.en: Most notably, the samples began regenerating articular cartilage.
paras.zh: 最值得注意的是，样本开始再生关节软骨。

paras.en: "The mechanism is quite striking and really shifted our perspective about how tissue regeneration can occur," Bhutani said. "It's clear that a large pool of already existing cells in cartilage are changing their gene expression patterns. And by targeting these cells for regeneration, we may have an opportunity to have a bigger overall impact clinically."
paras.zh: “这个机制非常引人注目，确实改变了我们对组织再生如何发生的看法，”布塔尼说。 “很明显，软骨中现有的大量细胞正在改变它们的基因表达模式。通过靶向这些细胞进行再生，我们可能有机会在临床上产生更大的整体影响。”

paras.en: The findings do not yet establish that the treatment can regrow cartilage or prevent osteoarthritis in people. The mouse results and experiments on human tissue represent important early evidence, but clinical trials specifically testing cartilage regeneration will be needed to determine whether the approach is safe and effective for patients.
paras.zh: 研究结果尚未证实该治疗可以使人的软骨再生或预防骨关节炎。小鼠结果和人体组织实验代表了重要的早期证据，但需要专门测试软骨再生的临床试验来确定该方法对患者是否安全有效。

paras.en: An oral 15-PGDH inhibitor has already reached clinical testing for a different age related problem: muscle weakness.
paras.zh: 一种口服 15-PGDH 抑制剂已经针对不同的年龄相关问题进行了临床测试：肌肉无力。

paras.en: Blau added, "Phase 1 clinical trials of a 15-PGDH inhibitor for muscle weakness have shown that it is safe and active in healthy volunteers. Our hope is that a similar trial will be launched soon to test its effect in cartilage regeneration. We are very excited about this potential breakthrough. Imagine regrowing existing cartilage and avoiding joint replacement."
paras.zh: Blau 补充道：“针对肌肉无力的 15-PGDH 抑制剂的一期临床试验表明，它在健康志愿者中是安全且有效的。我们希望很快就会启动类似的试验，以测试其在软骨再生方面的效果。我们对这一潜在突破感到非常兴奋。想象一下，重新生长现有的软骨并避免关节置换。”

paras.en: Researchers from the Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute contributed to the work.
paras.zh: 桑福德伯纳姆普雷比斯医学发现研究所的研究人员对这项工作做出了贡献。

paras.en: The study was funded by the National Institutes of Health (grants R01AR070864, R01AR077530, R01AG069858 and R00NS120278), the Baxter Foundation for Stem Cell Biology, the Li Ka Shing Foundation, the Stanford Cardiovascular Institute, the Milky Way Research Foundation, the Canadian Institutes of Health Research, a Stanford Translational Research and Applied Medicine Pilot grant, a GlaxoSmithKline Sir James Black Postdoctoral Fellowship, and a Stanford Dean's Postdoctoral Fellowship.
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院（拨款R01AR070864、R01AR077530、R01AG069858和R00NS120278）、巴克斯特干细胞生物学基金会、李嘉诚基金会、斯坦福心血管研究所、银河研究基金会、加拿大卫生研究院、斯坦福转化研究和应用医学试点拨款、葛兰素史克詹姆斯·布莱克爵士博士后奖学金和斯坦福大学院长博士后奖学金。

paras.en: Blau, Bhutani and other coauthors are inventors on patent applications held by Stanford University involving 15-PGDH inhibition for cartilage and tissue rejuvenation. Those applications are licensed to Epirium Bio. Blau is a cofounder of Myoforte/Epirium and holds equity and stock options in the company.
paras.zh: Blau、Bhutani 和其他合著者是斯坦福大学持有的涉及 15-PGDH 抑制软骨和组织再生的专利申请的发明人。这些应用程序已授权给 Epirium Bio。 Blau 是 Myoforte/Epirium 的联合创始人，持有该公司的股权和股票期权。

paras.zh: 材料由斯坦福大学医学院提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Colorectal cancer is rising in young people and often found too late

paras.en: Colorectal cancer is rising in young people and often found too late
paras.zh: 结直肠癌在年轻人中呈上升趋势，但发现时往往为时已晚

paras.en: Colorectal cancer is striking some young people with aggressive, advanced disease, prompting researchers to warn that key symptoms should not be ignored.
paras.zh: 结直肠癌正在侵袭一些患有侵袭性晚期疾病的年轻人，促使研究人员警告说，不应忽视关键症状。

paras.en: - Colorectal cancer in young people is often diagnosed at an advanced stage, with researchers finding most patients age 21 or younger already had Stage III or IV disease. Because symptoms like rectal bleeding, weight loss, abdominal pain, and bowel changes may be overlooked, researchers are calling for greater vigilance.
paras.zh: - 年轻人的结直肠癌通常在晚期被诊断出来，研究人员发现大多数 21 岁或以下的患者已经患有 III 期或 IV 期疾病。由于直肠出血、体重减轻、腹痛和肠道变化等症状可能被忽视，研究人员呼吁提高警惕。

paras.en: New research suggests that advanced colorectal cancer is becoming more common in young patients, raising concerns that warning signs may be missed or recognized too late. The findings were presented at the American Academy of Pediatrics 2026 National Conference & Exhibition Oct. 2-6, 2026, at the San Diego Convention Center.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，晚期结直肠癌在年轻患者中越来越常见，这引发了人们对警告信号可能被错过或识别得太晚的担忧。研究结果于 2026 年 10 月 2 日至 6 日在圣地亚哥会议中心举行的美国儿科学会 2026 年全国会议暨展览会上公布。

paras.en: The study, "Clinical Presentation and Epidemiology of Pediatric and Adolescent Colorectal Carcinoma: A Pediatric Surgical Oncology Research Collaborative Study," reviewed the medical records of 84 patients age 21 or younger who were diagnosed with colorectal cancer between 2012 and 2023.
paras.zh: 这项名为“儿童和青少年结直肠癌的临床表现和流行病学：儿童外科肿瘤学研究合作研究”的研究回顾了 2012 年至 2023 年间被诊断患有结直肠癌的 84 名 21 岁或以下患者的医疗记录。

paras.en: Only 20% of the patients had a first- or second-degree family history of colorectal cancer. Despite that, most had aggressive disease that had already progressed to Stage III or IV by the time it was diagnosed.
paras.zh: 只有20%的患者有一级或二级结直肠癌家族史。尽管如此，大多数人患有侵袭性疾病，在诊断时已经进展到第三期或第四期。

paras.en: The researchers say the findings add to growing concern about colorectal cancer appearing more often in young people and frequently being detected at an advanced stage.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这些发现加剧了人们对结肠直肠癌更常见于年轻人且经常在晚期被发现的担忧。

paras.en: Possible warning signs include lower back pain, abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, weight loss, and rectal bleeding. Because colorectal cancer remains uncommon in younger patients, these symptoms may not immediately raise suspicion and can sometimes be overlooked.
paras.zh: 可能的警告信号包括腰痛、腹痛、排便习惯改变、体重减轻和直肠出血。由于结直肠癌在年轻患者中仍然不常见，因此这些症状可能不会立即引起怀疑，有时可能会被忽视。

paras.en: "Colorectal cancer is, unfortunately, becoming more common in adolescents and young adults and represents a different disease than colorectal cancer diagnosed in older adults," said study author and pediatric surgery research fellow Erica Arnold, MD. "When diagnosed, it is often aggressive, presenting with late-stage disease and associated with high rates of disease relapse and mortality."
paras.zh: 研究作者、小儿外科研究员埃里卡·阿诺德医学博士说：“不幸的是，结直肠癌在青少年和年轻人中变得越来越常见，并且与老年人中诊断出的结直肠癌是一种不同的疾病。” “确诊后，它通常具有侵袭性，表现为晚期疾病，并且与疾病复发率和死亡率较高有关。”

paras.en: Delayed Diagnosis Can Have Serious Consequences
paras.zh: 延迟诊断可能会产生严重后果

paras.en: Researchers found that delays in diagnosis, combined with aggressive tumor behavior, can contribute to poor long-term outcomes.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，诊断延迟加上肿瘤的侵袭性行为可能会导致长期结果不佳。

paras.en: More than one-third of the patients in the study later developed recurrent disease. Nearly half died as a result of their diagnosis.
paras.zh: 研究中超过三分之一的患者后来出现了复发性疾病。近一半的人因诊断而死亡。

paras.en: The authors say symptoms such as unexplained weight loss and rectal bleeding should be taken seriously when they occur in younger patients. As cancers typically associated with adults continue to appear at younger ages, they also stress the importance of coordinating care between pediatric and adult medical teams and developing treatment plans tailored to these patients.
paras.zh: 作者表示，当年轻患者出现不明原因的体重减轻和直肠出血等症状时，应认真对待。由于通常与成人相关的癌症继续出现在较年轻的年龄，因此他们还强调协调儿科和成人医疗团队之间的护理以及制定适合这些患者的治疗计划的重要性。

paras.en: Materials provided by American Academy of Pediatrics. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由美国儿科学会提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: NASA’s Curiosity Rover Catches Stunning Martian Dawn
articles.author: Stephen Carney

paras.en: A newly released panorama captured by NASA’s Curiosity rover offers the most detailed view yet of distant, wind-carved Martian cliffs, highlighting features the mission’s scientists have long been waiting to see up close. The scene was snapped at 8:30 a.m. local Mars time, showing striking blue hues in the foreground as bright morning light illuminates crags known as yardangs on the horizon.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局好奇号火星车拍摄的最新发布的全景图提供了迄今为止最详细的遥远的风蚀火星悬崖视图，突出了该任务的科学家们长期以来一直等待近距离观察的特征。这一场景是在火星当地时间上午 8 点 30 分拍摄的，明亮的晨光照亮了地平线上被称为雅丹的峭壁，前景呈现出醒目的蓝色调。

paras.en: The panorama was captured by Curiosity’s Mastcam on Aug. 11, the 4,982nd Martian day, or sol, of the mission, and comprises six individual images that were stitched together after being sent to Earth. Unlike most of Curiosity’s Mastcam images, this one was processed without white balancing, preserving the early morning appearance.
paras.zh: 这张全景图是好奇号的桅杆摄像机于 8 月 11 日（即任务的第 4,982 个火星日）拍摄的，由六张单独的图像组成，这些图像在发送到地球后拼接在一起。与好奇号的大多数桅杆摄像头图像不同，这张图像没有经过白平衡处理，保留了清晨的外观。

paras.en: The yardang layer extends roughly 10 miles (16 kilometers) across the northwestern reaches of Mount Sharp, a 3-mile-tall (5-kilometer-tall) mountain that Curiosity has been ascending since 2014. In fact, the rover recently passed another milestone in its ascent, reaching 0.6 miles (1 kilometer) of elevation — the most ever climbed on Mars. As it draws ever-closer to the yardangs, mission scientists expect to get even more amazing imagery — and, they hope, answers to how these cliffs were created.
paras.zh: 雅丹层在夏普山西北延伸约 10 英里（16 公里），好奇号自 2014 年以来一直在攀登这座 3 英里（5 公里）高的山峰。事实上，火星车最近在其上升过程中跨越了另一个里程碑，达到了 0.6 英里（1 公里）的海拔——这是火星上攀登过的最高海拔。随着它越来越接近雅丹，任务科学家期望获得更令人惊叹的图像，并且他们希望能够解答这些悬崖是如何形成的。

paras.en: Mount Sharp is made up of layers, each recording a distinct period of Mars’ history. By studying them, scientists have been able to learn more about lakes and streams that covered this part of the Red Planet billions of years ago. Eventually, the water dried up and left salty minerals behind. After new material stopped settling on the mountain, some of it may have been stripped away by wind, giving rise to the yardangs.
paras.zh: 夏普山由多层组成，每一层都记录了火星历史的一个独特时期。通过研究它们，科学家们能够更多地了解数十亿年前覆盖这片红色星球的湖泊和溪流。最终，水干了，留下了咸味矿物质。当新物质停止在山上沉积后，其中一些可能被风吹走了，形成了雅丹。

paras.en: “The yardang layer looks out of place. It’s the wrong color, the layers tilt at an odd angle, and it almost appears plastered on,” said Ashwin Vasavada, Curiosity project scientist of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. “But that’s what makes it exciting to reach. No one is sure exactly what created this layer, but one idea is it may be ash deposited by ancient volcanic eruptions.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室好奇号项目科学家阿什温·瓦萨瓦达 (Ashwin Vasavada) 表示：“雅丹层看起来格格不入。它的颜色不对，各层以奇怪的角度倾斜，而且几乎看起来像抹了灰。” “但这就是到达它令人兴奋的原因。没有人确切知道是什么创造了这一层，但一个想法是它可能是古代火山喷发沉积的火山灰。”

paras.en: Curiosity is in the second year of its fifth extended mission, which started with an exploration of the spiderweb-like boxwork ridges. The rover will spend most of the next year or so driving through layers enriched with sulfates and carbonates, both signs of ancient drying on the surface. Sometime in 2027, scientists hope to reach the base of the yardangs, where Curiosity will be able to use its robotic arm to collect one-of-a-kind data on these mysterious features.
paras.zh: 好奇号已进入第五次扩展任务的第二年，这次任务首先是探索蜘蛛网状的箱形山脊。火星车将在明年左右的大部分时间里行驶穿过富含硫酸盐和碳酸盐的地层，这都是地表古老干燥的迹象。 2027 年的某个时候，科学家们希望到达雅丹的底部，好奇号将能够在那里使用其机械臂收集有关这些神秘特征的独一无二的数据。

paras.en: Curiosity was built by NASA JPL, which is managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California. NASA JPL leads the mission on behalf of the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington as part of its Mars Exploration Program portfolio. Malin Space Science Systems in San Diego built and operates Mastcam.
paras.zh: 好奇号由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室建造，由加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳市的加州理工学院管理。 NASA 喷气推进实验室代表该机构位于华盛顿的科学任务理事会领导这项任务，作为其火星探索计划组合的一部分。圣地亚哥的马林空间科学系统公司建造并运营桅杆摄像机。

paras.en: Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室，加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳

paras.zh: karen.c.fox@nasa.gov / alana.r.johnson@nasa.gov

articles.title: Astronomers Solve Cosmic Cold Case with NASA Hubble Data
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: Diligent sleuthing by astronomers uncovered a surprising chemical clue that indicates the white dwarf star HS 0209+0832 may host a second-generation planet. This artist’s concept released on Oct. 5, 2026, depicts that possible explanation.
paras.zh: 天文学家的辛勤调查发现了一个令人惊讶的化学线索，表明白矮星 HS 0209+0832 可能拥有一颗第二代行星。这位艺术家于 2026 年 10 月 5 日发布的概念图描绘了这种可能的解释。

paras.en: The white dwarf is the “dead” core of a star that burned through all of its nuclear fuel and lost its outer envelope of gas and dust to space. The second-generation planet formed from that cast-off gas and dust, which is why its chemical content is very different from a planet that formed as its host star was forming.
paras.zh: 白矮星是一颗恒星的“死亡”核心，它燃烧掉了所有的核燃料，并失去了气体和尘埃的外壳，进入太空。第二代行星是由排出的气体和尘埃形成的，这就是为什么它的化学成分与其主恒星形成时形成的行星非常不同。

paras.en: Image credit: NASA, ESA, Leah Hustak (STScI)
paras.zh: 图片来源：NASA、ESA、Leah Hustak (STScI)

articles.title: NASA Glenn Invites Phase 1 Proposals for Aerospace Power Systems Laboratory
articles.author: Gary Daines

paras.en: NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland is seeking Phase 1 proposals for the design and construction of the Aerospace Power Systems Laboratory. The principal purpose of this procurement is to deliver a laboratory facility to support the testing and development of power systems, with associated site work, infrastructure, and systems.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局位于克利夫兰的格伦研究中心正在寻求航空航天动力系统实验室设计和建设的第一阶段提案。此次采购的主要目的是提供实验室设施，以支持电力系统的测试和开发，以及相关的现场工作、基础设施和系统。

paras.en: The laboratory will provide modern test facilities to advance power research and enable NASA to meet current and future mission needs. Glenn’s expertise in power is crucial to the Artemis program, the Moon Base, and the exploration of Mars and beyond.
paras.zh: 该实验室将提供现代化的测试设施，以推进电力研究，并使美国宇航局能够满足当前和未来的任务需求。格伦在电力方面的专业知识对于阿耳忒弥斯计划、月球基地以及火星及其他地方的探索至关重要。

paras.en: Proposals submitted in response to this solicitation are due no later than Oct. 30, 2026, at 1 p.m. EST.
paras.zh: 针对本次征集提交的提案应于 2026 年 10 月 30 日下午 1 点之前提交。美国东部时间。

paras.en: NASA will conduct this acquisition as a full and open competition. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 236220, and the small business size standard of $45 million.
paras.zh: NASA 将把此次收购作为一场全面、公开的竞争来进行。本次收购的北美行业分类系统（NAICS）代码为236220，小型企业规模标准为4500万美元。

paras.en: The anticipated contract award date is Dec. 16, 2026. The contract will be performed on-site at NASA Glenn and off-site at the contractor’s facilities.
paras.zh: 预计合同授予日期为 2026 年 12 月 16 日。该合同将在 NASA 格伦现场和承包商设施外执行。

paras.en: Proposals for this solicitation are required to be submitted through NASA’s Enterprise File Sharing and Sync Box (EFSS Box), a FedRAMP Moderate certified platform.
paras.zh: 本次征集的提案需要通过 NASA 的企业文件共享和同步盒 (EFSS Box) 提交，这是一个经过 FedRAMP Moderate 认证的平台。

paras.en: All questions regarding this request should be submitted electronically, in writing, to John Christel, contracting officer, at john.a.christel@nasa.gov on or before Oct. 12, 2026. Offerors are encouraged to submit questions as soon as possible for consideration.
paras.zh: 有关此请求的所有问题应于 2026 年 10 月 12 日或之前以书面形式以电子方式提交给合同官员 John Christel，电子邮件地址为 john.a.christel@nasa.gov。鼓励报价人尽快提交问题以供考虑。

paras.en: For more information about NASA and agency programs, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 和机构项目的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: ‘Ebola takes the people children depend on’: UNICEF

paras.en: ‘Ebola takes the people children depend on’: UNICEF
paras.zh: “埃博拉夺走了儿童所依赖的人”：联合国儿童基金会

paras.en: The Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is robbing children of their loved ones – with some succumbing to the deadly disease themselves, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) reported on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）周二报告称，刚果民主共和国（刚果民主共和国）东部爆发的埃博拉疫情正在夺走儿童的亲人，其中一些儿童自己也死于这种致命疾病。

paras.en: The update comes as regional neighbour Kenya confirmed its first case and death from the disease, believed to have come from DRC.
paras.zh: 这一更新发布之际，该地区邻国肯尼亚确认了首例病例和死亡病例，据信来自刚果民主共和国。

paras.en: “Ebola takes the people children depend on and unravels their lives,” said Halimatou Amadou, UNICEF Chief of Communication in the DRC, speaking to journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: “埃博拉病毒夺走了儿童所依赖的人，并破坏了他们的生活，”联合国儿童基金会驻刚果民主共和国通讯主管哈利马图·阿马杜在日内瓦对记者说。

paras.en: “The parents fall ill, a child may be exposed, the parent is taken for treatment or dies. At the very moment a child most needs someone, fear and stigma can keep relatives and neighbours away.”
paras.zh: “父母生病了，孩子可能被感染，父母被送往治疗或死亡。在孩子最需要有人的时刻，恐惧和耻辱会让亲戚和邻居远离。”

paras.en: More than 1,900 boys and girls have either lost one or both parents, or their caregivers, since the outbreak was declared in May, or have been separated from them.
paras.zh: 自 5 月份疫情爆发以来，已有 1,900 多名男孩和女孩失去了父母一方或双亲，或者失去了他们的照顾者，或者已经与父母分离。

paras.en: Most of these children, 1,581, are in North Kivu province, the epicentre of the crisis. A further 322 are in neighbouring North Kivu province.
paras.zh: 这些儿童中的大多数（1,581 名）生活在危机中心的北基伍省。另外 322 人位于邻近的北基伍省。

paras.en: “And these are the children we know about because these figures cover only the area where UNICEF works with social affairs teams in the affected provinces,” she said.
paras.zh: “这些都是我们所了解的儿童，因为这些数字仅涵盖了联合国儿童基金会与受影响省份的社会事务团队合作的地区，”她说。

paras.en: Ms. Amadou put names behind the numbers, such as Lina*, a seven-month-old girl who she met at a UNICEF-supported nursery next to an Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, the Ituri capital.
paras.zh: 阿马杜女士在数字后面写了名字，比如莉娜*，她是一个七个月大的女孩，她是在伊图里首府布尼亚埃博拉治疗中心旁边的一个由联合国儿童基金会支持的托儿所认识的。

paras.en: Lina’s mother died and her father is missing. Her grandfather, who lives nearby, has visited twice and the hope is that they will soon be together.
paras.zh: 莉娜的母亲去世了，父亲失踪了。她的祖父住在附近，已经来过两次，希望他们很快就能团聚。

paras.en: Another child, Raphael*, just eight months old, survived Ebola but lost eight family members. He stayed at the nursery for more than three weeks until his older brother could take him home.
paras.zh: 另一个孩子拉斐尔*，只有八个月大，在埃博拉病毒中幸存下来，但失去了八名家庭成员。他在托儿所呆了三个多星期，直到他哥哥带他回家。

paras.en: “Children are not only losing their parents. They're also losing their own lives,” Ms. Amadou said.
paras.zh: “孩子们不仅失去了父母。他们还失去了自己的生命，”阿马杜女士说。

paras.en: As of 29 September, at least 2,017 children had been confirmed with Ebola in DRC. At least 1,062 have died.
paras.zh: 截至9月29日，刚果民主共和国至少有2,017名儿童被确诊感染埃博拉病毒。至少 1,062 人死亡。

paras.en: She noted that children make up just over one in four confirmed cases, but around one in three deaths. However, the situation is worse among under-fives where the death rate is seven in 10, up from six in 10 just a few weeks ago.
paras.zh: 她指出，儿童仅占确诊病例的四分之一以上，但死亡病例中约有三分之一是儿童。然而，五岁以下儿童的情况更糟，死亡率为十分之七，而几周前为十分之六。

paras.en: “Many die before the virus is ever detected, before they ever reach treatment,” she said.
paras.zh: “许多人在病毒被发现之前、在接受治疗之前就死亡了，”她说。

paras.en: While in Bunia Ms. Amadou “also saw what works” for young lives upended by Ebola.
paras.zh: 在布尼亚期间，阿马杜女士“还看到了对埃博拉病毒颠覆的年轻人生命有效的方法”。

paras.en: UNICEF supports 12 nurseries in Ituri and North Kivyu that care for babies and young children who have been exposed to the virus, or whose parents are in treatment, or who are on their own.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会为伊图里和北基伍省的 12 家托儿所提供支持，这些托儿所照顾接触过病毒、父母正在接受治疗或独自生活的婴儿和幼儿。

paras.en: “Children are fed, they are held, they're cared for, they are also watched closely so that if symptoms appear, they get paediatric care fast,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“孩子们被喂食、被抱住、照顾，并且受到密切关注，这样一旦出现症状，他们就能迅速得到儿科护理。”

paras.en: UNICEF is calling for nurseries at every Ebola treatment centre in the DRC, while underscoring the need to maintain health essential services. That way children receive early detection and quick referral to Ebola care, as well as protection from common childhood diseases.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会呼吁在刚果民主共和国的每个埃博拉治疗中心设立托儿所，同时强调维持基本卫生服务的必要性。这样，儿童就能及早发现并快速转诊至埃博拉护理，并免受常见儿童疾病的影响。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the World Health Organization (WHO) is monitoring the situation in Kenya, which on Tuesday confirmed its first case and fatality, according to media reports.
paras.zh: 与此同时，世界卫生组织（WHO）正在监测肯尼亚的局势，据媒体报道，肯尼亚于周二确认了首例病例和死亡病例。

paras.en: Spokesman Christian Lindmeier the case was “likely imported from DRC” but more information was not available.
paras.zh: 发言人克里斯蒂安·林德迈尔（Christian Lindmeier）表示，该案件“可能是从刚果（金）输入的”，但尚未提供更多信息。

paras.en: He said colleagues on the ground are working with the Kenyan authorities to get more details.
paras.zh: 他说，现场同事正在与肯尼亚当局合作以获取更多细节。

paras.en: *Names have been changed to protect the children’s privacy and identity
paras.zh: *姓名已更改，以保护儿童的隐私和身份

articles.title: In Islamabad, Guterres calls for end to US-Iran conflict

paras.en: In Islamabad, Guterres calls for end to US-Iran conflict
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在伊斯兰堡呼吁结束美伊冲突

paras.en: “From Islamabad, I want to send a loud and clear message to all parties,” António Guterres told journalists in the capital.
paras.zh: 安东尼奥·古特雷斯在首都对记者说：“我想从伊斯兰堡向各方发出响亮而明确的信息。”

paras.en: “End the conflict. Return to diplomacy. Fully restore navigational rights and freedoms in accordance with international law.”
paras.zh: “结束冲突。回归外交。根据国际法全面恢复航行权利和自由。”

paras.en: The crisis began in late February following joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran.
paras.zh: 这场危机始于二月底，美国和以色列联合打击伊朗。

paras.en: In response, Tehran launched counter attacks on targets in Gulf countries and Jordan, and blocked transit through the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint.
paras.zh: 作为回应，德黑兰对海湾国家和约旦的目标发动反击，并封锁了霍尔木兹海峡咽喉要道的过境。

paras.en: The maritime corridor is critical for global trade in crude oil, fertilisers and liquified natural gas. Hundreds of ships and their crews have been stuck at sea for months.
paras.zh: 海上走廊对于原油、化肥和液化天然气的全球贸易至关重要。数百艘船只及其船员已被困在海上数月之久。

paras.en: Meanwhile, fighting has spread to Yemen’s Red Sea coast where Iran-backed Houthi forces are battling Government troops, supported by Saudi Arabia, for control of the crucial Bab al-Mandab Strait.
paras.zh: 与此同时，战斗已经蔓延到也门红海沿岸，伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在与沙特阿拉伯支持的政府军作战，争夺关键的曼德海峡的控制权。

paras.en: The Secretary-General saluted Pakistan for its leadership in helping to create the conditions for dialogue between the US and Iran.
paras.zh: 秘书长赞扬巴基斯坦在帮助为美国和伊朗之间的对话创造条件方面发挥的领导作用。

paras.en: “Your efforts helped deliver the 17 June Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, the subsequent ceasefire, and the framework for further negotiations,” he said, adding that “every Pakistani should be proud of that pivotal role.”
paras.zh: 他说：“你们的努力帮助达成了 6 月 17 日的伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录、随后的停火以及进一步谈判的框架。”他补充说，“每个巴基斯坦人都应该为这一关键作用感到自豪。”

paras.en: Addressing wider issues, Mr. Guterres said that “there will never be peace in the region until the right of self-determination of the Palestinian people is fully realized – as Pakistan has long championed”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生在谈到更广泛的问题时表示，“除非巴勒斯坦人民充分实现自决权——正如巴基斯坦长期以来所倡导的那样，该地区永远不会有和平”

paras.en: He expressed hope for regional peace and prosperity, “anchored in dialogue and cooperation.”
paras.zh: 他表达了“以对话与合作为基础”的地区和平与繁荣的希望。

paras.en: The Secretary-General praised Pakistan for being “a source of solidarity and solutions.”
paras.zh: 秘书长称赞巴基斯坦是“团结和解决方案的源泉”。

paras.en: For decades, the country has sheltered millions of Afghans fleeing conflict and instability, and he underlined UN commitment to work with Pakistan to ensure that returns are voluntary, safe and dignified.
paras.zh: 几十年来，该国庇护了数百万逃离冲突和不稳定的阿富汗人，他强调联合国致力于与巴基斯坦合作，确保回返是自愿、安全和有尊严的。

paras.en: He recalled that Pakistan has served as a member of the UN Security Council over the past two years.
paras.zh: 他回顾说，巴基斯坦过去两年担任联合国安理会成员。

paras.en: “At a time of growing division and mistrust around the world, Pakistan put a spotlight on the value of multilateralism, dialogue, mediation and diplomacy,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在世界各地分歧和不信任日益加剧之际，巴基斯坦强调了多边主义、对话、调解和外交的价值。”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres added that Pakistan is also among the world’s longstanding and largest contributors to UN peacekeeping. He paid tribute to the more than 180 Pakistani blue helmets who “gave their lives in the service of peace.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生补充说，巴基斯坦也是世界上联合国维和行动的长期和最大捐助国之一。他向180多名“为和平而献出生命”的巴基斯坦蓝盔军人致敬。

paras.en: Pakistan and Denmark also took the lead on UN Security Council resolution 2823, which strengthens accountability for crimes against UN peacekeepers.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦和丹麦还带头执行了联合国安理会第 2823 号决议，该决议加强了对针对联合国维和人员的犯罪行为的问责。

paras.en: He noted that 153 countries co-sponsored the document, making it “the largest number of co-sponsors for a Security Council resolution in United Nations history.”
paras.zh: 他指出，该文件有 153 个国家共同提出，使其成为“联合国历史上安理会决议共同提案国数量最多的一次”。

paras.en: The Secretary-General also acknowledged the “immense suffering” Pakistan has endured due to deadly terrorist attacks.
paras.zh: 秘书长还承认巴基斯坦因致命恐怖袭击而遭受“巨大痛苦”。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres concluded by addressing the climate crisis, recalling that his last visit to Pakistan came during the catastrophic floods in 2022.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生最后谈到了气候危机，他回顾说，他上次访问巴基斯坦是在 2022 年发生灾难性洪水期间。

paras.en: “Pakistan is on the frontlines of climate chaos despite contributing only a tiny fraction of global emissions,” he said, but “it is also on the frontlines of the response.”
paras.zh: 他说：“尽管巴基斯坦的排放量只占全球的一小部分，但它仍处于气候混乱的前线，但它也处于应对措施的前线。”

paras.en: He pointed to the country’s leadership in establishing the Loss and Damage Fund, and the growing clean energy transition in the country.
paras.zh: 他指出了该国在建立损失和损害基金方面的领导作用，以及该国日益增长的清洁能源转型。

paras.en: The UN chief used the occasion to again call for developed countries to take the lead in ensuring a “drastic reduction” in global emissions this decade.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长借此机会再次呼吁发达国家带头确保本十年全球排放量“大幅减少”。

articles.title: Testing and monitoring underway in suspected Russia plague death

paras.en: Testing and monitoring underway in suspected Russia plague death
paras.zh: 俄罗斯疑似鼠疫死亡病例正在进行检测和监测

paras.en: The death of a lab worker in Russia’s Siberia region has sparked concerns over a possible plague case, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday, adding that it was following the situation closely.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）周二表示，俄罗斯西伯利亚地区一名实验室工作人员的死亡引发了人们对可能发生鼠疫病例的担忧，并补充说正在密切关注事态发展。

paras.en: “A woman who worked at the laboratory in Irkutsk oblast has died, and the authorities are looking into whether pneumonic plague caused her death,” WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier told reporters in Geneva.
paras.zh: 世卫组织发言人克里斯蒂安·林德梅尔在日内瓦对记者表示：“伊尔库茨克州实验室的一名妇女死亡，当局正在调查是否是肺鼠疫导致她死亡。”

paras.en: He underscored that her workplace was “an institute that studies dangerous pathogens, including plague, in a part of Siberia where plague occurs naturally in wild animals.”
paras.zh: 他强调说，她的工作场所是“一个研究危险病原体的研究所，其中包括鼠疫，位于西伯利亚的一个地区，鼠疫在野生动物中自然发生。”

paras.en: Plague is caused by the bacteria Yersinia pestis usually found in small mammals and their fleas.
paras.zh: 鼠疫是由通常在小型哺乳动物及其跳蚤中发现的鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague occurs when the bacteria infect the lungs. WHO notes that this form of plague infection is especially contagious and “can trigger severe epidemics through person-to-person transmission via respiratory particles”.
paras.zh: 当细菌感染肺部时就会发生肺鼠疫。世卫组织指出，这种鼠疫感染的传染性特别强，“可以通过呼吸道颗粒在人与人之间传播，引发严重的流行病”。

paras.en: According to WHO, pneumonic plague “can be fatal within 18 to 24 hours of disease onset if left untreated, but common antibiotics for enterobacteria can effectively cure the disease if they are delivered early”.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，肺鼠疫“如果不及时治疗，可能会在发病后 18 至 24 小时内致命，但如果尽早使用针对肠杆菌的普通抗生素，可以有效治愈这种疾病”。

paras.en: No cause of death has been officially confirmed to date and laboratory testing is reportedly underway, Mr. Lindmeier said.
paras.zh: 林德梅尔先生说，迄今为止，尚未正式确认死因，据报道正在进行实验室检测。

paras.en: Sharing with reporters a message received from the Russian health authorities moments earlier on Tuesday, the WHO spokesperson said that “according to the test results, no pathogens of dangerous infectious diseases were detected among any of the contacts.”
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织发言人周二早些时候向记者分享了从俄罗斯卫生当局收到的消息，称“根据检测结果，在所有接触者中均未发现危险传染病的病原体。”

paras.en: The authorities’ message indicated that the illness “initially presented as a typical acute respiratory viral infection”.
paras.zh: 当局的信息表明，这种疾病“最初表现为典型的急性呼吸道病毒感染”。

paras.en: Explaining the timeline of events, Mr. Lindmeier said that on 2 October “the internal monitoring system picked up the media reports of a suspected death from pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk oblast and started monitoring the situation.”
paras.zh: 林德梅尔在解释事件发生时间时表示，10 月 2 日，“内部监控系统收到了媒体关于伊尔库茨克州疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报道，并开始监控事态发展”。

paras.en: The next day, WHO contacted the Russian health authorities to get more information under the International Health Regulations “to verify the event, its circumstances, the laboratory tests underway and their results, the rationale for contact tracing and the health status of the contacts as well as any potential international public health implication”, Mr. Lindmeier said.
paras.zh: 第二天，世卫组织联系了俄罗斯卫生当局，以根据《国际卫生条例》获取更多信息，“以核实事件、情况、正在进行的实验室检测及其结果、接触者追踪的理由、接触者的健康状况以及任何潜在的国际公共卫生影响”，林德迈尔先生说。

paras.en: All of the patients' contacts have reportedly been identified and are being monitored, he added, stressing that “none to date have shown symptoms of illness.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，据报道，所有患者的接触者都已被识别并正在接受监测，并强调“迄今为止没有人表现出疾病症状。”

paras.en: Mr. Lindmeier stated that WHO’s initial risk assessment from the information available “estimates the risk to be moderate to low for Irkutsk, a low risk for the Russian Federation as a whole and very low for the WHO European region”.
paras.zh: 林德迈尔先生表示，世卫组织根据现有信息进行的初步风险评估“估计伊尔库茨克的风险为中度至低度，整个俄罗斯联邦的风险为低度，世卫组织欧洲区域的风险非常低”。

paras.en: He stressed that this assessment will be updated as more information comes in.
paras.zh: 他强调，随着更多信息的出现，这一评估将得到更新。

paras.en: WHO is following the situation closely, working with headquarters to keep other countries informed and stands “ready to support the Russian authorities if they ask”.
paras.zh: 世卫组织正在密切关注事态发展，与总部合作，向其他国家通报情况，并“准备好在俄罗斯当局提出要求时提供支持”。

articles.title: O'Neill confirms decision to stay on as Celtic boss

paras.en: Celtic boss Martin O'Neill confirms decision to stay after reflecting on future over international break

paras.en: The Celtic boss admitted he would consider his future after three consecutive defeats, but 74-year-old Martin O'Neill has now declared himself up for the challenge; watch Motherwell vs Celtic on Sunday, live on Sky Sports, from 11am; kick-off 12pm
paras.zh: 凯尔特人主帅承认在三连败后他会考虑自己的未来，但74岁的马丁·奥尼尔现在已经宣布自己已经做好了迎接挑战的准备。周日上午 11 点开始，天空体育直播马瑟韦尔对阵凯尔特人队的比赛；中午12点开始

paras.en: Martin O'Neill has confirmed his decision to stay on as Celtic manager after reflecting on his future over the international break.
paras.zh: 马丁·奥尼尔在考虑了国际比赛日的未来后，确认了继续担任凯尔特人队主教练的决定。

paras.en: The Celtic manager admitted before the international break that he would consider his future after three consecutive defeats and talk to the board.
paras.zh: 凯尔特人主帅在国际比赛日之前承认，他将在三连败后考虑自己的未来，并与董事会交谈。

paras.en: The 74-year-old has now declared himself up for the challenge after two defeats by Rangers sandwiched a Europa League setback against Ferencvaros.
paras.zh: 这位74岁的老人在两次输给流浪者队以及在欧罗巴联赛中输给费伦茨瓦罗斯后，现在宣布自己已经准备好迎接挑战。

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Scottish Premiership games on your phone
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看苏格兰超级联赛比赛

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Stream Scottish Premiership games flexibly on your phone
paras.zh: - 没有天空？在手机上灵活观看苏格兰超级联赛比赛

paras.en: When asked how ready and determined he was to lead the team forward, O'Neill told the club's Celtic Player: "I am. I'm extremely prepared for it.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否准备好并决心带领球队前进时，奥尼尔告诉俱乐部的凯尔特人球员：“我准备好了。我已经做好了充分的准备。

paras.en: "We had a difficult week. It can happen, you can lose to your arch-rivals, you can lose a European game.
paras.zh: “我们度过了艰难的一周。这种情况有可能发生，你可能会输给你的主要对手，你可能会输掉一场欧洲比赛。

paras.en: "It's certainly not the end of the world, as it seemed to be described. But (I'm) ready to go.
paras.zh: “这当然不是世界末日，正如它所描述的那样。但是（我）已经准备好了。

paras.en: "I did think I would take a little bit of time and it didn't take me that much time to think about it.
paras.zh: “我确实认为我会花一点时间，但我并没有花太多时间去考虑。

paras.en: "I want to lead the club, I want to try and win the league, which is what we set out to do, and just as determined now as ever before.
paras.zh: “我想领导俱乐部，我想尝试赢得联赛冠军，这就是我们的目标，而且现在和以前一样坚定。

paras.en: "It was a time of reflection for a moment or two and, yes, some things that you think about.
paras.zh: “这是一个反思一两分钟的时间，是的，你会思考一些事情。

paras.en: "But overall, I'm back, I'm raring to go and the team's ready."
paras.zh: “但总的来说，我回来了，我很想离开，球队已经准备好了。”

paras.en: O'Neill, whose side face Motherwell at Fir Park on Sunday, live on Sky Sports, added: "What you try and do is analyse the things that you've done or perhaps the things that you haven't done.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔周日在冷杉公园迎战马瑟韦尔，他在天空体育直播中补充道：“你尝试做的就是分析你已经做过的事情，或者可能是你没有做过的事情。

paras.en: "Throughout my managerial time, I've been exactly that. I think I look to myself, first of all. Maybe a wee bit different as a player, because I think I used to blame every other player for my own bad performance. But as a manager, you've got to look at yourself.
paras.zh: “在我的执教生涯中，我一直都是这样。我想我首先要审视自己。作为一名球员，也许有点不同，因为我认为我过去常常将自己的糟糕表现归咎于其他球员。但作为一名教练，你必须审视自己。

paras.en: "And if you feel as if something has dropped away, of course you have to analyse it.
paras.zh: “如果你感觉好像有什么东西消失了，你当然必须分析它。

paras.en: "Now, there wasn't a great deal in some of the games. If we get the equaliser just after half-time in the Rangers game, totally different ball game, totally different. But it wasn't to be. So you have to reflect on a few things like that.
paras.zh: “现在，有些比赛并没有什么大不了的。如果我们在与流浪者队的比赛中半场结束后扳平比分，那是完全不同的比赛，完全不同的。但事实并非如此。所以你必须反思一些类似的事情。

paras.en: "But overall, did the reflection, did all of that and a bit of self-analysing and just prepared for the battle."
paras.zh: “但总的来说，我们进行了反思，进行了所有这些工作，并进行了一些自我分析，并为战斗做好了准备。”

paras.en: O'Neill also revealed that Jota had played 45 minutes of a training-ground friendly against Falkirk on Friday, as the Portuguese winger steps up his comeback attempts following 18 months out with a knee injury.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔还透露，若塔在周五对阵福尔柯克的训练场友谊赛中打了45分钟，这位葡萄牙边锋在因膝伤缺席18个月后加大了复出的尝试。

paras.en: The Celtic manager has also been encouraged by Alistair Johnston and Callum Osmand getting back on the training pitch following hamstring injuries.
paras.zh: 凯尔特人主教练阿利斯泰尔·约翰斯顿和卡勒姆·奥斯曼德在腿筋受伤后重返训练场也受到了鼓励。

paras.en: O'Neill added he would assess the fitness of Hyun-Jun Yang on Friday after the South Korea winger experienced hamstring trouble on international duty.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔补充说，在韩国边锋在国际比赛中遭遇腿筋问题后，他将在周五评估杨贤俊的健康状况。

paras.en: Analysis: Celtic were always calm over O'Neill future
paras.zh: 分析：凯尔特人对奥尼尔的未来始终保持冷静

paras.en: Martin O'Neill was never going to be sacked by Celtic after three humiliating defeats in one week before the international break - but there was a real potential of him walking away from the job.
paras.zh: 马丁·奥尼尔在国际比赛日前一周内遭遇三场耻辱性失利后，永远不会被凯尔特人解雇——但他确实有可能辞去这份工作。

paras.en: After losing 1-0 at home to Rangers on September 20, O'Neill said he would take some time to think about whether he would continue as manager of the club.
paras.zh: 9月20日主场0-1输给流浪者队后，奥尼尔表示他将花一些时间考虑是否继续担任俱乐部主教练。

paras.en: Those comments sparked widespread reports and supporter speculation that the 74-year-old was on the verge of resigning.
paras.zh: 这些言论引发了广泛的报道和支持者的猜测，认为这位 74 岁的老人即将辞职。

paras.en: Sky Sports News understands Celtic have always remained calm about the situation, despite the recent results. There was no appetite to pull the trigger themselves, especially when the teams are sitting at the top of the league.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻了解到，尽管最近的成绩不佳，凯尔特人队始终对局势保持冷静。他们没有兴趣自己扣动扳机，尤其是当球队位居联盟榜首时。

paras.en: That was proven when Celtic CEO Michael Nicholson backed O'Neill in a statement announcing the club's latest financial results. He said: "We will now come together and support Martin and the players, as we focus our efforts on achieving success domestically and in the Europa League."
paras.zh: 当凯尔特人首席执行官迈克尔·尼科尔森在宣布俱乐部最新财务业绩的声明中支持奥尼尔时，就证明了这一点。他说：“我们现在将团结起来，支持马丁和球员们，我们将集中精力在国内和欧洲联赛中取得成功。”

paras.en: The ball has been completely in O'Neill's court and - as he has said today - he very quickly indicated his intention and desire to stay.
paras.zh: 球已经完全掌握在奥尼尔的手中，正如他今天所说的那样，他很快就表明了自己留下来的意图和愿望。

paras.en: Celtic face a tricky next five games back - Motherwell away (live on Sky Sports), Benfica away, Hearts at home (live on Sky Sports), Celta Vigo at home and Hibernian away (live on Sky Sports).
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队接下来的五场比赛将面临棘手的比赛——客场马瑟韦尔（天空体育直播）、本菲卡客场、哈茨主场（天空体育直播）、塞尔塔维戈主场和希伯尼安客场（天空体育直播）。

paras.en: It's going to be an interesting month ahead for O'Neill and Celtic.
paras.zh: 对于奥尼尔和凯尔特人来说，接下来的一个月将是有趣的。

articles.title: Flydubai pilot planned a 9/11-style attack on Tel Aviv airport, source says
articles.author: Keir Simmons

paras.en: TEL AVIV — The pilot who allegedly tried to bring down an Israel-bound flight had been planning a 9/11-style attack by crashing into the country’s main airport in Tel Aviv, a Middle Eastern official has told NBC News.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——一名中东官员告诉 NBC 新闻，据称试图击落一架飞往以色列的航班的飞行员一直在策划一场 9/11 式的袭击，撞向特拉维夫的该国主要机场。

paras.en: The pilot, identified by NBC News as Hamman al-Hamammi, told investigators Monday that he wanted to evade Israel’s defenses and crash into the Ben Gurion Airport or another building, said the official, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the person was not authorized to speak publicly.
paras.zh: 这位被 NBC 新闻确认为哈曼·哈马米 (Hamman al-Hamammi) 的飞行员周一告诉调查人员，他想躲避以色列的防御并撞向本古里安机场或另一座建筑，该官员表示，由于未获授权公开发言，该官员要求匿名。

paras.en: An Omani citizen, multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East identified al-Hammami. Authorities have not officially released the identity.
paras.zh: 一名阿曼公民、三个了解调查情况的机构的多个消息来源以及一名中东外交官确认了哈马米的身份。当局尚未正式公布该身份。

paras.en: He is currently being questioned by investigators in the United Arab Emirates after he was transferred from Saudi Arabia. The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to an airport in Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely, after last week’s dramatic midair incident.
paras.zh: 他从沙特阿拉伯被转移后，目前正在阿拉伯联合酋长国接受调查人员的讯问。在上周发生戏剧性的空中事件后，这架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班被转移到沙特阿拉伯的一个机场并安全降落。

paras.en: Emirati authorities said Saturday that the pilot attacked his fellow pilot, Capt. Smit Machchhar, with a crash axe and attempted to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls.
paras.zh: 阿联酋当局周六表示，这名飞行员用一把坠毁斧袭击了他的飞行员同伴斯密特·马赫恰尔机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制装置。

paras.en: The jet which was carrying 174 mostly Israeli passengers then plummeted 14,000 feet in just 29 seconds, according to data from the aviation tracking service Flightradar24, causing panic onboard.
paras.zh: 根据航空跟踪服务 Flightradar24 的数据，这架飞机载有 174 名乘客，其中大部分是以色列乘客，然后在短短 29 秒内从 14,000 英尺的高度坠落，引起机上恐慌。

paras.en: Machchhar, an Indian national and a veteran pilot of 17 years, said in a call Friday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that his fellow pilot told him he was going to pray, something he didn’t consider unusual as observant Muslims pray five times a day.
paras.zh: 马赫哈尔是一名印度公民，也是一名拥有 17 年飞行经验的资深飞行员。他周五在与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的通话中表示，他的飞行员同伴告诉他，他要祈祷，他认为这并不罕见，因为虔诚的穆斯林每天祈祷五次。

paras.en: A few minutes later, he said he felt a strong blow to the head. “Because of his initial blows, my vision was almost like nothing, and I was completely blurred out,” he added. “The next feeling that I had was that the aircraft was sharply going down.”
paras.zh: 几分钟后，他说他感到头部受到重击。 “由于他最初的打击，我的视力几乎为零，我完全模糊了，”他补充道。 “我的下一个感觉是飞机正在急剧下降。”

paras.en: A video of the call was released by Netanyahu’s office.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室发布了通话视频。

paras.en: Initially, Machchhar said, he thought there was “catastrophic damage to the aircraft,” but once the blows kept coming he “realized that it’s not the aircraft, it’s the other guy who was in the cockpit with me.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说，最初，他认为“飞机遭受了灾难性损坏”，但当撞击不断发生时，他“意识到问题不是飞机，而是和我一起在驾驶舱里的另一个人。”

paras.en: In a separate call with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, also Friday, Machchhar said he managed to open the cockpit’s door on the second attempt, despite the blows raining down.
paras.zh: 同样在周五与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的另一次通话中，马赫恰尔表示，尽管猛烈的攻击，他在第二次尝试中成功打开了驾驶舱的门。

paras.en: “I gave everything that I had, and just went for the door and opened the door. And thankfully, people were waiting to pounce back,” he said.
paras.zh: “我竭尽全力，走到门口，打开了门。值得庆幸的是，人们正在等待着反击，”他说。

paras.en: Focus has shifted onto the missed security signals ahead of the flight.
paras.zh: 焦点已转移到飞行前错过的安全信号上。

paras.en: Citing sources familiar with the matter, The Wall Street Journal reported Saturday that al-Hammami had “previously been banned from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted radical ideological views.”
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周六援引知情人士的话报道称，哈马米“此前曾因担心他采取激进的意识形态观点而被阿曼禁止乘坐飞机”。

paras.en: It is unclear how a citizen of Oman, an Arab country with no diplomatic relations with Israel, was allowed to fly the plane carrying Israelis to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚与以色列没有外交关系的阿拉伯国家阿曼的公民如何被允许驾驶载有以色列人的飞机飞往特拉维夫。

paras.en: According to Israeli law, airlines must provide information about passengers and crew members, including their names and nationalities, up to 48 hours before a flight.
paras.zh: 根据以色列法律，航空公司必须在航班起飞前 48 小时内提供乘客和机组人员的信息，包括姓名和国籍。

paras.en: Israeli investigators are leaning towards the assessment that the pilot was acting as a lone wolf, according to an Israeli official and a source familiar with the matter, although they said there is still more to learn about what led to his radicalization.
paras.zh: 据以色列官员和知情人士透露，以色列调查人员倾向于认为这名飞行员是“独狼”，不过他们表示，关于导致他变得激进的原因，还有更多信息需要了解。

paras.en: In the meantime, Netanyahu has called on the head of the National Security Council to appoint an examiner to review “all security aspects” of Israel’s civil aviation in the aftermath of the incident.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡呼吁国家安全委员会主席任命一名审查员，对事件发生后以色列民航的“所有安全方面”进行审查。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Vice President JD Vance underlined the concerns potential security failures.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，副总裁 JD Vance 强调了对潜在安全故障的担忧。

paras.en: “That person should not have been flying an airline, and so we’re certainly looking at our procedures within the United States to make sure that people who are obviously flight risks are not getting behind the wheel of an airplane,” he told a reporter at Joint Base Andrews on Monday.
paras.zh: 他周一在安德鲁斯联合基地对记者表示：“那个人不应该乘坐航空公司的航班，因此我们肯定会审查美国境内的程序，以确保明显有飞行风险的人不会驾驶飞机。”

articles.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员周二表示，西伯利亚一家抗鼠疫实验室上周死亡的一名工作人员的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫，目前已对已确定人群中的 60% 进行了检测。

paras.en: News from Russia’s consumer and health watchdog on Sunday that a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week has raised public health fears worldwide.
paras.zh: 周日，俄罗斯消费者和健康监管机构发布消息称，西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的一名女工作人员上周死于“不明原因肺炎”，这一消息引发了全世界的公共卫生担忧。

paras.en: “Laboratory testing identified two cases of Covid-19 and two cases of rhinovirus infection,” watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said in a statement, referring to the virus that causes the common cold. “No other infectious disease pathogens were detected among the contacts,” the statement said, without mentioning the word “plague.”
paras.zh: 监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 在一份声明中表示，“实验室检测发现了两例 Covid-19 病例和两例鼻病毒感染病例”，指的是引起普通感冒的病毒。声明称，“在接触者中未发现其他传染病病原体”，但没有提及“鼠疫”一词。

paras.en: Regional and national Russian authorities have not confirmed that plague was involved in the woman’s death. However, a State Department spokesperson said Monday there had been “reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague” in Irkutsk oblast.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯地区和国家当局尚未证实该妇女的死亡与瘟疫有关。然而，美国国务院发言人周一表示，伊尔库茨克州有“疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告”。

paras.en: Separately, a State Department official told NBC News Tuesday that the U.S. had been in contact with the Russian government as early as last Friday. Health experts at the State Department had taken part in the contact along with the Russian Foreign Ministry, the official said.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务院一名官员周二对 NBC 新闻表示，美国早在上周五就已与俄罗斯政府进行了接触。这位官员说，国务院的卫生专家与俄罗斯外交部一起参与了接触。

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control & Prevention also said on X that it was “working across the U.S. government to assess developments as additional information becomes available.”
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心也在 X 上表示，它“正在与美国政府合作，在获得更多信息时评估事态发展”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization, which oversees global public health matters, said Tuesday that Russian health officials had informed the agency in response to its request on the lab worker’s death that no case of plague has been recorded in Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 负责监督全球公共卫生事务的世界卫生组织周二表示，俄罗斯卫生官员已根据其关于实验室工作人员死亡的要求通知该机构，伊尔库茨克尚未记录到鼠疫病例。

paras.en: “According to the authorities, the woman’s illness initially presented as a typical acute respiratory viral infection,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“据当局称，该妇女的病情最初表现为典型的急性呼吸道病毒感染。”

paras.en: No case of plague or other high threat pathogen has reportedly been found among the woman’s close contacts, the WHO said, quoting the response from the Russian officials, adding that it’s awaiting confirmation from the Russian side about “what pneumonia-causing pathogen had led to the individual’s death.”
paras.zh: 世卫组织援引俄罗斯官员的回应称，据报道在该妇女的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫或其他高危病原体病例，并补充说，正在等待俄罗斯方面确认“是什么引起肺炎的病原体导致了该人的死亡”。

paras.en: On Friday, Maksim Modin, mayor of the Shelekhov municipal district near the border with Mongolia, said that the inpatient facility where the worker is said to have been treated had been closed for quarantine. Russian media cited officials saying that nearly 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under precautionary medical observation.
paras.zh: 周五，靠近蒙古边境的谢列霍夫市市长马克西姆·莫丁表示，据称这名工人接受治疗的住院设施已关闭进行隔离。俄罗斯媒体援引官员的话称，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Russian media outlets have named the woman and identified her as being 28 years old. These details have not been announced by officials.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体已公布这名女子的姓名，确认她今年 28 岁。这些细节尚未由官方公布。

paras.en: Irkutsk’s governor, Igor Kobsev, said Monday that no “microorganisms linked to the employee’s professional activities were detected” in her body.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布采夫周一表示，在她的体内“未检测到与该员工职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: The Irkutsk regional branch of Rospotrebnadzor on Tuesday denied what it called “fake” reports circulating online that an “enhanced sanitary-epidemiological regime” and strict restrictions have been imposed in the region.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦运输局伊尔库茨克地区分公司周二否认了网上流传的“虚假”报道，称该地区已实施“加强卫生流行病学制度”和严格限制。

paras.en: “No such decisions have been made at this time,” it said in a statement, saying the situation in the region remains stable.
paras.zh: 它在一份声明中表示，“目前尚未做出此类决定”，并称该地区局势保持稳定。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that even though there is “very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia,” if “something like that gets out, it could quickly spread.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，尽管“美国和俄罗斯之间的旅行非常有限”，但如果“类似的事情传出去，它可能会迅速蔓延。”

paras.en: Rospotrebnadzor, the health watchdog, said Tuesday its probe found “no incidents involving the handling of pathogenic microorganisms.”
paras.zh: 卫生监督机构 Rospotrebnadzor 周二表示，其调查发现“没有涉及处理病原微生物的事件”。

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters Monday the United States would do what it could to help Russia.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一告诉记者，美国将尽其所能帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: “I hate to see them having it,” Trump said. “It’s a rough disease.”
paras.zh: “我讨厌看到他们拥有它，”特朗普说。 “这是一种很严重的疾病。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, some of Russia’s neighbors have been stepping up preventive measures and quarantine controls at border crossings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的一些邻国一直在加强边境口岸的预防措施和检疫控制。

paras.en: The Kremlin has called for those concerned to heed official statements.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫呼吁有关人士留意官方声明。

paras.en: “Rospotrebnadzor provides comprehensive information,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said when reporters pressed him about rumors spreading amid sparse official statements.
paras.zh: 当记者追问克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）称，“俄罗斯联邦通讯社”提供了全面的信息。

paras.en: Peskov also deferred to Rospotrebnadzor when asked if the worker’s lab results would be released or if an autopsy has been conducted.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否会公布该工人的实验室结果或是否已进行尸检时，佩斯科夫也听取了俄罗斯联邦俄罗斯局的意见。

paras.en: On its website, the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East says it was founded in 1934 “as a scientific and operational body for combating plague,” but over the years, its scope of responsibility expanded to include “other highly dangerous diseases,” including cholera and anthrax.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所在其网站上表示，它成立于 1934 年，“是一个抗击鼠疫的科学和业务机构”，但多年来，其责任范围扩大到包括“其他高度危险的疾病”，包括霍乱和炭疽。

paras.en: The institute says it’s a “multidisciplinary research and anti-epidemic facility” that helps ensure epidemic safety in the region.
paras.zh: 该研究所表示，这是一个“多学科研究和抗疫设施”，有助于确保该地区的疫情安全。

articles.title: Taylor concedes aged care workers would be hit by migration plan
articles.author: Clare Armstrong

paras.en: The Coalition is being warned its migration plan would worsen skills shortages and damage the economy.
paras.zh: 联盟党被警告其移民计划将加剧技能短缺并损害经济。

paras.en: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has acknowledged that some aged care workers would be affected though flagged "transition" plans for the regions.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒承认，尽管标记了这些地区的“过渡”计划，但一些老年护理人员将受到影响。

paras.en: The Coalition is yet to detail how many aged care workers would be affected and will wait until the election to release costings underpinning its claim that the migration plan is budget neutral.
paras.zh: 该联盟尚未详细说明有多少老年护理人员将受到影响，并将等到选举后发布成本核算，以支持其移民计划对预算中性的主张。

paras.en: The Coalition's plan to slash Australia's temporary migration program would damage the economy and push talented workers offshore, education and business groups have warned.
paras.zh: 教育和商业团体警告说，联盟党削减澳大利亚临时移民计划的计划将损害经济，并将有才华的工人推向海外。

paras.en: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has rejected criticism of the economic impact of his proposal but acknowledged the changes would hit "some" visa holders working in aged care.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒拒绝了对其提案的经济影响的批评，但承认这些变化将影响“一些”从事老年护理工作的签证持有者。

paras.en: "What we need to have is a reset, breathing space, get the economy moving, get the right skills matches for our country," he told 7.30.
paras.zh: “我们需要的是重新调整、喘息空间、推动经济发展、为我们的国家找到合适的技能匹配者，”他告诉 7.30。

paras.en: Mr Taylor said he did not have the "exact number" of aged care workers affected, with a "transition" arrangement only flagged for health workers in the regions.
paras.zh: 泰勒先生表示，他没有了解受影响的老年护理人员的“确切数量”，仅针对这些地区的卫生工作者进行了“过渡”安排。

paras.en: Under the Coalition's plan, graduate, bridging and student visas would be significantly cut to achieve net overseas migration (NOM) of 100,000 people for two years before returning it to about 160,000 in the fourth year.
paras.zh: 根据联盟党的计划，毕业生、过桥和学生签证将大幅削减，以在两年内实现海外净移民（NOM）达到10万人，然后在第四年恢复到约16万人。

paras.en: By comparison Labor is targeting a NOM of 245,000 this year and 225,000 in 2027-28, while One Nation has pledged a "negative" intake for three years before settling at a target of 130,000 people "long-term".
paras.zh: 相比之下，工党今年的目标是 245,000 人，2027-28 年的目标是 225,000 人，而一国党则承诺三年内“负”吸纳人数，然后确定“长期”130,000 人的目标。

paras.en: Business groups warned the Coalition's low migration target undermined Australia's capacity to "prosper" while universities argued it would hurt the country's ability to funnel talented students from education into skilled work.
paras.zh: 商业团体警告称，联盟党的低移民目标削弱了澳大利亚“繁荣”的能力，而大学则认为这将损害该国将有才华的学生从教育转向技术工作的能力。

paras.en: Coalition claims skilled migrants will offset cuts
paras.zh: 联盟声称技术移民将抵消削减

paras.en: Yesterday Mr Taylor declared he was "confident" the Coalition's migration plan would be "budget neutral" because the deep cuts to temporary visa numbers would be offset by increased taxation income from higher value skilled migrants.
paras.zh: 昨天，泰勒先生宣称，他“相信”联盟党的移民计划将是“预算中性”，因为临时签证数量的大幅削减将被高价值技术移民增加的税收收入所抵消。

paras.en: But critics have questioned where the promised extra 100,000 skilled workers would come from, given the program was already demand driven.
paras.zh: 但批评者质疑，鉴于该计划已经是需求驱动的，所承诺的额外 10 万名技术工人将从何而来。

paras.en: There are also concerns that requiring almost all temporary visa holders leave Australia to lodge extension or other applications would deter high skilled workers.
paras.zh: 还有人担心，要求几乎所有临时签证持有者离开澳大利亚提交延期或其他申请会阻止高技术工人。

paras.en: Mr Taylor said the Coalition had worked with the Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO) to determine the impact on the budget but did not release the advice or indicate if modelling on the broader impact to the economy had been conducted.
paras.zh: 泰勒表示，联盟党已与议会预算办公室（PBO）合作，以确定对预算的影响，但没有发布建议，也没有表明是否已经对对经济的更广泛影响进行了建模。

paras.en: The PBO's 2026-27 medium-term budget outlook modelled sustained reductions in NOM and found 40,000 fewer migrants each year would worsen the federal budget by $79.1 billion by 2036-27, while 80,000 fewer would cost about $155.5 billion.
paras.zh: PBO 的 2026-27 年中期预算展望模拟了 NOM 的持续减少，发现每年减少 40,000 名移民将使联邦预算到 2036-27 年减少 791 亿美元，而减少 80,000 名移民将花费约 1,555 亿美元。

paras.en: This was largely because fewer working-age migrants would mean less income tax revenue.
paras.zh: 这主要是因为工作年龄移民的减少意味着所得税收入的减少。

paras.en: The Coalition, which has committed to cuts over a four-year period, has argued the budget impact would be neutralised by an increase to the amount of skilled workers who generally earn higher wages and pay more tax.
paras.zh: 联盟党承诺在四年内削减预算，并认为增加技术工人的数量可以抵消预算影响，因为技术工人的工资通常更高，纳税也更高。

paras.en: High-skilled migrants generally deliver a stronger return per person due to their younger age, stronger wage and labour-market performance, according to Treasury's 2021 Fiscal Impact of New Australians report.
paras.zh: 根据财政部 2021 年新澳大利亚人的财政影响报告，高技能移民由于年龄较小、工资和劳动力市场表现强劲，通常会带来更高的人均回报。

paras.en: Independent economist Saul Eslake said it was "true in general terms" that skilled migrants paid more tax than other temporary migrants, but without the PBO costings of the Coalition's plan it was difficult to assess if the plan would be budget neutral.
paras.zh: 独立经济学家索尔·埃斯莱克（Saul Eslake）表示，技术移民比其他临时移民缴纳的税款“一般来说是正确的”，但如果没有联盟党计划的 PBO 成本计算，很难评估该计划是否会保持预算中性。

paras.en: "They clearly have sought to address concerns about the impact that a big migration cut will have on the economy," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他们显然是在寻求解决人们对大规模移民削减对经济影响的担忧。”

paras.en: "I'm not sure I buy everything the Coalition has said, but at least it appears they have thought about it."
paras.zh: “我不确定我是否相信联盟党所说的一切，但至少看来他们已经考虑过这一点。”

paras.en: Mr Eslake said he thought the opposition was "right" to try focus on reducing the number of people in the country on temporary bridging visas.
paras.zh: 艾斯莱克表示，他认为反对派尝试集中精力减少持有临时过桥签证的人数是“正确的”。

paras.en: But he said it felt "unnecessary" to halve Australia's humanitarian intake to 10,000 people as it was a "tiny number" in the "grand scheme" of the migration program.
paras.zh: 但他表示，感觉“没有必要”将澳大利亚的人道主义接收人数减半至 1 万人，因为这在移民计划的“宏伟计划”中只是“很小的数字”。

paras.en: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke said the Coalition's policy was a "response" to One Nation's surge in the polls and warned it would negatively impact the economy.
paras.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克表示，联盟党的政策是对一国党民意调查激增的“回应”，并警告称这将对经济产生负面影响。

paras.en: "What does it mean when you get fewer skilled workers? The outcomes are pretty obvious," he said.
paras.zh: “当技术工人减少时，这意味着什么？结果非常明显，”他说。

paras.en: "It's bad for businesses, prices go up for consumers — it's a bad deal all around."
paras.zh: “这对企业不利，对消费者来说价格上涨——这对各方来说都是一笔糟糕的交易。”

paras.en: Coalition plan will 'end in tears', business groups say
paras.zh: 商业团体称联盟计划将“以泪水结束”

paras.en: Business Council of Australia (BCA) chief executive Bran Black said the major reduction proposed by the Coalition risked a "significant hit" to the economy and workforce.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚商业委员会（BCA）首席执行官布兰·布莱克（Bran Black）表示，联盟党提议的大幅削减可能会对经济和劳动力造成“重大打击”。

paras.en: "We must avoid a race to the bottom based on an arbitrary migration figure that could hurt Australia's economy while worsening the skills shortage," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们必须避免基于任意移民数字的逐底竞争，这可能会损害澳大利亚经济，同时加剧技能短缺。”

paras.en: "There are many unanswered questions as to how a cut of 650,000 temporary visas will be achieved without creating economic damage."
paras.zh: “关于如何在不造成经济损失的情况下削减 65 万个临时签证，还有许多悬而未决的问题。”

paras.en: Property Council chief executive Mike Zorbas said it was "hard to see" how Australia's skills gap would not get "worse" under the Coalition's plan.
paras.zh: 房地产委员会首席执行官迈克·佐巴斯(Mike Zorbas)表示，“很难想象”在联盟党的计划下，澳大利亚的技能差距不会变得“更糟”。

paras.en: "These migration cuts are just too deep for precision outcomes," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这些移民削减幅度太大，无法取得精确的结果。”

paras.en: Mr Zorbas said he agreed faith in the migration system had "deteriorated" but argued the Coalition's attempt to follow One Nation's policy position would "end in tears".
paras.zh: 佐巴斯先生表示，他同意对移民制度的信心已经“恶化”，但他认为联盟党遵循一国党政策立场的尝试将“以泪水告终”。

paras.en: Master Builders Australia boss Denita Wawn said it seemed "crazy" to require skilled migrants leave the country in order to reapply for a visa in the construction sector.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚建筑大师协会（Master Builders Australia）老板德尼塔·沃恩（Denita Wawn）表示，要求技术移民离开澳大利亚才能重新申请建筑行业的签证似乎“疯狂”。

paras.en: "We appreciate the concern around visa hopping, but I would have thought where you've got priority issues and priority industries, and you want to get projects and houses built as quickly as possible, you would not delay that," she told News24.
paras.zh: 她对 News24 表示：“我们理解人们对跳签问题的担忧，但我认为，如果你有优先问题和优先产业，并且你希望尽快建设项目和房屋，你就不会拖延。”

paras.en: Education sector joins criticism of cuts
paras.zh: 教育部门也加入批评削减开支的行列

paras.en: Phil Honeywood from the International Education Association described the cuts to student and graduate visas as a "own goal" by the Coalition.
paras.zh: 国际教育协会的菲尔·霍尼伍德将学生和研究生签证的削减描述为联盟党的“自己的目标”。

paras.en: "We're talking about Australia's biggest service industry," he told the ABC.
paras.zh: “我们正在谈论澳大利亚最大的服务业，”他告诉澳大利亚广播公司。

paras.en: "We're talking about the number one industry in Victoria and South Australia.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是维多利亚州和南澳大利亚州的第一大产业。

paras.en: "Here we have 250,000 Australian jobs at risk for people who work in international education related areas."
paras.zh: “对于从事国际教育相关领域工作的人来说，我们有 25 万个澳大利亚工作岗位面临风险。”

paras.en: Mr Honeywood said international student fees funded Australia's research output and subsidised the study of domestic students.
paras.zh: 霍尼伍德表示，国际学生的学费资助了澳大利亚的研究成果，并补贴了国内学生的学习。

paras.en: "Without that income, our universities are really going to be in incredible financial strain," he said.
paras.zh: “如果没有这笔收入，我们的大学真的将面临令人难以置信的财务压力，”他说。

paras.en: Universities Australia chief executive Luke Sheehy said the cuts to international student and graduate visas would come with "real consequences" for the economy.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚大学联盟首席执行官卢克·希伊表示，国际学生和研究生签证的削减将对经济产生“真正的影响”。

paras.en: "Restricting post-study work rights … risks making Australia less competitive for talented students and graduates at precisely the time we need more skilled people," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在我们需要更多技术人才的时候，限制毕业后的工作权利……可能会导致澳大利亚在人才和毕业生方面的竞争力下降。”

paras.en: One Nation says renters will save under migration plan
paras.zh: 一国党表示租房者将根据移民计划节省开支

paras.en: Meanwhile, One Nation has released analysis of the impact of its own migration plan, which includes cutting the temporary program by 750,000 over four years, on rental inflation.
paras.zh: 与此同时，One Nation 发布了对其自身移民计划影响的分析，其中包括在四年内将临时计划削减 75 万人口，对租金通胀的影响。

paras.en: The internal modelling used rental figures from the Australian Housing and Urban Research Institute to assume a substantial reduction in demand for rented properties as a result of the migration cuts.
paras.zh: 内部模型使用澳大利亚住房和城市研究所的租金数据，假设由于移民减少，对租赁房产的需求大幅减少。

paras.en: The party estimated a "middle" case scenario where rental inflation would reduce by 6.5 per cent, which would result in an annual saving of $2,818 on the average rental by the third year of immigration cuts.
paras.zh: 该党估计，在“中等”情况下，租金通胀率将下降 6.5%，这将导致移民削减第三年平均租金每年节省 2,818 美元。

paras.en: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson said her party would deliver "net negative" migration for three years before returning to a long-term "ceiling" of a 130,000 NOM.
paras.zh: 一国党领袖宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 表示，她的政党将在三年内实现“净负”移民，然后再回到 13 万挪威姆的长期“上限”。

paras.en: "A bigger population is not an achievement if Australians cannot afford somewhere to live," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“如果澳大利亚人买不起地方居住，人口增加并不是一项成就。”

articles.title: Train station intended to ease growing pains already bursting at seams
articles.author: Margaret Paul

paras.en: Melbourne's newest train station, West Tarneit, opened last month in Melbourne's booming outer west.
paras.zh: 墨尔本最新的火车站 West Tarneit 于上个月在墨尔本蓬勃发展的外西区启用。

paras.en: The station's 400 car parking spaces rapidly fill up on weekdays.
paras.zh: 车站的 400 个停车位在工作日很快就满了。

paras.en: Experts say better bus connections are critical in growth areas.
paras.zh: 专家表示，更好的公交连接对于经济增长地区至关重要。

paras.en: A train station in Melbourne's booming outer west that opened less than a month ago is already bursting at the seams, with commuters having to start work earlier to secure a car park.
paras.zh: 墨尔本蓬勃发展的外西区的一个火车站在不到一个月前启用，已经人满为患，通勤者必须提前开始工作才能获得停车位。

paras.en: West Tarneit train station, on the busy Geelong V/Line service, opened last month with 400 car parking spaces.
paras.zh: 位于繁忙的吉朗 V/Line 服务上的西塔尼特火车站于上个月开业，设有 400 个停车位。

paras.en: When the ABC visited — during the school holidays when fewer people might be commuting to work — the car park was already full just after 8am.
paras.zh: 当 ABC 访问时——正值学校放假，上班的人可能会减少——早上 8 点刚过，停车场就已经满了。

paras.en: Commuter Dershan Vyas works in the CBD, and got to the station about 40 minutes earlier than usual.
paras.zh: 通勤者Dershan Vyas在CBD上班，比平时提前了约40分钟到站。

paras.en: "Just for the parking, I came early, and there was a few spots left," he said.
paras.zh: “只是为了停车，我来得早，还有几个车位，”他说。

paras.en: He said the government needed to provide more car parks.
paras.zh: 他说政府需要提供更多停车场。

paras.en: Commuter Abdul Majid agreed there needed to be more car parks, but also wants to see bus services improve.
paras.zh: 通勤者阿卜杜勒·马吉德同意需要更多的停车场，但也希望看到公交车服务得到改善。

paras.en: "We need sufficient car parking there is no doubt, but this is a growing suburb, there will never be enough," he said.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，我们需要足够的停车位，但这是一个不断发展的郊区，永远不会足够，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Majid said he had to walk more than a kilometre to get to the bus stop. When he gets there, he can wait up to 30 minutes for the bus to arrive.
paras.zh: 马吉德先生说，他必须步行一公里多才能到达公交车站。当他到达那里时，他最多可以等待 30 分钟公交车到达。

paras.en: "It has to be more frequent — that would get me to shift from my car to bus,"
paras.zh: “它必须更频繁——这会让我从私家车换到公共汽车，”

paras.en: He added the trains were often crowded, with commuters having to stand in the aisles for the journey to the CBD.
paras.zh: 他补充说，火车经常很拥挤，通勤者不得不站在过道里才能前往中央商务区。

paras.en: The ABC spoke to several people who had caught the bus to the station or walked. All agreed more car parking spaces were needed.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司采访了几位乘坐公共汽车或步行前往车站的人。所有人都同意需要更多的停车位。

paras.en: Minister for Public Transport Vicki Ward said Labor had invested record amounts in Melbourne's west, "including the newly-opened West Tarneit station, longer trains for more passengers and 1,100 new bus services connecting these growing communities".
paras.zh: 公共交通部长维姬·沃德 (Vicki Ward) 表示，工党在墨尔本西部地区的投资金额创历史新高，“包括新开通的 West Tarneit 车站、为更多乘客提供更长的火车以及连接这些不断发展的社区的 1,100 条新巴士服务”。

paras.en: The new station has a four-bay bus interchange.
paras.zh: 新车站有一个四车位的巴士换乘站。

paras.en: Last month, Labor said the existing 182 bus would run more often and travel via the new station, and that a new route 186 would run between Tarnet and West Tarneit stations.
paras.zh: 上个月，工党表示，现有的 182 路公交车将更加频繁地运行，并途经新车站，而新的 186 路公交车将在 Tarnet 和 West Tarneit 站之间运行。

paras.en: Tarneit Labor MP Dylan Wight posted on social media that land had been set aside to the north of the station for more parking, but developers needed to build access roads.
paras.zh: 塔尼特工党议员迪伦·怀特(Dylan Wight)在社交媒体上发帖称，车站以北已预留土地用于更多停车位，但开发商需要修建通道。

paras.en: Public Transport Users Association spokesman Daniel Bowen said car parking near train stations was an issue across Melbourne, particularly in growth zones.
paras.zh: 公共交通用户协会发言人 Daniel Bowen 表示，整个墨尔本火车站附近的停车位都是一个问题，尤其是在经济增长区。

paras.en: But he said improving bus services was a better option than simply adding more car parking spaces.
paras.zh: 但他表示，改善公交车服务是比简单增加停车位更好的选择。

paras.en: "That turns out to be incredibly expensive — often $100,000 per space,"
paras.zh: “事实证明这非常昂贵——每个空间通常需要 10 万美元，”

paras.en: "The government really needs to look at more efficient ways of getting people to train stations."
paras.zh: “政府确实需要寻找更有效的方式让人们前往火车站。”

paras.en: Other stations struggling with population growth
paras.zh: 其他因人口增长而苦苦挣扎的车站

paras.en: Tarneit station opened in 2015, and is the second busiest V/Line in metropolitan Melbourne, behind Southern Cross.
paras.zh: Tarneit 车站于 2015 年启用，是墨尔本大都市第二繁忙的 V/Line，仅次于南十字星 (Southern Cross)。

paras.en: It has 1,500 car parking spaces, which locals say are regularly full before 7am.
paras.zh: 它有 1,500 个停车位，当地人说，早上 7 点之前停车位经常停满。

paras.en: Commuter Mnya Bhatia works in Deer Park, and catches the bus to West Tarneit station.
paras.zh: 通勤者 Mnya Bhatia 在 Deer Park 工作，搭乘巴士前往 West Tarneit 车站。

paras.en: She said she was "very grateful" the new station was operating, but when she visited just days after it opened, she noticed the car park was already full.
paras.zh: 她说她“非常感激”新车站的运营，但当她在新车站开业几天后前往时，她注意到停车场已经满了。

paras.en: "I was like, 'Oh god, it's getting like Tarneit again'," she said.
paras.zh: “我当时想，‘天哪，这又变得像塔尼特了’，”她说。

paras.en: "I don't like Tarneit station, it's very crowded, and being a person who feels suffocated very easily, I hate it."
paras.zh: “我不喜欢Tarneit车站，那里很拥挤，而且作为一个很容易感到窒息的人，我讨厌它。”

paras.en: According to Wyndham City Council, the area's population will pass 500,000 people by 2050.
paras.zh: 据温德姆市议会称，到 2050 年，该地区的人口将超过 50 万。

paras.en: The council is calling on both sides of politics to build new train stations at Truganina, Sayers Road and Black Forest Road, redevelop the Werribee railway station precinct and fund an electrification of the Regional Rail Link with a connection to the Werribee line.
paras.zh: 该委员会呼吁政治双方在 Truganina、Sayers Road 和 Black Forest Road 修建新火车站，重新开发 Werribee 火车站区，并为连接 Werribee 线的区域铁路线电气化提供资金。

paras.en: "Transport remains one of Wyndham's most pressing challenges, with growing demand placing increasing pressure on rail services and road networks across the municipality," Wyndham Mayor Mia Shaw said.
paras.zh: 温德姆市市长米娅·肖 (Mia Shaw) 表示：“交通仍然是温德姆面临的最紧迫的挑战之一，不断增长的需求给全市的铁路服务和道路网络带来了越来越大的压力。”

paras.en: The opposition's spokesperson on transport infrastructure, Evan Mulholland, said the opposition would consider building more car parks at West Tarneit.
paras.zh: 反对派交通基础设施发言人埃文·穆赫兰(Evan Mulholland)表示，反对派将考虑在西塔尼特修建更多停车场。

paras.en: He said the government had fallen behind on planning for growth areas, particularly in Melbourne's west and north.
paras.zh: 他表示，政府在发展地区规划方面落后了，特别是在墨尔本西部和北部。

paras.en: "If you're going to plan a new train station, you want to have everything ready by the time it opens, not leaving people scrambling for car parks or having to drive into the city because they couldn't get one," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果你要规划一个新火车站，你希望在开放时一切准备就绪，而不是让人们争先恐后地寻找停车场，或者因为找不到停车场而不得不开车进城。”

articles.title: UTAS debts mounting after CBD move 'turned sour', economist says
articles.author: Paddy Manning

paras.en: The University of Tasmania's finances face twin problems of large debts and little revenue coming in, an economist who fronted a parliamentary inquiry says.
paras.zh: 一位负责议会调查的经济学家表示，塔斯马尼亚大学的财务面临着债务高和收入少的双重问题。

paras.en: UTAS had tried to move into the Hobart CBD and sell off its Sandy Bay campus to raise funds, but has had to largely abandon those plans.
paras.zh: UTAS曾试图迁入霍巴特中央商务区并出售其桑迪湾校区以筹集资金，但不得不基本上放弃这些计划。

paras.en: A parliamentary hearing into the university's 2025 annual report will be held next week, with UTAS officials, including vice-chancellor Rufus Black, expected to answer questions.
paras.zh: 议会听证会将于下周举行，该大学 2025 年年度报告的听证会将于下周举行，包括副校长鲁弗斯·布莱克 (Rufus Black) 在内的 UTAS 官员预计将回答问题。

paras.en: The University of Tasmania faces a liquidity crisis, with $355 million in borrowings and financial pressure mounting from loss-making operations, a state parliamentary inquiry has heard.
paras.zh: 州议会调查获悉，塔斯马尼亚大学面临流动性危机，借款额达 3.55 亿美元，亏损业务带来的财务压力不断加大。

paras.en: One economist involved in the inquiry has told the ABC that UTAS's plan to shift into the Hobart city centre from its nearby Sandy Bay campus was based on "expecting blue sky to last forever", but the COVID pandemic put an end to that.
paras.zh: 一位参与调查的经济学家告诉澳大利亚广播公司，塔斯马尼亚大学计划从附近的桑迪湾校区搬到霍巴特市中心是基于“期望蓝天永远持续下去”，但新冠疫情结束了这一计划。

paras.en: A closed briefing last week heard from invited organisations and individuals, including the National Tertiary Education Union, the Save UTAS campaign, independent economist John Lawrence and UTAS Papers blogger Robert Hogan, who has campaigned for greater transparency at the university.
paras.zh: 上周举行的闭门简报会听取了受邀组织和个人的发言，其中包括国家高等教育联盟、拯救塔斯马尼亚大学运动、独立经济学家约翰·劳伦斯和塔斯马尼亚大学论文博主罗伯特·霍根，后者一直致力于提高大学的透明度。

paras.en: The briefing will inform committee members ahead of a public hearing with university officials next week, including vice-chancellor Rufus Black, who will answer questions about the 2025 annual report, tabled in state parliament in June.
paras.zh: 该简报将在下周与大学官员举行的公开听证会之前向委员会成员通报，其中包括副校长鲁弗斯·布莱克(Rufus Black)，他将回答有关 6 月在州议会提交的 2025 年年度报告的问题。

paras.en: The hearing will be the first of its kind and held annually, to provide the same ongoing scrutiny to the university as is given to government business enterprises.
paras.zh: 此次听证会是此类听证会的首次，每年举行一次，旨在为大学提供与政府商业企业相同的持续审查。

paras.en: Economist John Lawrence said the university's 2025 accounts revealed "a decade of financial engineering" had left it with little room to manoeuvre.
paras.zh: 经济学家约翰·劳伦斯表示，该大学 2025 年的账目显示，“十年的金融工程”已使其几乎没有回旋余地。

paras.en: UTAS announced its plan to spend $600 million to relocate from its Sandy Bay campus to the Hobart CBD in 2019, buying up multiple city properties for redevelopment.
paras.zh: UTAS宣布计划斥资6亿澳元于2019年从桑迪湾校区搬迁至霍巴特中央商务区，购买多处城市房产进行重建。

paras.en: It later released controversial plans to develop 2,500 homes plus aged care and tourism precincts at Sandy Bay.
paras.zh: 随后，该公司公布了一项备受争议的计划，即在桑迪湾开发 2,500 套住宅以及老年护理和旅游区。

paras.en: Pandemic scuttled CBD plan for sell-off and move
paras.zh: 大流行破坏了 CBD 的抛售和搬迁计划

paras.en: John Lawrence told the ABC that UTAS' key financial decisions were made before the COVID pandemic.
paras.zh: 约翰·劳伦斯 (John Lawrence) 告诉 ABC，UTAS 的关键财务决策是在新冠疫情大流行之前做出的。

paras.en: "All the decisions were made expecting blue sky to last forever," he said.
paras.zh: “所有的决定都是为了蓝天永远持续下去，”他说。

paras.en: "They were going to accumulate a big pool of cash, they were going to spend it, they were going to redevelop Hobart, and then they were going to sell Sandy Bay.
paras.zh: “他们将积累大量现金，他们将花掉它，他们将重新开发霍巴特，然后他们将出售桑迪湾。

paras.en: "They would just be overflowing with riches as they sold off something like 2,000 apartments.
paras.zh: “当他们卖掉大约 2000 套公寓时，他们就会变得非常富有。

paras.en: "But when COVID struck, the whole thing turned sour. The build-up in international students just ceased.
paras.zh: “但当新冠疫情来袭时，整个事情就变糟了。国际学生的增加就停止了。

paras.en: Mr Lawrence, who is a public policy analyst retained by independent Member for Murchison Ruth Forrest, said the 2025 accounts showed UTAS had $1.3 billion in net assets, but a steep decline in cash and so-called "unrestricted assets".
paras.zh: 默奇森·露丝·福雷斯特 (Murchison Ruth Forrest) 独立议员聘请的公共政策分析师劳伦斯表示，2025 年账目显示 UTAS 的净资产为 13 亿澳元，但现金和所谓的“非限制资产”急剧下降。

paras.en: Unrestricted assets are available to sustain operations, service debt obligations and fund maintenance and development, while restricted assets, such as research grants, scholarships, bequests and endowments, which are essentially held in trust and can only be used for the intended purpose.
paras.zh: 不受限制的资产可用于维持运营、偿还债务以及基金维护和发展，而受限制的资产，例如研究补助金、奖学金、遗赠和捐赠，基本上以信托形式持有，只能用于预期目的。

paras.en: UTAS's unrestricted assets fell from $530 million in 2022, according to Mr Lawrence's estimates, to just $112 million in 2025.
paras.zh: 根据劳伦斯先生的估计，UTAS 的非限制资产从 2022 年的 5.3 亿澳元降至 2025 年的 1.12 亿澳元。

paras.en: "UTAS has always appeared to have had lots and lots of cash and not to be in any danger, but it has transpired that a lot of the cash that they have is actually restricted, that it is not available.
paras.zh: “UTAS似乎一直拥有大量现金，并且没有任何危险，但事实证明，他们拥有的很多现金实际上受到限制，无法使用。

paras.en: "[To me] that was the most stunning thing that came out of the 2025 annual report.
paras.zh: “[对我来说]这是 2025 年年度报告中最令人震惊的事情。

paras.en: "They've got plenty of assets, they're solvent, but they don't have a lot of usable assets. And there is a danger that in the next few years that they will run into real strife."
paras.zh: “他们拥有大量资产，有偿付能力，但他们没有很多可用资产。而且在未来几年里，他们有可能陷入真正的冲突。”

paras.en: Mr Lawrence also said the university had borrowed too heavily, raising $350 million through "Green Bonds" due to be repaid from 2032 and another $203 million in a one-off sale of the right to collect future rents from student accommodation to an external provider, Spark Living.
paras.zh: 劳伦斯先生还表示，该大学借贷过多，通过“绿色债券”筹集了 3.5 亿美元，将于 2032 年开始偿还，并通过向外部供应商 Spark Living 一次性出售从学生宿舍收取未来租金的权利，筹集了 2.03 亿美元。

paras.en: Given interest rate rises since the Green Bonds were issued, the cost of servicing this debt is likely to increase sharply when the first tranche of $280 million falls due in 2032.
paras.zh: 鉴于自绿色债券发行以来利率上升，当第一笔 2.8 亿美元于 2032 年到期时，偿还债务的成本可能会急剧增加。

paras.en: Dr Robert Czernkowski, senior lecturer in accounting at the University of Technology, Sydney, told the ABC that UTAS was "an outlier" in terms of debt levels, with borrowings as a proportion of assets hovering around 16 per cent.
paras.zh: 悉尼科技大学会计学高级讲师 Robert Czernkowski 博士告诉 ABC，UTAS 的债务水平“异常”，借款占资产的比例徘徊在 16% 左右。

paras.en: "It's definitely near the top end of unis in the same size category by assets," Dr Czernkowski said.
paras.zh: “按资产计算，它绝对接近同类规模大学中的高端，”Czernkowski 博士说。

paras.en: "They're not going down the tube, but neither are they growing or showing a lot of potential to improve their position."
paras.zh: “他们不会走下坡路，但他们也没有成长或表现出很大的潜力来提高他们的地位。”

paras.en: Credit rating agency Moody's, which recently upgraded UTAS' rating from negative to stable, counts these student accommodation arrangements as a form of debt, lifting the university's effective borrowings to more than half a billion dollars.
paras.zh: 信用评级机构穆迪最近将 UTAS 的评级从负面升级为稳定，将这些学生住宿安排视为一种债务形式，使该大学的有效借款增加到超过 5 亿美元。

paras.en: Moody's analysis assumes that UTAS' debts would be guaranteed by the state and/or federal governments if it went into serious financial strife.
paras.zh: 穆迪的分析假设，如果UTAS陷入严重的财务冲突，其债务将由州和/或联邦政府担保。

paras.en: Dr Czernkowski said that with interest rates rising, the issue for UTAS was not whether it could refinance its Green Bonds, but how much it would cost.
paras.zh: Czernkowski 博士表示，随着利率上升，UTAS 的问题不在于能否为其绿色债券再融资，而在于其成本是多少。

paras.en: "Even a one per cent move is going to push them back into deficit," he said.
paras.zh: “即使是百分之一的变动也会让他们重新陷入赤字，”他说。

paras.en: UTAS rejected suggestions that it was an outlier in terms of debt levels, pointing to the recent Moody's credit ratings upgrade and to its preferred ratio of debt to equity, which was sitting at 26 per cent — in line with the sector average and below the 30 per cent limit imposed by the university's governing council.
paras.zh: UTAS拒绝了有关其债务水平异常的说法，并指出最近穆迪的信用评级上调，以及其优先债务股本比率为26%，与行业平均水平一致，低于大学管理委员会规定的30%的上限。

paras.en: This compared favourably to the University of Wollongong (68 per cent), University of Western Sydney (59 per cent) and Macquarie University (39 per cent).
paras.zh: 这与卧龙岗大学（68%）、西悉尼大学（59%）和麦考瑞大学（39%）相比毫不逊色。

paras.en: UTAS argues that, like other regional universities, it faces higher operating costs due to its smaller scale and greater distances between campuses.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚大学辩称，与其他地区大学一样，由于规模较小且校园之间距离较远，它面临着较高的运营成本。

paras.en: In a written statement to the ABC, the university's chief financial officer Ben Rose said UTAS had been "very clear about the impact of a volatile operating environment for universities on our financial position, particularly the impact of sharp drops in international students caused by COVID and changes in government policy".
paras.zh: 该大学首席财务官本·罗斯(Ben Rose)在给ABC的一份书面声明中表示，UTAS“非常清楚大学不稳定的运营环境对我们财务状况的影响，特别是新冠疫情和政府政策变化造成的国际学生急剧下降的影响”。

paras.en: "Our 2025 Annual Report shows that we remain on track to return to a long-term sustainable position that will enable us to meet current obligations and support future capital investment."
paras.zh: “我们的 2025 年年度报告显示，我们仍然有望恢复长期可持续的地位，这将使我们能够履行当前的义务并支持未来的资本投资。”

paras.en: Mr Lawrence said the university's core earnings were negative, and that unrestricted or usable assets had collapsed while restricted assets had surged.
paras.zh: 劳伦斯先生表示，该大学的核心收益为负，非限制性或可用资产已经崩溃，而限制性资产却激增。
