articles.title: Rays capitalize on four Yankees errors to take commanding 2-0 ALDS lead

paras.en: Start spreading the news: the Yankees are out of answers.
paras.zh: 开始传播消息：洋基队没有答案。

paras.en: New York flatlined in a 5-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Monday night, falling into a 2-0 ALDS hole as the series heads north.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，纽约队以 5-2 输给坦帕湾光芒队，在系列赛向北进行的过程中，纽约队陷入了 2-0 的困境。

paras.en: Tampa Bay stayed hot after Jon Gruden's pregame hype at Tropicana Field. Needing a bounce-back after Drew Rasmussen’s eight no-hit innings in Game 1, the Yankees instead stumbled right out of the gate.
paras.zh: 乔恩·格鲁登 (Jon Gruden) 在热带球场 (Tropicana Field) 进行赛前大肆宣传后，坦帕湾 (Tampa Bay) 继续保持火热状态。在德鲁·拉斯穆森在第一场比赛中打出八局无安打后，洋基队需要反弹，但他们却跌跌撞撞地走出了大门。

paras.en: Three first-inning defensive errors handed Tampa Bay an early 1-0 lead when Junior Caminero hit into a fielder's choice off starter Cam Schlittler. It marked the fifth postseason game in Yankees franchise history with four or more errors.
paras.zh: 第一局的三个防守失误让坦帕湾队早早以 1-0 领先，当时朱尼尔·卡米内罗 (Junior Caminero) 击中先发球员卡姆·施利特勒 (Cam Schlittler) 的外野手选择球。这是洋基队历史上第五场季后赛出现四次或更多失误。

paras.en: New York tied the game in the fourth on a solo home run by Ben Rice off Rays starter Freddy Peralta.
paras.zh: 纽约队在第四局中依靠本·赖斯 (Ben Rice) 在光芒队先发球员弗雷迪·佩拉尔塔 (Freddy Peralta) 的帮助下打出单打本垒打将比赛扳平。

paras.en: The Yankees loaded the bases in the top of the fifth, but Cody Bellinger flied out to the warning track against reliever Cam Booser to leave everyone stranded.
paras.zh: 洋基队在第五局上半垒上垒，但科迪·贝林格飞到警告跑道上对抗中继投手卡姆·布瑟，让所有人陷入困境。

paras.en: The Rays made them pay immediately in the bottom half with an RBI groundout by Liam Hicks, an RBI infield hit by Chandler Simpson, and a two-run single from Richie Palacios to break it open.
paras.zh: 光线队在下半场立即让他们付出了代价，利亚姆·希克斯（Liam Hicks）的打点滚地球，钱德勒·辛普森（Chandler Simpson）的打点内野安打，以及里奇·帕拉西奥斯（Richie Palacios）的两分安打打破了局面。

paras.en: Rice was the only Yankee providing any real sign of life, launching his second home run of the night in the eighth inning to trim the deficit to 5-2. His two-homer game couldn't wake up the rest of the lineup, and New York's frustration peaked when Spencer Jones hit a fly ball that struck the Tropicana Field catwalk for an out under 'live-play' rules, echoing Ty France’s roof hit at American Family Field on Saturday.
paras.zh: 赖斯是唯一一个真正展现出生命迹象的洋基队，他在第八局打出了当晚的第二支本垒打，将比分差距缩小到 5-2。他的两支全垒打比赛无法唤醒阵容中的其他球员，当斯宾塞·琼斯(Spencer Jones)击出一记高飞球，击中特罗皮康纳球场(Tropicana Field)的走道，根据“现场比赛”规则出局时，纽约队的挫败感达到了顶峰，这与周六泰·弗朗斯(Ty France)在美国家庭球场(American Family Field)的屋顶击球相呼应。

paras.en: With no room left for error, the Yankees head back to the Bronx facing elimination. Game 3 pits Yankees ace Max Fried against the Rays' 15-game winner, Nick Martinez, to keep New York alive.
paras.zh: 由于没有犯错的余地，洋基队回到布朗克斯面临淘汰。第 3 场比赛由洋基队王牌马克斯·弗里德 (Max Fried) 对阵光芒队 15 场胜利者尼克·马丁内斯 (Nick Martinez)，以保住纽约队的活力。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Falcons turn primetime doubters into believers behind Bijan Robinson's back-to-back masterpieces

paras.en: When football fans saw three straight Primetime games on the NFL schedule for the Atlanta Falcons, there were some social media eye rolls, sighs and more, and who could blame them?
paras.zh: 当球迷在 NFL 赛程中连续观看亚特兰大猎鹰队的三场黄金时段比赛时，社交媒体上出现了一些翻白眼、叹息等等，谁能责怪他们呢？

paras.en: The Falcons, who started third-string quarterback Cooper Rush and were sitting at 0-2 at the start of the year, didn’t really make for must-watch television under the bright lights of a nationally-televised contest.
paras.zh: 猎鹰队以三号四分卫库珀·拉什（Cooper Rush）为首发，年初战绩为 0 胜 2 负，在全国电视转播的比赛的明亮灯光下，猎鹰队并没有真正成为必看的电视节目。

paras.en: But that’s the beautiful thing about the NFL: each week is a chance to prove everyone wrong, especially this early in the season. The Falcons are doing just that, and now they’re can’t-miss entertainment on the gridiron.
paras.zh: 但这就是 NFL 的美妙之处：每周都有机会证明每个人都错了，尤其是在赛季初期。猎鹰队正在这样做，现在他们是球场上不容错过的娱乐节目。

paras.en: Why? The man in the backfield wearing No. 7 on his red and black jersey: running back Bijan Robinson.
paras.zh: 为什么？后场身穿红黑球衣的7号男子：跑卫比扬·罗宾逊。

paras.en: In Week 3 against the Green Bay Packers, Robinson, who had modest showings for his standards in the Falcons’ two losses to begin the year, broke out for 194 yards on 29 carries with two touchdowns in the blowout victory at Lambeau Field.
paras.zh: 在第三周对阵绿湾包装工队的比赛中，罗宾逊在猎鹰队年初的两场失利中表现平平，但在兰博球场的一场大胜中，他以 29 次冲球推进 194 码并取得两次达阵。

paras.en: Once again on the road against a divisional foe in the New Orleans Saints, a team celebrating the 20th anniversary of the "Domecoming" where they emotionally reopened their beloved Superdome following the devastation of Hurricane Katrina against these same Falcons, Robinson put up another magnificent stat line.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊再次在客场对阵分区劲敌新奥尔良圣徒队，这是一支庆祝“圆顶降临”20周年的球队，在卡特里娜飓风对猎鹰队造成的破坏之后，他们激动地重新开放了他们心爱的超级圆顶体育馆，罗宾逊又打出了另一条宏伟的数据线。

paras.en: On just 19 carries, Robinson finished the game with 145 yards rushing and two more touchdowns to help lead the way to a 45-17 thrashing to move to 2-2 on the season. And though they have shown tons of fight through three weeks, the 1–3 Saints were stumped all night long on home turf.
paras.zh: 仅 19 次冲球，罗宾逊就以 145 码的冲球和两次达阵结束了比赛，帮助球队以 45-17 击败对手，将赛季战绩升至 2-2。尽管圣徒队在三周内表现出了巨大的战斗力，但1胜3负的圣徒队在主场整晚都被困住了。

paras.en: Robinson’s agility, explosiveness and consistent running is just a joy to watch for those who love the great game of football. His first touch of the game went for 59 yards and a touchdown on a run that saw him hit 21 mph without looking like he broke a sweat. Then, it’s the tough-nosed running in the red area that can also break the spirit of a defense, as he made it 14-0 in the first quarter with a four-yard touchdown run.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的敏捷性、爆发力和持续的奔跑对于那些热爱伟大足球比赛的人来说是一种享受。他本场比赛的第一次触球推进了 59 码，并以 21 英里/小时的速度冲球达阵，看起来毫不费力。然后，在红区的强硬跑动也能打破防守的精神，他在第一节就以 4 码达阵跑动将比分打成 14-0。

paras.en: And just as they did last week, the Falcons are all about spreading the wealth. Brian Robinson Jr., Bijan Robinson’s backup, had more touchdowns than his counterpart, scoring three times and rushing for 62 yards on 14 carries in this one.
paras.zh: 就像他们上周所做的那样，猎鹰队的一切都是为了传播财富。 Bijan Robinson 的替补小布莱恩·罗宾逊 (Brian Robinson Jr.) 比他的对手有更多达阵，在这一场比赛中得分 3 次并冲球 62 码，14 次冲球。

paras.en: Finally, there’s Michael Penix Jr., whose job is to conduct the offense in a timely manner and make some key throws to keep drives going. Thankfully for Atlanta, he’s back healthy and doing just that, going 15-of-20 for 223 yards with a touchdown pass to Jahan Dotson to get himself involved in the scoring. He also loved tossing the rock to Drake London, who matched Bijan Robinson with 194 yards through the air last week in Green Bay, as he finished with five catches for 96 yards.
paras.zh: 最后，还有小迈克尔·佩尼克斯（Michael Penix Jr.），他的工作是及时组织进攻，并投出一些关键球来保持进攻。值得庆幸的是，亚特兰大队的他已经健康回归，并且做到了这一点，他20投15中，推进223码，达阵传球给贾汉·多特森(Jahan Dotson)，帮助自己参与得分。他还喜欢把石头扔给德雷克·伦敦(Drake London)，德雷克·伦敦上周在绿湾以194码的空中成绩追平了毕扬·罗宾逊(Bijan Robinson)，最终他完成了5次接球，推进了96码。

paras.en: Of course, the Falcons’ offensive line has a large share in making this magic happen, and the defense for Atlanta has been solid over the past two weeks to allow the ball to get back into the hands of Penix, Bijan Robinson and more as much as possible.
paras.zh: 当然，猎鹰队的进攻线在实现这一奇迹的过程中发挥了很大的作用，亚特兰大队的防守在过去两周里一直很稳固，让球尽可能地回到佩尼克斯、比扬·罗宾逊等人的手中。

paras.en: But there’s no denying that watching this Falcons team over the past two weeks has been pure joy because one of the best players in the sport has put on back-to-back spectacles in Primetime, and there’s still one more game to go on Sunday night against the Baltimore Ravens in Week 5.
paras.zh: 但不可否认的是，过去两周观看猎鹰队的比赛纯粹是一种乐趣，因为这项运动中最好的球员之一在黄金时段连续上演了精彩的表演，而且第五周周日晚上还有一场对阵巴尔的摩乌鸦队的比赛。

paras.en: "I love the Primetime games under the lights. It brings out a different energy, and I just love this team," Bijan Robinson said after the game.
paras.zh: “我喜欢灯光下的黄金时段比赛。它带来了不同的能量，我就是喜欢这支球队，”比扬·罗宾逊赛后说道。

articles.title: Massachusetts felon pleads guilty after DOJ says he sold Russian plutonium to 67 customers

paras.en: A convicted felon from Massachusetts has pleaded guilty to illegally importing plutonium from Russia and selling the radioactive material and other highly toxic and hazardous materials to customers in the U.S. and abroad, while also pleading guilty to possessing child sexual abuse material.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州一名被定罪的重罪犯承认从俄罗斯非法进口钚并向美国和国外的客户出售放射性材料和其他剧毒危险材料，同时还承认持有儿童性虐待材料。

paras.en: Jacob D. Miller, 44, pleaded guilty to one count of being a felon in possession of ammunition, one count of being a felon in possession of explosive materials, one count of importing nuclear material without lawful authority, one count of mailing hazardous materials and one count of possession of child pornography, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 据马萨诸塞州联邦检察官办公室称，44 岁的雅各布·D·米勒 (Jacob D. Miller) 承认了一项持有弹药的重罪犯罪、一项持有爆炸材料的重罪犯罪、一项未经合法授权进口核材料的罪名、一项邮寄危险材料的罪名和一项持有儿童色情制品的罪名。

paras.en: Miller was arrested on April 9, 2025, and indicted by a grand jury on April 17. He has remained in federal custody since his arrest.
paras.zh: 米勒于 2025 年 4 月 9 日被捕，并于 4 月 17 日被大陪审团起诉。自被捕以来，他一直被联邦拘留。

paras.en: He had previously been convicted on Feb. 9, 2004, in Massachusetts state court for possessing child pornography and possessing an explosive device. According to federal prosecutors, Miller received seven years of probation in the child pornography case and, in a separate case involving two counts of possessing an explosive device, was sentenced to 2½ years in jail and 10 years of probation.
paras.zh: 此前，他曾于 2004 年 2 月 9 日在马萨诸塞州法院因持有儿童色情制品和持有爆炸装置而被定罪。据联邦检察官称，米勒在儿童色情案中被判处 7 年缓刑，在另一起涉及两项持有爆炸装置罪名的案件中，米勒被判处 2.5 年监禁和 10 年缓刑。

paras.en: After his release, Miller started a business called Collect The Periodic Table (CTPT) and sold samples of elements such as plutonium, which is highly radioactive, and thallium, which is highly toxic, according to prosecutors. In addition to selling through CTPT directly, Miller used an online third-party retailer, Bonanza, to make sales.
paras.zh: 检察官称，获释后，米勒创办了一家名为“收集元素周期表”(CTPT) 的企业，出售高放射性钚和剧毒铊等元素的样品。除了直接通过 CTPT 进行销售外，米勒还通过在线第三方零售商 Bonanza 进行销售。

paras.en: Miller imported plutonium from Russia and arranged for it to be mailed to him at his Massachusetts residence, prosecutors said. Between Dec. 30, 2020, and March 31, 2025, Miller sold plutonium to about 67 customers across the U.S. and abroad. Miller shipped the plutonium to his customers through a U.S. mail service, despite plutonium being a hazardous substance that was prohibited from being shipped.
paras.zh: 检察官称，米勒从俄罗斯进口钚，并安排将其邮寄给他在马萨诸塞州的住所。 2020年12月30日至2025年3月31日期间，米勒向美国和国外约67名客户出售钚。米勒通过美国邮政服务将钚运送给他的客户，尽管钚是一种禁止运输的危险物质。

paras.en: Between Oct. 12, 2017, and April 5, 2025, Miller used CTPT and Bonanza to sell thallium to about 71 customers, according to prosecutors. Miller also shipped the thallium to his customers through the U.S. mail, even though thallium was also a hazardous substance that was barred from being mailed.
paras.zh: 检察官称，2017 年 10 月 12 日至 2025 年 4 月 5 日期间，米勒利用 CTPT 和 Bonanza 向约 71 名客户出售铊。米勒还通过美国邮件将铊运送给他的客户，尽管铊也是一种禁止邮寄的危险物质。

paras.en: During a search of Miller’s residence in April 2025, a box containing bottles of explosive powder, numerous rounds of ammunition and six firearms were recovered by investigators. The ammunition, firearms and explosive materials were unlawfully possessed because of his previous felony convictions, prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 2025 年 4 月，调查人员搜查米勒的住所时，发现了一个装有炸药瓶、多发弹药和六支枪支的盒子。检察官称，由于他之前曾被判重罪，这些弹药、枪支和爆炸材料是非法持有的。

paras.en: Miller’s laptop and cell phone were also found with child sexual abuse materials, which he had opened as recently as the day before the search warrant, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检察官称，米勒的笔记本电脑和手机中还发现了儿童性虐待材料，他在搜查令前一天打开了这些材料。

paras.en: His sentencing has been scheduled for Jan 21.
paras.zh: 他的宣判定于 1 月 21 日进行。

articles.title: Tigray rebel groups ‘forcibly recruiting boys as young as 15’ as fighting spreads
articles.author: Lucy Kassa

paras.en: As renewed fighting has threatened a fresh humanitarian crisis in the northern region of Ethiopia, reports are emerging that a new alliance of armed groups in Tigray has been forcibly recruiting men and boys to its ranks.
paras.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚北部地区重新爆发的战斗威胁着新的人道主义危机，有报道称，提格雷的一个新的武装团体联盟一直在强行招募男子和男孩加入其队伍。

paras.en: Renewed conflict erupted on 23 September between Ethiopia’s federal government and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), which rules the region, shattering the fragile Pretoria peace agreement signed between the two sides in November 2022.
paras.zh: 9 月 23 日，埃塞俄比亚联邦政府与统治该地区的提格雷人民解放阵线 (TPLF) 再次爆发冲突，破坏了双方于 2022 年 11 月签署的脆弱的比勒陀利亚和平协议。

paras.en: The latest fighting started after months of escalating tensions when the TPLF launched an attack in what it claims was a response to drone strikes by the federal government.
paras.zh: 最近的战斗是在紧张局势升级数月后开始的，当时TPLF发动了袭击，声称这是对联邦政府无人机袭击的回应。

paras.en: Witnesses who spoke to the Guardian described a broad campaign of forced recruitment in Tigray, targeting men and boys between the ages of 15 and 65.
paras.zh: 接受《卫报》采访的目击者描述了提格雷大规模的强制征兵活动，目标对象是 15 岁至 65 岁的男性和男孩。

paras.en: The Eritrean Defence Forces and Amhara militias, which committed war crimes and crimes against humanity during the 2020-22 conflict, have switched allegiance and are now fighting in support of the TPLF.
paras.zh: 在 2020-22 年冲突期间犯下战争罪和危害人类罪的厄立特里亚国防军和阿姆哈拉民兵已改变效忠对象，目前正在为支持蒂格雷人阵而战。

paras.en: Along with this new alliance, testimonies of forced recruitment, child soldiers and fresh humanitarian crises are emerging out of the already battered region.
paras.zh: 随着这个新联盟的建立，强行征兵、儿童兵和新的人道主义危机的迹象正在从这个已经饱受摧残的地区出现。

paras.en: Gezu*, 34, who fought with the Tigrayan forces in the 2020-22 war, lost many of his friends on the battlefield and was grateful to survive the deadly conflict. He was planning to start a family when he received a call from the TPLF authorities to join their armed group after the latest outbreak of hostilities.
paras.zh: 34 岁的 Gezu* 曾在 2020-22 年战争中与提格雷人部队并肩作战，他在战场上失去了许多朋友，他很庆幸自己能在这场致命的冲突中幸存下来。最近一次敌对行动爆发后，他正计划组建家庭，却接到了蒂格雷人阵当局的电话，要求他加入他们的武装组织。

paras.en: “I refused to join the war,” he said. “I responded to them to kill me rather than ever force me back to the horrors of the battlefield.
paras.zh: “我拒绝参加战争，”他说。 “我对他们的回应是杀了我，而不是强迫我回到战场的恐怖之中。

paras.en: “When they saw no one would join their army willingly, and people fleeing to the capital city, they started rounding up people from the streets. I didn’t want to leave my home town until things started getting worse.”
paras.zh: “当他们看到没有人愿意参军，人们逃往首都时，他们就开始在街上围捕人们。我不想离开我的家乡，直到事情开始变得更糟。”

paras.en: In the past few months, Tigrayans with the means to leave have been heading for the capital, Addis Ababa, fearing that war was coming. But on 23 September, Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to and from the Tigray region, stranding many people, after Tigrayan forces seized the airport in Mekelle, the capital of Tigray region.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，有能力离开的提格雷人一直前往首都亚的斯亚贝巴，担心战争即将来临。但9月23日，提格雷武装占领提格雷地区首府梅克莱机场后，埃塞俄比亚航空暂停了往返提格雷地区的航班，导致多人滞留。

paras.en: Solomon*, a 52-year-old man who was able to flee to Addis Ababa, said: “The main targets are those between the ages of 15 and 40. I have seen the armed group of the TPLF rounding up people as young as 15 and 16 at gunpoint from the streets and public transportation areas.
paras.zh: 逃到亚的斯亚贝巴的 52 岁男子所罗门 * 说：“主要目标是 15 岁至 40 岁之间的人。我看到 TPLF 武装团体在街道和公共交通区域用枪威胁围捕年仅 15 岁和 16 岁的人。

paras.en: “I know parents who tried to save their children by showing medical certificates. The officers don’t care whatever internal disease you have; they forcefully recruit anyone whose hands, eyes and feet work.”
paras.zh: “我认识一些父母，他们试图通过出示医疗证明来拯救自己的孩子。警察不在乎你有什么内科疾病；他们强行招募任何手、眼、脚能工作的人。”

paras.en: Ephrem, 40, is a father of three who, fearing conscription, was planning to leave the region weeks before the fresh fighting erupted. “Every time I go outside the house, my wife and the kids are anxious. The kids cry fearing that I will be rounded up from the street.
paras.zh: 40 岁的埃弗莱姆 (Ephrem) 是三个孩子的父亲，由于担心征兵，他计划在新的战斗爆发前几周离开该地区。 “每次我走出家门，我的妻子和孩子们都很焦虑。孩子们哭着担心我会在街上被围捕。

paras.en: “People who have money protect themselves and their children from the forced recruitment by bribing the officers. It is devastating; no one wants to join the war,” he said.
paras.zh: “有钱的人通过贿赂军官来保护自己和孩子免遭强行征兵。这是毁灭性的；没有人愿意参加战争，”他说。

paras.en: The Tigray region has been under siege for the past week, when citizens’ bank accounts were abruptly frozen by the federal government, leaving people unable to withdraw their money. The banks have since reopened with a daily withdrawal limit of 2,000 birr (£9) and with long queues forming outside.
paras.zh: 提格雷地区过去一周一直处于围困状态，公民的银行账户被联邦政府突然冻结，导致人们无法提取资金。此后，银行重新开业，每日取款限额为 2,000 比尔（9 英镑），外面排起了长队。

paras.en: Negus*, an elderly man in Mekelle, said: “We don’t know for how long the siege and the war are going to stay. A daily withdrawal limit of 2,000 birr can hardly afford to buy the skyrocketing food prices. It is impossible to leave this embattled region. There is no way for relatives outside to send medicine or cash. I am just hoping it all ends soon.”
paras.zh: 默克莱的一位老人内格斯*说：“我们不知道围困和战争会持续多久。每天2000比尔的提款限额很难买得起飞涨的食品价格。离开这个陷入困境的地区是不可能的。外面的亲戚没有办法送药品或现金。我只希望这一切尽快结束。”

paras.en: Internet and phone communications were also cut off on the orders of the TPLF until this week, leaving families desperate for news of relatives in the region.
paras.zh: 直至本周，根据TPLF的命令，互联网和电话通讯也被切断，这使得许多家庭迫切需要该地区亲人的消息。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Ethiopian government has been accused of carrying out indiscriminate drone airstrikes and there have been reports of attacks by the opposition forces coming close to Addis Ababa.
paras.zh: 与此同时，埃塞俄比亚政府被指控进行不分青红皂白的无人机空袭，有报道称反对派部队在亚的斯亚贝巴附近发动袭击。

paras.en: An estimated 300,000 to 800,000 civilians died during the Tigray conflict, according to the British government. The Ethiopian army, Eritrean forces and Amhara nationalist “fano” militias, have previously committed grave atrocities against the Tigrayan population that amount to war crimes and crimes against humanity, according to the UN International Commission of Human Rights Experts on Ethiopia. Tigrayan forces were also accused in an Amnesty report of committing atrocities during the war.
paras.zh: 据英国政府称，估计有 30 万至 80 万平民在提格雷冲突中死亡。据联合国埃塞俄比亚问题国际人权专家委员会称，埃塞俄比亚军队、厄立特里亚军队和阿姆哈拉民族主义“法诺”民兵此前曾对提格雷人民犯下严重暴行，构成战争罪和反人类罪。国际特赦组织的一份报告还指控提格雷军队在战争期间犯下暴行。

paras.en: * Names have been changed to protect their identities
paras.zh: * 姓名已更改以保护其身份

articles.title: Agreement to transition away from fossil fuels ‘not open for renegotiation’, Pacific leader tells pre-Cop
articles.author: Adam Morton in Funafuti, Tuvalu

paras.en: Pacific island leaders have urged a promised global transition away from fossil fuels must not be left open to renegotiation as they gather in tiny Tuvalu in a bid to build momentum before a major climate summit.
paras.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人聚集在小国图瓦卢，力求在重大气候峰会前积聚动力，敦促全球不要对放弃化石燃料的承诺进行重新谈判。

paras.en: About 50 dignitaries – 14 national heads including Australia’s prime minister, Anthony Albanese, a list of climate change ministers and the heads of global agencies – flew to the low-lying atoll nation in a bid to bring attention to the plight of the countries most at risk from the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 大约 50 名政要——包括澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞在内的 14 名国家元首、一系列气候变化部长和全球机构负责人——飞往这个地势低洼的环礁国家，以期引起人们对气候危机风险最大的国家困境的关注。

paras.en: As a showcase for the remote Pacific promised by Albanese, things could have gone more smoothly. Tuvalu was wet and grey, and the capital of Funafuti – spectacular from the air on a clear day – was visible only in strips between heavy rain clouds during descent.
paras.zh: 作为阿尔巴尼斯承诺的偏远太平洋的展示，事情本来可以进展得更顺利。图瓦卢天气潮湿，呈灰色，首都富纳富提在晴朗的日子里从空中俯瞰十分壮观，但在下降过程中只能在大雨云之间的条带中看到。

paras.en: The visit was promised by the Albanese government last year as part of a compromise deal when it missed out on hosting the Cop31 conference. The event will be in Turkey next month; the Pacific is hosting a preparatory meeting, mostly in Fiji.
paras.zh: 去年，阿尔巴尼亚政府在错过举办第 31 届缔约方会议时承诺进行这次访问，作为妥协协议的一部分。该活动将于下个月在土耳其举行；太平洋地区正在主办一次筹备会议，主要地点在斐济。

paras.en: Speaking at a “saultalaga” – an exchange of views around a meeting table – at the end of a three-hour visit, a string of leaders argued the world must stand behind a 2023 agreement, made at a UN summit in Dubai, to transition away from fossil fuels. More recently it has faced wavering support, with pushback particularly led by oil-producing nations.
paras.zh: 在三个小时的访问结束后，多位领导人在“saultalaga”（围绕会议桌交换意见）上发表讲话，认为世界必须支持在迪拜举行的联合国峰会上达成的 2023 年协议，以摆脱化石燃料。最近，它面临着摇摆不定的支持，尤其是产油国的抵制。

paras.en: Tuvalu is among a handful of countries most at risk from the climate crisis. A collection of three reef islands and six atolls, it is mostly less than 2 metres above sea level. About half its population of 10,600 live in a corner of Funafuti.
paras.zh: 图瓦卢是受气候危机影响最严重的少数国家之一。由三个礁岛和六个环礁组成，大部分海拔不到2米。 10,600 名人口中约有一半居住在富纳富提的一个角落。

paras.en: The visitors heard from Melelusi Sokotia, a 13-year-old local student. She said her friends dreamed of “becoming teachers, doctors, builders” but spent their lives wondering if their island would be safe to live on when they were adults. “We all have one single dream: to grow safely here in Tuvalu,” she said. “We are not asking for peace. We are asking for help and partnership. Please work together to protect small islands like ours.”
paras.zh: 游客们听到了当地 13 岁学生 Melelusi Sokotia 的讲述。她说，她的朋友们梦想着“成为教师、医生、建筑商”，但他们一生都在想，当他们成年后，他们的岛上生活是否安全。 “我们都有一个梦想：在图瓦卢安全成长，”她说。 “我们不是在寻求和平。我们是在寻求帮助和伙伴关系。请共同努力保护像我们这样的小岛屿。”

paras.en: The Fijian prime minister, Sitiveni Rabuka, said with the world on the brink of overshooting the goal of limiting global heating to 1.5C – agreed in the 2015 Paris agreement – and facing a super El Niño, it must bring forward plans to cut emissions. “That is not radical. It is in line with our agreement, our obligation, and the scientific reality,” he said. “The transition away from fossil fuels was agreed to by all of us in Dubai. It is not a new ask, and it is not open for renegotiation.”
paras.zh: 斐济总理西蒂维尼·拉布卡 (Sitiveni Rabuka) 表示，世界即将实现 2015 年《巴黎协定》中达成的将全球升温限制在 1.5 摄氏度的目标，并且面临超级厄尔尼诺现象，因此必须提出减排计划。 “这并不激进。它符合我们的协议、我们的义务和科学现实，”他说。 “迪拜所有人都同意放弃化石燃料。这不是一个新要求，也不会重新谈判。”

paras.en: Tuvalu’s prime minister, Feleti Teo, stressed island states needed faster access to global climate funding to deal with worsening extreme events. “Why should countries like Tuvalu take on more debt to protect ourselves from a climate crisis we did so little to cause? We should not have to borrow our way out of a crisis.”
paras.zh: 图瓦卢总理费莱蒂·特奥强调，岛国需要更快地获得全球气候资金，以应对日益恶化的极端事件。 “为什么像图瓦卢这样的国家要承担更多债务来保护自己免受我们几乎没有造成的气候危机的影响？我们不应该借债来摆脱危机。”

paras.en: The visit came less than a week after an Australian state regulator approved the latest of more than 30 fossil fuel developments to have been given the greenlight in the country in less than five years.
paras.zh: 不到一周前，澳大利亚国家监管机构批准了该国在不到五年的时间里批准的 30 多项化石燃料开发项目中的最新一项。

paras.en: Albanese, attending his first UN climate conference as prime minister since his election in 2022, said the message from the Tuvalu trip was that “climate change must be understood as being something more than about science or targets”.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞自 2022 年当选总理以来首次参加联合国气候会议，他表示图瓦卢之行传达的信息是“必须将气候变化理解为不仅仅是科学或目标”。

paras.en: “It must be understood that effectively it’s about people, is what it comes down to,” he said. “And the impact on humanity. The perspective of elders reminds us of what must be protected – the knowledge, the identity, the traditions and the culture pass from one generation to the next.”
paras.zh: “必须明白，归根结底，这实际上是关于人的，”他说。 “以及对人类的影响。长辈的观点提醒我们必须保护什么——知识、身份、传统和文化代代相传。”

paras.en: After being greeted by a cultural ceremony, the leaders were shown a land reclamation project to extend space for homes and infrastructure by about 20 hectares using sand and gravel dredged from the lagoon inside the atoll. Overseen by the UN Development Program and partly funded by the Australian government, the project is a race against time.
paras.zh: 在举行文化仪式后，领导人参观了一项土地开垦项目，该项目利用从环礁内泻湖中挖出的沙子和砾石，将住宅和基础设施的空间扩大了约 20 公顷。该项目由联合国开发计划署监督，并由澳大利亚政府提供部分资助，是一场与时间的赛跑。

paras.en: Tuvalu’s director of climate change, Jamie Ovia, said the flooding risk was worsening, with the likelihood of what was once a 100-year flood increasing as the sea level rose. Projected sea level rise this century could increase the annual economic damage from flooding and storm surges to US$34m a year by 2050 and $63m – more than Tuvalu’s GDP – by 2100.
paras.zh: 图瓦卢气候变化主管杰米·奥维亚表示，洪水风险正在恶化，随着海平面上升，一度百年一遇的洪水发生的可能性也随之增加。预计本世纪海平面上升可能会使洪水和风暴潮造成的年度经济损失增加至 2050 年的 3,400 万美元，到 2100 年将增加至 6,300 万美元，超过图瓦卢的 GDP。

paras.en: He said the coastal fishing catch could be cut by 16% and tuna stocks worth $4m a year to the local economy could be lost as the seas warmed and species moved away from the atoll nation.
paras.zh: 他表示，随着海洋变暖和物种远离这个环礁国家，沿海捕鱼量可能会减少 16%，每年为当地经济带来价值 400 万美元的金枪鱼种群可能会消失。

paras.en: “We need time to adapt,” Ovia said. “Tuvalu is doing our part. Will you act with Tuvalu and will you act in time?”
paras.zh: “我们需要时间适应，”奥维亚说。 “图瓦卢正在尽我们的一份力量。你会与图瓦卢一起行动吗？你会及时采取行动吗？”

articles.title: Australian consumer confidence plunges to worst level since 1990s after RBA rate rise
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Australian households are the most persistently pessimistic they have been since the early-1990s recession, after a fourth rate rise this year.
paras.zh: 在今年第四次加息之后，澳大利亚家庭正处于自 20 世纪 90 年代初经济衰退以来最持续的悲观情绪。

paras.en: Confidence among Australian consumers has plunged about 20% since the Reserve Bank of Australia lifted interest rates to the highest levels since 2011, according to the Westpac–Melbourne Institute consumer sentiment index.
paras.zh: 根据西太平洋银行-墨尔本研究所的消费者信心指数，自澳大利亚储备银行将利率提高至 2011 年以来的最高水平以来，澳大利亚消费者的信心下降了约 20%。

paras.en: The survey, conducted between 28 September and 1 October, showed the confidence index dropped by 4.7% to 80.4% in October – the worst level since the outbreak of the Middle East conflict in early April.
paras.zh: 这项于9月28日至10月1日进行的调查显示，10月份信心指数下降4.7%至80.4%，这是自4月初中东冲突爆发以来的最糟糕水平。

paras.en: But for respondents surveyed after the RBA call on 29 September, the index dropped to 67.2% – the lowest level since the late 1990s.
paras.zh: 但对于 9 月 29 日澳洲联储电话会议后接受调查的受访者来说，该指数降至 67.2%，这是 20 世纪 90 年代末以来的最低水平。

paras.en: That was broadly in line with the weekly ANZ-Roy Morgan consumer survey, which fell about 5% to 67.1 points.
paras.zh: 这与每周 ANZ-Roy Morgan 消费者调查结果大致一致，该调查下降了约 5%，至 67.1 点。

paras.en: Westpac’s head of Australian macro-forecasting, Matthew Hassan, said sentiment had been extremely weak for the longest period since the “disastrous” recession of the early 1990s.
paras.zh: 西太平洋银行（Westpac）澳大利亚宏观预测主管马修·哈桑（Matthew Hassan）表示，自 20 世纪 90 年代初“灾难性”经济衰退以来，市场情绪一直极度疲软。

paras.en: “Australian consumers remain stuck in a cost-of-living nightmare that seems to have no end in sight,” Hassan said.
paras.zh: 哈桑说：“澳大利亚消费者仍然陷入生活成本的噩梦，而且似乎没有结束的迹象。”

paras.en: “The latest RBA move looks to have badly rattled consumers. Responses over the course of the survey week show a very sharp deterioration after the decision was announced.”
paras.zh: “澳洲联储的最新举措似乎让消费者感到严重不安。调查周期间的反应显示，在决定宣布后，情况急剧恶化。”

paras.en: Assessments of family finances and buyer sentiment were the biggest categories affected.
paras.zh: 家庭财务评估和买家情绪是受影响最大的类别。

paras.en: Expectations about the economic outlook fell less sharply, but assessments about the economy in the next five years were back to lows not seen since August 2020, shortly after Melbourne’s second lockdown and before jobkeeper subsidies were expanded.
paras.zh: 对经济前景的预期下降幅度较小，但对未来五年经济的评估又回到了自 2020 年 8 月以来的最低水平，即墨尔本第二次封锁后不久、保工补贴扩大之前。

paras.en: AMP economist My Bui said the decline was unsurprising given the September rate hike and rising fuel prices.
paras.zh: AMP 经济学家 My Bui 表示，考虑到 9 月份加息和燃油价格上涨，这种下降并不令人意外。

paras.en: “On our calculation the weekly petrol bill for a typical Australian household has gone up by $20 versus the beginning of the year,” Bui said.
paras.zh: “根据我们的计算，典型澳大利亚家庭每周的汽油费用比年初上涨了 20 美元，”Bui 说。

paras.en: “The worry with declining confidence is that it tends to correlate with household spending on a per capita basis: the downtrend in confidence over the past 12 months suggests consumption per person will likely fall further into contraction this year.”
paras.zh: “信心下降的担忧在于，它往往与人均家庭支出相关：过去 12 个月的信心下降趋势表明，今年人均消费可能会进一步萎缩。”

paras.en: Mortgage holders were the most pessimistic home ownership subgroup given rising borrowing costs at 77 index points.
paras.zh: 鉴于借贷成本上升 77 个点，抵押贷款持有人是最悲观的住房拥有者群体。

paras.en: Those who own their home outright experienced the largest decline in sentiment in the month, as the housing market downturn extended for a sixth month.
paras.zh: 随着房地产市场低迷持续第六个月，那些直接拥有房屋的人在本月经历了最大的情绪下降。

paras.en: Renters were the most optimistic, unchanged at 84.8 points.
paras.zh: 租房者最为乐观，维持在 84.8 分不变。

paras.en: Hassan said fears of job losses were rising, with unemployment expectations ticking up 1.9% higher. But there are still signs the labour market is holding strong.
paras.zh: 哈桑表示，对失业的担忧正在加剧，失业率预期上升 1.9%。但仍有迹象表明劳动力市场保持强劲。

paras.en: Citi analysts Josh Williamson and Faraz Syed said “job vacancies have increased to a two-year high of 122 points, which accords with business sentiment expectations of positive employment growth”.
paras.zh: 花旗分析师Josh Williamson和Faraz Syed表示，“职位空缺已增至两年高点122点，这符合企业对就业积极增长的信心预期”。

articles.title: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway

paras.en: Yemeni pro-government forces backed by Saudi Arabia say they have "secured" the Bab al-Mandab Strait at the southern end of the Red Sea, at the start of a major offensive against the Iran-backed Houthi movement.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯支持的也门亲政府部队表示，在对伊朗支持的胡塞运动发起大规模进攻之际，他们已经“保卫”了红海南端的曼德海峡。

paras.en: The Yemeni military also said in a statement that National Shield, Giants Brigades and Tihama Resistance forces had captured the Red Sea city of Mokha on Monday afternoon with the help of Saudi air strikes.
paras.zh: 也门军方还在一份声明中表示，国家盾牌、巨人旅和蒂哈马抵抗力量周一下午在沙特空袭的帮助下占领了红海城市莫卡。

paras.en: But in conflicting reports, unnamed Yemeni government and military sources told news agencies Reuters and AFP that the forces have only reached the city's outskirts.
paras.zh: 但在相互矛盾的报道中，未透露姓名的也门政府和军方消息人士告诉路透社和法新社，部队仅到达该市郊区。

paras.en: The Houthis said they had struck Riyadh's international airport and other sites, but did not comment regarding Mokha.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们袭击了利雅得国际机场和其他地点，但没有对莫卡发表评论。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia condemned the attacks and reiterated calls for the UN Security Council's permanent members to support Yemen's government.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯谴责袭击事件，并再次呼吁联合国安理会常任理事国支持也门政府。

paras.en: Four government sources told Reuters that Yemeni forces had reached the outskirts of Mokha late on Monday, and that Houthi fighters were now retreating.
paras.zh: 四名政府消息人士告诉路透社，也门军队已于周一晚间抵达莫卡郊区，胡塞武装目前正在撤退。

paras.en: Government military sources who spoke to AFP would not confirm the capture of the city, but said "our forces took control of the Dhubab military airfield and cut the road linking the Dhubab district to the Bab al-Mandab area".
paras.zh: 接受法新社采访的政府军方消息人士不愿证实该市被占领，但表示“我们的部队控制了杜巴布军用机场，并切断了连接杜巴布地区和曼德卜地区的道路”。

paras.en: Earlier, the Yemeni military also said its forces had seized Dhubab airport, 45km (27 miles) to the south, and were besieging Houthi fighters inside the nearby town.
paras.zh: 早些时候，也门军方还表示，其部队占领了以南 45 公里（27 英里）处的杜巴布机场，并围攻附近城镇内的胡塞武装分子。

paras.en: Houthi-run media denied reports that government forces had also made advances in Dhubab.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装媒体否认了有关政府军也在杜巴布取得进展的报道。

paras.en: The government said operations had also begun on other fronts on Monday, including the capital Sanaa, which fell to the Houthis at the start of the civil war 12 years ago.
paras.zh: 政府表示，周一其他战线也开始行动，其中包括12年前内战爆发时落入胡塞武装手中的首都萨那。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a Saudi-led military coalition said its fighter jets were providing "round-the-clock" air support to the pro-government forces and had destroyed 324 "high-value" targets since the start of the offensive.
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特领导的军事联盟表示，其战斗机正在向亲政府部队提供“全天候”空中支援，自进攻开始以来已摧毁了 324 个“高价值”目标。

paras.en: Turkey and Pakistan, allies of Saudi Arabia, held an emergency meeting in Riyadh on Monday and agreed to rapidly deploy military forces in Saudi Arabia in an invocation of their Mecca defence pact, according to a joint statement shared by Pakistan's foreign ministry.
paras.zh: 根据巴基斯坦外交部分享的联合声明，沙特阿拉伯的盟友土耳其和巴基斯坦周一在利雅得举行紧急会议，同意援引其麦加防御协议，在沙特阿拉伯迅速部署军队。

paras.en: Saudi air strikes killed a schoolgirl and a woman in the Sanhan and Saawan districts of Sanaa on Monday, according to Houthi-run Al Masirah TV.
paras.zh: 据胡塞武装运营的 Al Masirah 电视台报道，沙特的空袭周一在萨那的 Sanhan 和 Saawan 地区造成一名女学生和一名妇女死亡。

paras.en: Houthi spokesman Mohammed Abdul Salam said Saudi Arabia was committing "dozens of massacres" and that it must "bear all the consequences".
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人穆罕默德·阿卜杜勒·萨拉姆表示，沙特阿拉伯正在实施“数十起屠杀”，必须“承担一切后果”。

paras.en: The Houthi-run Humanitarian Operations Co-ordination Centre warned civilian airlines that Saudi airspace, except for the skies above the Islamic holy cities of Mecca and Medina, was no longer safe because it had become "a theatre of operations".
paras.zh: 胡塞武装管理的人道主义行动协调中心警告民用航空公司，除了伊斯兰圣城麦加和麦地那上空外，沙特领空已不再安全，因为它已成为“行动战场”。

paras.en: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres condemned "the continued Houthi cross-border attacks" on Saudi Arabia and said he was "deeply concerned by the sharp escalation in fighting", in a statement to AFP.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在给法新社的一份声明中谴责胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的“持续跨境袭击”，并表示他“对战斗急剧升级深感担忧”。

paras.en: On Sunday, the head of Yemen's internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council announced the beginning of an offensive, dubbed Operation Yemen Dawn, aimed at retaking all territory held by the Houthis.
paras.zh: 周日，国际公认的也门总统领导委员会主席宣布开始发动名为“也门黎明行动”的攻势，旨在夺回胡塞武装控制的所有领土。

paras.en: Rashad al-Alimi insisted that all opportunities for de-escalation had been exhausted and called on all forces to carry out their assigned missions "until the country is liberated from the grip of the Houthi terrorist militia".
paras.zh: 拉沙德·阿里米坚称，所有缓和局势的机会都已用尽，并呼吁所有部队执行指定的任务，“直到该国摆脱胡塞恐怖民兵的控制”。

paras.en: It came after the Houthis reportedly cut a mountain road near the south-western city of Taiz, effectively leaving government forces and residents there surrounded.
paras.zh: 据报道，胡塞武装在西南部城市塔伊兹附近切断了一条山路，实际上使政府军和当地居民被包围。

paras.en: The Houthis also said they had launched ballistic missiles and drones at oil facilities belonging to Saudi Aramco in Riyadh and the Khurais area of Saudi Arabia in retaliation for dozens of Saudi strikes on their territory.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装还表示，他们向沙特阿美公司位于利雅得和沙特阿拉伯胡赖斯地区的石油设施发射了弹道导弹和无人机，以报复沙特对其领土发动的数十次袭击。

paras.en: In addition to the strikes on Riyadh's international airport, the Houthis attacked an Aramco oil refinery, and Abha airport, as well as other sites, according to Yemen's Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree in a statement on Telegram.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨里在 Telegram 上发表声明称，除了袭击利雅得国际机场外，胡塞武装还袭击了沙特阿美炼油厂、艾卜哈机场以及其他地点。

paras.en: According to BBC Verify, satellite imagery from Saturday shows thick, dark smoke coming from the site of a strike at the Aramco Riyadh Refinery, in the city's south-east.
paras.zh: 据 BBC verify 报道，周六的卫星图像显示，位于该市东南部的沙特阿美利雅得炼油厂罢工现场冒出浓浓的黑烟。

paras.en: A similar plume of smoke can be seen rising from the Khurais Central Processing Facility as well as from a potential strike point in satellite imagery from Sunday.
paras.zh: 从周日起，从库赖斯中央处理设施以及卫星图像中的潜在袭击点都可以看到类似的烟雾。

paras.en: Yemen has been devastated by a civil war that began in 2014, when the Houthis ousted the government from Sanaa. The conflict escalated in 2015, after a Saudi-led coalition of Arab states intervened in an attempt to restore the government's rule.
paras.zh: 2014 年胡塞武装将政府从萨那赶下台后，也门爆发了内战，导致也门遭受重创。 2015年，沙特领导的阿拉伯国家联盟介入并试图恢复政府统治后，冲突升级。

paras.en: A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 7月，胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施“海上禁运”，并开始对沙特机场、石油设施和红海油轮进行导弹和无人机袭击，长达四年的非正式停火开始瓦解。

paras.en: The Houthis said they were retaliating for a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们是为了报复沙特封锁其领土上的港口和机场，以及对萨那机场的空袭，他们将其归咎于沙特。

paras.en: Last month, the Houthis launched a surprise offensive along Yemen's south-western Red Sea coast and quickly ousted pro-government forces from areas overlooking the Bab al-Mandab Strait, including Mokha, Dhubab and Perim (Mayyun) Island.
paras.zh: 上个月，胡塞武装沿也门红海西南部海岸发起突然攻势，并迅速将亲政府军从俯瞰曼德海峡的地区驱逐，包括莫卡岛、杜巴布岛和佩里姆岛。

paras.en: They said they posed no threat to international shipping passing through the waterway but that they would continue to target vessels from Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 他们表示，他们对通过该水道的国际航运没有构成威胁，但他们将继续针对来自沙特阿拉伯的船只。

paras.en: However, the seizure of the strait contributed to a surge in global oil prices because Saudi Arabia had been relying on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war with Iran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 然而，占领该海峡导致全球油价飙升，因为自美国和以色列与伊朗的战争有效关闭了海湾的霍尔木兹海峡以来，沙特阿拉伯一直依赖红海进行石油出口。

paras.en: At least 959 people have been killed and 5,000 injured in the fighting in Yemen since 6 August, according to the government's health ministry.
paras.zh: 据政府卫生部称，自 8 月 6 日以来也门的战斗已造成至少 959 人死亡、5,000 人受伤。

paras.en: The UN says another 197,000 people have been displaced.
paras.zh: 联合国称另有 197,000 人流离失所。

articles.title: Watch: Moment Indonesian shoe shop is torn apart by explosion

paras.en: Watch: Moment Indonesian shoe shop is torn apart by explosion
paras.zh: 观看：印度尼西亚鞋店被爆炸撕裂的瞬间

paras.en: CCTV has captured the moment a sneaker shop was torn apart by an explosion in the San Antonio area of Surabaya, Indonesian authorities have confirmed.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚当局证实，闭路电视捕捉到了泗水圣安东尼奥地区一家运动鞋店被爆炸摧毁的瞬间。

paras.en: Police have said five people have been hospitalised following the incident that was âstrongly suspectedâ to be the result of a gas leak, and no suspicious substances or explosives have been found at the site.
paras.zh: 警方表示，事件发生后，已有五人被送往医院，“强烈怀疑”是煤气泄漏造成的，现场没有发现可疑物质或爆炸物。

paras.en: They added that at least 41 buildings had been damaged by the explosion.
paras.zh: 他们补充说，至少有 41 座建筑物在爆炸中受损。

articles.title: OpenAI admits response to Australian government hacks 'not good enough'

paras.en: OpenAI has admitted its actions were "not good enough" after one of its rogue agents breached Australian government websites in June and said it had added more precautions to its training environments.
paras.zh: OpenAI 承认，在其一名流氓特工于 6 月入侵澳大利亚政府网站后，其行动“不够好”，并表示已对其培训环境增加了更多预防措施。

paras.en: The company's chief strategy officer Jason Kwon faced a parliamentary hearing into AI on Tuesday in Sydney, saying the breach "should not have happened" and it "should have handled our response better". It took weeks before Australia was notified via an email to a generic inbox.
paras.zh: 该公司首席战略官杰森·权（Jason Kwon）周二在悉尼接受了关于人工智能的议会听证会，他表示此次违规行为“不应该发生”，并且“应该更好地处理我们的应对措施”。澳大利亚花了数周时间才通过通用收件箱收到电子邮件通知。

paras.en: "We are sorry and we know we have work to do to rebuild trust with the Australian people," Kwon said.
paras.zh: 权说：“我们很抱歉，我们知道我们需要努力重建与澳大利亚人民的信任。”

paras.en: Anthropic also appeared and said it had not found any cases of Australian breaches during a recent investigation.
paras.zh: Anthropic 也出现了，并表示在最近的调查中没有发现任何澳大利亚违规案例。

paras.en: An OpenAI agent went "rogue" and "infiltrated" a private statistics portal containing "non-sensitive" data from Australia's universal healthcare scheme Medicare in June in what cyber-security experts said was the first hack of its kind.
paras.zh: 6 月份，一名 OpenAI 代理“作恶”并“渗透”了一个私人统计门户网站，其中包含来自澳大利亚全民医疗保健计划 Medicare 的“非敏感”数据，网络安全专家称这是此类黑客行为中的首次。

paras.en: Asked why OpenAI had not directly contacted government ministers immediately after it found out about the breaches, Kwon acknowledged it was a mistake.
paras.zh: 当被问及为什么 OpenAI 在发现违规行为后没有立即直接联系政府部长时，Kwon 承认这是一个错误。

paras.en: "In retrospect, we should have done what you're suggesting," Kwon said, in response to a question by the committee on why it had not dialled the mobile numbers of government ministers.
paras.zh: “回想起来，我们应该按照你的建议去做，”权在回答委员会关于为什么没有拨打政府部长的手机号码的问题时说。

paras.en: "The reason why it happened the way that it did is I think people were thinking about this as a technical situation and they wanted to contact the technical counterparties but it's not good enough."
paras.zh: “之所以会出现这样的情况，是因为我认为人们将其视为一种技术情况，他们想联系技术对手，但这还不够好。”

paras.en: Kwon said the company has changed how it handles such incidents.
paras.zh: 权表示，该公司已经改变了处理此类事件的方式。

paras.en: "Even if we don't fully understand the situation, we are just going to notify and start working through the situation collaboratively with the impacted party."
paras.zh: “即使我们不完全了解情况，我们也会通知并开始与受影响方合作解决该情况。”

paras.en: OpenAI has also added "more precautions" to its training environments since the incidents, Kwon told the 12-member committee which is made up of Labor, Liberal and independent MPs and senators who are looking at AI and its impact on Australia.
paras.zh: Kwon 告诉这个由 12 名成员组成的委员会，自事件发生以来，OpenAI 还对其培训环境增加了“更多预防措施”。该委员会由工党、自由党和独立议员以及参议员组成，他们正在研究人工智能及其对澳大利亚的影响。

paras.en: The company was also establishing a local taskforce in Australia to investigate "how to better manage the risks associated with increasingly capable AI".
paras.zh: 该公司还在澳大利亚建立了一个当地工作组，以调查“如何更好地管理与日益强大的人工智能相关的风险”。

paras.en: Kwon told the committee that training models were now monitored in real time during tests, and an alarm was triggered if they interact with the internet in a way they were not meant to.
paras.zh: Kwon 告诉委员会，现在在测试期间会实时监控训练模型，如果它们以不符合预期的方式与互联网交互，就会触发警报。

paras.en: This meant that it had been able to alert the New South Wales government to another hack last week within 48 hours.
paras.zh: 这意味着它能够在 48 小时内就上周另一起黑客攻击事件向新南威尔士州政府发出警报。

paras.en: The company would also support a framework on mandatory disclosure of incidents, Kwon said, as it would set out "clear expectations".
paras.zh: 权表示，该公司还将支持强制披露事件的框架，因为它将提出“明确的期望”。

paras.en: "We were trying to come up with a standard to apply to our voluntary actionsâ¦ based on our learned experience here, we should have been probably talking to more people about how to do that well."
paras.zh: “我们试图制定一个适用于我们自愿行动的标准……根据我们在这里学到的经验，我们可能应该与更多的人讨论如何做好这一点。”

paras.en: Anthropic's head of safeguards Dave Orr said in the wake of OpenAI agents hacking tech platform Hugging Face in July, it had reviewed "hundreds of millions of transcripts" to detect any potential breaches of Australian government websites similar to OpenAI.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的安全保障负责人戴夫·奥尔 (Dave Orr) 表示，在 OpenAI 特工于 7 月份黑客攻击技术平台 Hugging Face 后，该公司已审查了“数亿份记录”，以检测任何与 OpenAI 类似的澳大利亚政府网站的潜在违规行为。

paras.en: "We haven't found anything like this and we have looked," he told the committee.
paras.zh: “我们还没有发现类似的东西，我们已经看过了，”他告诉委员会。

paras.en: The public hearings, which will continue until Friday, also heard evidence from arts and media organisations about copyright and their concerns on how AI models use their materials.
paras.zh: 公开听证会将持续到周五，还听取了艺术和媒体组织关于版权的证据以及他们对人工智能模型如何使用其材料的担忧。

paras.en: An opt-out model - where the onus would be on the artist to ask AI not to use their material for training purposes - was flawed and could means artists do not get paid for their content, the committee heard.
paras.zh: 委员会获悉，选择退出模式——艺术家有责任要求人工智能不要将他们的材料用于培训目的——是有缺陷的，可能意味着艺术家不会因其内容而获得报酬。

paras.en: "In other words, Australia's artists will be the roadkill in the rush to this AI deal," said Annabelle Herd, chief executive of the Australian Recording Industry Association.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚唱片工业协会首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示：“换句话说，澳大利亚的艺术家将成为匆忙达成这项人工智能协议的路上的牺牲品。”

articles.title: All the Guests at Shakira’s Madrid Residency (Updating)
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: Since Shakira kicked off her residency in Madrid, each new date has brought the anticipation of discovering who might join her on stage. The 12-concert series began on Sept. 18 and runs through Oct. 11 as part of the Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour.
paras.zh: 自从夏奇拉在马德里开始她的驻地演出以来，每一次新的约会都会让人期待谁会和她一起登台。作为 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡回演唱会的一部分，这个由 12 场音乐会组成的系列从 9 月 18 日开始，一直持续到 10 月 11 日。

paras.en: For the first two nights, there were no guest appearances, but they weren’t needed to maintain the energy during the two-hour show. Songs like “Girl Like Me,” “Te Felicito,” “TQG,” “Soltera” and “Hips Don’t Lie” kept the stadium singing at full volume — along with “Te Dejo Madrid,” a new addition to the setlist compared to previous stops on the tour. As the residency progressed, the first guest appearances began to roll in — some completely unexpected, others hinted at by Shakira herself through clues on her social media.
paras.zh: 前两晚没有客串，但也不需要他们在两个小时的演出中保持精力。像“Girl Like Me”、“Te Felicito”、“TQG”、“Soltera”和“Hips Don't Lie”这样的歌曲让体育场的歌声保持在最大音量，还有“Te Dejo Madrid”，与巡演之前的几站相比，这是新加入的歌曲。随着驻场的进展，第一批客串开始出现——有些完全出乎意料，有些是夏奇拉本人通过社交媒体上的线索暗示的。

paras.en: The Colombian superstar has been drawing around 55,000 people per night to Estadio Shakira, a temporary venue built specifically for these 12 shows at Iberdrola Music. Back in January, Billboard announced that Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour had set a Guinness World Record as the highest-grossing tour of all time by a Hispanic artist, with $421.6 million earned and 3.3 million tickets sold across 86 shows, according to figures reported to Billboard Boxscore.
paras.zh: 这位哥伦比亚巨星每晚都会吸引约 55,000 人前往 Estadio Shakira，这是一个专门为 Iberdrola Music 的这 12 场演出而建造的临时场地。 Billboard Boxscore 的数据显示，早在 1 月份，Billboard 就宣布 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡回演唱会创下了吉尼斯世界纪录，成为西班牙裔艺人有史以来票房最高的巡回演唱会，共 86 场演出，收入 4.216 亿美元，售出 330 万张门票。

paras.en: Midway through the residency, Shakira shared her thoughts on Instagram about the experience so far: “We’re halfway through our residency! 6 concerts in total, and each one has had an incredible energy. It’s impossible to say which of the 6 has been the best; they’ve all been absolutely spectacular. Thank you, Madrid, for being with me!” the global superstar wrote.
paras.zh: 驻场进行到一半时，夏奇拉在 Instagram 上分享了她对迄今为止这段经历的看法：“我们的驻场已经过半了！总共 6 场音乐会，每一场都充满了令人难以置信的能量。很难说 6 场音乐会中哪一场是最好的；它们都非常壮观。谢谢马德里和我在一起！”这位全球巨星写道。

paras.en: Below, see our updating list of all the artists who have joined Shakira on stage during her European residency in Madrid.
paras.zh: 下面是我们更新的所有在夏奇拉欧洲驻地马德里演出期间与夏奇拉一起登上舞台的艺术家名单。

paras.en: - Sept. 20: Laura Pausini The first guest arrived during the third show of the residency, when Laura Pausini made a surprise appearance to sing “Antología” alongside Shakira. The Italian singer had previously covered the Pies Descalzos (1995) classic on her album Yo Canto 2 (2026), but this time she was able to perform it with Shakira, creating one of the most moving moments of the night. “I don’t know if it showed on the big screen, but her eyes were filled with tears,” Pausini said before joking about the title of the Colombian singer’s latest album. “The album is Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran (Women Don’t Cry Anymore), but tonight there’s one woman who’s going to cry tears of happiness, and that’s me.” The two ended the performance in an embrace.
paras.zh: - 9月20日：劳拉·保西尼 (Laura Pausini) 第一位嘉宾在驻场项目的第三场演出中抵达，劳拉·保西尼 (Laura Pausini) 惊喜现身，与夏奇拉 (Shakira) 一起演唱《Antología》。这位意大利歌手此前曾在她的专辑《Yo Canto 2》（2026）中翻唱过《Pies Descalzos》（1995）经典歌曲，但这次她能够与夏奇拉一起表演，创造了当晚最动人的时刻之一。 “我不知道它是否出现在大屏幕上，但她的眼睛里充满了泪水，”保西尼在开玩笑地谈论这位哥伦比亚歌手最新专辑的标题之前说道。 “这张专辑是 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran（女人不再哭泣），但今晚有一个女人会流下幸福的眼泪，那就是我。”两人在拥抱中结束了演出。

paras.en: - Sept. 25: Triplets Ghetto Kids The Triplets Ghetto Kids also joined the residency during “Dai Dai,” the official song of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The collective of young Ugandan dancers reunited with Shakira after having shared the stage with her during the World Cup final performance. On Oct. 3, they returned to accompany her during the song.
paras.zh: - 9 月 25 日：Triplets Ghetto Kids Triplets Ghetto Kids 也加入了 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯官方歌曲《Dai Dai》的驻场演出。乌干达年轻舞者团体在世界杯决赛表演期间与夏奇拉同台演出后，与夏奇拉重聚。 10月3日，他们回来为她伴奏。

paras.en: - Sept. 25 & 26: Alejandro Sanz One of the most anticipated reunions happened with Alejandro Sanz, who joined Shakira for two consecutive nights. On Sept. 25, they performed “La Tortura” together once again, the hit collaboration they released more than two decades ago, in 2005. Sanz returned to the stage the following night, and this time they added his hit “Corazón Partío,” which they performed together for the first time. “Alejandro, I love you!” Shakira shouted as she bid him farewell after the first night, while Sanz later summarized the reunion on his social media: “Two nights with you, and my ‘corazón partío’ (broken heart) feels fuller than ever.” Watch the moment here.
paras.zh: - 9 月 25 日和 26 日：亚历杭德罗·桑斯 (Alejandro Sanz) 最令人期待的重聚之一发生在亚历杭德罗·桑斯 (Alejandro Sanz) 身上，他连续两晚与夏奇拉 (Shakira) 在一起。 9月25日，他们再次一起表演了《La Tortura》，这是他们二十多年前（2005年）发行的热门合作歌曲。第二天晚上，桑斯回到舞台，这次他们添加了他的热门歌曲《Corazón Partío》，这是他们第一次一起表演。 “亚历杭德罗，我爱你！”第一晚结束后，夏奇拉在向他告别时大声喊道，而桑斯后来在社交媒体上总结了这次团聚：“和你在一起的两个晚上，我的‘corazónpartío’（破碎的心）感觉比以往任何时候都更加充实。”在这里观看这一刻。

paras.en: - Sept. 27: Manuel Turizo The guest for the sixth night of the residency was Manuel Turizo, whose appearance Shakira had teased on social media the day before. The two Colombians teamed up to perform their 2023 collaboration “Copa Vacía” live for the first time. Watch them here.
paras.zh: - 9 月 27 日：Manuel Turizo 驻场第六晚的嘉宾是 Manuel Turizo，前一天夏奇拉在社交媒体上调侃了他的出现。两位哥伦比亚人首次联手现场表演了 2023 年合作的“Copa Vacía”。在这里观察他们。

paras.en: - Oct. 3: Dua Lipa When it seemed like the guest list had already delivered plenty of unforgettable moments, Dua Lipa’s appearance became one of the biggest surprises of the residency. Shakira invited her to sing “Antología,” and the two shared the stage for the first time. “For me, it’s an honor and a privilege to sing this song, which means so much to me, with this woman who is so admired and loved around the world,” Shakira said before welcoming the British star. “Today, I officially declare myself your fan.” After their performance, as the two embraced, the Colombian singer-songwriter once again expressed her excitement. “Oh my, oh my, what this tour was missing,” she said. Dua Lipa had previously performed “Antología” in November 2025 during her show in Bogota as part of her Radical Optimism Tour. This time, she had the chance to sing it alongside Shakira, and after the concert, she shared her excitement via Instagram. “I felt that you, me, and the audience were one. Very grateful to take home such a beautiful memory!!!” she wrote in Spanish.
paras.zh: - 10月3日：Dua Lipa 当嘉宾名单似乎已经带来了很多难忘的时刻时，Dua Lipa的出现成为了驻场最大的惊喜之一。夏奇拉邀请她演唱《Antología》，两人首次同台演出。夏奇拉在欢迎这位英国明星之前说道：“对我来说，能和这位在全世界都受到钦佩和喜爱的女人一起演唱这首歌是一种荣幸，这对我来说意义重大。” “今天，我正式宣布自己是你的粉丝。”演出结束后，当两人拥抱时，这位哥伦比亚创作型歌手再次表达了她的兴奋之情。 “天哪，天哪，这次旅行缺少了什么，”她说。 Dua Lipa 此前曾于 2025 年 11 月在波哥大演出期间表演过《Antología》，这是她激进乐观巡演的一部分。这次，她有机会与夏奇拉一起演唱这首歌，演唱会结束后，她通过Instagram分享了她的兴奋之情。 “我觉得你、我、观众是一体的。非常感谢能把这么美好的回忆带回家！！！”她用西班牙语写的。

articles.title: Shakira’s Madrid Concert Sets an Amazon Music Livestreaming Record
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Shakira‘s Oct. 3 Madrid concert has made history as the most-viewed livestream performance by a female artist on Amazon Music to date.
paras.zh: 夏奇拉 10 月 3 日的马德里演唱会创造了历史，成为亚马逊音乐上迄今为止观看次数最多的女艺人现场直播表演。

paras.en: The streaming service shared the news via press release on Sunday (Oct. 4), the day after the Colombian superstar’s performance was broadcast live. The show was part of Shakira’s 12-date residency in Spain’s capital at Shakira Stadium on her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour.
paras.zh: 周日（10 月 4 日），也就是这位哥伦比亚巨星现场直播表演的第二天，该流媒体服务通过新闻稿分享了这一消息。这场演出是夏奇拉在西班牙首都夏奇拉体育场进行 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran 世界巡演 12 场演出的一部分。

paras.en: Beyond Shakira’s anticipated set full of hits spanning three decades of her career in Latin music, the Oct. 3 concert included a very special surprise: Dua Lipa appeared onstage with the star to perform an acoustic “Antología,” from Shakira’s 1997 Pies Descalzos album — an intimate moment that Shak gushed was “what this tour was missing.”
paras.zh: 除了夏奇拉在拉丁音乐生涯三十年里所期待的一系列热门歌曲之外，10 月 3 日的音乐会还带来了一个非常特别的惊喜：杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa) 与这位明星一起出现在舞台上，表演了夏奇拉 1997 年 Pies Descalzos 专辑中的原声歌曲《Antología》——夏奇滔滔不绝地说，这是“这次巡演所缺少的”亲密时刻。

paras.en: “For me, it’s an honor and a privilege to sing this song, which means so much to me, with this woman who is so admired and loved around the world,” Shakira said while introducing Dua Lipa to the crowd of more than 50,000 fans in front of them, plus those at home catching their duet via livestream, which viewers were able to watch via Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch.
paras.zh: “对我来说，与这位在全世界都受到钦佩和喜爱的女性一起演唱这首歌对我来说意义重大，”夏奇拉在向面前的 50,000 多名歌迷以及那些在家里通过直播观看二重唱的观众介绍 Dua Lipa 时说道，观众可以通过 Amazon Music、Prime Video 和 Twitch 观看这首歌。

paras.en: Post-show, Dua Lipa shared her excitement on Instagram, writing in Spanish, “I felt that you, me, and the audience were one. Very grateful to take home such a beautiful memory!!!”
paras.zh: 演出结束后，杜阿·利帕在 Instagram 上分享了她的兴奋之情，用西班牙语写道：“我觉得你、我和观众是一体的。非常感谢能把如此美好的回忆带回家！！！”

paras.en: Shakira Stadium was built as a temporary venue within Madrid’s Iberdrola Music complex specifically for the star’s concert residency in the city, which opened on Sept. 18 and wraps with a 12th date on Oct. 11.
paras.zh: 夏奇拉体育场是马德里 Iberdrola 音乐中心内的一个临时场地，专门用于这位明星在该市的驻场音乐会，该体育场于 9 月 18 日开幕，并于 10 月 11 日结束第 12 场演出。

paras.en: Amazon Music’s livestream of Saturday night’s Shakira concert led the streamer’s 2026 Women Shaping Latin Music campaign, celebrating the artists, sounds and cultural movements shaping Latin music.
paras.zh: 亚马逊音乐周六晚上的夏奇拉音乐会直播引领了该流媒体的 2026 年女性塑造拉丁音乐活动，庆祝塑造拉丁音乐的艺术家、声音和文化运动。

articles.title: Fans Choose Victoria Monét’s ‘Frequency of Love’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Frequency of Love, the new album from Victoria Monét, tops this week’s new music poll.
paras.zh: 维多利亚·莫奈 (Victoria Monet) 的新专辑《爱的频率》(Frequency of Love) 在本周的新音乐民意调查中名列前茅。

paras.en: Listeners voted in a poll published Friday (Oct. 2) on Billboard, choosing Monét’s sophomore full-length LP as their favorite new music.
paras.zh: 周五（10 月 2 日）在 Billboard 上发布的一项民意调查中，听众进行了投票，选择莫奈的第二张全长 LP 作为他们最喜欢的新音乐。

paras.en: The album topped new Friday music releases from Noah Kahan, Miranda Lambert, Drake and more. By the poll’s closing time on Sunday, Monét pulled in 40% of the vote.
paras.zh: 这张专辑在诺亚·卡汉、米兰达·兰伯特、德雷克等人的周五新音乐发行中名列前茅。截至周日投票结束时，莫奈获得了 40% 的选票。

paras.en: Fans first got a taste of Frequency of Love, Monét’s follow-up to Jaguar II, through three early singles, “Let Me,” “Reach Out” and “Juicy.” The 22-track collection officially arrived on Oct. 2.
paras.zh: 歌迷们首先通过三首早期单曲《Let Me》、《Reach Out》和《Juicy》领略了莫奈继《Jaguar II》之后的《Frequency of Love》。该专辑包含 22 首曲目，于 10 月 2 日正式上市。

paras.en: The album has a number of intriguing features, including one from her own daughter — who got a special shout-out from the singer on social media this weekend for her contribution to the song “You Mean the World to Me”: “Thank you for your patience and understanding and unconditional love while mommy was in school, while I made this album, every time I had to step out of the door without you and when work didn’t end once I got back home!” Monét wrote to 5-year-old Hazel on Saturday. “I am so honored to have you as a feature on this album (you sound soooo beautiful) and I am so proud of your growth in every way, your natural empathy, your humor, your respect, the way you love and your undeniable talent! Forevemore, it’s you and me baby.”
paras.zh: 这张专辑有许多有趣的特点，其中包括她自己女儿的一个特点——这个周末，她在社交媒体上特别感谢了她对歌曲“You Mean the World to Me”的贡献：“感谢您在妈妈上学时的耐心、理解和无条件的爱，当我制作这张专辑时，每次我不得不在没有您的情况下走出家门，当我回到家后工作还没有结束时！”周六，莫奈给 5 岁的黑兹尔写了一封信。 “我很荣幸你能成为这张专辑的主角（你听起来太美了），我为你在各方面的成长、你天生的同理心、你的幽默、你的尊重、你爱的方式和你不可否认的才华感到骄傲！永远，这是你和我的宝贝。”

paras.en: “You Mean the World to Me” also features Leon Thomas. Also on Monét’s new album: Lucky Daye, SZA, Bryson Tiller, Chlöe and Bruno Mars, whose Romantic Tour recently had Monet booked as a supporting act.
paras.zh: 莱昂·托马斯还出演了《你对我来说意味着整个世界》。莫奈的新专辑中还有 Lucky Daye、SZA、Bryson Tiller、Chlöe 和布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars)，他们的浪漫巡演最近为莫奈预订了配角。

paras.en: Following her spot as an opener on the road with Bruno Mars, she’s embarking on her own headlining Frequency of Love Tour this month, starting Oct. 27 in Raleigh, N.C., and running through mid-December.
paras.zh: 继与布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars) 一起作为开场嘉宾之后，她本月将开始自己的头条新闻“Frequency of Love”巡演，从 10 月 27 日在北卡罗来纳州罗利开始，一直持续到 12 月中旬。

paras.en: Trailing behind Frequency of Love on the poll are Noah Kahan’s new single “Draw You Out,” with 29% of the vote, Miranda Lambert’s Crisco album, with nearly 7% of the vote, and Drake’s HABIBTI (FOMO) deluxe release, with almost 6% of the vote.
paras.zh: 在民意调查中，落后于《Frequency of Love》的是诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 的新单曲《Draw You Out》，获得了 29% 的选票；米兰达·兰伯特 (Miranda Lambert) 的 Crisco 专辑，获得了近 7% 的选票；以及德雷克 (Drake) 的 HABIBTI (FOMO) 豪华专辑，获得了近 6% 的选票。

paras.en: See the final results of this week’s poll below.
paras.zh: 请参阅下面本周投票的最终结果。

articles.title: So Long, Kody & Robyn: Where to Watch ‘Sister Wives’ Season 21 for Free Online Featuring Only the OG Spouses

paras.en: Kody and Robyn Brown will not return for Season 21 of Sister Wives, according to TLC’s recently released trailer. While the network and couple have not shared a detailed explanation, reports suggest several possible factors. These include the show’s new focus on Kody’s former wives, possible contract and creative disagreements and Kody’s previously stated desire to step away from reality television and reduce public scrutiny. Sister Wives Season 21 will focus primarily on Meri, Janelle and Christine.
paras.zh: 根据 TLC 最近发布的预告片，科迪和罗宾·布朗将不会回归《妻子姐妹》第 21 季。虽然该网络和这对夫妇没有分享详细的解释，但报告提出了几个可能的因素。其中包括该节目对科迪前妻的新关注、可能的合同和创意分歧，以及科迪之前表示的退出真人秀节目并减少公众监督的愿望。 《姐妹妻子》第 21 季将主要关注梅里、珍妮尔和克里斯汀。
