paras.en: Materials provided by The Conversation. Original written by Levon Pogosian, Karsten Jedamzik, and Tom Abel. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由对话提供。原创作者为 Levon Pogosian、Karsten Jedamzik​​ 和 Tom Abel。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Karsten Jedamzik, Levon Pogosian, Tom Abel. Hints of primordial magnetic fields at recombination and implications for the Hubble tension. Nature Astronomy, 2025; 10 (2): 317 DOI: 10.1038/s41550-025-02737-x
paras.zh: - 卡斯滕·杰达姆齐克、莱文·波戈西安、汤姆·阿贝尔。重组时原始磁场的暗示以及对哈勃张力的影响。自然天文学，2025； 10 (2): 317 DOI: 10.1038/s41550-025-02737-x

articles.title: A meteor hit Oklahoma 100 million years later than scientists thought

paras.en: A meteor hit Oklahoma 100 million years later than scientists thought
paras.zh: 一颗流星撞击俄克拉荷马州的时间比科学家想象的晚了一亿年

paras.en: - A meteor crater buried beneath Oklahoma has turned out to be nearly 100 million years younger than scientists thought. Zircon crystals show the Ames impact occurred about 370 million years ago, meaning it was not part of the mysterious Ordovician bombardment once linked to a possible ring of debris around Earth. Instead, the impact coincided closely with a major mass extinction that devastated marine life.
paras.zh: - 埋藏在俄克拉荷马州下方的一个陨石坑被证明比科学家想象的要年轻近一亿年。锆石晶体显示艾姆斯撞击发生在大约 3.7 亿年前，这意味着它不是神秘的奥陶纪撞击的一部分，该撞击曾与地球周围可能存在的碎片环有关。相反，这次撞击恰逢一场严重破坏海洋生物的大规模灭绝。

paras.en: Researchers at The University of Texas at Austin have revised a key piece of Oklahoma's geologic history, with possible implications for how scientists interpret major events in the history of life on Earth.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的研究人员修改了俄克拉荷马州地质历史的一个关键部分，这可能对科学家如何解释地球生命史上的重大事件产生影响。

paras.en: Beneath the town of Ames, Oklahoma, lies a meteor impact structure that stretches for miles underground. Layers of sediment now cover the crater, but it remains significant both scientifically and economically. The Ames impact structure is also a major producer of oil and gas.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州艾姆斯镇下方有一个流星撞击结构，延伸至地下数英里。现在，火山口被沉积层覆盖，但它在科学和经济上仍然具有重要意义。艾姆斯撞击构造也是石油和天然气的主要产地。

paras.en: A Crater Long Linked to an Ancient Meteor Event
paras.zh: 与古代流星事件长期相关的陨石坑

paras.en: For years, the Ames crater was thought to belong to a cluster of major meteor impacts across North America dating to roughly 467.5 million years ago. That period is known as the Ordovician Meteor Event.
paras.zh: 多年来，艾姆斯陨石坑被认为属于横跨北美的一系列主要流星撞击事件，其历史可追溯到大约 4.675 亿年前。那段时期被称为奥陶纪流星事件。

paras.en: Because so many impact structures appear to date from around the same time, some researchers have proposed that Earth may once have been surrounded by a Saturn-like ring of asteroid debris during the Middle Ordovician.
paras.zh: 由于如此多的撞击结构似乎可以追溯到大约同一时期，一些研究人员提出，在中奥陶世期间，地球可能曾经被类似土星的小行星碎片环所包围。

paras.en: New work from UT researchers now shows that the Ames impact does not belong to that episode.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学研究人员的新研究现在表明，艾姆斯撞击并不属于那一事件。

paras.en: By dating zircon crystals taken from granite altered by the impact, the team determined that the meteorite struck about 370 million years ago during the Late Devonian. That makes the crater nearly 100 million years younger than previously believed.
paras.zh: 通过对从因撞击而改变的花岗岩中取出的锆石晶体进行年代测定，研究小组确定这块陨石是在大约 3.7 亿年前的泥盆纪晚期撞击的。这使得这个陨石坑比之前认为的要年轻近一亿年。

paras.en: "No matter what technique we used, it was coming back to this younger signal," said lead author Elizabeth Catlos, associate professor at UT's Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences.
paras.zh: “无论我们使用什么技术，它都会返回到这个更年轻的信号，”主要作者、德克萨斯大学地球与行星科学系副教授伊丽莎白·卡特洛斯说。

paras.en: The research was published in July in Meteoritics & Planetary Science.
paras.zh: 该研究发表于七月的《Meteoritics & Planetary Science》杂志上。

paras.en: Before this study, the Ames impact had only been dated using biological evidence. Researchers had found teeth from an ancient eel-like animal called a conodont preserved in the rock. Those fossils came from organisms that lived during the older Ordovician period.
paras.zh: 在这项研究之前，艾姆斯撞击的年代只能通过生物学证据来确定。研究人员在岩石中发现了一种古老的类似鳗鱼的动物的牙齿，这种动物被称为牙形刺。这些化石来自生活在旧奥陶纪时期的生物。

paras.en: But Catlos said the teeth were probably already millions of years old by the time the asteroid struck. The impact likely churned up older material and mixed the fossils into the rocks while still preserving them.
paras.zh: 但卡特洛斯表示，当小行星撞击时，这些牙齿可能已经有数百万年的历史了。这次撞击可能搅动了较旧的物质，并将化石混合到岩石中，同时仍然保存着它们。

paras.en: The zircon dating provides a very different timeline. It shows that the Ames crater could not have formed during the Ordovician Meteor Event.
paras.zh: 锆石年代测定提供了一个非常不同的时间表。这表明艾姆斯陨石坑不可能是在奥陶纪流星事件期间形成的。

paras.en: Instead, its new age places it close to the Frasnian-Famennian mass extinction event, which occurred about 372 million years ago and wiped out a large proportion of marine life on Earth.
paras.zh: 相反，它的新时代使其接近弗拉斯尼-法门大灭绝事件，该事件发生在大约 3.72 亿年前，消灭了地球上很大一部分海洋生物。

paras.en: Tiny Zircon Crystals Preserve the Impact
paras.zh: 微小的锆石晶体保留了冲击力

paras.en: Danny Stockli, dean of the Jackson School of Geosciences and a co-author of the study, said zircon U-Pb dating offers one of the most accurate ways to determine when events occurred deep in Earth's past.
paras.zh: 杰克逊地球科学学院院长、该研究的合著者丹尼·斯托克利表示，锆石 U-Pb 测年法是确定地球过去深处事件发生时间的最准确方法之一。

paras.en: Zircon crystals can also preserve microscopic structures created by the intense pressures generated during an impact.
paras.zh: 锆石晶体还可以保存撞击过程中产生的强大压力所产生的微观结构。

paras.en: "These small crystals allow us to go back in time and learn about the major changes to Earth's ancient landscapes," Stockli said. "It would be great to do this for more of the meteor impact sites across the continent so we could get a more accurate timeline for these major events."
paras.zh: 斯托克利说：“这些小晶体让我们能够回到过去，了解地球古代景观的重大变化。” “如果能够为非洲大陆更多的流星撞击地点做到这一点，那就太好了，这样我们就可以获得这些重大事件的更准确的时间表。”

paras.en: To confirm that the zircons had actually been affected by the meteor strike, the team worked with NASA to image the crystals using cathodoluminescence and electron backscatter diffraction.
paras.zh: 为了确认锆石确实受到了流星撞击的影响，该团队与美国宇航局合作，利用阴极发光和电子背散射衍射对晶体进行了成像。

paras.en: When zircon experiences the extreme conditions of an impact, it recrystallizes in a distinctive way. Those changes can be detected with these imaging techniques, allowing researchers to verify that the crystals recorded the collision itself.
paras.zh: 当锆石经历极端的冲击条件时，它会以独特的方式再结晶。这些变化可以通过这些成像技术来检测，从而使研究人员能够验证晶体是否记录了碰撞本身。

paras.en: According to Catlos, establishing more precise dates for mass extinctions and other major events is essential for understanding how Earth has changed over time.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯表示，确定大规模灭绝和其他重大事件的更精确日期对于了解地球随时间的变化至关重要。

paras.en: One key question is whether extinction events were triggered primarily by forces from space, such as meteor impacts, or by processes within Earth, including episodes of massive volcanic activity.
paras.zh: 一个关键问题是，灭绝事件是否主要是由太空力量（例如流星撞击）引发的，还是由地球内部的过程（包括大规模火山活动）引发的。

paras.en: "With this research, we're basically taking a major pawn out of the Ordovician Meteor Event and dumping it into the Frasnian-Famennian event, and saying, 'This is where this impact belongs,'" she said.
paras.zh: “通过这项研究，我们基本上是从奥陶纪流星事件中拿出了一个重要的棋子，并将其投入到了弗拉斯尼-法门尼事件中，并说，‘这就是这种影响所属的地方，’”她说。

paras.en: The project was initiated by former Jackson School of Geosciences graduate student Andrew Parisi, who graduated in 2018 and has since passed away. Parisi traveled to Oklahoma to obtain the Ames rock core from the Oklahoma Geological Survey, extracted zircon crystals from the material, and helped determine their ages.
paras.zh: 该项目由前杰克逊地球科学学院研究生安德鲁·帕里西发起，他于 2018 年毕业，现已去世。帕里西前往俄克拉荷马州，从俄克拉荷马州地质调查局获取艾姆斯岩芯，从材料中提取锆石晶体，并帮助确定其年龄。

paras.en: Co-author Michael Brookfield, an affiliated researcher at the school, also passed away before the paper was published.
paras.zh: 共同作者、该校附属研究员迈克尔·布鲁克菲尔德（Michael Brookfield）也在论文发表前去世。

paras.en: Research Professor Sean Gulick and Professor Emeritus Mark Cloos at the Jackson School also contributed to the research.
paras.zh: 杰克逊学院的研究教授肖恩·古利克（Sean Gulick）和名誉教授马克·克鲁斯（Mark Cloos）也对这项研究做出了贡献。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Texas at Austin. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Elizabeth J. Catlos, Andrew F. Parisi, Michael E. Brookfield, Timmons Erickson, Sean P.S. Gulick, Axel K. Schmitt, Daniel F. Stockli, Daniel P. Miggins, Ben Ruchte, Mark Cloos. paras.zh: - Elizabeth J. Catlos、Andrew F. Parisi、Michael E. Brookfield、Timmons Erickson、Sean P.S.古利克、阿克塞尔·K·施密特、丹尼尔·F·斯托克利、丹尼尔·P·米金斯、本·鲁赫特、马克·克鲁斯。俄克拉荷马州艾姆斯撞击结构：新的放射性同位素限制和对北美撞击年代学的影响。流星学，2026； 61（8）：2103 DOI：10.1111/maps.70191

articles.title: If AI cannot be trusted in a classroom, why should it be trusted in orbit?
articles.author: Qurat-Ul-Ain Shabbir

paras.en: On September 9, 2026, Evan Hubinger, Anthropic’s alignment science lead, said on social media that he personally believed there was a greater than 10% chance that artificial intelligence could kill all of humanity within the next decade. He was responding to Jacob Coxon, a researcher who had just resigned from Anthropic after working on pretraining at both that company and OpenAI, and who wrote in his own resignation thread that “the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” Hubinger did not walk the claim back. He confirmed it, while noting that the danger he had in mind was not today’s models but a future superintelligence for which the industry does not yet have a solved alignment plan.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，Anthropic 的对齐科学负责人 Evan Hubinger 在社交媒体上表示，他个人认为人工智能在未来十年内杀死全人类的可能性超过 10%。他是在回应雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon)，这位研究员在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 从事预训练工作后刚刚从 Anthropic 辞职，他在自己的辞职帖子中写道，“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人。”胡宾格没有收回索赔。他证实了这一点，同时指出，他想到的危险不是今天的模型，而是未来的超级智能，而业界尚未制定出解决的协调计划。

paras.en: Coming from the safety lead at one of the two or three companies most responsible for the technology’s current trajectory, this was not a fringe warning. It was, in effect, an admission from inside the room.
paras.zh: 来自对当前技术发展轨迹负有最大责任的两三家公司之一的安全主管，这并不是一个边缘警告。实际上，这是房间内部的承认。

paras.en: The exchange was framed almost entirely around AI in the abstract: chatbots, agents, the eventual arrival of self-improving systems. But the domain where this risk is least abstract and most immediate is not a hypothetical future superintelligence. It is the set of systems already being integrated into nuclear early warning satellites, missile-tracking constellations and the command and control architecture that decides, in minutes, whether a detected launch is real. If a company’s own safety researchers are willing to say on the record that current AI development carries a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe, the question that follows is not academic: What happens when systems built by that same industry, with that same acknowledged uncertainty, are the ones watching for nuclear launches from orbit and feeding what they see directly into the decision loop of nuclear-armed states?
paras.zh: 这场交流几乎完全围绕抽象的人工智能展开：聊天机器人、代理、自我改进系统的最终到来。但这种风险最不抽象、最直接的领域并不是假设的未来超级智能。这套系统已经集成到核预警卫星、导弹跟踪星座以及指挥和控制架构中，可以在几分钟内决定检测到的发射是否真实。如果一家公司自己的安全研究人员愿意公开表示，当前的人工智能发展带来文明灾难的可能性达到两位数，那么接下来的问题就不是学术问题了：当同一行业构建的系统具有同样公认的不确定性时，如果那些在轨道上监视核发射并将其看到的信息直接反馈到核武器国家的决策循环中，会发生什么？

paras.en: The nuclear-space nexus is where AI safety debate stops being abstract
paras.zh: 核与太空的联系是人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方

paras.en: This is the nuclear space nexus, and it is where the abstract AI safety debate stops being abstract.
paras.zh: 这就是核空间的联系，也是抽象人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方。

paras.en: The mechanism runs through space architecture itself. Satellite constellations, orbital processing units and ground relay stations are the physical layer that decides what a nuclear armed state believes is happening in the world. The AI systems currently doing that work are narrow, frozen weight models, convolutional networks for image classification, sensor fusion algorithms for combining radar and satellite feeds, nothing resembling the self improving superintelligence Coxon and Hubinger were warning about. That distinction is precisely what makes the space layer worth examining rather than dismissing.
paras.zh: 这一机制贯穿于空间建筑本身。卫星星座、轨道处理单元和地面中继站是决定核武器国家认为世界上正在发生什么的物理层。目前从事这项工作的人工智能系统是狭窄的、冻结重量的模型、用于图像分类的卷积网络、用于结合雷达和卫星馈送的传感器融合算法，与考克森和胡宾格警告的自我改进的超级智能完全不同。正是这种区别使得空间层值得研究而不是忽视。

paras.en: For decades, that layer worked on a simple “bent pipe” model: satellites captured raw infrared and radar data and beamed it down to Earth for human analysts to interpret. That model is being replaced. Modern space architecture is shifting toward onboard edge AI, with computer vision models embedded directly into satellite payloads deciding, in orbit, what counts as a missile plume before a human ever sees the raw image. At the same time, the shift from a handful of large geostationary satellites to proliferated low Earth orbit constellations of thousands of smaller satellites means no human team can parse the feeds directly. Data fusion platforms now do that work, aggregating radar, imagery and signals intelligence into a single real time track. Even a narrow, well tested model compresses the time available for human judgment, since the entire argument for automating this layer is that orbital and hypersonic threats move faster than people can react to.
paras.zh: 几十年来，该层工作在一个简单的“弯管”模型上：卫星捕获原始红外和雷达数据，并将其传送到地球供人类分析人员解释。该模型正在被替换。现代太空架构正在向机载边缘人工智能转变，计算机视觉模型直接嵌入卫星有效载荷中，在人类看到原始图像之前，在轨道上决定什么算作导弹羽流。与此同时，从少数大型对地静止卫星到由数千颗小型卫星组成的激增的近地轨道星座的转变意味着没有人类团队可以直接解析馈送。数据融合平台现在可以完成这项工作，将雷达、图像和信号情报聚合到一个实时轨道中。即使是一个经过严格测试的狭窄模型也会压缩人类判断的时间，因为自动化这一层的整个论点是轨道和高超音速威胁的移动速度比人们的反应速度要快。

paras.en: And while today’s systems are not the unaligned frontier models Coxon feared, they still introduce a structural risk: the same edge processing and data fusion architecture being built now is the substrate that a future self improving system, if one ever gained access to military networks, would inherit and exploit. A false positive in this setting is not a chatbot hallucination. It is a satellite misreading a solar flare or a glint of debris as a missile plume, and passing that reading up a chain of command that may have only minutes to decide whether to believe it.
paras.zh: 虽然今天的系统并不是 Coxon 所担心的不统一的前沿模型，但它们仍然引入了结构性风险：现在正在构建的相同边缘处理和数据融合架构是未来自我改进系统（如果能够访问军事网络）将继承和利用的基础。这种情况下的误报并不是聊天机器人的幻觉。它是一颗卫星将太阳耀斑或闪烁的碎片误读为导弹羽流，并将读取的信息传递给指挥链，而指挥链可能只有几分钟的时间来决定是否相信它。

paras.en: A useful, if unlikely, point of comparison arrived days apart from the Hubinger exchange. On September 2, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a one-year moratorium on generative AI for public school students through eighth grade, affecting nearly 600,000 children and disabling AI functions in dozens of previously approved classroom programs. The justification was not that the technology does not work. It was that the city could not yet be confident it belonged in a setting where the cost of getting it wrong, a child’s developing capacity to think for herself, was too important to risk on a technology still being evaluated.
paras.zh: 一个有用的（即使不太可能）比较点在 Hubinger 交易所发生几天后就出现了。 9 月 2 日，纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 宣布，公立学校八年级学生暂停使用生成式人工智能一年，这影响了近 60 万名儿童，并在数十个之前批准的课堂项目中禁用了人工智能功能。理由并不是该技术不起作用。问题是，这座城市还不能确信自己属于这样一种环境，在这种环境中，犯错的代价，即孩子独立思考能力的发展，太重要了，不能冒险冒险一项仍在评估的技术。

paras.en: “Children need teachers and human connection in order to learn and in order to grow,” Mamdani said. “We hold an obligation to do the same” when it comes to AI’s role in that development.
paras.zh: “孩子们需要老师和人际关系才能学习和成长，”马姆达尼说。当谈到人工智能在这一发展中的作用时，“我们有义务做同样的事情”。

paras.en: It is worth sitting with the asymmetry this produces. New York City possesses centralized, enforceable authority over what software runs on its own school-issued devices, and used that authority to pause AI in a setting where the downside of error is developmental, not existential. Nuclear-armed states, by contrast, are integrating comparable AI systems into early warning and command infrastructure where the downside of error is civilizational, and there is no equivalent central authority capable of imposing a comparable pause. If the mere possibility of AI eroding a child’s critical thinking was sufficient grounds for New York City to disable the technology outright pending further study, the far larger and more immediate possibility of AI misreading a satellite feed and compressing a nuclear decision to seconds deserves at least the same precautionary instinct, applied to the domain where a mistake cannot be undone.
paras.zh: 值得坐视由此产生的不对称性。纽约市对在自己学校发行的设备上运行哪些软件拥有集中的、可执行的权力，并利用该权力在错误的负面影响是发展而不是存在的环境中暂停人工智能。相比之下，拥有核武器的国家正在将类似的人工智能系统集成到早期预警和指挥基础设施中，其中错误的负面影响是文明的，而且没有同等的中央机构能够实施类似的暂停。如果人工智能侵蚀儿童批判性思维的可能性足以让纽约市有充分理由在进一步研究之前彻底禁用该技术，那么人工智能误读卫星信号并将核决策压缩到几秒钟的更大、更直接的可能性至少值得同样的预防本能，应用于错误无法挽回的领域。

paras.en: The honest complication is that a school district and the international nuclear order are not remotely comparable in their capacity to act on that instinct. A ban is enforceable when one authority controls the devices in question; it is close to unenforceable when the object being restricted is software that can be updated remotely over an encrypted satellite uplink, and when no state trusts another enough to grant the kind of intrusive access that verifying compliance would require. This is precisely the gap that existing international efforts are now trying, with limited success, to close.
paras.zh: 老实说，复杂之处在于，学区和国际核秩序根据这种本能采取行动的能力根本无法相提并论。当一个机构控制相关设备时，禁令即可强制执行；当受到限制的对象是可以通过加密卫星上行链路远程更新的软件，并且没有一个国家足够信任另一个国家以授予验证合规性所需的侵入性访问权限时，它几乎无法执行。这正是现有国际努力正在试图弥补的差距，但成效有限。

paras.en: International bodies efforts to establish global norms regarding AI and nuclear command
paras.zh: 国际机构努力建立有关人工智能和核指挥的全球规范

paras.en: The most direct attempt sits at the United Nations. On December 1, 2025, the General Assembly adopted Resolution A/RES/80/23 on the risks of integrating artificial intelligence into nuclear command, control, and communications, passing 118 to 9 with 44 abstentions. The resolution calls on states to adopt and publish national policies affirming that AI-enabled NC3 systems will remain under human control and will not be capable of autonomously initiating a nuclear launch decision. That it passed with broad support is meaningful. That nine states voted against it, and that France, a nuclear power that itself insists human control must be preserved at every critical stage of a launch decision, was reportedly among them, says something sharper about how far declaratory consensus is from binding practice.
paras.zh: 最直接的尝试来自于联合国。 2025年12月1日，大会以118票对9票、44票弃权通过了关于将人工智能纳入核指挥、控制和通信的风险的A/RES/80/23号决议。该决议呼吁各国通过并公布国家政策，确认人工智能支持的 NC3 系统将继续处于人类控制之下，并且无法自主发起核发射决定。它得到广泛支持的通过是有意义的。据报道，九个国家投了反对票，而法国这个核大国本身就坚持在发射决定的每个关键阶段都必须保留人类控制，这更清楚地表明了宣言性共识与具有约束力的实践之间的差距。

paras.en: Alongside the UN process, the Summit on Responsible AI in the Military Domain, known as REAIM, has become the closest thing to a running multilateral forum on this question. Its third summit was held in A Coruña, Spain, on February 4 and 5, following earlier summits in The Hague in 2023 and Seoul in 2024. It was explicitly framed as an attempt to move from declared principles to “concrete, practical and realistic steps.” That framing was itself a quiet admission that the first two summits had not managed the transition. The 2026 outcome document was endorsed by only 39 states, down from more than 60 in 2024, a decline several analysts have linked to deteriorating relations among the major AI and nuclear powers rather than to any narrowing of the underlying risk.
paras.zh: 除了联合国进程之外，军事领域负责任人工智能峰会（REAIM）已成为该问题最接近正在运行的多边论坛的机构。第三次峰会于 2 月 4 日至 5 日在西班牙拉科鲁尼亚举行，之前曾于 2023 年在海牙和 2024 年在首尔举行过峰会。这次峰会被明确定位为从宣布的原则转向“具体、实际和现实的步骤”的尝试。这一框架本身就是在悄悄承认前两次峰会未能成功实现过渡。 2026 年成果文件仅获得 39 个国家的认可，低于 2024 年的 60 多个国家，一些分析人士认为，这一下降与主要人工智能国家和核大国之间关系的恶化有关，而不是与潜在风险的任何缩小有关。

paras.en: What both processes share is the same structural weakness: They are norm-setting exercises operating in a domain where the thing being regulated, software, cannot be counted, inspected or verified the way a missile silo can. A state can comply with the letter of a resolution on human control while still deploying an AI system that filters, prioritizes and frames the sensor data a human ultimately sees, shaping the decision long before a human formally makes it. The requirement that a person retain final authority does very little if that person’s picture of reality has already been constructed by a model no outside party can audit.
paras.zh: 这两个流程都有一个相同的结构性弱点：它们是在一个领域内进行的规范制定活动，在该领域中，被监管的东西（软件）无法像导弹发射井那样进行计数、检查或验证。一个国家可以遵守关于人类控制的决议的字面意思，同时仍然部署人工智能系统，对人类最终看到的传感器数据进行过滤、优先排序和框架，从而在人类正式做出决定之前很久就做出决定。如果一个人的现实图景已经由外部各方无法审计的模型构建而成，那么要求一个人保留最终权威的要求就没有什么作用。

paras.en: How independent research bodies evaluate these UN blueprints
paras.zh: 独立研究机构如何评估这些联合国蓝图

paras.en: Independent research bodies evaluating these blueprints have converged on a similar diagnosis. In an assessment of the UNGA resolution published shortly after its adoption, the Observer Research Foundation concluded that the measure signals a genuine and broadly shared anxiety among states, but that it remains constrained by exactly the fault lines one would expect: the divide between nuclear and non-nuclear states, the reluctance of major nuclear powers to accept binding restrictions on capabilities they consider central to deterrence and the fact that the resolution’s core language, human control and oversight, was never defined with enough technical precision to be verified rather than merely declared. The same critique applies to REAIM’s outcome documents, which rely on states to describe their own compliance rather than submitting to any external check. Both processes are, in the assessment of the researchers who study them, aspirational rather than enforceable, useful for establishing that a problem is taken seriously, but not yet capable of constraining the behavior of the states whose behavior actually matters.
paras.zh: 评估这些蓝图的独立研究机构已得出类似的诊断。观察家研究基金会在联合国大会决议通过后不久发表的一份评估报告中得出结论，该措施标志着各国之间真正和广泛共同的焦虑，但它仍然受到人们所期望的断层线的限制：核国家与无核国家之间的分歧，主要核大国不愿接受对其认为对威慑至关重要的能力的有约束力的限制，以及该决议的核心语言，即人类控制和监督，从来没有以足够的技术精确度进行定义，而只是宣布。同样的批评也适用于 REAIM 的结果文件，该文件依赖于各州描述自己的合规性，而不是提交给任何外部检查。根据研究人员的评估，这两个过程都是理想的而非可执行的，有助于确定问题得到认真对待，但尚不能限制其行为真正重要的国家的行为。

paras.en: This is, in effect, the diplomatic community’s answer to the technical impossibility of a blanket prohibition. Recognizing this, the UN General Assembly and allied processes have instead pursued a narrower, more realistic strategy: isolating AI from specific, high-consequence use cases, nuclear launch authority chief among them, rather than attempting to regulate military AI as a single undifferentiated category. Resolution A/RES/80/23 is itself an example of this approach in practice. It does not ban AI from space or defence systems generally; it targets one function, the initiation of a nuclear launch decision and insists that function alone remain exclusively human. The strategy is sound in principle. Its weakness, as the evaluations above make clear, is that use-case segregation only works if the boundary between an isolated function and the surrounding system can actually be verified.
paras.zh: 实际上，这是外交界对全面禁止在技术上不可能的问题的回答。认识到这一点，联合国大会和相关进程转而追求一种更狭隘、更现实的战略：将人工智能与具体的、后果严重的用例（其中最主要的是核发射授权）隔离开来，而不是试图将军事人工智能作为一个单一的、无差别的类别进行监管。 A/RES/80/23 号决议本身就是这种方法在实践中的一个例子。它并不普遍禁止人工智能进入太空或防御系统；它针对一项功能，即发起核发射决定，并坚持认为这一功能完全是人类的。该战略原则上是合理的。正如上面的评估所表明的那样，它的弱点是用例隔离只有在隔离功能与周围系统之间的边界实际上可以得到验证的情况下才有效。

paras.en: None of this means the underlying comparison to Mamdani’s classroom ban should be read too literally. What it usefully exposes is the gap between the precautionary standard a single city was willing to apply to a developmental risk and the precautionary standard the international system has so far been able to apply to an existential one. The nuclear order, by contrast, continues to integrate AI into its most sensitive systems while the very researchers building the underlying technology are, in public, on the record, unable to rule out a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe. The core policy question this raises is not whether AI can be kept out of nuclear command systems entirely.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着与马姆达尼课堂禁令的潜在比较应该过于字面解读。它有效地揭示了单个城市愿意应用于发展风险的预防标准与国际体系迄今为止能够应用于生存风险的预防标准之间的差距。相比之下，核秩序继续将人工智能整合到其最敏感的系统中，而构建底层技术的研究人员在公开场合却无法排除文明灾难的两位数可能性。这引发的核心政策问题不是人工智能是否可以完全排除在核指挥系统之外。

paras.en: It is whether the international community can move from resolutions that describe the danger, and use-case boundaries that sound precise on paper, to verification mechanisms that actually constrain it, before the gap between declared principle and deployed practice is tested by a false alarm instead of a vote count.
paras.zh: 问题在于国际社会能否在通过虚假警报而不是计票来检验所宣布的原则与部署的实践之间的差距之前，从描述危险的决议和纸面上听起来精确的用例边界转向实际限制危险的核查机制。

articles.title: NaviGate successfully demonstrates onboard precise orbit determination aboard D-Orbit’s ION Satellite Carrier
articles.author: NaviGate

paras.en: ROME, 30/09/2026 – NaviGate, an Italian space technology company spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, has successfully completed the in-orbit demonstration (IoD) of NaviCode Caravel, its autonomous onboard precise orbit determination software, aboard an ION Satellite Carrier operated by D-Orbit. During the demonstration, NaviCode Caravel ran directly on the satellite’s onboard computer, computing the spacecraft’s position in real time using only the raw data of the GNSS receiver already onboard, with no additional hardware.
paras.zh: 罗马，2026 年 9 月 30 日 – NaviGate 是一家从罗马第一大学衍生出来的意大利空间技术公司，在 D-Orbit 运营的 ION 卫星运载器上成功完成了 NaviCode Caravel（其自主机载精确定轨软件）的在轨演示 (IoD)。在演示过程中，NaviCode Caravel 直接在卫星的机载计算机上运行，​​仅使用卫星上已有的 GNSS 接收器的原始数据实时计算航天器的位置，无需额外的硬件。

paras.en: Today, knowing precisely where a satellite is remains largely a ground-based activity: operators rely on dedicated infrastructure, specialized flight dynamics teams, and repeated ground contacts to accurately reconstruct and predict the orbit of each spacecraft. As constellations grow in size and missions become more responsive, this approach turns into a bottleneck in terms of cost, workload, and reaction time. NaviCode Caravel moves precise orbit determination onboard: a software-only product that transforms the raw measurements of the GNSS receiver a satellite already carries into high-accuracy, real-time knowledge of its own position, available directly where operational decisions are made. Beyond determining where the satellite is now, Caravel can also predict where it will be, together with a measure of how reliable that prediction is, giving the spacecraft the forward-looking awareness it needs to anticipate upcoming events, such as ground station contacts or payload operations, and manage them autonomously onboard.
paras.zh: 如今，准确了解卫星的位置在很大程度上仍然是一项地面活动：运营商依靠专用基础设施、专门的飞行动力学团队以及反复的地面接触来准确重建和预测每个航天器的轨道。随着星座规模的扩大和任务的响应速度越来越快，这种方法在成本、工作量和反应时间方面变成了瓶颈。 NaviCode Caravel 实现机载精确轨道确定：这是一款纯软件产品，可将卫星已携带的 GNSS 接收器的原始测量结果转换为对其自身位置的高精度、实时了解，可直接在做出操作决策时使用。除了确定卫星现在的位置之外，Caravel 还可以预测它将在哪里，并衡量该预测的可靠性，从而为航天器提供预测即将发生的事件（例如地面站接触或有效载荷操作）所需的前瞻性意识，并在船上自主管理它们。

paras.en: The demonstration was carried out through D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service and structured in two phases. NaviCode Caravel was first validated on the ground on an engineering model replicating the in-orbit computing environment. The application was then uploaded to an ION Satellite Carrier already in orbit and executed onboard, processing real flight telemetry from the spacecraft’s GNSS receiver across multiple runs.
paras.zh: 该演示通过 D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务进行，分两个阶段进行。 NaviCode Caravel 首先在复制在轨计算环境的工程模型上进行了地面验证。然后，该应用程序被上传到已在轨道上的 ION 卫星载体并在机上执行，在多次运行中处理来自航天器 GNSS 接收器的真实飞行遥测数据。

paras.en: The software executed nominally onboard and in real time without anomalies. Onboard positioning reached a best-case formal uncertainty of 5.2 cm, with mean values in the decimeter range across the runs, using GPS-only measurements. NaviGate then verified the onboard solutions on the ground, proving them consistent with the reference orbits reconstructed through classical ground-based precise orbit determination performed with GODOT, the European Space Agency’s flight dynamics software. NaviCode Caravel is also designed to process multi-constellation GNSS data and correction services such as SBAS and Galileo HAS, enabling even higher accuracy in operational deployments.
paras.zh: 该软件名义上在船上实时执行，没有出现异常。使用仅 GPS 测量，机载定位的最佳情况形式不确定度达到 5.2 厘米，整个运行的平均值在分米范围内。随后，NaviGate 在地面验证了机载解决方案，证明它们与通过欧洲航天局飞行动力学软件 GODOT 执行的经典地面精确轨道确定重建的参考轨道一致。 NaviCode Caravel 还设计用于处理多星座 GNSS 数据和校正服务，例如 SBAS 和 Galileo HAS，从而在操作部署中实现更高的准确性。

paras.en: “Satellites still depend heavily on the ground to know exactly where they are and where they will be. NaviCode Caravel changes that: it is a software product that lets a satellite compute its own position with high accuracy, in real time, using the GNSS receiver it already carries, with no new hardware,” said Andrea Sesta, Chief Technology Officer and Co-founder at NaviGate. “Seeing it run in orbit without a single anomaly, and produce solutions consistent with the reference orbits computed on the ground, is the validation we were working toward, and a real milestone for the whole NaviGate team. D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service was key to getting there quickly: we developed and tested our application on the ground in the same containerized environment used in orbit, iterated fast, and flew on real flight data within months, which is exactly what a company like ours needs to bring a flight-proven product to market.”
paras.zh: NaviGate 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrea Sesta 表示：“卫星仍然严重依赖地面来准确了解它们所在的位置和将要到达的位置。NaviCode Caravel 改变了这一点：它是一款软件产品，可以让卫星使用其已携带的 GNSS 接收器实时高精度地计算自己的位置，而无需新硬件。” “看到它在轨道上运行而没有出现任何异常，并生成与地面计算的参考轨道一致的解决方案，是我们正在努力实现的验证，也是整个 NaviGate 团队的一个真正的里程碑。D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务是快速实现这一目标的关键：我们在轨道上使用的相同容器化环境中在地面上开发和测试了我们的应用程序，快速迭代，并在几个月内根据真实的飞行数据进行了飞行，这正是像我们这样的公司将经过飞行验证的产品推向市场。”

paras.en: “With five networked Intelligence Nodes in orbit, we can give customers access to space infrastructure that is already up and running. For NaviGate, that means testing their precise orbit determination algorithms ingesting raw GNSS measurements and attitude telemetry in real time from D-Orbit’s ION platform, in-situ directly on-board, with no satellite to develop or launch. It’s a practical way to move from simulation to real flight data in less time and at lower cost,” said Viney Jean-Francois Dhiri, Head of Growth, Sales and Marketing of the Space Cloud Business Unit at D-Orbit.
paras.zh: “通过在轨的五个网络智能节点，我们可以让客户访问已经启动并运行的空间基础设施。对于 NaviGate 来说，这意味着测试他们的精确定轨算法，从 D-Orbit 的 ION 平台实时获取原始 GNSS 测量数据和姿态遥测数据，直接在原位机载，无需开发或发射卫星。这是一种在更短的时间内、以更低的成本从模拟转向真实飞行数据的实用方法，”Viney Jean-Francois 说道。 Dhiri，D-Orbit 太空云业务部增长、销售和营销主管。

paras.en: Caravel is the first release of the NaviCode fleet: subsequent versions will extend these capabilities to multi-sensor resilient navigation and to autonomous maneuver planning for large constellations. NaviCode Caravel was also selected as a winner of the CASSINI Challenges 2026, the European Union’s space entrepreneurship competition run by the EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA).
paras.zh: Caravel 是 NaviCode 舰队的第一个版本：后续版本将把这些功能扩展到多传感器弹性导航和大型星座的自主机动规划。 NaviCode Caravel 还被选为 2026 年 CASSINI 挑战赛的获胜者，这是由欧盟太空计划署 (EUSPA) 主办的欧盟太空创业竞赛。

paras.en: The in-orbit demonstration is the culminating milestone of the proof-of-concept program funded by Galaxia, the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures, which backed NaviGate from its earliest stage. NaviGate was founded by researchers who developed deep expertise in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination through their work on ESA and NASA missions, and originated as a spin-off of Sapienza University of Rome.
paras.zh: 这次在轨演示是概念验证项目的最终里程碑，该项目由 Galaxia 资助，Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持，Obloo Ventures 从最初阶段就支持 NaviGate。 NaviGate 的创始人是罗马第一大学的附属机构，他们通过在欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和美国宇航局 (NASA) 任务中的工作，在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面积累了深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: Following the demonstration, NaviGate is engaging constellation operators and mission integrators for the first pilot deployments. NaviCode Caravel addresses concrete needs across the market: reducing the ground workload and infrastructure required for precise orbit determination in constellation operations, enhancing onboard image processing for Earth observation missions, supporting PNT constellations, and improving orbit knowledge for launch vehicles and orbital transfer applications, with further applications across other mission types and orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 演示结束后，NaviGate 正在与星座运营商和任务集成商合作进行首次试点部署。 NaviCode Caravel 满足整个市场的具体需求：减少星座运行中精确定轨所需的地面工作量和基础设施、增强地球观测任务的机载图像处理、支持 PNT 星座、改善运载火箭和轨道转移应用的轨道知识，以及在其他任务类型和轨道制度中的进一步应用。

paras.en: Spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, NaviGate S.r.l. is an Italian space technology startup founded by researchers with extensive experience in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination across ESA and NASA missions including Juno, Cassini, Veritas, BepiColombo, and JUICE, and initiatives such as ESA Moonlight and Marconi constellations. The company develops NaviCode, a modular, data-agnostic software platform that enables satellites and constellations to perform precise orbit determination, orbit prediction, and autonomous maneuvering without continuous ground intervention, leveraging GNSS, radiometric, optical, and other navigation measurements. NaviGate was incorporated in 2026 and is backed by Galaxia, Italy’s national technology transfer hub for aerospace, and supported by the ESA BIC Lazio incubation program.
paras.zh: NaviGate S.r.l. 是从罗马第一大学分离出来的。是一家意大利空间技术初创公司，由在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面拥有丰富经验的研究人员创立，这些研究人员参与了欧空局和美国宇航局的任务，包括朱诺号、卡西尼号、Veritas、BepiColombo 和 JUICE，以及​​欧空局月光和马可尼星座等计划。该公司开发了 NaviCode，这是一个与数据无关的模块化软件平台，使卫星和星座能够利用 GNSS、辐射、光学和其他导航测量来执行精确的定轨、轨道预测和自主操纵，而无需持续的地面干预。 NaviGate 成立于 2026 年，得到意大利国家航空航天技术转移中心 Galaxia 的支持，并得到 ESA BIC Lazio 孵化计划的支持。

paras.en: More information on www.navigate-space.com
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 www.navigate-space.com

paras.en: D-Orbit develops space logistics systems for orbital transportation, hosted payload operations, and in-orbit data processing. Its ION Satellite Carrier is an orbital transfer vehicle (OTV) used for satellite deployment and hosted payload operations; since 2020 it has flown 23 missions and carried 240+ payloads, including hosted payloads and satellites deployed in orbit. The company also provides space cloud services based on onboard computing for in-orbit data processing and is developing GEA, a servicing spacecraft intended to support autonomous rendezvous, inspection, and refueling, as well as NOX, a synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) Earth observation satellite.
paras.zh: D-Orbit 开发用于轨道运输、托管有效载荷操作和在轨数据处理的空间物流系统。其ION卫星载体是一种轨道传输运载工具（OTV），用于卫星部署和托管有效载荷操作；自 2020 年以来，它已执行 23 次飞行任务，携带 240 多个有效载荷，包括托管有效载荷和部署在轨道上的卫星。该公司还提供基于机载计算的空间云服务，用于在轨数据处理，并正在开发 GEA（一种旨在支持自主交会、检查和加油的服务航天器）以及 NOX（一颗合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 地球观测卫星）。

paras.en: Galaxia is the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace, powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures. Its mission is to promote the development of startups conceived within research laboratories specialized in the aerospace sector. The scientific promoters of Galaxia are Politecnico di Torino and Sapienza University of Rome, together with other leading Italian universities, including the University of Padua and Politecnico di Bari. NEVA SGR, the venture capital company of the Intesa Sanpaolo Group, and Compagnia di San Paolo Foundation are investors in the initiative. Obloo Ventures acts as the entrepreneurial partner and co-investor of the hub, managing the scouting, investment execution and portfolio monitoring. Along with Lazio Innova and the I3P Incubator of the Politecnico di Torino, Obloo Ventures also coordinates the business creation program, dedicated to startups originating from academic research and selected by the hub for seed investments.
paras.zh: Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持。其使命是促进航空航天领域专门研究实验室内构思的初创企业的发展。 Galaxia 的科学推动者是都灵理工大学和罗马第一大学，以及其他意大利领先大学，包括帕多瓦大学和巴里理工大学。 Intesa Sanpaolo 集团的风险投资公司 NEVA SGR 和 Compagnia di San Paolo 基金会是该计划的投资者。 Obloo Ventures 是该中心的创业合作伙伴和联合投资者，负责管理搜寻、投资执行和投资组合监控。 Obloo Ventures 与 Lazio Innova 和都灵理工大学的 I3P 孵化器一起协调企业创建计划，致力于源自学术研究并由种子投资中心选择的初创企业。

paras.en: More information on https://galaxia.vc/it/
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 https://galaxia.vc/it/

articles.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
articles.author: Galileo Space

paras.en: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected and traced to its source. A ship lost at sea may still broadcast a distress signal. A tumbling satellite may lose contact with the ground while still emitting signals that help locate it. Rescue crews may have only hours to find someone before nightfall.
paras.zh: 伽利略航天公司正在建造旨在将信号转化为轨道上答案的卫星。现代国防和商业运营需要快速了解正在发生的事情和地点。现有系统可能会让分段数据在处理过程中爬行数小时或数天。 FPV 无人机和移动雷达必须被快速检测和跟踪。弹道导弹发射羽流检测可以提供关键的早期预警。必须检测干扰导航频率或关键卫星通信链路的干扰并追踪其来源。在海上失踪的船只仍可能会发出求救信号。翻滚的卫星可能会与地面失去联系，但仍会发出有助于定位卫星的信号。救援人员可能只有几个小时的时间才能在夜幕降临之前找到人。

paras.en: The solution combines innovative sensors with AI fusion at the edge to generate actionable reports directly in orbit. The system is designed to operate fully autonomously for weeks, selecting and carrying out its own sensing tasks. It identifies threats, geolocates signals and delivers actionable intelligence to operators within minutes, not hours or days. The mission is to give defense teams the early warning they need to survive and commercial operators the answers they need to act.
paras.zh: 该解决方案将创新传感器与边缘人工智能融合相结合，直接在轨道上生成可操作的报告。该系统设计为完全自主运行数周，选择并执行自己的传感任务。它可以在几分钟（而不是几小时或几天）内识别威胁、对信号进行地理定位并向操作员提供可采取行动的情报。其使命是为防御团队提供生存所需的早期预警，并为商业运营商提供采取行动所需的答案。

paras.en: Working side by side with government stakeholders, the team has developed a deep understanding of operational needs and critical capability gaps. The company is in the final stages of securing its first government contract. Its first demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2027 to prove its capabilities in orbit and open the door to a potential Phase III government contract. Galileo has also deepened relationships with commercial companies that need near live data, creating a path to early revenue alongside its defense business.
paras.zh: 该团队与政府利益相关者并肩工作，对运营需求和关键能力差距有了深入的了解。该公司正处于获得第一份政府合同的最后阶段。其第一颗示范卫星计划于 2027 年第四季度发射，以证明其在轨能力，并为潜在的第三阶段政府合同打开大门。伽利略还加深了与需要近乎实时数据的商业公司的关系，为其国防业务创造了一条早期收入的途径。

paras.en: Galileo was selected for a16z speedrun as one of 80 companies chosen from 30,000 applicants.
paras.zh: Galileo 是从 30,000 名申请者中选出的 80 家公司之一，被选为 a16z speedrun 项目的一员。

paras.en: CEO: Brings a decade of experience in national security space and military systems at Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin. Led testing in orbit for protected military communications satellites and consulted for the U.S. Space Force on acquiring new technology. Combines spacecraft engineering expertise with deep knowledge of defense missions, government procurement and what operators need.
paras.zh: 首席执行官：在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和洛克希德·马丁公司拥有十年的国家安全空间和军事系统经验。领导受保护的军用通信卫星在轨测试，并就获取新技术为美国太空军提供咨询。将航天器工程专业知识与国防任务、政府采购和运营商需求的深入了解相结合。

paras.en: CSO: Was responsible for building machine learning systems for Google, YouTube and Amazon’s Prime Video. Brings expertise in AI, software infrastructure and building systems at global scale. Now leads Galileo’s satellite software, bringing that experience into orbit to turn complex sensor data into clear intelligence that operators can act on.
paras.zh: CSO：负责为谷歌、YouTube 和亚马逊的 Prime Video 构建机器学习系统。在全球范围内带来人工智能、软件基础设施和建筑系统方面的专业知识。现在领导伽利略的卫星软件，将这种经验带入轨道，将复杂的传感器数据转化为操作员可以采取行动的清晰情报。

paras.en: CTO: Designed, tested and delivered all RF radios for SpaceX Starship flights, owning the radios through Flight 10, including first booster catch at the tower. Introduced Starship’s first integrated Starlink phased array antenna and RTK GPS receiver hardware that helped guide the booster back to the tower. Previously worked on electronic warfare for a Navy jammer missile at Raytheon and designed high power RF amplifiers for the Navy and Ka band block upconverters for the Army at two startups.
paras.zh: 首席技术官：为 SpaceX 星舰飞行设计、测试并交付了所有 RF 无线电设备，并拥有 10 号航班的无线电设备，包括塔上的第一个助推器捕获器。推出 Starship 首款集成 Starlink 相控阵天线和 RTK GPS 接收器硬件，帮助引导助推器返回塔楼。此前曾在雷神公司从事海军干扰导弹的电子战工作，并在两家初创公司为海军设计高功率射频放大器，为陆军设计 Ka 频段上变频器。

paras.en: Visit our website: https://galileo-space.com
paras.zh: 访问我们的网站：https://galileo-space.com

articles.title: No more execution attempts on Christa Pike: UN rights chief

paras.en: No more execution attempts on Christa Pike: UN rights chief
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员：不再尝试处决克里斯塔·派克

paras.en: The UN human rights chief and nine independent rights experts on Thursday called on authorities in Tennessee not to pursue any further attempts to execute Christa Pike, saying her case highlights multiple concerns surrounding the death penalty.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员和九名独立人权专家周四呼吁田纳西州当局不要进一步尝试处决克里斯塔·派克，称她的案件凸显了围绕死刑的多重担忧。

paras.en: - Ms. Pike was denied clemency and, one hour before her execution, a court halted it then lifted the stay
paras.zh: - 派克女士被拒绝宽大处理，在执行死刑前一小时，法院中止了执行，然后又取消了中止执行

paras.en: - She was twice injected with lethal drugs and survived
paras.zh: - 她两次被注射致命药物并幸存

paras.en: - Calls are growing for authorities to commute Ms. Pike’s death sentence
paras.zh: - 要求当局减刑派克女士死刑的呼声越来越高

paras.en: “The prolonged suffering – physical and mental – arising from multiple failed execution attempts is abhorrent and cruel,” Volker Türk said in a statement.
paras.zh: 沃尔克·蒂尔克在一份声明中表示：“多次失败的处决尝试所带来的长期痛苦——身体上和精神上的痛苦是令人憎恶和残酷的。”

paras.en: The UN rights chief pointed to unresolved questions surrounding Ms. Pike’s fair trial, saying they raised additional concerns about proceeding with another execution attempt.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务负责人指出了围绕派克女士公平审判的悬而未决的问题，并表示他们对继续进行另一次处决提出了更多担忧。

paras.en: The statement comes amid what the UN office described as an increase in the number of executions in the United States, with the Pike case renewing attention to the human rights implications of capital punishment in the country, including safeguards for fair trials and the treatment of people subjected to repeated execution attempts.
paras.zh: 该声明发表之际，联合国办事处称美国处决数量有所增加，派克案重新引起人们对该国死刑对人权的影响的关注，包括公平审判的保障和多次遭受处决的人的待遇。

paras.en: Mr. Türk reiterated the UN’s opposition to capital punishment, stating that “the death penalty has no place in any society.”
paras.zh: 图尔克重申联合国反对死刑，并表示“死刑在任何社会都没有立足之地”。

paras.en: Nine UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts echoed those calls.
paras.zh: 九名联合国人权理事会任命的专家响应了这些呼吁。

paras.en: “The state of Tennessee must immediately and irrevocably end this cruelty by commuting Christa Pike’s death sentence,” the experts said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 专家们周四表示：“田纳西州必须立即、不可撤销地结束这种残酷行为，为克里斯塔·派克减刑。”

paras.en: “Not one but two botched execution attempts are a flagrant breach of the prohibition of torture and arbitrary deprivation of life and show why [the] death penalty should be prohibited everywhere,” they said.
paras.zh: 他们说：“不是一次而是两次拙劣的处决企图公然违反了禁止酷刑和任意剥夺生命的规定，这表明为什么在任何地方都应该禁止死刑。”

paras.en: Rights experts are appointed by the UN Human Rights Council, are mandated to monitor and report on specific thematic issues or country situations, are not UN staff and do not receive a salary for their work.
paras.zh: 人权专家由联合国人权理事会任命，其任务是监测和报告具体专题问题或国家情况，他们不是联合国工作人员，也不领取薪水。

articles.title: UN Member States weigh latest Security Council veto, this time on Iran

paras.en: UN Member States weigh latest Security Council veto, this time on Iran
paras.zh: 联合国成员国权衡安理会最新否决权，这次是针对伊朗

paras.en: - The right to use a veto is held by permanent Security Council members – China, France, Russia, United Kingdom and United States – whereby if any votes against a resolution or decision, it automatically fails
paras.zh: - 安理会常任理事国——中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国——拥有使用否决权——如果有人对一项决议或决定投反对票，该决议或决定将自动失败

paras.en: - Council vetoes wielded over the past few years have included multiple resolutions for a ceasefire in Gaza and to end the war triggered by US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February
paras.zh: - 过去几年安理会行使否决权，包括多项关于加沙停火的决议以及结束美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动袭击引发的战争的决议

paras.en: - The veto initiative – established in 2022 – requires the General Assembly to meet within 10 working days of any veto in the Security Council
paras.zh: - 2022 年设立的否决权倡议要求大会在安理会否决后 10 个工作日内召开会议

paras.en: Many nations have called for removing or limiting veto power in the Council, but reform of the 15-member organ remains a work in progress.
paras.zh: 许多国家呼吁取消或限制安理会的否决权，但这个由 15 名成员组成的机构的改革仍在进行中。

paras.en: At last year’s annual veto debate, then-General Assembly president Annalena Baerbock called repeated veto use a “poster child” for global gridlock.
paras.zh: 在去年的年度否决辩论中，时任大会主席安娜莱娜·贝尔博克称，反复否决是造成全球僵局的“典范”。

paras.en: Thursday’s debate was triggered by the assembly’s landmark veto initiative, established in 2022.
paras.zh: 周四的辩论是由大会于 2022 年制定的具有里程碑意义的否决倡议引发的。

paras.en: Khalilur Rahman, president of the assembly’s 81st session, said the veto initiative “cannot substitute for effective Security Council action”.
paras.zh: 大会第81届会议主席哈利勒·拉赫曼表示，否决权倡议“不能替代安理会的有效行动”。

paras.en: Each invocation of the initiative “highlights both the value of this mechanism and the circumstances that make it necessary” and affirms the assembly’s complementary role, ensuring that veto use is accompanied by transparency, explanation and consideration by the wider membership.
paras.zh: 每次援引该倡议都“强调了该机制的价值以及使其必要的情况”，并确认了大会的补充作用，确保否决权的使用伴随着透明度、解释和更广泛会员国的考虑。

paras.en: While the initiative does not override the veto, it guarantees a public and accountable debate on each use and its implications in the General Assembly, where there is no veto power.
paras.zh: 虽然该倡议并不推翻否决权，但它保证在没有否决权的大会上就每次使用及其影响进行公开和负责任的辩论。

paras.en: During the debate, Deputy Permanent Representative Sun Lei of China said that his delegation voted against the draft resolution to “uphold a correct sense of right and wrong”.
paras.zh: 中国常驻副代表孙雷在辩论中表示，中国代表团对决议草案投了反对票，是为了“秉持正确的是非观”。

paras.en: The current impasse on the sanctions panel arises from the United States’ unilateral withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action on Iran’s nuclear facilities – the Iran nuclear deal of 2015 – its campaign of “maximum pressure” and its “two rounds of strikes against Iran in the midst of negotiations”.
paras.zh: 目前制裁小组的僵局源于美国单方面退出伊朗核设施联合全面行动计划——2015年伊核协议——其“极限施压”行动和“在谈判中对伊朗进行两轮打击”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, other delegates argued for extending the panel’s mandate.
paras.zh: 与此同时，其他代表主张延长专家组的任期。

paras.en: “No UN Member State should prevent the UN Security Council from functioning properly and being fully operational,” said Hedda Samson, Deputy Head of the European Union delegation, noting that the need for a panel of experts is “even great today”.
paras.zh: 欧盟代表团副团长赫达·萨姆森表示：“任何联合国会员国都不应阻止联合国安理会正常运作和全面运作。”她指出，“今天甚至非常需要”一个专家小组。

paras.en: Following Thursday’s debate, the assembly president will send a summary of discussions back to the Security Council.
paras.zh: 周四的辩论结束后，大会主席将向安理会发送讨论摘要。

paras.en: At the outset of the meeting, Mr. Rahman said the assembly and the council “serve humanity best when they operate in balance”, each fulfilling its distinct but complementary responsibilities under the UN Charter.
paras.zh: 拉赫曼先生在会议开始时表示，大会和理事会“在平衡运作时才能最好地为人类服务”，各自履行《联合国宪章》规定的独特但互补的职责。

paras.en: “Let us, therefore, use this debate not to exacerbate tensions or assign blame, but to clarify positions, identify common ground for constructive solutions and chart a credible path forward to support dialogue and diplomacy and ultimately restore trust in the organization and its ability to deliver,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“因此，让我们利用这场辩论，不是为了加剧紧张局势或相互指责，而是为了澄清立场，确定建设性解决方案的共同点，并制定一条可信的前进道路，支持对话和外交，最终恢复人们对本组织及其履行能力的信任。”

articles.title: Rotting food waste emits 5 times more greenhouse gases than planes

paras.en: Rotting food waste emits 5 times more greenhouse gases than planes
paras.zh: 腐烂的食物垃圾排放的温室气体比飞机多5倍

paras.en: If overlooked, food waste represents a key driver of the climate crisis, according the UN Environment Programme (UNEP), but tools are already being deployed to tackle that threat, from black soldier flies to empowering waste pickers across the world.
paras.zh: 根据联合国环境规划署（UNEP）的说法，如果忽视的话，食物浪费是气候危机的一个关键驱动因素，但我们已经部署了一些工具来应对这一威胁，从黑水虻到为世界各地的拾荒者提供帮助。

paras.en: Food waste encompasses everything from unfinished meals to spoiled crops (that’s food that is lost after harvest and before reaching stores).
paras.zh: 食物浪费包括从未吃完的饭菜到变质的农作物（即收获后和到达商店之前损失的食物）。

paras.en: The most polluting form of waste from the kitchen table however is the rotting food which ends up in landfills.
paras.zh: 然而，餐桌上污染最严重的废物是最终被扔进垃圾填埋场的腐烂食物。

paras.en: When organic matter such as uneaten food is buried in landfills and deprived of oxygen, it interacts with micro-organisms to produce methane.
paras.zh: 当未吃的食物等有机物被埋在垃圾填埋场并失去氧气时，它会与微生物相互作用产生甲烷。

paras.en: Greenhouse gas, which is currently responsible for nearly one third of global warming, is particularly polluting. It traps 86 times more heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period, the UN warns.
paras.zh: 温室气体造成的污染尤其严重，目前全球变暖的近三分之一是由温室气体造成的。联合国警告称，在 20 年内，它吸收的热量是二氧化碳的 86 倍。

paras.en: Importantly, this decomposing food is one of the main drivers of methane emissions worldwide.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这种分解的食物是全球甲烷排放的主要驱动因素之一。

paras.en: In the United States, for instance, municipal solid waste landfills are the third largest source of human-related methane emissions.
paras.zh: 例如，在美国，城市固体废物填埋场是与人类相关的甲烷排放的第三大来源。

paras.en: The issue is inherently tied to the very large amount of food waste continuously produced around the world.
paras.zh: 这个问题本质上与世界各地不断产生的大量食物垃圾有关。

paras.en: Every day, more than one billion meals are left uneaten according to a UNEP report, with 60 per cent of this “mountain of discarded food” coming from households.
paras.zh: 根据环境署的一份报告，每天有超过 10 亿顿饭菜没有吃完，其中 60% 的“废弃食品山”来自家庭。

paras.en: This means that resources used to produce this uneaten food are also wasted. The UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) estimates that 1.4 billion hectares of land, or around 28 per cent of the world’s agricultural land, is used to produce food that is never eaten, while the water used to grow and prepare that food is also wasted.
paras.zh: 这意味着用于生产这种未食用食物的资源也被浪费了。联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 估计，有 14 亿公顷土地（约占世界农业用地的 28%）被用来生产从未被食用的食物，而用于种植和准备食物的水也被浪费了。

paras.en: As agricultural expansion remains a leading root of deforestation, food waste is thus also contributing to unnecessarily cutting down trees that can no longer pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 由于农业扩张仍然是森林砍伐的主要原因，食物浪费也导致了不必要的砍伐树木，这些树木不再能从大气中吸收二氧化碳。

paras.en: At the same time, methane, which rotting food waste emits, is short-lived: it breaks down much faster in the atmosphere than carbon dioxide.
paras.zh: 与此同时，腐烂的食物垃圾排放的甲烷是短暂的：它在大气中的分解速度比二氧化碳快得多。

paras.en: This means that cutting methane emissions today can produce climate benefits within decades.
paras.zh: 这意味着今天减少甲烷排放可以在几十年内产生气候效益。

paras.en: “At a time when the world is searching for practical ways to slow warming quickly, tackling food waste may be one of the most immediate and cost-effective climate solutions available,” underscored Martin Krause, a UNEP official.
paras.zh: 环境署官员马丁·克劳斯强调说：“当全世界都在寻找快速减缓变暖的实际方法时，解决食物浪费问题可能是最直接、最具成本效益的气候解决方案之一。”

paras.en: Yet, FAO warns that despite international commitments, there has been no tangible progress in reducing food losses since 2015, and the world remains far from achieving the Sustainable Development Goal target of halving per capita global food waste by 2030.
paras.zh: 然而，粮农组织警告说，尽管国际社会做出了承诺，但自2015年以来，在减少粮食损失方面尚未取得切实进展，而且世界距离实现到2030年将全球人均粮食浪费减半的可持续发展目标还很遥远。

paras.en: “We have to move faster,” stressed UNEP’s Mr. Krause.
paras.zh: “我们必须加快步伐，”联合国环境规划署的克劳斯先生强调。

paras.en: Aside from cleaning your plate, effective methane-reduction tools are being deployed around the world.
paras.zh: 除了清洁你的盘子之外，世界各地还在部署有效的减少甲烷排放的工具。

paras.en: Eleven governments in Africa committed to reducing methane emissions by incorporating waste pickers into formal waste management systems, training them on how to sort and compost organic waste. With funding from the UNEP-convened Climate and Clean Air Coalition, these initiatives have improved the livelihoods of waste pickers, raised awareness of waste separation and led to creating community composting sites.
paras.zh: 非洲十一个政府承诺通过将垃圾收集者纳入正式的垃圾管理系统来减少甲烷排放，并对他们进行如何分类和堆肥有机垃圾的培训。在环境署召集的气候和清洁空气联盟的资助下，这些举措改善了垃圾捡拾者的生计，提高了垃圾分类的意识，并促成了社区堆肥场的创建。

paras.en: An alternative to composting, black soldier flies bred by specialised facilities around the world are being used to recycle organic material. From Malawi to Uganda, these helpful insects are already part of waste management systems in a growing number of villages and cities.
paras.zh: 作为堆肥的替代方案，世界各地专门设施培育的黑水虻正被用来回收有机材料。从马拉维到乌干达，这些有益的昆虫已经成为越来越多村庄和城市废物管理系统的一部分。

articles.title: Broncos demolish Doncaster 78-6 in Championship Grand Final

paras.en: Championship Grand Final: London Broncos demolish Doncaster in 78-6 victory to complete treble
paras.zh: 冠军总决赛：伦敦野马队以78-6击败唐卡斯特队完成三冠王

paras.en: London Broncos were dominant with a 78-6 victory over Doncaster in the Championship Grand Final; It means they have completed the treble after winning the League Leaders' Shield and 1895 trophy
paras.zh: 伦敦野马队在冠军总决赛中以 78-6 战胜唐卡斯特队，占据统治地位；这意味着他们在赢得联赛领袖盾牌和1895年奖杯后完成了三冠王

paras.en: London Broncos are Championship Grand Final winners following a 78-6 win over Doncaster RLFC.
paras.zh: 伦敦野马队 (London Broncos) 以 78-6 击败唐卡斯特 RLFC，夺得冠军总决赛冠军。

paras.en: Jason Demetriou's side completed the 'treble' after sweeping aside the South Yorkshire club this afternoon.
paras.zh: 杰森·德米特里奥的球队今天下午横扫南约克郡俱乐部后完成了“三冠王”。

paras.en: They had already eased to the League Leaders' Shield in August and quickly added the 1895 Cup to their haul after defeating Widnes Vikings.
paras.zh: 他们在 8 月份已经轻松获得联盟领袖盾牌，并在击败威德尼斯维京人队后迅速将 1895 年杯冠军收入囊中。

paras.en: London lost just one of their 24 regular round games and, therefore, were overwhelming favourites to go on and claim the Championship title after successfully navigating the play-offs.
paras.zh: 伦敦队在 24 场常规比赛中只输掉了一场，因此在成功晋级附加赛后，他们是继续夺冠的热门球队。

paras.en: They duly did with a commanding display at Cherry Red Records Stadium, racing into a 38-0 interval lead and never looking back.
paras.zh: 他们在樱桃红唱片体育场 (Cherry Red Records Stadium) 上演了一场精彩的比赛，以 38-0 领先，并且一往无前。

paras.en: Jimmy Meadows finished with a personal haul of 20 points courtesy of two tries and six goals while Robert Mathias, Siliva Havili, Connor O'Beirne, Emarly Bitungane, Dean Hawkins and newly-crowned Championship Player of the Year Gairo Voro all also crossed.
paras.zh: 吉米·梅多斯 (Jimmy Meadows) 通过两次尝试和 6 个进球，个人获得 20 分，而罗伯特·马蒂亚斯 (Robert Mathias)、西利瓦·哈维利 (Siliva Havili)、康纳·奥贝尔纳 (Connor O'Beirne)、埃玛丽·比特冈 (Emarly Bitungane)、迪恩·霍金斯 (Dean Hawkins) 和新加冕的年度最佳球员盖罗·沃罗 (Gairo Voro) 也全部过关。

paras.en: Papuan star Voro added four conversions and Luke Smith - in his final game before returning to the NRL with Perth Bears - added a last-minute penalty.
paras.zh: 巴布亚球星沃罗完成了四次转换，卢克·史密斯在随珀斯熊队返回 NRL 之前的最后一场比赛中在最后一刻罚进了一个点球。

paras.en: Doncaster, who had impressively worked their way to the showpiece from fourth spot, could only muster a 64th-minute Luis Johnson try, improved by Connor Robinson.
paras.zh: 唐卡斯特以令人印象深刻的方式从第四位晋级，但只能在第 64 分钟由路易斯·约翰逊 (Luis Johnson) 射门，由康纳·罗宾逊 (Connor Robinson) 改进。

paras.en: The game marked the last professional outing for Doncaster star Reece Lyne, the ex-Hull FC, Wakefield Trinity and England centre who now retires aged 33, plus former Leeds Rhinos winger Luke Briscoe.
paras.zh: 这场比赛是唐卡斯特球星里斯·莱恩、前赫尔足球俱乐部、韦克菲尔德三一队和现年 33 岁退役的英格兰中锋，以及前利兹犀牛队边锋卢克·布里斯科的最后一次职业比赛。

articles.title: Labuschagne hits timely ton as Australia warm up for South Africa Tests

paras.en: Australia's Marnus Labuschagne hits timely hundred ahead of South Africa Test series, live on Sky Sports from Friday
paras.zh: 澳大利亚选手马努斯·拉布沙涅 (Marnus Labuschagne) 在南非测试系列赛之前及时打进百分，天空体育周五开始直播

paras.en: Steve Smith scores half-century as he warms up for first Test in South Africa since ball-tampering scandal in 2018; Australia playing the Proteas in Durban, Gqeberha and Cape Town; England to take on South Africa in three Test matches this winter, starting in Johannesburg on December 17
paras.zh: 自 2018 年篡球丑闻以来，史蒂夫·史密斯 (Steve Smith) 在为南非首次测试热身时取得了半个世纪的成绩；澳大利亚在德班、格凯贝哈和开普敦对阵 Proteas；英格兰将于今年冬天在约翰内斯堡开始三场测试赛，对阵南非

paras.en: Marnus Labuschagne scored a speedy, and timely, century in Australia's sole warm-up match before the three-Test series in South Africa from Friday, live on Sky Sports Cricket.
paras.zh: 马努斯·拉布沙涅 (Marnus Labuschagne) 在澳大利亚唯一一场热身赛中迅速、及时地打进了一个世纪球，随后周五在南非举行了三场测试赛，天空体育板球直播。

paras.en: Labuschagne struck 111 from 89 balls, including 19 fours, before retiring out against a Cricket South Africa Invitation XI in Potchefstroom.
paras.zh: 拉布沙涅在波切夫斯特鲁姆举行的板球南非邀请赛第十一届比赛中退役之前，共打出 89 个球，其中 19 个四分球，打出 111 个球。

paras.en: The 32-year-old will hope to carry that form into the Test arena, starting in Durban this week, having gone 43 innings and over three years without a hundred in the format.
paras.zh: 这位 32 岁的选手希望将这种状态带入测试赛场，从本周在德班开始，他已经打了 43 局，并且在三年多的时间里没有参加过 100 局比赛。

paras.en: - Scorecard: CSA Invitation XI vs Australia, Potchefstroom
paras.zh: - 记分卡：CSA 邀请赛 XI 对阵澳大利亚，波切夫斯特鲁姆

paras.en: - Sky Sports to show South Africa's home matches
paras.zh: - 天空体育转播南非主场比赛

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播

paras.en: After Labuschagne made scores of one, 31 and four in the recent 1-1 series draw at home to Bangladesh, ex-Australia captain Ricky Ponting told Sky Sports thar the batter's spot in the XI had become "untenable".
paras.zh: 在拉布沙涅最近在主场1-1战平孟加拉国的系列赛中分别打出一杆、31杆和四杆后，前澳大利亚队队长里基·庞廷告诉天空体育，这位击球手在首发阵容中的位置已经“站不住脚”了。

paras.en: However, the Baggy Greens have kept faith with the South Africa-born player and he seems set to line up in his usual No 3 berth at Kingsmead as Australia begin their first Test series in the country since the 2018 ball-tampering scandal.
paras.zh: 然而，松松垮垮的绿队对这位出生于南非的球员一直保持着信心，随着澳大利亚自 2018 年篡球丑闻以来在该国开始他们的首次测试系列赛，他似乎将在金麦德站上他通常的三号位。

paras.en: Smith scores half-century in Test tune-up
paras.zh: 史密斯在测试调整中取得了半个世纪的成绩

paras.en: Steve Smith - who along with David Warner and Cameron Bancroft received a ban for the role he played in using sandpaper to alter the condition of the ball - Josh Hazlewood, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Nathan Lyon and Matt Renshaw are the survivors from that contest eight years ago.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·史密斯（Steve Smith）与大卫·沃纳（David Warner）和卡梅伦·班克罗夫特（Cameron Bancroft）因使用砂纸改变球的状况而受到禁赛。乔什·黑兹尔伍德（Josh Hazlewood）、帕特·康明斯（Pat Cummins）、米切尔·斯塔克（Mitchell Starc）、内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）和马特·伦肖（Matt Renshaw）是八年前那场比赛的幸存者。

paras.en: Smith, who followed Labuschagne in retiring out, and Renshaw scored 61 and 32 respectively on the second and final day of the tune-up for this month's Tests, while Alex Carey made 57 as Australia replied to the hosts' 318-7 with 368-6.
paras.zh: 继拉布沙涅之后退役的史密斯和伦肖在本月测试赛的第二天和最后一天分别打出61杆和32杆，而亚历克斯·凯里则打出57杆，澳大利亚队以368-6回应东道主的318-7。

paras.en: On day one, Australia used 11 bowlers in order to manage workload with seven taking a wicket apiece and none of the seamers getting through more than 10 overs.
paras.zh: 第一天，澳大利亚队使用了 11 名投球手来控制工作量，其中 7 名投球手各拿了一个三柱门，而且没有一个投球手完成了超过 10 轮的比赛。

paras.en: All-rounder Cameron Green did not feature after picking up an abdominal injury in the final ODI against South Africa last week and appears a doubt for the first Test.
paras.zh: 全能选手卡梅伦·格林在上周对阵南非的最后一场 ODI 比赛中腹部受伤后没有出场，并且似乎无法参加第一次测试。

paras.en: After the series opener in Durban, the teams will meet in Gqeberha from October 18 and then Cape Town from October 27.
paras.zh: 在德班举行的系列赛揭幕战之后，两队将于 10 月 18 日在格贝哈进行比赛，然后从 10 月 27 日开始在开普敦进行比赛。

paras.en: South Africa also host Bangladesh and England in Test cricket this winter, with the series against Joe Root's men starting at Wanderers in Johannesburg on December 17.
paras.zh: 今年冬天，南非还将在板球测试赛中接待孟加拉国队和英格兰队，系列赛将于 12 月 17 日在约翰内斯堡流浪者队对阵乔·鲁特 (Joe Root) 的球队。

paras.en: Watch the first Test between South Africa and Australia live on Sky Sports Cricket from Friday (7.30am on air, 8.30am first ball).
paras.zh: 从周五开始，您可以在天空体育板球频道观看南非和澳大利亚之间的首次测试直播（上午 7.30 直播，上午 8.30 第一场球）。

articles.title: Sale defy Vermeulen's first-half red card to beat Saracens

paras.en: Gallagher Prem: Sale Sharks defy Jacques Vermeulen's first-half red card to beat Saracens
paras.zh: 加拉格尔·普雷姆：塞尔鲨鱼队无视雅克·维尔穆伦上半场的红牌，击败了撒拉逊人

paras.en: Sale Sharks' Jacques Vermeulen received a 20-minute red card for a tackle on Tomos Williams in the first half; Sale's Alex Lozowski had also seen yellow for a similar offence; Sale managed to hold on and get the win
paras.zh: 塞尔鲨鱼队的雅克·维尔穆伦在上半场对托莫斯·威廉姆斯铲球，在 20 分钟内被红牌罚下；塞尔队的亚历克斯·洛佐斯基（Alex Lozowski）也因类似的犯规而被黄牌警告。销售成功坚持住并获得胜利

paras.en: Sale defied Jacques Vermeulen's first-half red card to dispatch Saracens 21-17 with Tom O'Flaherty emerging as the star of a slugfest at StoneX Stadium.
paras.zh: 塞尔无视雅克·维尔穆伦上半场的红牌，以 21-17 击败撒拉逊人，汤姆·奥弗莱厄蒂 (Tom O'Flaherty) 成为斯通克斯体育场 (StoneX Stadium) 激战中的明星。

paras.en: Vermeulen was shown a 20-minute red for a dangerous tackle on Tomos Williams at a point in the first half when Alex Lozowski was in the sin bin because of the same offence.
paras.zh: 费尔默伦在上半场的某个时刻因对托莫斯·威廉姆斯的危险铲球而被出示红牌，当时亚历克斯·洛佐夫斯基也因同样的犯规而被扔进了垃圾箱。

paras.en: Saracens then took control but it was only temporary and in the 41st minute O'Flaherty produced the match's pivotal moment by racing over for a dynamic solo try.
paras.zh: 撒拉逊人随后控制了比赛，但这只是暂时的，在第 41 分钟，奥弗拉赫蒂通过一次充满活力的单人尝试创造了比赛的关键时刻。

paras.en: - Latest rugby union news, headlines, results and reports
paras.zh: - 最新的橄榄球联盟新闻、头条新闻、结果和报告

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？无需签订合同即可观看天空体育或直播

paras.en: It was part of a dominant second half from Sale, who capitalised on the hosts' lifeless performance to bounce back after losing to Bristol on the opening weekend with their hooker Nathan Jibulu also outstanding.
paras.zh: 这是塞尔下半场占据统治地位的一部分，他们在首周末输给布里斯托尔后，利用东道主毫无生气的表现反弹，他们的妓女内森·吉布卢也表现出色。

paras.en: Referee Joe James and TMO Hamish Smales experienced a busy opening half an hour, issuing two cards and disallowing a Saracens try.
paras.zh: 裁判乔·詹姆斯和 TMO 哈米什·斯梅尔斯经历了半个小时的繁忙开场，发出了两张牌并禁止撒拉逊人的尝试。

paras.en: It had started so well for Sale when Jibulu finished a driving maul but soon after centre Lozowski was sent to the sin bin for a high tackle on Alfie Barbeary, who was forced off for an HIA.
paras.zh: 当吉布鲁（Jibulu）完成一次冲撞时，塞尔（Sale）的开局非常好，但不久之后中锋洛佐夫斯基（Lozowski）因对阿尔菲·巴比里（Alfie Barbeary）的高铲而被送入垃圾箱，后者因 HIA 被迫下场。

paras.en: Worse was to come when Vermeulen was given his marching orders for a dangerous challenge on Williams as the Sharks looked to press home an attack down the right touchline.
paras.zh: 更糟糕的是，当维尔穆伦接到对威廉姆斯发起危险挑战的命令时，鲨鱼队希望从右侧边线发起进攻。

paras.en: It meant Saracens were given the opportunity to play against 13 for three minutes and Sale's situation would have deteriorated further had Courtney Lawes not seen an attempted deliberate knock go backwards.
paras.zh: 这意味着撒拉逊人有机会与 13 人比赛三分钟，如果考特尼·劳斯没有看到有人故意向后击球，塞尔的情况将会进一步恶化。

paras.en: Almost immediately the hosts appeared to have taken advantage but a Nick Tompkins try was ruled out because of obstruction by Nick Isiekwe and it was not until Eroni Mawi bundled over in the 34th minute that they were off the mark.
paras.zh: 主队几乎立刻就占据了优势，但尼克·汤普金斯的射门因尼克·伊西奎的阻挡而被排除，直到第 34 分钟埃罗尼·马维的射门才使他们偏离目标。

paras.en: For all Saracens' sustained pressure they still trailed 7-5 and a minute into the second half that became 14-5 after O'Flaherty caught a George Ford up and under that went sideways and then slipped through the home defence before sprinting over.
paras.zh: 尽管撒拉森人持续施压，他们仍然以7-5落后，下半场一分钟后，奥弗拉赫蒂抓住了乔治·福特，乔治·福特横向移动，然后滑过主场防守，然后冲过去，比分变成14-5。

paras.en: Sale ran out of tacklers to enable Sione Va'enuku to strike back almost immediately but they resumed on the front foot and were frustrated to be penalised just short of the whitewash on two occasions.
paras.zh: 塞尔耗尽了铲球手，使西奥内·瓦埃努库几乎立即反击，但他们恢复了前脚，并因两次在差点被罚球而感到沮丧。

paras.en: They continued knocking on the door and suddenly changed pace with a series of runs gaining yards until Ford sent Ben Bamber galloping over.
paras.zh: 他们继续敲门，突然改变了步伐，一连串的跑动增加了码数，直到福特让本·班伯疾驰过来。

paras.en: Sale now led 21-10 and Saracens' dismal afternoon continued when Theo Dan limped off while his fellow hooker Jamie George watched from the stands, sidelined by injury.
paras.zh: 塞尔现在以 21-10 领先，撒拉逊人阴沉的下午还在继续，西奥·丹 (Theo Dan) 一瘸一拐地下场，而他的妓女同伴杰米·乔治 (Jamie George) 因伤缺席，在看台上观看比赛。

paras.en: Charlie Bracken combined with brother Jack to race over with eight minutes to go and the Sharks then let another commanding position slip away because of a penalty close to the line, but they had already done enough to see off Saracens.
paras.zh: 查理·布雷肯 (Charlie Bracken) 与兄弟杰克 (Jack) 联手在比赛还剩八分钟时奋起直追，鲨鱼队随后因罚球线附近的罚球让另一个指挥位置溜走，但他们已经做了足够多的努力来击退撒拉逊人。

articles.title: British police find no explosives in vehicles of men detained near base used by U.S.
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: No explosives were found in vehicles searched after five men were arrested in connection with a huge security operation near an air base the U.S. Air Force uses to facilitate strikes on Iran, British counterterrorism police confirmed Tuesday.
paras.zh: 英国反恐警察周二证实，五名男子因参与美国空军用于协助袭击伊朗的空军基地附近的大规模安全行动而被捕，搜查的车辆中没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: In an update explaining Monday’s decision to release all five suspects who were arrested on terrorism and explosives charges on bail, Laurence Taylor, Britain’s head of counterterrorism policing, said “a quantity” of gasoline was recovered from three vans near RAF Fairford.
paras.zh: 英国反恐警务负责人劳伦斯·泰勒(Laurence Taylor)在解释周一决定释放所有因恐怖主义和爆炸物指控被捕的五名嫌疑人的最新消息中表示，从英国皇家空军费尔福德附近的三辆货车中发现了“一定数量”的汽油。

paras.en: “Those vehicles have been subject to extensive examination, with the support of military assets and forensic experts, and we can confirm that no improvised explosive devices were found,” he said, adding that investigators had searched properties in London.
paras.zh: 他说：“在军事资产和法医专家的支持下，这些车辆已经接受了广泛的检查，我们可以确认没有发现简易爆炸装置。”他补充说，调查人员已搜查了伦敦的房产。

paras.en: Taylor said it was an “investigative decision” to release the men on bail, “grounded in experience and careful considerations of policing powers.”
paras.zh: 泰勒表示，保释这些人是一项“调查决定”，“基于经验和对治安权力的仔细考虑”。

paras.en: No charges have been filed against the men.
paras.zh: 目前尚未对这些人提出任何指控。

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters Tuesday that he was disappointed about that decision.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周二告诉记者，他对这一决定感到失望。

paras.en: “I’m just disappointed that they caught terrorists — they did a good job, and then they sort of let them go,” he said, adding, “How do you give bail to a terrorist?”
paras.zh: “我只是对他们抓获恐怖分子感到失望——他们做得很好，然后又放了他们，”他说，并补充道，“你如何保释恐怖分子？”

paras.en: Asked if it was a long-standing investigation, Trump replied, “A long standing. Yeah, we were involved in it.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这是否是一项长期调查时，特朗普回答说：“长期调查。是的，我们参与其中。”

paras.en: “They put them out on bail. I assume they have, they have them watched closely. But these were serious people, seriously bad people, and they should not have done that,” he added.
paras.zh: “他们将他们保释了。我想他们已经这么做了，他们对他们进行了密切监视。但这些人都是严肃的人，非常坏的人，他们不应该这样做，”他补充道。

paras.en: Trump also said he was surprised about the decision to release the men on bail on Monday. “I would have said, ‘Don’t let them have bail,’” Trump said in the Oval Office. “I’m surprised that they released them. I wouldn’t have done that.”
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，他对周一保释这些人的决定感到惊讶。 “我会说，‘不要让他们保释，’”特朗普在椭圆形办公室说道。 “我很惊讶他们竟然释放了他们。我不会那么做。”

paras.en: Trump indicated U.S. officials were cooperating with their British counterparts on the case.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，美国官员正在与英国同行就此案进行合作。

paras.en: “Look, they’ve been very good. They are working with us very closely,” he said, adding that the U.S. knew “everything” about the suspects.
paras.zh: “看，他们非常好。他们正在与我们非常密切地合作，”他说，并补充说美国了解嫌疑人的“一切”。

paras.en: Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the incident “clearly involves the hands of a foreign actor” — an allegation British officials haven’t confirmed.
paras.zh: 另外，国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，这起事件“显然涉及外国演员”——英国官员尚未证实这一指控。

paras.en: The five men, all British nationals in their 20s from London, were arrested Sunday on suspicion of terrorism and explosives offenses after three vehicles were seen moving toward RAF Fairford, a British air force station about 90 minutes west of London.
paras.zh: 这五名男子都是来自伦敦的 20 多岁英国公民，他们于周日因涉嫌恐怖主义和爆炸罪而被捕，原因是有人看到三辆汽车驶向距离伦敦以西约 90 分钟路程的英国皇家空军费尔福德基地。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police took over the case after a major incident was declared, disrupting life in the normally quiet, rural community of the Cotswolds.
paras.zh: 反恐警察在宣布发生重大事件后接手了此案，扰乱了科茨沃尔德通常安静的乡村社区的生活。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police said Sunday that the men had been arrested on suspicion of committing offenses under the Explosives Act, British legislation dating to 1875 that regulates manufacturing, keeping, selling, carrying and importing gunpowder and explosive substances. The men were further suspected of preparation of a terrorist act.
paras.zh: 反恐警察周日表示，这些人因涉嫌违反《爆炸物法》而被捕，该法是英国于 1875 年制定的立法，旨在规范火药和爆炸物的制造、保存、销售、运输和进口。这些人还涉嫌准备恐怖活动。

paras.en: “What seems to be happening is that you’ve got a developing investigation where the custody clock for the terrorism arrest, which is a very long custody clock, has stopped,” said Max Hill, a former director of public prosecutions of England and Wales.
paras.zh: 英格兰和威尔士前检察长马克斯·希尔 (Max Hill) 表示：“目前的情况似乎是，调查正在进行中，逮捕恐怖主义分子的拘留时间（这是一个非常长的拘留时间）已经停止了。”

paras.en: In the U.K., police can usually hold people for up to 24 hours before they have to charge or release them, although officers can apply to extend that time if they suspect a serious crime has been committed. Suspects arrested under the Terrorism Act can be held without charge for up to 14 days.
paras.zh: 在英国，警方通常可以将人拘留长达 24 小时，然后才必须指控或释放他们，不过如果警察怀疑发生了严重犯罪，可以申请延长这一时间。根据《恐怖主义法》被捕的嫌疑人可在不受到指控的情况下被拘留最多 14 天。

paras.en: “So there must be an element of uncertainty about whether ultimately any terrorism-related charges are going to emerge,” Hill said in a telephone interview Tuesday. Releasing the suspects on bail also doesn’t mean they won’t be taken back into custody, he added. “But it does indicate that there’s just not enough for a formal remand application.”
paras.zh: “因此，最终是否会出现任何与恐怖主义相关的指控，肯定存在一定的不确定性，”希尔周二在接受电话采访时表示。他补充说，保释嫌疑人并不意味着他们不会被重新拘留。 “但这确实表明，正式还押申请还不够。”

paras.en: The incident prompted questions about whether a foreign actor could be involved — in particular, Iran. Its Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned Britain this summer that RAF Fairford could be a “legitimate target” months after then-Prime Minister Keir Starmer gave permission for the U.S. to use its bases for “specific and limited defensive” operations against Iran.
paras.zh: 这一事件引发了人们的疑问：是否有外国势力参与其中——尤其是伊朗。今年夏天，英国伊斯兰革命卫队警告英国，英国皇家空军费尔福德可能成为“合法目标”，几个月前，时任英国首相基尔·斯塔默允许美国使用其基地对伊朗进行“具体和有限的防御”行动。

paras.en: The Iranian Embassy in Britain denied any involvement Monday.
paras.zh: 伊朗驻英国大使馆周一否认与此事有任何关系。

paras.en: In an appearance on Fox News later Monday, Rubio said, “What happened, what almost happened, what could have happened in the U.K. over the weekend is a very serious situation.”
paras.zh: 周一晚些时候，卢比奥在福克斯新闻节目中表示，“周末在英国发生的事情、差点发生的事情以及可能发生的事情是一个非常严重的情况。”

paras.en: “There’s a lot more news that’ll come out on this in the days to come,” he added.
paras.zh: “未来几天将会有更多关于此事的消息发布，”他补充道。

paras.en: Taylor said that “it was simply not possible for me to go into detail about every strand that we are looking at and all of the intelligence we have got,” which he said wasn’t unusual for such an investigation.
paras.zh: 泰勒说，“我根本不可能详细了解我们正在研究的每一条线索以及我们获得的所有情报”，他说这对于此类调查来说并不罕见。

paras.en: “It is unusual for it to be as visible as it is in this incident,” he said, adding that his team was working with international partners.
paras.zh: 他说：“它在这起事件中如此明显，这是不寻常的。”他补充说，他的团队正在与国际合作伙伴合作。

articles.title: Settlers clash with Israeli forces to block Palestinian family’s return home
articles.author: Matt Bradley

paras.en: TEL AVIV — Dozens of Jewish settlers repulsed an attempt by Israeli security forces to return a Palestinian family to its home in the occupied West Bank before setting fire to its property and car.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——数十名犹太定居者击退了以色列安全部队试图将一个巴勒斯坦家庭送回被占领约旦河西岸的家的企图，然后放火焚烧了其财产和汽车。

paras.en: The Tubassi family was forced to leave its home in July following a weekslong siege by violent settlers in the West Bank town of Jalud. But after security forces tried to enforce an order by Israel’s High Court of Justice to facilitate the family’s return Monday night, an extended and violent confrontation ensued, Mahmoud Tubassi, 60, said.
paras.zh: 在约旦河西岸城镇贾鲁德遭受暴力定居者长达一周的围困后，图巴西一家于 7 月被迫离开家园。但 60 岁的马哈茂德·图巴西 (Mahmoud Tubassi) 表示，周一晚上，安全部队试图执行以色列高等法院的命令，为一家人返回提供便利，随后发生了一场旷日持久的暴力冲突。

paras.en: “I went through a terrifying experience that I could never have imagined,” he said in a telephone interview Tuesday. “We saw death with our own eyes. Death came very close to us at the hands of the settlers.”
paras.zh: “我经历了一次我从未想象过的可怕经历，”他在周二的电话采访中说道。 “我们亲眼目睹了死亡。死亡在定居者手中离我们非常近。”

paras.en: It is the second time that Tubassi and his wife, Aida Ahmed Abdullah, 51, have suffered at the hands of Jewish settlers in just over a month. On Aug. 28, masked settlers attacked and injured them and an NBC News crew that was interviewing them. The crew were injured and Abdullah was beaten unconscious but has since recovered.
paras.zh: 这是图巴西和他 51 岁的妻子艾达·艾哈迈德·阿卜杜拉在短短一个多月内第二次遭受犹太定居者的迫害。 8 月 28 日，蒙面定居者袭击并伤害了他们以及正在采访他们的 NBC 新闻工作人员。船员受伤，阿卜杜拉被打昏，但现已康复。

paras.en: Tubassi said their latest ordeal began just before midnight Monday when Abdel Azim Wadi, the mayor of the nearby village of Qusra, which has also faced serious settler violence, told him that Israeli officials would accompany him, his wife and their son Wael Tubassi, 33, to their home in Jalud.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，他们最近的磨难始于周一午夜之前，附近库斯拉村的村长阿卜杜勒·阿齐姆·瓦迪 (Abdel Azim Wadi) 告诉他，以色列官员将陪伴他、他的妻子和 33 岁的儿子瓦尔·图巴西 (Wael Tubassi) 前往贾鲁德的家。库斯拉村也面临着严重的定居者暴力。

paras.en: After they were picked up by four Israeli vehicles, they were driven the short distance to their home — two structures that sit in a small walled compound atop a hill, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，他们被四辆以色列车辆接走后，经过很短的距离就回到了自己的家——两栋建筑坐落在山顶的一个小围墙院落里。

paras.en: As the family arrived, settlers started throwing stones at the armed police and military, who responded with tear gas and stun grenades, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，当这家人到达时，定居者开始向武装警察和军队投掷石块，武装警察和军队则用催泪瓦斯和眩晕手榴弹予以回应。

paras.en: “They could shoot rubber bullets, they could fire live bullets in air,” Tubassi said of the Israeli security forces’ response. “They could use force, but they didn’t do anything, unfortunately,” he added.
paras.zh: “他们可以发射橡皮子弹，他们可以在空中发射实弹，”图巴西谈到以色列安全部队的反应时说道。 “他们可以使用武力，但不幸的是他们没有采取任何行动，”他补充道。

paras.en: Describing the violence as “severe,” the Israel Defense Forces said in a statement that “violent rioters began arriving” after the Tubassis entered their home.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军在一份声明中将暴力事件描述为“严重”，并表示，在图巴西人进入他们的家后，“暴力骚乱者开始到来”。

paras.en: “They set fire to the neighboring house and subsequently entered the family’s home, where severe violence began,” the statement said, adding that the rioters “blocked access roads with large rocks, set tires on fire, threw rocks at security forces, and set fire to Palestinian structures and vehicles.”
paras.zh: 声明称：“他们放火烧毁了邻近的房屋，随后进入了这家人的家，在那里开始了严重的暴力行为。”声明还补充说，骚乱者“用大石头堵塞了道路，点燃轮胎，向安全部队投掷石块，并放火焚烧巴勒斯坦建筑物和车辆。”

paras.en: As a result, “three Border Police officers were injured and a security forces vehicle was damaged,” the IDF statement said.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军声明称，结果“三名边防警察受伤，一辆安全部队车辆被损坏”。

paras.en: The IDF did not immediately respond to NBC News’ request for comment on whether stun grenades and tear gas had been used to try to disperse the rioters.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军没有立即回应 NBC 新闻就是否使用眩晕手榴弹和催泪瓦斯来试图驱散骚乱者发表评论的请求。

paras.en: After the settlers entered the property, Tubassi said, his family was urged by the Israeli security forces to go to the roof, where the settlers followed them. Several of the soldiers and officers formed a physical barrier between the family and the settlers, Tubassi said.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，定居者进入该房产后，以色列安全部队敦促他的家人前往屋顶，定居者也跟着他们。图巴西说，几名士兵和军官在这家人和定居者之间形成了物理屏障。

paras.en: Tubassi said the security officials told them to get back in an armored car and drove them to safety.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，安全官员让他们乘坐装甲车返回，并将他们带到安全的地方。

paras.en: The security forces’ failure to return the Tubassis to their home comes as settler violence in the occupied West Bank has become a growing international embarrassment for Israeli leaders, who have struggled to explain how Israel’s formidable military has repeatedly found itself outmatched by hundreds of lightly armed young men.
paras.zh: 安全部队未能将图巴西人送回家园之际，被占领的约旦河西岸定居者的暴力行为已经成为以色列领导人日益感到的国际尴尬，他们一直在努力解释以色列强大的军队如何屡屡被数百名轻武装的年轻人击败。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned the attacks in a statement Tuesday and called on the rioters to be prosecuted. The “handful of rioters are not representative of the law-abiding settler public in Judea and Samaria,” he said, using the biblical and historical term for the West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周二在一份声明中谴责袭击事件，并呼吁起诉骚乱者。他说，“少数骚乱者不能代表犹太和撒马利亚守法的定居者公众”，他用的是约旦河西岸的圣经和历史术语。

paras.en: The statement echoed his comments at the United Nations General Assembly last week, in which he rejected “vigilantism” by Jewish settlers in the West Bank but sought to minimize the violence, suggesting the problem only involved “a handful of juvenile delinquents, about 150 in number, who throw stones, who down olive trees, occasionally they light some fires.”
paras.zh: 该声明呼应了他上周在联合国大会上的言论，其中他拒绝接受约旦河西岸犹太定居者的“私刑主义”，但力求将暴力降到最低，暗示问题只涉及“少数青少年犯罪分子，人数约 150 人，他们投掷石块，从橄榄树上掉下来，偶尔还会生火。”

paras.en: According to the U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), some 6,500 Palestinians have been displaced due to settler attacks in the West Bank since 2023. Between Jan. 1 and July 24, Israeli forces or settlers killed 76 Palestinians, according to the latest data available from OCHA. Three Israelis were killed over the same period, the data shows.
paras.zh: 据联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 称，自 2023 年以来，约 6,500 名巴勒斯坦人因定居者在西岸的袭击而流离失所。根据 OCHA 提供的最新数据，1 月 1 日至 7 月 24 日期间，以色列军队或定居者杀害了 76 名巴勒斯坦人。数据显示，三名以色列人在同一时期被杀。

paras.en: The agency recorded nearly 200 settler attacks that resulted in Palestinian casualties or property damage in August alone.
paras.zh: 该机构记录了仅 8 月份就发生了近 200 起定居者袭击事件，造成巴勒斯坦人伤亡或财产损失。

paras.en: Israel has regularly accused the U.N. of siding against it. But many governments around the world consider the West Bank to be illegally occupied by Israel.
paras.zh: 以色列经常指责联合国站在一边反对它。但世界许多国家政府认为约旦河西岸被以色列非法占领。

paras.en: Monday night’s police and military action in Jalud was an attempt to execute an order by Israel’s High Court of Justice, which had instructed the “relevant authorities” earlier this month to ensure that the Tubassis return to their home within two weeks.
paras.zh: 周一晚上在贾鲁德的警察和军事行动是为了执行以色列高等法院的一项命令，该法院本月早些时候指示“有关当局”确保图巴斯一家在两周内返回家园。

paras.en: The court also demanded that security forces explain to the Tubassis and another Palestinian family “why they are not working to return the family to their homes and why they are not removing the barriers and obstacles blocking access to the houses.”
paras.zh: 法院还要求安全部队向图巴斯一家和另一个巴勒斯坦家庭解释“为什么他们不努力让家人返回家园，以及为什么他们不清除阻碍进入房屋的障碍和障碍”。

paras.en: It was unclear Tuesday if or when the police and military would try to execute the court’s order again, and the Israel Defense Forces said it had no details about how the issue would be handled in the near term.
