paras.zh: 2015 年，霍尔向女友艾丽西亚·梅勒 (Alicia Meller) 承诺，当他们组建家庭时，他会找到一条更安全的道路。他们很快就结婚了。他还在福克斯伦敦分社找到了一份全职工作，该工作仍然需要报道冲突和冲突。但在 2021 年，霍尔搬到华盛顿特区，负责美国国务院的工作。

paras.en: "I made that final decision to pull back from the front lines," Hall wrote. "It was much harder than I imagined it would be to make this professional change in my life; the pull of distant wars never weakened or went away. But I understood new paths were opening for me."
paras.zh: “我做出了从前线撤军的最终决定，”霍尔写道。 “在我的生活中做出这种职业改变比我想象的要困难得多；遥远战争的吸引力从未减弱或消失。但我知道新的道路正在为我敞开。”

paras.en: That new path lasted roughly four months.
paras.zh: 这条新道路持续了大约四个月。

paras.en: On Feb. 24, 2022, Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the invasion of Ukraine. Hall got a call from a Fox News executive: Would he go overseas and cover the war? As he wrote, "I understood my obligations to Alicia and my family, and I knew I had to stop putting myself in dangerous situations."
paras.zh: 2022年2月24日，俄罗斯总统普京宣布入侵乌克兰。霍尔接到福克斯新闻高管的电话：他会去海外报道战争吗？正如他所写，“我明白我对艾丽西亚和我的家人的义务，我知道我必须停止让自己陷入危险的境地。”

paras.en: Four days after the Russians invaded, Hall arrived in the city of Lviv. It was an arduous drive from Poland; he was swimming against the tide as long columns of motorists were fleeing Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯人入侵四天后，霍尔抵达利沃夫市。从波兰出发，经过一段艰苦的车程；当一长串驾车者逃离乌克兰时，他正在逆流而上。

paras.en: He started reporting and hosting a show that aired nightly on Fox. The major action, however, was hundreds of miles to the east.
paras.zh: 他开始报道并主持福克斯每晚播出的节目。然而，主要行动发生在以东数百英里处。

paras.en: Fox had established news coverage from Kyiv with a team of journalists; now it was pulling producers out as the risk increased. Only a skeleton crew remained.
paras.zh: 福克斯与一组记者在基辅建立了新闻报道；现在，随着风险的增加，它正在将生产商撤出。只剩下骨干人员了。

paras.en: Yet Fox summoned all its journalists in Lviv for a Zoom call, Hall wrote in Saved. Executives hoped to send another correspondent to Kyiv.
paras.zh: 霍尔在 Saved 中写道，然而福克斯召集了利沃夫的所有记者进行 Zoom 电话会议。高管们希望派另一名记者前往基辅。

paras.en: "All of us wanted to go, including me," Hall wrote. He was the one invited.
paras.zh: “我们所有人都想去，包括我，”霍尔写道。他是被邀请的人。

paras.en: Hall's wife urged him not to go, he wrote. He assured her he'd be fine.
paras.zh: 他写道，霍尔的妻子敦促他不要去。他向她保证他会没事的。

paras.en: Fox had a team of high-risk security contractors to keep its journalists safe. Such security advisers typically have military backgrounds. They provide guidance, muscle and medical aid. They can also serve as a brake on journalists who put their hunger for a story ahead of their own well-being.
paras.zh: 福克斯拥有一支由高风险安全承包商组成的团队来保证记者的安全。此类安全顾问通常具有军事背景。他们提供指导、肌肉和医疗援助。它们还可以对那些把对报道的渴望置于自身福祉之上的记者起到制止作用。

paras.en: Aaron King was one of Fox's high-risk security advisers. He says that like Hall's wife — and like another Fox safety contractor — he told Hall not to go to Kyiv.
paras.zh: 亚伦·金是福克斯的高风险安全顾问之一。他说，就像霍尔的妻子一样，也像另一位福克斯安全承包商一样，他告诉霍尔不要去基辅。

paras.en: "It wasn't in his best interest to go down there," King said. "And I asked him what he believed that he would achieve that other teams haven't already achieved at this point in time."
paras.zh: “去那里并不符合他的最佳利益，”金说。 “我问他相信自己能够实现哪些其他球队目前尚未实现的目标。”

paras.en: King says it was like all battle zone assignments — balancing the risks versus the possible reward.
paras.zh: 金说，这就像所有战区任务一样——平衡风险与可能的回报。

paras.en: "He kind of processed what I'd spoken to him about, for about 10 seconds, kind of shrugged his shoulders and said, 'Ah, I'll go anyway,'" King said. "And that was the last I seen of Benjamin."
paras.zh: “他花了大约 10 秒钟的时间消化了我跟他说的话，然后耸了耸肩说，‘啊，无论如何我都会去，’”金说。 “那是我最后一次见到本杰明。”

paras.en: In his book, Hall presented the pull to Kyiv as inescapable.
paras.zh: 霍尔在他的书中表示，基辅的吸引力是不可避免的。

paras.en: "I could not say no to the offer to go to Kyiv and continue anchoring the show from there," he wrote in Saved. "It was, in a way, the culmination of all that I had worked on and all the risks I'd taken before. It was the big one, the war that might change the world—change the course of history. This was who I was and what I had prepared to do."
paras.zh: “我无法拒绝前往基辅并继续在那里主持节目的提议，”他在 Saved 中写道。 “在某种程度上，这是我所做的一切以及我之前所冒的风险的顶峰。这是一场伟大的战争，可能会改变世界——改变历史的进程。这就是我，这就是我准备做的事情。”

paras.en: Sasha Kuvshynova: A life filled with promise
paras.zh: Sasha Kuvshynova：充满希望的生活

paras.en: Among the people Hall would encounter once he arrived in Kyiv was Sasha Kuvshynova, Fox's new Gen Z fixer.
paras.zh: 霍尔抵达基辅后会遇到的人中有萨沙·库夫希诺娃 (Sasha Kuvshynova)，她是福克斯的新 Z 世代修复者。

paras.en: Her Facebook page bears a motto in English: "if you never try you will never know."
paras.zh: 她的 Facebook 页面上有一句英文座右铭：“如果你不尝试，你永远不会知道。”

paras.en: Her other social media accounts brim with life too: music and film festivals, her photographic shoots, travel to Tuscany, pictures of her as a child, her cat, Zephyr. She posted about her pride that her father, trained as a physicist, taught her math.
paras.zh: 她的其他社交媒体账户也充满了活力：音乐和电影节、她的摄影作品、托斯卡纳旅行、她小时候的照片、她的猫 Zephyr。她在帖子中表示，她为自己受过物理学家训练的父亲教她数学而感到自豪。

paras.en: Her accounts turned grim starting in February 2022, after the invasion by Russia. After a Russian strike on the primary television tower in Kyiv, she posted on Instagram: "Glory to Ukraine!"
paras.zh: 自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯入侵后，她的账户开始变得严峻。俄罗斯袭击基辅主要电视塔后，她在 Instagram 上发帖称：“荣耀属于乌克兰！”

paras.en: Kuvshynova's mother, Iryna Mamaysur, and her father, Andriy Kuvshynov, spoke with pride laced with sorrow during hourslong interviews by video conference from NPR's Kyiv bureau, sometimes interrupted by air raid sirens. Their words were interpreted by two NPR Ukrainian producers present.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃的母亲伊琳娜·马马苏尔 (Iryna Mamaysur) 和父亲安德烈·库夫希诺夫 (Andriy Kuvshynov) 在美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 基辅分社的视频会议上接受长达数小时的采访，采访中充满了自豪，但也夹杂着悲伤，有时会被空袭警报打断。他们的话由在场的两名 NPR 乌克兰制片人进行了解读。

paras.en: Kuvshynova's parents say she was remarkable from her youngest years. (Under Ukrainian naming conventions, Kuvshynova took the surname of her father, with an added "a" to reflect her gender.) She learned to read by 3, mastered English by 11 and showed flair as an interpreter early on, her mother said.
paras.zh: 库夫申诺娃的父母说她从小就表现出色。 （根据乌克兰命名惯例，库夫希诺娃采用了她父亲的姓氏，并添加了“a”以反映她的性别。）她的母亲说，她三岁就学会了阅读，十一岁就掌握了英语，并很早就表现出了作为翻译的天赋。

paras.en: As a teen, Kuvshynova briefly aided foreign reporters during the popular uprising in 2014 against Ukraine's then pro-Russian president, who ultimately fled.
paras.zh: 十几岁的时候，库夫希诺娃在 2014 年反对乌克兰时任亲俄总统的民众起义期间曾短暂协助外国记者，但总统最终逃离。

paras.en: That's when she met Zakrzewski, the Fox video journalist, and discovered how to blend her interests into a single passion: to tell Ukraine's story.
paras.zh: 就在那时，她遇到了福克斯视频记者扎克热夫斯基，并发现了如何将自己的兴趣融入单一的热情：讲述乌克兰的故事。

paras.en: When Fox approached her in early 2022 to aid its reporting on the coming war, she embraced the offer eagerly.
paras.zh: 当福克斯于 2022 年初联系她，协助报道即将到来的战争时，她热切地接受了这一提议。

paras.en: "I will tell you that I was very glad," her father said. "I thought that getting into such a level of a global, vital company [would be a good experience]. Fascinating material, interesting people."
paras.zh: “我会告诉你，我很高兴，”她的父亲说。 “我认为进入这样一家全球性、充满活力的公司[将是一次很好的经历]。令人着迷的材料，有趣的人。”

paras.en: "She was excited," her mother recalled. "She said, 'I have already found my profession.'"
paras.zh: “她很兴奋，”她的母亲回忆道。 “她说，‘我已经找到了我的职业。’”

paras.en: Hall arrived in the Ukrainian capital on March 2.
paras.zh: 霍尔于3月2日抵达乌克兰首都。

paras.en: The Fox crew stayed at the InterContinental Kyiv, a luxury hotel in the historical heart of the Ukrainian capital. Other networks holed up there too. He encountered the familiar faces of Yingst and Zakrzewski, a crackerjack visual journalist with a big heart, a mischievous streak and a salt-and-pepper walrus mustache.
paras.zh: 福克斯剧组住在基辅洲际酒店，这是一家位于乌克兰首都历史中心的豪华酒店。其他网络也躲在那里。他遇到了英斯特和扎克热夫斯基熟悉的面孔，他们是一位出色的视觉记者，心胸宽广，脾气暴躁，留着海象般的胡须。

paras.en: Kuvshynova had also moved into the hotel. As a "fixer" for Fox, she was in touch with people in the Ukrainian military and the government and scouted possible sites and scenes to film. She knew the language, and she knew her way around. It was home.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃也搬进了酒店。作为福克斯的“调解人”，她与乌克兰军方和政府人员保持联系，寻找可能的拍摄地点和场景。她懂当地语言，也熟悉周围的环境。那是家。

paras.en: Kuvshynova would send her parents reassuring texts frequently. She let them know, for example, when she had returned from outings near battle zones.
paras.zh: 库夫申诺娃会经常给父母发安慰短信。例如，当她从战区附近外出回来时，她会让他们知道。

paras.en: "She said, 'Mom, don't worry. We have security on these crews who are very experienced,'" said her mother, Iryna Mamaysur.
paras.zh: “她说，‘妈妈，别担心。我们的保安人员都是经验丰富的，’”她的母亲伊琳娜·马马苏尔 (Iryna Mamaysur) 说道。

paras.en: And she joked, given the protective gear they all wore, that she was "a very fashionable lady who outfits our team."
paras.zh: 她开玩笑说，考虑到他们都穿着防护装备，她是“一位非常时尚的女士，为我们团队提供服装”。

paras.en: Toward the end of each day, the team would hold what it called "evening prayers," based on a British military practice. The crew would break down its intentions for the next day and map out the logistics with Fox producers and security consultants. Senior producers in London and Jerusalem and even executives in New York City would participate in the call.
paras.zh: 每天快结束时，团队都会根据英国军事惯例举行所谓的“晚间祈祷”。工作人员将分解第二天的意图，并与福克斯制片人和安全顾问一起制定后勤计划。伦敦和耶路撒冷的高级制作人，甚至纽约市的高管都将参加此次电话会议。

paras.en: A senior network executive or security official was supposed to sign off on each assignment, particularly if it involved going near the front, Thomson, the security adviser, wrote in his sworn affidavit.
paras.zh: 安全顾问汤姆森在宣誓证词中写道，每项任务都应该由一名高级网络主管或安全官员签字，特别是当涉及到前线时。

paras.en: Thomson also alleged in the affidavit that the staff — "overstressed and overworked" before Hall's arrival — began "working to the point of exhaustion." The presence of an additional correspondent put an additional burden on Kuvshynova in particular, he alleged.
paras.zh: 汤姆森还在证词中声称，在霍尔到来之前，工作人员“压力过大、工作过度”，开始“工作到精疲力尽的程度”。他声称，额外一名记者的出现给库夫希诺娃带来了额外的负担。

paras.en: Initially, Hall wrote, he continued to host the live show from a hotel room balcony in the freezing winter morning.
paras.zh: 霍尔写道，最初，他在寒冷的冬日早晨继续在酒店房间的阳台上主持现场表演。

paras.en: "You've got to try and get the pictures"
paras.zh: “你必须尝试去获取照片”

paras.en: Even in a war zone — especially in a war zone — television news stories are based on one thing.
paras.zh: 即使在战区——尤其是在战区——电视新闻报道也是基于一件事。

paras.en: "Inevitably, you've got to try and get the pictures," said Jon Williams, who oversaw international coverage at the BBC and ABC News and later led the Irish public broadcaster RTÉ.
paras.zh: “不可避免的是，你必须尝试拍摄照片，”乔恩·威廉姆斯 (Jon Williams) 说道。他曾负责 BBC 和 ABC News 的国际报道，后来领导了爱尔兰公共广播公司 RTÉ。

paras.en: "What's happening on the streets of Tehran or in Dubai or in Doha, when you can see buildings going up in flames — you have the images. You can tell the story. And there is a compelling reason to try and get the images."
paras.zh: “在德黑兰、迪拜或多哈的街道上发生的事情，当你看到建筑物在火焰中燃烧时——你就有了图像。你可以讲述故事。并且有一个令人信服的理由去尝试获取图像。”

paras.en: In recent decades, there have been more armed conflicts to cover. And press groups and media outlets have put a far-greater emphasis on journalists' safety and careful planning of assignments. Many reporters, including those at NPR, are required to go through what's called "hostile environment training" before heading off to cover conflict.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，有更多的武装冲突需要报道。新闻团体和媒体机构更加重视记者的安全和仔细规划任务。许多记者，包括美国国家公共广播电台的记者，在前往报道冲突之前都必须接受所谓的“敌对环境培训”。

paras.en: Williams heads up the Rory Peck Trust, which provides funds and training to aid the security of freelance journalists who are reporting in perilous zones. It also provides support for families of those reporters who are injured or killed in such circumstances.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯领导着罗里·派克信托基金，该信托基金提供资金和培训，以帮助在危险地区进行报道的自由记者的安全。它还为在这种情况下受伤或死亡的记者的家人提供支持。

paras.en: Williams said the danger of combat reporting can never be eliminated. Shortly after the attack on the Fox crew in 2022, CNN's Ben Wedeman and his colleagues were almost struck while filming a report in Bucha, a northwest suburb of Kyiv.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯表示，战斗报道的危险永远无法消除。 2022 年福克斯剧组遭遇袭击后不久，CNN 的本·韦德曼 (Ben Wedeman) 和他的同事在基辅西北郊区布查 (Bucha) 拍摄报道时差点被击中。

paras.en: "In these vast open spaces, the Russians seem far away," Wedeman narrated. "They're not."
paras.zh: “在这些广阔的空地上，俄罗斯人似乎很遥远，”韦德曼叙述道。 “他们不是。”

paras.en: In 2022 alone — the year of the incident — 28 journalists were killed in conflict zones around the world, according to UNESCO.
paras.zh: 据联合国教科文组织称，仅 2022 年（事件发生的一年）就有 28 名记者在世界各地的冲突地区被杀。

paras.en: Broadly speaking, Williams offered this caution: "When correspondents or crews begin not to recognize the risks that they're facing and become too comfortable with risk, then it's time to take them out."
paras.zh: 从广义上讲，威廉姆斯提出了这样的警告：“当记者或工作人员开始不认识到他们所面临的风险并变得对风险过于坦然时，那么就到了把他们带出去的时候了。”

paras.en: In her last publicly available Facebook post, Kuvshynova paid homage to people fleeing Kyiv on planks beneath the remains of a bombed-out bridge on the city's northwest side. She posted in Ukrainian and English.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃在她最后一篇公开的 Facebook 帖子中，向在基辅西北侧一座被炸毁的桥梁残骸下的木板上逃离的人们致敬。她用乌克兰语和英语发帖。

paras.en: Irpin. Evacuation of the civilians. March 5, 2022.
paras.zh: 伊尔平.疏散平民。 2022 年 3 月 5 日。

paras.en: Under the sound of shelling, soldiers and volunteers are helping to move thousands of people under the blown-up (by Russians) bridge.
paras.zh: 在炮击声中，士兵和志愿者正在帮助将数千人转移到被俄罗斯人炸毁的桥下。

paras.en: "We have been here for three hours, since the morning. Fortunately, the night was finally quiet" holding back tears [a] local tells me.
paras.zh: “从早上开始，我们已经在这里待了三个小时。幸运的是，夜晚终于安静了”，一位当地人强忍着泪水告诉我。

paras.en: The evacuation of the population lasts [a] 3rd day. About 200 tanks and armored personnel carriers of the occupiers have been accumulated near Irpin.
paras.zh: 人口疏散持续了第三天。占领者的约200辆坦克和装甲运兵车已集结在伊尔平附近。

paras.en: Russian troops blew up an evacuation train that was going to pick up people. The railway tracks were also blown up.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队炸毁了一辆准备接人的疏散列车。铁轨也被炸毁。

paras.en: Currently, the Zhytomyr highway, Bucha - Irpin - [H]ostomel, Makariv and the north of Vyshhorod district remain the most dangerous in the Kyiv region.
paras.zh: 目前，日托米尔高速公路、Bucha - Irpin - [H]ostomel、Makariv 和 Vyshhorod 区北部仍然是基辅地区最危险的。

paras.en: That area northwest of Kyiv would be where Kuvshynova lost her life.
paras.zh: 基辅西北部的那个地区就是库夫希诺娃丧生的地方。

paras.en: On March 12, high-risk security adviser Shane Thomson set out with Fox's Trey Yingst toward that same area but stopped short of it at a checkpoint in the northwest suburbs.
paras.zh: 3 月 12 日，高风险安全顾问肖恩·汤姆森 (Shane Thomson) 与福克斯电视台的特雷·英斯特 (Trey Yingst) 一起出发前往同一地区，但在西北郊区的一个检查站停下来。

paras.en: They were near Ukrainian forces and a string of foxholes, with other soldiers a kilometer ahead of them engaging with the Russians, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，他们靠近乌克兰军队和一系列散兵坑，其他士兵在他们前方一公里处与俄罗斯人交战。

paras.en: "The trigger point for me was close fire," Thomson says. "We had mortars coming over. We took cover, and then we evacuated back."
paras.zh: “对我来说，触发点是近距离射击，”汤姆森说。 “迫击炮向我们袭来。我们进行了掩护，然后又撤了回来。”

paras.en: Despite the dangers, a number of TV networks had already aired dramatic footage from that region. Fox wanted more images of those refugees fleeing Irpin, a northwest Kyiv suburb, and Thomson says he understood why.
paras.zh: 尽管存在危险，一些电视网络已经播放了该地区的戏剧性镜头。福克斯想要更多有关逃离基辅西北部郊区伊尔平的难民的照片，汤姆森说他明白原因。

paras.en: "Just behind them, you got a shot of the city, where it's a, it's smoke. They can hear gunfire. They can hear explosions. They wanted the atmospherics at the time," Thomson told NPR.
paras.zh: 汤姆森告诉美国国家公共广播电台：“就在他们身后，你可以看到城市的照片，那里有烟雾。他们可以听到枪声。他们可以听到爆炸声。他们想要当时的气氛。”

paras.en: But the risks were real. A British Army veteran serving with Ukrainian troops, Dale Sutton, had texted the high-risk advisers that it was too dangerous to bring journalists to Irpin, Thomson told NPR, a key claim in his affidavit. Russian forces were in the area; some even pretended to be news crews.
paras.zh: 但风险是真实存在的。汤姆森告诉美国公共广播电台，在乌克兰军队服役的英国退伍军人戴尔·萨顿曾给高风险顾问发短信说，带记者前往伊尔平太危险了，这是他宣誓书中的一个关键主张。俄罗斯军队在该地区；有些人甚至假装是新闻工作人员。

paras.en: Sutton affirmed Thomson's account in an interview with NPR. "It's an absolute no-go area. It's beyond hot," Sutton recalled telling Thomson and King. "You've got no business being here."
paras.zh: 萨顿在接受 NPR 采访时证实了汤姆森的说法。 “这绝对是一个禁区。太热了，”萨顿回忆道，他告诉汤姆森和金。 “你没有资格来这里。”

paras.en: Thomson alleges in his lawsuit that tensions mounted between Fox's journalists and their security advisers. King, who consulted with them from Lviv, told NPR the same thing. (NPR could not reach Duncan "Jock" Gordon, a third Fox security contractor who was present in Kyiv, for comment, despite numerous attempts.)
paras.zh: 汤姆森在诉讼中声称，福克斯的记者与其安全顾问之间的关系日益紧张。金在利沃夫与他们进行了协商，他对美国国家公共广播电台也说了同样的事情。 （尽管多次尝试，NPR 仍无法联系到在基辅的第三位福克斯安全承包商邓肯·“乔克”·戈登发表评论。）

paras.en: At evening prayers, Thomson told NPR, he vetoed the proposed trip toward Irpin. He alleges Fox News CEO Suzanne Scott was on the call. Fox says that he has no evidence that Scott directed the movements of the network's team in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 汤姆森告诉美国国家公共广播电台，在晚间祈祷时，他否决了前往伊尔平的计划。他声称福克斯新闻首席执行官苏珊娜·斯科特参加了电话会议。福克斯表示，他没有证据表明斯科特指挥了该网络团队在乌克兰的行动。

paras.en: The next day, March 13, Russians scattered across the area. They overtook the nearby town of Bucha and half of Irpin. There, they shot dead the American documentarian Brent Renaud and wounded his colleague. The mayor of Irpin issued a public warning to journalists: Stay out. It's too dangerous.
paras.zh: 第二天，即 3 月 13 日，俄罗斯人分散到该地区各地。他们占领了附近的布查镇和伊尔平的一半。在那里，他们枪杀了美国纪录片导演布伦特·雷诺，并打伤了他的同事。伊尔平市市长向记者发出公开警告：远离。太危险了。

paras.en: Given all that, the message at evening prayers on the night of the 13th was clear-cut, according to the plaintiffs' filings: Stay within Kyiv city limits. In his affidavit, Thomson said the nearby suburbs were out of bounds.
paras.zh: 鉴于所有这些，根据原告的文件，13 日晚上的晚祷传达的信息很明确：留在基辅市范围内。汤姆森在其宣誓书中表示，附近郊区是禁区。

paras.en: "There was no way we were going there," Thomson told NPR. "No way. Not after the credible intel, what we had and everything what we had before. It was all on point. There's nothing, no gray areas."
paras.zh: 汤姆森告诉美国国家公共广播电台：“我们不可能去那里。” “不可能。在获得可靠的情报、我们所拥有的以及我们之前所拥有的一切之后就不会了。这一切都是正确的。没有任何东西，没有灰色地带。”

paras.en: It's not clear exactly how the team hatched its alternative plan. According to Thomson, Kuvshynova proposed filming footage at the perimeter line that Ukrainian defense forces were building in Kyiv along the highway to Irpin.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚该团队究竟是如何制定替代计划的。据汤姆森称，库夫希诺娃提议在乌克兰国防军在基辅沿通往伊尔平的高速公路修建的周界线拍摄镜头。

paras.en: "This represented a sort of a compromise with the pressure to go to Irpin ... without leaving the Kyiv city limits or going outside established defense positions," Thomson said in his sworn affidavit.
paras.zh: 汤姆森在宣誓证词中说：“这代表着对前往伊尔平的压力的一种妥协……而不离开基辅城市范围或超出既定的防御阵地。”

paras.en: In the interviews and the lawsuit, the Kuvshynovs and Thomson allege that this outing occurred at Hall's direction, and they say they believe it occurred with the support of Fox executives tracking events from New York.
paras.zh: 在采访和诉讼中，库夫希诺夫夫妇和汤姆森声称这次外出是在霍尔的指示下发生的，他们相信这是在纽约跟踪事件的福克斯高管的支持下发生的。

paras.en: In her lawsuit filed in the U.K., Zakrzewski's widow, Michelle Ross-Stanton, similarly alleges that it was clear by March 13 that Irpin was not safe and that Fox failed to heed or recognize the warning signs. She says it was the network's job to exercise care for her husband's safety.
paras.zh: 扎克热夫斯基的遗孀米歇尔·罗斯-斯坦顿在英国提起的诉讼中同样声称，到 3 月 13 日，伊尔平显然并不安全，福克斯未能注意到或认识到这些警告信号。她说，该网络的职责就是保护她丈夫的安全。

paras.en: In his own court filing in the Kuvshynov case, Hall says Zakrzewski would have been responsible for communicating with Fox about security and logistical concerns for March 14. Hall adds that he does not know of anyone in New York being consulted on March 14.
paras.zh: 霍尔在库夫希诺夫案的法庭文件中表示，扎克热夫斯基将负责与福克斯就 3 月 14 日的安全和后勤问题进行沟通。霍尔补充说，他不知道纽约有任何人在 3 月 14 日接受过咨询。

paras.en: The assignment was simple, Hall wrote in his memoir: "Pierre and I decided to visit the defensive trenches being dug in Kyiv and find a story there."
paras.zh: 霍尔在回忆录中写道，任务很简单：“皮埃尔和我决定参观基辅正在挖掘的防御战壕，并在那里寻找故事。”

paras.en: The next day, Zakrzewski, Hall and Kuvshynova boarded a white van at the hotel. They planned to travel up the highway to a checkpoint set up by Ukrainian forces just inside the city limits.
paras.zh: 第二天，扎克热夫斯基、霍尔和库夫希诺娃在酒店登上了一辆白色面包车。他们计划沿着高速公路前往乌克兰军队在市区内设立的检查站。

paras.en: In Saved, Hall recounts a careful approach:
paras.zh: 在《Saved》一书中，霍尔讲述了一种谨慎的方法：

paras.en: "Pierre and I knew how we would cover the elaborate trench systems the Ukrainians were building within Kyiv as a defense against Russian military units like the Wagner Group, ruthless mercenaries dispatched by Putin to fight his wars across the globe," Hall wrote. "Our explicit intention was to avoid the front lines, stay clear of active fighting, remain within the city's borders, and only report on the trenches inside Kyiv."
paras.zh: 霍尔写道：“皮埃尔和我知道如何覆盖乌克兰人在基辅境内建造的复杂战壕系统，以防御瓦格纳集团等俄罗斯军事单位，这些部队是普京派遣到全球各地进行战争的无情雇佣兵。” “我们的明确意图是避开前线，远离激烈的战斗，留在城市边界内，只报告基辅境内的战壕。”

paras.en: Security adviser Jock Gordon was with them. Thomson stayed behind. By Thomson's account in his affidavit, the initial driver assigned to drive the crew refused, citing the danger. The team pulled in a replacement.
paras.zh: 安全顾问乔克·戈登和他们在一起。汤姆森留在后面。根据汤姆森在其宣誓书中的说法，最初分配给机组人员的司机以危险为由拒绝了。球队找来了替补。

paras.en: They were escorted by two Ukrainian soldiers in a separate car. In Saved, Hall wrote that those soldiers had been arranged by a Ukrainian army press liaison at Kuvshynova's request. Her parents' lawsuit contends the military did not sign off on the work; the soldiers were freelancing as security guards to make some extra money on the side.
paras.zh: 他们由两名乌克兰士兵乘坐另一辆汽车护送。霍尔在《Saved》中写道，这些士兵是应库夫希诺娃的要求，由乌克兰军队新闻联络员安排的。她父母的诉讼称，军方没有批准这项工作；士兵们以自由职业者身份担任保安，以赚取额外的收入。

paras.en: When they arrived at the trenches, the team could see Ukrainian soldiers conducting target practice, but they weren't allowed to film.
paras.zh: 当他们到达战壕时，团队可以看到乌克兰士兵正在进行打靶练习，但他们不被允许拍摄。

paras.en: "I tried to negotiate with the soldiers through Sasha, but they were adamant," Hall wrote in his memoir. "Our plan to report on the strategic trench system was not going to happen."
paras.zh: “我试图通过萨沙与士兵们谈判，但他们态度坚决，”霍尔在回忆录中写道。 “我们报告战略战壕系统的计划不会发生。”

paras.en: But they didn't have to go back empty-handed. Their escorts — the two troops — suggested they continue on to the nearby suburb of Horenka, Hall said in a court filing last year. The village "had been recently destroyed by Russian forces, where [the same Ukrainian soldiers escorting the Fox team] had taken a crew from the New York Times only the day before," Hall wrote.
paras.zh: 但他们不必空手而归。霍尔在去年的一份法庭文件中表示，他们的护送人员——两名士兵——建议他们继续前往附近的霍伦卡郊区。霍尔写道，这个村庄“最近被俄罗斯军队摧毁，[护送福克斯团队的乌克兰士兵]就在前一天带走了《纽约时报》的一名工作人员”。

paras.en: The area was, Hall wrote in Saved, "abandoned except for some Ukrainian troops. The Russian forces, we understood, would be at least thirty miles away and not pushing in our direction."
paras.zh: 霍尔在《Saved》中写道，“除了一些乌克兰军队外，该地区已被废弃。据我们所知，俄罗斯军队将在至少三十英里之外，不会向我们的方向推进。”

paras.en: In a footnote in a recent legal filing, Fox's attorneys wrote that "the gist of that statement was that Hall believed it was safer than it actually was and that he — and the Ukrainian soldiers who drove the team out — was wrong. That is certainly true."
paras.zh: 在最近一份法律文件的脚注中，福克斯的律师写道，“该声明的要点是，霍尔认为这比实际情况更安全，而他——以及驱逐该团队的乌克兰士兵——是错误的。这当然是真的。”

paras.en: The Kuvshynovs and Thomson reject that. Their attorneys argued that the reasonable conclusion is that Hall's claim was "at all times, patently and knowingly false."
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫和汤姆森拒绝了这一点。他们的律师辩称，合理的结论是霍尔的主张“在任何时候都是明显且故意错误的”。

paras.en: And their lawsuit against Fox and Hall alleges one more thing about that trip up the highway.
paras.zh: 他们对福克斯和霍尔的诉讼还指控了关于那次高速公路之旅的另一件事。

paras.en: The white van the journalists traveled in had the word "press" in big letters on its hood and sides — a possible target for Russian forces. The two Ukrainian soldiers wanted everyone to go in their smaller car. But there were only three seats available.
paras.zh: 记者乘坐的白色面包车的引擎盖和侧面都用大写字母写着“新闻”一词，这可能是俄罗斯军队的目标。两名乌克兰士兵希望每个人都乘坐他们的小汽车。但只有三个座位。

paras.en: According to the lawsuit, Hall said the Fox team should leave behind Gordon — the security consultant charged with keeping them safe that day — in favor of Kuvshynova, the only one who could speak Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 根据诉讼，霍尔表示福克斯团队应该留下戈登——当天负责保护他们安全的安全顾问——而选择库夫希诺娃，因为他是唯一会说乌克兰语的人。

paras.en: "According to Jock," a February 2026 court filing for the Kuvshynovs states, "before he was left behind, the security adviser gave Ben Hall specific instructions not to go anywhere else, not to go to any location that had not been vetted with a proper security analysis, or go beyond the [checkpoint] inside the Kyiv city limits where the crew intended to film." (NPR could not reach Gordon for comment.)
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月库夫希诺夫一家的法庭文件称，“根据乔克的说法，在他被留下之前，安全顾问向本·霍尔发出了具体指示，要求他不要去其他任何地方，不要去任何未经适当安全分析审查的地点，也不要超出剧组打算拍摄的基辅市范围内的[检查站]。” （美国国家公共广播电台无法联系到戈登请其置评。）

paras.en: Thomson says Gordon urged Zakrzewski to turn on a livestream that would display his location to Fox colleagues in New York and London. An image shared in a Fox WhatsApp group chat that day, referred to in court filings and reviewed by NPR, shows Zakrzewski had done just that as the team traveled in the soldiers' car, past the checkpoint and the city limits and into Kyiv's contested northwest suburbs.
paras.zh: 汤姆森说，戈登敦促扎克热夫斯基打开直播，向福克斯在纽约和伦敦的同事显示他的位置。当天福克斯 WhatsApp 群聊中分享的一张图片显示，扎克热夫斯基就是这么做的，当时球队乘坐士兵的汽车，经过检查站和城市边界，进入基辅有争议的西北郊区。

paras.en: How far they pushed is a matter of contention in the litigation. Regardless, when the team finished getting footage of destruction, it turned back toward Kyiv.
paras.zh: 他们到底能走多远是诉讼中争论的问题。不管怎样，当小组拍摄完破坏的镜头后，他们返回了基辅。

paras.en: The attack came on a suburban stretch of road near some light industrial warehouses, including an auto repair shop.
paras.zh: 袭击发生在郊区的一段道路上，靠近一些轻工业仓库，其中包括一家汽车修理店。

paras.en: "The first missile came out of nowhere, lands about 30 feet in front of us. Immediately, Pierre shouts, 'Reverse the car! Reverse the car!'" Hall told Fox's Sean Hannity in March 2023. "The car got stuck. We couldn't go back, and Pierre shouted, 'Get out of the car! Everyone, get out of the car!' And the next second, the second bomb hits right in front of the left of the car. And that one, I went black."
paras.zh: “第一枚导弹不知从何而来，落在我们面前约 30 英尺处。皮埃尔立即大喊，‘倒车！倒车！’”霍尔在 2023 年 3 月告诉福克斯电视台的肖恩·汉尼提。“汽车被卡住了。我们无法回去，皮埃尔大喊，‘下车！所有人，下车！’”下一秒，第二枚炸弹击中了汽车的左前方。那一件事，我变黑了。”

paras.en: "I was in a dark place. I couldn't feel or see. I'd taken shrapnel in the eye and the matchbox-sized shrapnel in my neck. And I was — I was out. I was out dead," Hall told Hannity.
paras.zh: “我在一个黑暗的地方。我感觉不到，也看不见。我的眼睛里有弹片，脖子上有火柴盒大小的弹片。我——我出去了。我死了，”霍尔告诉汉尼蒂。

paras.en: In his memoir, Hall credited two people with convincing him to get out of the car before yet another attack would destroy it: Zakrzewski, who Hall said flung the car door open and ordered him to get out, and his young daughter Honor, whose disembodied voice he heard urging him on: Daddy, you've got to get out of the car. Hall, by his account, dragged himself to a nearby vehicle and a soldier with Ukrainian special forces got out and pulled him to safety.
paras.zh: 霍尔在回忆录中称赞有两个人说服他在另一次袭击摧毁汽车之前下车：扎克热夫斯基（霍尔说扎克热夫斯基猛地打开车门并命令他下车）和他的小女儿奥诺尔（他听到她虚幻的声音催促他：爸爸，你必须下车）。据霍尔称，他拖着自己爬到了附近的一辆汽车上，一名乌克兰特种部队士兵下了车，把他拉到了安全地带。

paras.en: Zakrzewski "escaped the car but suffered a penetrating wound to his left upper leg from which he bled to death at the side of the road," according to his widow's lawsuit.
paras.zh: 扎克热夫斯基的遗孀在诉讼中称，他“逃离了汽车，但左大腿受了贯穿伤，最终失血过多而死在路边”。

paras.en: Kuvshynova and the two soldiers never made it out of the car.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃和两名士兵最终未能下车。

paras.en: Later that day, with no trace of the team, Thomson and Gordon — the two security advisers in Kyiv — began a desperate search. They checked with Ukrainian military and civil authorities, hospitals and morgues. Journalists and security consultants for competing news outlets pitched in too.
paras.zh: 当天晚些时候，由于没有团队的踪迹，基辅的两名安全顾问汤姆森和戈登开始了绝望的搜寻。他们向乌克兰军事和民事当局、医院和太平间进行了核实。竞争新闻媒体的记者和安全顾问也参与其中。

paras.en: Finally, Thomson said, a doctor called, asking him whether one of the missing was British. His patient was severely wounded and had a U.K. passport. It was Hall.
paras.zh: 汤姆森说，最后，一名医生打来电话，询问他其中一名失踪者是否是英国人。他的病人受了重伤，持有英国护照。是霍尔。

paras.en: Doctors in Kyiv amputated Hall's right leg, but he needed far more intensive care — and soon. He was spirited out of Kyiv with maneuvers right out of a spy novel.
paras.zh: 基辅的医生截去了霍尔的右腿，但他需要更多的重症监护——而且很快。他以间谍小说中的手法被偷偷带离基辅。

paras.en: They included a special rescue squad from the private group Save Our Allies operating amid curfews, a voyage out of the war zone on the train of the prime minister of Poland and an airlift to a U.S. military hospital in Germany.
paras.zh: 其中包括私人组织“拯救我们的盟友”的一支特别救援队在宵禁期间行动、乘坐波兰总理的火车离开战区以及空运到德国的一家美军医院。

paras.en: Fox News chief national security correspondent Jennifer Griffin secured the approval of then-U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin for the airlift.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻首席国家安全记者詹妮弗·格里芬获得了当时美国的批准。国防部长劳埃德·奥斯汀负责空运。

paras.en: But what about the others? To find Zakrzewski and Kuvshynova, Thomson again enlisted security contractors for other news organizations. They spoke to sources in Ukrainian military and intelligence agencies. The international journalists in Kyiv pulled together, with CNN's Clarissa Ward aiding Fox's Yingst in the search, according to people at both networks. All came up short.
paras.zh: 但其他人呢？为了找到扎克热夫斯基和库夫希诺娃，汤姆森再次为其他新闻机构招募了安全承包商。他们与乌克兰军方和情报机构的消息人士进行了交谈。据两家电视台的人士透露，基辅的国际记者齐心协力，CNN 的克拉丽莎·沃德 (Clarissa Ward) 协助福克斯电视台的英斯特 (Yingst) 进行搜寻。一切都达不到目的。

paras.en: "We tried to locate their [geolocating] devices, satellite phones, their iPhones, and we just couldn't do it," Thomson recalled. The last point identified was the site where they were struck.
paras.zh: “我们试图找到他们的[地理定位]设备、卫星电话、iPhone，但我们就是做不到，”汤姆森回忆道。最后确定的地点是他们被击中的地点。

paras.en: Finally, a call came from the Kyiv city morgue. He rushed there to identify Zakrzewski. Fox ordered Thomson to drive the body to Poland.
paras.zh: 终于，基辅市太平间打来了电话。他赶到那里去确认扎克热夫斯基的身份。福克斯命令汤姆森将尸体运往波兰。

paras.en: In his affidavit, Thomson said it was an onerous, dangerous and emotionally crushing burden.
paras.zh: 汤姆森在其宣誓书中表示，这是一个繁重、危险且令人精神崩溃的负担。

paras.en: In Poland, Thomson met Ross-Stanton, Zakrzewski's widow. Fox employees also were there. They signaled him not to answer questions, Thomson said in the affidavit, effectively ordering him "to hide the truth from my friend's grieving widow." They toasted Zakrzewski, a citizen of France and Ireland, with a bottle of Irish whiskey over his coffin, Ross-Stanton says.
paras.zh: 在波兰，汤姆森遇到了扎克热夫斯基的遗孀罗斯-斯坦顿。福克斯的员工也在场。汤姆森在宣誓书中说，他们示意他不要回答问题，实际上是命令他“向我朋友悲伤的遗孀隐瞒真相”。罗斯-斯坦顿说，他们在法国和爱尔兰公民扎克热夫斯基的棺材上放了一瓶爱尔兰威士忌，向他敬酒。

paras.en: The Kuvshynovs' lawsuit against Fox and Hall can be divided into two parts: what happened that led to their daughter's death, and how they say they were treated afterward.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫夫妇对福克斯和霍尔的诉讼可以分为两个部分：到底发生了什么导致了他们女儿的死亡，以及他们所说的女儿死后受到的待遇。

paras.en: They began to worry when they didn't get the usual reassuring message from her after her trip up the highway. Fox has not addressed what it did in the days immediately following Sasha Kuvshynova's death.
paras.zh: 当她在高速公路上行驶后，他们没有收到她通常令人放心的信息时，他们开始担心。福克斯尚未提及萨沙·库夫希诺娃去世后几天内所做的事情。

paras.en: According to the Kuvshynovs' allegations, there are many things the network did not do.
paras.zh: 根据库夫希诺夫夫妇的指控，该网络有很多事情没有做。

paras.en: Fox executives didn't immediately call to tell them what it knew and what it did not.
paras.zh: 福克斯高管没有立即打电话告诉他们知道什么、不知道什么。

paras.en: They didn't send someone who spoke Ukrainian to serve as an interpreter and guide them through the terrible hours and days that followed.
paras.zh: 他们没有派出会说乌克兰语的人担任翻译并指导他们度过接下来的可怕的时光和日子。

paras.en: They didn't offer immediate comfort and condolences to demonstrate how much Kuvshynova was valued as a colleague.
paras.zh: 他们没有立即表示安慰和哀悼，以表明库夫希诺娃作为同事的重视程度。

paras.en: "We were not informed about anything about the search for Sasha, about any investigations," her father, Andriy Kuvshynov, told NPR. "They didn't tell us. And it's not clear if they knew that — what had happened — why they didn't tell us."
paras.zh: 她的父亲安德烈·库夫希诺夫 (Andriy Kuvshynov) 告诉美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR)，“我们没有获悉任何有关寻找萨莎的信息，也没有任何调查的消息。” “他们没有告诉我们。目前还不清楚他们是否知道——发生了什么——为什么他们不告诉我们。”

paras.en: In fact, Kuvshynova's parents said, no one reached out on the day of the attack.
paras.zh: 事实上，库夫希诺娃的父母说，袭击当天没有人伸出援手。

paras.en: The next day, they said, they got a call from someone on Fox's team in Kyiv encouraging them to pick up their daughter's belongings.
paras.zh: 他们说，第二天，他们接到了基辅福克斯团队的一个人的电话，鼓励他们去取回女儿的物品。

paras.en: Kuvshynov told NPR he took that as an ominous turn. He didn't go. The man called back, but still the father didn't go.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫告诉美国国家公共广播电台，他认为这是一个不祥的转折。他没有去。那人又打了电话，但父亲还是没有走。

paras.en: The next day, Kuvshynova's boyfriend — Sviatoslav Yurash — brought them her suitcase from the InterContinental.
paras.zh: 第二天，库夫希诺娃的男友斯维亚托斯拉夫·尤拉什 (Sviatoslav Yurash) 从洲际酒店给他们带来了她的手提箱。

paras.en: It was Yurash, a member of parliament, who told them their daughter had been killed, Kuvshynov said in his sworn statement. (Yurash backed up the broad strokes of this account in his interview with NPR.)
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫在宣誓声明中说，是国会议员尤拉什告诉他们，他们的女儿被杀了。 （尤拉什在接受 NPR 采访时证实了这一说法的大致内容。）

paras.en: The two men bundled into a car to retrace the path of the news team. They first were stopped at the checkpoint where the Fox crew had intended to film the trenches.
paras.zh: 两人挤进一辆汽车，沿着新闻组的路线走去。他们首先在福克斯摄制组打算拍摄战壕的检查站被拦住。

paras.en: A Ukrainian army post commander there said he had seen the Fox team and had warned Hall not to go farther, according to Kuvshynov's statement. The journalists had proceeded anyway.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫的声明称，那里的一名乌克兰陆军哨所指挥官表示，他看到了福克斯队，并警告霍尔不要走得更远。不管怎样，记者们还是继续了。

paras.en: Kuvshynov said he and Yurash continued, retracing the Fox team's path up the highway. At the southern tip of Hostomel, on the boundary line of Irpin, the two men came upon "the burned wreck" of the car, Kuvshynov said in his affidavit.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫说，他和尤拉什继续前行，沿着福克斯车队的路线沿着高速公路前进。库夫希诺夫在证词中说，在霍斯托梅尔的南端，在伊尔平的边界线上，这两个人发现了汽车的“烧毁残骸”。

paras.en: Hall wrote in his court declaration that the strike occurred in Horenka, which is closer to Kyiv than Hostomel. His accounts in the memoir, on television and in his declaration make no mention of Hostomel.
paras.zh: 霍尔在法庭声明中写道，罢工发生在霍伦卡，比霍斯托梅尔更靠近基辅。他在回忆录、电视和声明中的叙述都没有提及霍斯托梅尔。

paras.en: Regardless, "Everything there was ruined, destroyed — that is, erased from the face of the earth," Kuvshynov told NPR. His daughter's body wasn't there.
paras.zh: 无论如何，“那里的一切都被毁了，被摧毁了——也就是说，从地球表面消失了，”库夫希诺夫告诉美国国家公共广播电台。他女儿的尸体不在那里。

paras.en: The following day — 48 hours after the deadly strike — the Kuvshynovs were told their daughter was at the morgue, Kuvshynov wrote in his affidavit. He said they could identify her only from her clothes "as the body had turned to ashes." They refused to accept it as the truth for weeks, until DNA tests confirmed the results.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫在宣誓书中写道，第二天，即致命袭击发生 48 小时后，库夫希诺夫一家被告知他们的女儿在太平间。他说，他们只能从她的衣服上认出她，“因为尸体已经化为灰烬”。数周以来，他们一直拒绝接受这一事实，直到 DNA 测试证实了结果。

paras.en: In the ensuing days, Yurash's social media posts mourned Kuvshynova's death and railed at the Russians.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，尤拉什的社交媒体帖子哀悼库夫希诺娃的去世，并谴责俄罗斯人。

paras.en: "She was murdered," he wrote in English. "Couldn't help but come. Couldn't help but search. Couldn't help but find. Couldn't help but hate like never hated before. Justice will be had."
paras.zh: “她被谋杀了，”他用英语写道。 “情不自禁地来。情不自禁地寻找。情不自禁地找到。情不自禁地怀着前所未有的仇恨。正义将会得到伸张。”

paras.en: On March 17, the day after Kuvshynov viewed his daughter's remains at the morgue, a Fox News human resources executive sent him an offer to pay her wages and benefits, funeral expenses and "an additional cash sum meant to approximate life insurance proceeds that would have been payable had she been a full-time employee," Fox's legal team wrote in court filings.
paras.zh: 3月17日，也就是库夫希诺夫在太平间查看女儿遗体的第二天，福克斯新闻的一名人力资源主管向他发出了一份提议，要求支付她的工资和福利、丧葬费以及“一笔额外的现金，这笔金额相当于如果她是一名全职雇员，本应支付的人寿保险收益”，福克斯的法律团队在法庭文件中写道。

paras.en: Considering Kuvshynova was not a permanent employee, the payment was meant "as a show of sympathy and goodwill," the network said. Indeed, Fox's court filings state it paid the family more than what was contractually required.
paras.zh: 该电视台表示，考虑到库夫希诺娃不是正式员工，这笔付款的目的是“表达同情和善意”。事实上，福克斯的法庭文件显示，它向这家人支付的费用超出了合同规定的金额。

paras.en: Kuvshynov said his daughter had not been paid by Fox at all at the time of her death. He figured, Kuvshynov said in his affidavit, that he was simply agreeing to receive standard compensation for her work.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫说，他的女儿在去世时根本没有收到福克斯的任何付款。库夫希诺夫在宣誓书中表示，他认为他只是同意为她的工作获得标准报酬。

paras.en: "I did not know the extent Fox was at fault," Kuvshynov wrote in his affidavit. "I did not intend or contemplate that the payment offered by Fox three days after Sasha was killed, and one day after we were officially informed of her death, covered any such wrongdoing by Fox."
paras.zh: “我不知道福克斯的过错有多大，”库夫希诺夫在他的宣誓书中写道。 “我并不打算或考虑到福克斯在萨莎被杀三天后、在我们正式得知她死亡的一天后提供的付款涵盖了福克斯的任何此类不当行为。”

paras.en: He said he never would have agreed to that. His wife, he said, had taken to bed, bereaved and unaware that Fox had sought this resolution.
paras.zh: 他说他永远不会同意这一点。他说，他的妻子已经上床睡觉，失去了亲人，并且不知道福克斯已经寻求了这个解决方案。

paras.en: A week later, Fox News CEO Suzanne Scott sent a condolence note by email to the Kuvshynovs in English and Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 一周后，福克斯新闻首席执行官苏珊娜·斯科特通过电子邮件用英语和乌克兰语向库夫希诺夫夫妇发送了慰问信。

paras.en: "There can be no pain greater for a parent, than losing a child. I know Sasha was an absolutely exceptional young woman," Scott wrote. "I've heard from so many of our reporters and producers about how talented she was, and how much she impressed them with her work and her passion."
paras.zh: “对于父母来说，没有比失去孩子更大的痛苦了。我知道萨莎绝对是一位杰出的年轻女性，”斯科特写道。 “我从我们的许多记者和制片人那里听说她有多么有才华，以及她的工作和热情给他们留下了多么深刻的印象。”

paras.en: "Please know that we will not forget your daughter or her sacrifice," Scott concluded. "We will honor Sasha in our work, celebrate her in our thoughts, and remember her in our prayers."
paras.zh: “请知道，我们不会忘记你的女儿或她的牺牲，”斯科特总结道。 “我们将在我们的工作中向萨莎致敬，在我们的思想中庆祝她，并在我们的祈祷中记住她。”

paras.en: On the same day, Fox posted a tribute to Kuvshynova on its website.
paras.zh: 同一天，福克斯在其网站上发布了对库夫希诺娃的悼念。

paras.en: On March 27, Fox sent the paperwork. Kuvshynov signed the document the next day — exactly two weeks after his daughter's death. In its court filings, Fox argued that it cannot be held legally responsible because Kuvshynov signed that document: "The valid contract is the beginning and the end of the case."
paras.zh: 3 月 27 日，福克斯发送了文件。库夫希诺夫于第二天签署了这份文件——恰好是他女儿去世两周后。福克斯在法庭文件中辩称，它不能承担法律责任，因为库夫希诺夫签署了该文件：“有效的合同是案件的开始和结束。”

paras.en: Fox's legal team also argued it had no legal duty to disclose any facts to the Kuvshynovs and therefore did not commit fraud in presenting the settlement.
paras.zh: 福克斯的法律团队还辩称，它没有法律义务向库夫希诺夫家族披露任何事实，因此在提交和解协议时没有犯下欺诈行为。

paras.en: According to the Kuvshynovs, Hall called them once. The gulf was too great: The mourning Ukrainians could not understand what the grief-choked reporter was saying in English.
paras.zh: 据库夫希诺夫夫妇称，霍尔曾给他们打过一次电话。鸿沟太大了：哀悼的乌克兰人听不懂悲伤的记者用英语说的话。

paras.en: Hall returned to Kyiv in November 2023 with Lachlan Murdoch, the executive chairman of Fox News' parent company. He is the network's controlling owner, along with his father, Rupert.
paras.zh: 霍尔于 2023 年 11 月与福克斯新闻母公司执行董事长拉克兰·默多克一起返回基辅。他和他的父亲鲁珀特是该网络的控股所有者。

paras.en: Hall had secured a one-on-one interview with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who awarded Hall the Order of Merit, III class, for his "outstanding personal contribution to strengthening ... support for Ukraine's independence and territorial integrity." Hall also met his rescuers to thank them.
paras.zh: 霍尔与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基进行了一对一的采访，泽连斯基授予霍尔三级功绩勋章，以表彰他“为加强……对乌克兰独立和领土完整的支持做出的杰出个人贡献”。霍尔还与救援人员会面，向他们表示感谢。

paras.en: Hall and Murdoch did not contact the Kuvshynovs during their visit. (A corporate spokesperson declined all comment on Murdoch's behalf.)
paras.zh: 霍尔和默多克在访问期间没有联系库夫希诺夫家族。 （公司发言人拒绝代表默多克发表任何评论。）

paras.en: Kuvshynov said he learned of the details of Kuvshynova's death only from Thomson, the security consultant, and Humphreys, the lawyer — not Fox. (Since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Humphreys has frequented Kyiv, documenting potential Russian war crimes and teaching courses at law schools there. Humphreys said that's how he came across the case.)
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫表示，他只是从安全顾问汤姆森和律师汉弗莱斯那里了解到库夫希诺娃死亡的细节，而不是从福克斯那里得知。 （自 2022 年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，汉弗莱斯经常前往基辅，记录俄罗斯潜在的战争罪行，并在那里的法学院教授课程。汉弗莱斯说，这就是他发现此案的原因。）

paras.en: Shane Thomson, the high-risk security adviser who warned Hall, Zakrzewski and Kuvshynova not to go beyond the Kyiv city limits, joined the grieving parents in their lawsuit against Fox and Hall.
paras.zh: 高风险安全顾问谢恩·汤姆森警告霍尔、扎克热夫斯基和库夫希诺娃不要超出基辅市范围，他与悲痛的父母一起对福克斯和霍尔提起诉讼。

paras.en: He says after the attack, some Fox employees insinuated that Thomson abused alcohol — he denies drinking — and that led to the deaths and debacle. He said in his affidavit that SEPAR, the security consulting firm that had hired him to work for Fox, fired him several months after the attack without telling him why. (SEPAR did not return NPR's calls and emails seeking comment.)
paras.zh: 他说，袭击发生后，一些福克斯员工暗示汤姆森酗酒——他否认饮酒——这导致了死亡和崩溃。他在宣誓书中表示，雇佣他为福克斯工作的安全咨询公司 SEPAR 在袭击发生几个月后解雇了他，但没有告诉他原因。 （SEPAR 没有回复 NPR 寻求置评的电话和电子邮件。）

paras.en: He blames Fox for his loss of a subsequent job. And he told NPR he was so distraught he later tried to take his own life.
paras.zh: 他指责福克斯导致他失去了随后的工作。他告诉美国国家公共广播电台，他非常心烦意乱，后来试图自杀。

paras.en: Former Fox security consultant Aaron King affirmed this and said Thomson did not abuse alcohol.
paras.zh: 福克斯前安全顾问亚伦·金证实了这一点，并表示汤姆森没有酗酒。

paras.en: In court documents, Fox's legal team noted that Thomson does not have concrete examples of specific claims being made about him. And the network argued it cannot be responsible for what is said unofficially about Thomson.
paras.zh: 在法庭文件中，福克斯的法律团队指出，汤姆森没有针对他提出具体指控的具体例子。该电视台辩称，它不能对有关汤姆森的非官方言论负责。

paras.en: Zakrzewski's widow, Michelle Ross-Stanton, last year filed a parallel civil lawsuit in London, where the couple lived, alleging that Fox did not properly secure the news crew's safety. Ross-Stanton told NPR that she cannot discuss the incident because of the litigation. (She first expressed her concerns in an interview published in a November 2022 story by Jeremy Barr, then of The Washington Post.) According to the Post, she was seeking more than $11 million in compensation for the failure to protect Zakrzewski from harm and to insure him adequately.
paras.zh: 扎克热夫斯基的遗孀米歇尔·罗斯-斯坦顿去年在这对夫妇居住的伦敦提起了一项平行民事诉讼，指控福克斯没有妥善确保新闻工作人员的安全。罗斯-斯坦顿告诉美国国家公共广播电台，由于诉讼，她无法讨论这一事件。 （她在当时的《华盛顿邮报》杰里米·巴尔 (Jeremy Barr) 2022 年 11 月发表的一篇报道中首次表达了她的担忧。）据《华盛顿邮报》报道，她因未能保护扎克热夫斯基免受伤害并为他提供充分保险而寻求超过 1100 万美元的赔偿。

paras.en: The lawsuit on behalf of the Kuvshynovs and Thomson raises questions of what evidence is relevant and whether U.S. law applies to an incident in a war zone thousands of miles away.
paras.zh: 代表库夫希诺夫和汤姆森的诉讼提出了哪些证据是相关的以及美国法律是否适用于千里之外的战区事件的问题。

paras.en: The suit alleges that Fox's actions rise to the level of corporate negligence under the Ukrainian civil code. The company argues that its New York-based executives cannot be held to account under Ukrainian law — in part because, it says, a key element of the relevant law didn't even exist until a year after the incident.
paras.zh: 该诉讼称，福克斯的行为已上升至乌克兰民法规定的企业过失的程度。该公司辩称，根据乌克兰法律，其驻纽约的高管不能被追究责任，部分原因是相关法律的关键要素直到事件发生一年后才存在。

paras.en: The odds that the Kuvshynovs will win their lawsuit appear long. They are up against a media empire. And the case has experienced setbacks.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫家族赢得诉讼的可能性似乎很小。他们面对的是一个媒体帝国。而案件也曾遭遇挫折。

paras.en: In December, Judge Mary V. Rosado dropped Rupert Murdoch and Fox News Media CEO Suzanne Scott as defendants from the case. Rosado also dismissed HarperCollins, the Murdoch-owned publisher that issued Hall's memoir, Saved: A War Reporter's Mission to Make It Home. The judge additionally rejected two of the counts filed by Thomson.
paras.zh: 去年 12 月，法官玛丽·V·罗萨多 (Mary V. Rosado) 不再将鲁珀特·默多克 (Rupert Murdoch) 和福克斯新闻媒体首席执行官苏珊娜·斯科特 (Suzanne Scott) 作为该案的被告。罗萨多还解雇了默多克旗下的哈珀柯林斯出版社，该出版社出版了霍尔的回忆录《拯救：战地记者的回家使命》。法官还驳回了汤姆森提出的两项指控。

paras.en: But some of his counts remain, including accusations of tortious interference and infliction of emotional distress. And Rosado ruled that the case can proceed to the discovery phase. That means the Kuvshynovs' legal team can review Fox News' internal correspondence, footage, materials and other evidence.
paras.zh: 但他的一些指控仍然存在，包括侵权干扰和造成精神痛苦的指控。罗萨多裁定此案可以进入证据开示阶段。这意味着库夫希诺夫家族的法律团队可以审查福克斯新闻的内部信件、录像、材料和其他证据。

paras.en: In stark terms, the judge rejected Fox's argument for dismissal.
paras.zh: 法官直截了当地驳回了福克斯的驳回论点。

paras.en: In her order, Rosado said it would be "a grave injustice" to deny the Kuvshynovs the ability to investigate whether Fox was telling them the truth. She noted that they were not represented by an attorney when they signed the agreement with Fox.
paras.zh: 罗萨多在命令中表示，剥夺库夫希诺夫家族调查福克斯是否告诉他们真相的能力将是“严重的不公正”。她指出，当他们与福克斯签署协议时，没有律师代表。

paras.en: "The circumstances under which Kuvshynova died were allegedly misrepresented to the Kuvshynovs, who, given the circumstances of grieving the loss of a daughter while navigating a calamitous invasion by a large nuclear-armed country, did not have the ability to investigate whether the Fox Defendants' representation of events was accurate," Rosado continued.
paras.zh: 罗萨多继续说道：“库夫希诺娃的死亡情况据称被向库夫希诺夫家族歪曲，考虑到在一个拥有核武器的大国的灾难性入侵期间失去女儿的悲痛，他们没有能力调查福克斯被告对事件的描述是否准确。”

paras.en: And the Kuvshynovs' lawyer, Humphreys, believes he has an unimpeachable source to use against Fox and Hall: Hall's own words. While his memoir's publisher is no longer on the hook, the Kuvshynovs' attorney is still using the book to help make their case.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺夫夫妇的律师汉弗莱斯相信，他有一个无懈可击的证据来反对福克斯和霍尔：霍尔自己的话。尽管库夫希诺夫回忆录的出版商不再承担责任，但库夫希诺夫夫妇的律师仍在利用这本书来帮助他们辩护。

paras.en: On first encounter, Humphreys seems an unlikely choice to take on topflight white-shoe defense firms hired by the United States' most profitable news channel. He has represented clients against the University of Georgia — the campus from which he earned his law degree — and against the state's larger public university system.
paras.zh: 在第一次交锋中，汉弗莱斯似乎不太可能选择与美国最赚钱的新闻频道雇用的顶级白鞋防御公司较量。他曾代表客户反对佐治亚大学（他获得法律学位的校园）以及该州更大的公立大学系统。

paras.en: Yet Humphreys is not unfamiliar with the corridors of power. He once worked in Washington, D.C., as an aide and speechwriter to then-U.S. Sen. Wyche Fowler, who remembers Humphreys as quick to try to right perceived injustices.
paras.zh: 然而汉弗莱斯对权力走廊并不陌生。他曾在华盛顿特区工作，担任当时美国总统的助手和演讲撰稿人。参议员威奇·福勒（Wyche Fowler）记得汉弗莱斯很快就试图纠正人们认为的不公正现象。

paras.en: "He is persistent and he is tenacious," Fowler says now.
paras.zh: “他很执着，也很顽强，”福勒现在说道。

paras.en: Fox is appealing Judge Rosado's ruling. It is also seeking to have Thomson's remaining allegations thrown out. (A new judge is overseeing the case since Rosado's retirement this year.)
paras.zh: 福克斯正在对罗萨多法官的裁决提出上诉。它还寻求推翻汤姆森的其余指控。 （自罗萨多今年退休以来，一名新法官正在监督此案。）

paras.en: The suit against Fox filed by Zakrzewski's widow, Michelle Ross-Stanton, is still winding its way through the British legal system. While she said she cannot comment on her case, Ross-Stanton told NPR that she held a celebration for what would have been Zakrzewski's 60th birthday in August.
paras.zh: 扎克热夫斯基的遗孀米歇尔·罗斯·斯坦顿对福克斯提起的诉讼仍在英国法律体系中蜿蜒前行。虽然罗斯-斯坦顿表示无法对自己的案件发表评论，但她告诉 NPR，她在 8 月份举办了一场庆祝活动，庆祝扎克热夫斯基的 60 岁生日。

paras.en: Ross-Stanton — a veteran reporter herself — is aiding the French National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor's Office with research and investigation. The office has initiated a formal judicial investigation of war crimes in the fatal strike, working with Irish and Ukrainian authorities.
paras.zh: 罗斯-斯坦顿本人也是一名资深记者，正在协助法国国家反恐检察官办公室进行研究和调查。该办公室已与爱尔兰和乌克兰当局合作，对这起致命袭击中的战争罪展开正式司法调查。

paras.en: In Ukraine, the prosecutor general's office told NPR that national police are still conducting a pretrial investigation into the deaths of Kuvshynova and Zakrzewski in advance of possible criminal proceedings against Russian forces.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰，总检察长办公室告诉美国国家公共广播电台，国家警察仍在对库夫希诺娃和扎克热夫斯基的死亡进行审前调查，然后可能对俄罗斯军队提起刑事诉讼。

paras.en: The day after Kuvshynova died, her former boyfriend, Yurash, signed papers to join the Ukrainian armed forces, he said. He is now an army sergeant while remaining in parliament. In the intervening years, Yurash has married and had a baby. He has commissioned a sculpture in Kuvshynova's honor.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃去世后的第二天，她的前男友尤拉什签署了加入乌克兰武装部队的文件，他说。他现在是一名陆军中士，同时仍留在议会。在随后的几年里，尤拉什结婚并生了孩子。他委托为库夫希诺娃制作一座雕塑。

paras.en: Weeks after her death, another friend of Kuvshynova, Oleksii Horbach, paid tribute in an online memorial.
paras.zh: 库夫希诺娃去世几周后，库夫希诺娃的另一位朋友奥莱克西·霍巴赫 (Oleksii Horbach) 在网上悼念活动中表达了哀悼。

paras.en: "I asked her repeatedly, 'Why, Oleksandra, do you have to do this?'" Horbach said, in remarks interpreted by NPR. "And she told me once, 'It is impossible to climb any peak without risk.' That's why she wanted to be a war correspondent, to be useful, to be in the center of events."
paras.zh: “我反复问她，‘为什么，奥莱克桑德拉，你必须这样做？’”霍巴赫在 NPR 解读的言论中说道。 “她有一次告诉我，‘没有风险就不可能攀登任何高峰。’”这就是为什么她想成为一名战地记者，成为有用的人，成为事件的中心。”

paras.en: Kuvshynova's mission — to tell the world about what was happening to her country — remains admirable, her friends say.
paras.zh: 她的朋友们说，库夫希诺娃的使命——向世界讲述她的国家正在发生的事情——仍然令人钦佩。

paras.en: But her parents argue that those she worked for, and trusted, failed to protect her.
paras.zh: 但她的父母认为，她为之工作和信任的人未能保护她。

paras.en: "Fox treated us shamefully because they didn't consider us and didn't respect us," said Kuvshynova's mother, Iryna Mamaysur. "Something went wrong."
paras.zh: “福克斯对我们感到羞耻，因为他们不考虑我们，也不尊重我们，”库夫希诺娃的母亲伊琳娜·马马苏尔 (Iryna Mamaysur) 说。 “出事了。”

paras.en: "This world has lost Oleksandra Kuvshynova — a musician, a poet, an athlete, a photographer and the best daughter. It lost my love."
paras.zh: “这个世界失去了奥列克桑德拉·库夫希诺娃（Oleksandra Kuvshynova）——一位音乐家、诗人、运动员、摄影师和最好的女儿。它失去了我的爱。”

articles.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队因涉嫌在日本冲绳谋杀一名妇女而被捕

paras.en: TOKYO — Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday, the latest criminal case on the southern island where the heavy American troop presence has remained a sensitive issue.
paras.zh: 东京——日本官员周日表示，日本警方逮捕了一名涉嫌在冲绳抢劫并谋杀一名妇女的美国海军陆战队员，这是冲绳南部岛屿上最新的刑事案件，那里的大量美军驻扎仍然是一个敏感问题。

paras.en: The Okinawa prefectural police said they arrested a 20-year-old Marine stationed at the Futenma Air Station on suspicion of killing a 39-year-old local woman at a hotel in Naha, Okinawa's capital city, and taking her wallet and backpack in the early hours of Saturday.
paras.zh: 冲绳县警方表示，他们逮捕了驻扎在普天间机场的一名 20 岁海军陆战队员，原因是他涉嫌于周六凌晨在冲绳首府那霸的一家酒店杀害了一名 39 岁的当地妇女，并抢走了她的钱包和背包。

paras.en: Kyodo News agency, citing the police, reported the woman's body was found in her hotel room and she appeared to have been strangled to death.
paras.zh: 共同社援引警方消息称，该女子的尸体在酒店房间内被发现，她似乎是被勒死的。

paras.en: Police said security camera footage showed the man believed to be the suspect entering the hotel with the victim and coming out alone. An officer arrested the suspect after spotting him walking alone on a street in Naha's entertainment district late Saturday, Kyodo said.
paras.zh: 警方称，监控录像显示，这名男子被认为是嫌疑人，与受害者一起进入酒店，然后独自出来。共同社称，周六晚，一名警官发现嫌疑人独自在那霸娱乐区的街道上行走，随后将其逮捕。

paras.en: "The case deals a major shock and adds fear to the Okinawans who have already been forced to live next to U.S. bases," newly elected Okinawa Gov. Genta Koja told reporters. "It is absolutely unforgivable and we are outraged."
paras.zh: 新当选的冲绳知事古贾元太对记者表示：“这起案件造成了重大冲击，给已经被迫住在美国基地附近的冲绳人增添了恐惧。” “这绝对是不可原谅的，我们感到愤怒。”

paras.en: "I must say, discipline and troop education are not working at all," said Koja, referring to the U.S. military's measures taken in response to past criminal cases.
paras.zh: 科贾说：“我必须说，纪律和部队教育根本不起作用。”他指的是美军针对过去刑事案件采取的措施。

paras.en: Some 50,000 U.S. troops are deployed in Japan under a bilateral security pact, about half of them on Okinawa, whose strategic role is seen as increasingly important for the Japan-U.S. military alliance amid growing tensions with China. Japan's southwestern shift in its military focus centers heavily on Okinawa and its nearby islands.
paras.zh: 根据双边安全协议，约有 5 万名美军部署在日本，其中约一半部署在冲绳岛。在与中国关系日益紧张的情况下，冲绳岛的战略作用被视为对日美军事同盟越来越重要。日本军事重心向西南部转移主要集中在冲绳及其附近岛屿。

paras.en: Okinawans have long complained about noise, pollution and crime related to U.S. bases, with crimes involving U.S. service members on Okinawa complicating ties between Japan's central government and the Okinawa administration. The latest case comes as Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's cabinet pushes to further fortify its Japanese military presence on Okinawa and work more closely with the U.S. military.
paras.zh: 冲绳人长期以来一直抱怨与美国基地有关的噪音、污染和犯罪，其中涉及驻冲绳美国军人的犯罪行为使日本中央政府和冲绳政府之间的关系变得复杂化。最新案件发生之际，日本首相高市早苗内阁正在推动进一步加强日本在冲绳的军事存在，并与美军进行更密切的合作。

paras.en: "The occurrence of the heinous crime is extremely regrettable," Takaichi said in her message on X. She said her government has strongly protested to the U.S. side and demanded maximum cooperation with the Japanese authorities in the investigation, as well as tougher discipline for U.S. service members and preventive measures.
paras.zh: 高一在X号留言中表示，“这一令人发指的罪行的发生令人极为遗憾”。她表示，日本政府已向美方提出强烈抗议，要求日本当局在调查工作中给予最大程度的合作，并加强对美国军人的纪律和预防措施。

paras.en: Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi summoned U.S. Ambassador to Japan George Glass to his office and conveyed "outrage," the ministry said in a statement.
paras.zh: 日本外务大臣茂木敏充在一份声明中表示，将美国驻日本大使乔治·格拉斯召至办公室，表达了“愤慨”。

paras.en: Glass, on X, expressed condolences to the victim's family, adding that the United States is cooperating with the Japanese national and local governments.
paras.zh: 格拉斯在X上向遇难者家属表示哀悼，并补充说，美国正在与日本国家和地方政府合作。

paras.en: The U.S. Marine Corps said in a statement the suspect is assigned to the III Marine Expeditionary Force on Okinawa and that it is fully cooperating with Japanese authorities. "The Marine Corps takes these allegations very seriously and expects every Marine to adhere to the highest standards of behavior."
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队在一份声明中表示，嫌疑人被派往冲绳的第三海军远征军，并表示正在与日本当局充分合作。 “海军陆战队非常严肃地对待这些指控，并希望每一位海军陆战队都能遵守最高的行为标准。”

paras.en: Futenma base, located in a densely populated area in central Okinawa, has been a sore spot for many Okinawans for decades, who demanded its relocation. Despite protests, the central government greenlit construction to relocate the base to Henoko on Okinawa's eastern coast, though the project has faced massive delays.
paras.zh: 普天间基地位于冲绳中部人口稠密地区，几十年来一直是许多冲绳人的痛处，他们要求将其搬迁。尽管遭到抗议，中央政府还是批准了将基地迁至冲绳东海岸边野古的建设计划，尽管该项目面临着大规模的延误。

paras.en: A high-profile 1995 rape of a 12-year-old girl by three U.S. service members sparked massive protests against the heavy U.S. troop presence on Okinawa. The number of arrests related to U.S. service members and their families exceeded 100 last year, according to prefectural police. Repeated occurrence of sexual crimes and some of their delayed disclosures have also sparked outrage on Okinawa in recent years.
paras.zh: 1995 年，三名美国军人强奸一名 12 岁女孩，引发了人们对冲绳大量驻军的大规模抗议。据县警方称，去年与美国军人及其家人有关的逮捕人数超过 100 人。近年来，反复发生的性犯罪事件以及部分案件迟迟未披露也引发了冲绳民众的愤怒。
