paras.zh: 迄今为止世界大奖赛的全部成绩

articles.title: Wakefield's Walmsley lives out Grand Final dream but uncertainty lies ahead

paras.en: The Super League Grand Final winner without a contract for 2027: Wakefield Trinity's Lachlan Walmsley lives out dream but uncertainty lies ahead
paras.zh: 没有2027年合同的超级联赛总决赛冠军：韦克菲尔德三一队的拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利实现了梦想，但未来充满不确定性

paras.en: Lachlan Walmsley came up with an assist in the Super League Grand Final but is without a contract for 2027; he was part of the Wakefield side that made history and ended a 58-year top-flight trophy drought
paras.zh: 拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利在中超总决赛中送出助攻，但他没有 2027 年的合同；他是韦克菲尔德队的一员，创造了历史，结束了长达 58 年的顶级联赛冠军荒

paras.en: Lachlan Walmsley is potentially in the most unique position of all. A Super League Grand Final winner with Wakefield Trinity and without a contract for 2027.
paras.zh: 拉克兰·沃尔姆斯利（Lachlan Walmsley）可能处于最独特的位置。韦克菲尔德三一队的超级联赛总决赛冠军，但没有 2027 年的合同。

paras.en: Walmsley was part of the Wakefield side that made history with their 23-10 victory over Warrington Wolves in the Super League Grand Final to become only the sixth winners of the competition.
paras.zh: 沃姆斯利所在的韦克菲尔德队在超级联赛总决赛中以23比10战胜沃灵顿狼队，创造了历史，成为该赛事的第六支获胜者。

paras.en: It ended a 58-year top-flight trophy drought for a side that have gone through everything Super League has had to offer. From at one point struggling to keep the lights on, they are now at the top of the sport.
paras.zh: 对于这支经历过超级联赛一切的球队来说，它结束了长达 58 年的顶级联赛奖杯荒。从一度为保持比赛状态而苦苦挣扎，到现在他们已处于这项运动的巅峰。

paras.en: During that game, winger Walmsley came up with an audacious no-look flick pass to set up Wakefield's opening try for Cam Scott. It was his farewell to a club that have given him so much.
paras.zh: 在那场比赛中，边锋沃姆斯利大胆地无视轻弹传球，为韦克菲尔德为卡姆·斯科特的开球创造了机会。这是他告别一个给了他如此多的俱乐部的人。

paras.en: Prior to living out his dream, Walmsley made a handful of appearances in the second division of Australian rugby before deciding to chase the dream on the other side of the world.
paras.zh: 在实现自己的梦想之前，沃姆斯利在澳大利亚橄榄球二级联赛中出场过几次，然后决定去世界的另一边追逐梦想。

paras.en: He gambled on a move to the UK with Championship side Whitehaven before joining Halifax Panthers were he scored 68 tries in 54 games and earned recognition.
paras.zh: 在加盟哈利法克斯黑豹队之前，他曾赌注要加盟英冠球队白天堂队前往英国，他在 54 场比赛中射门 68 次并赢得了认可。

paras.en: That caught the eye of Wakefield as they entered the Championship following their relegation in 2023. It was Walmsley's first full-time contract.
paras.zh: 当韦克菲尔德在 2023 年降级后进入英冠球队时，这一点引起了他们的注意。这是沃姆斯利的第一份全职合同。

paras.en: Three seasons later, he is a Grand Final champion.
paras.zh: 三个赛季后，他成为总决赛冠军。

paras.en: But now, once emotions subside his focus will have to turn to trying to get a contract for next season. Part of Walmsley's problem is he takes up a quota spot for clubs.
paras.zh: 但现在，一旦情绪消退，他的注意力将不得不转向争取下赛季的合同。沃姆斯利的部分问题是他占据了俱乐部的配额。

paras.en: "Hopefully something will come through in the next couple of weeks," Walmsley said.
paras.zh: 沃姆斯利说：“希望在接下来的几周内能有所进展。”

paras.en: "I have already had a dig at both Matt [Ellis] and Powelly [Daryl Powell] and said surely one more year won't hurt.
paras.zh: “我已经挖苦过马特（埃利斯）和鲍威利（达里尔·鲍威尔），并表示再多一年肯定不会有什么坏处。

paras.en: "I don't know. I haven't really thought about it. I have kind of put it in the back of my mind because, obviously, the Grand Final's coming up.
paras.zh: “我不知道。我还没有真正考虑过它。我已经把它放在脑后了，因为很明显，总决赛即将到来。

paras.en: "I will leave it to my agent and see what he can get. I have got a good mate in France who wants me to come play there. I might go play a bit, but we'll see what happens.
paras.zh: “我会把它留给我的经纪人，看看他能得到什么。我在法国有一个好朋友，他希望我去那里踢球。我可能会去踢球，但我们会看看会发生什么。”

paras.en: "If I wasn't on a quota spot, I'd probably get a few offers. It is just because I'm a quota. It just is what it is, isn't it?"
paras.zh: “如果我没有获得配额，我可能会收到一些报价。这只是因为我是一个配额。事情就是这样，不是吗？”

paras.en: Despite the uncertainty around his future, Walmsley knows he is a perfect example of someone taking a leap, putting the work in, and it paying off.
paras.zh: 尽管沃姆斯利的未来充满不确定性，但他知道自己是一个跨越式发展、投入工作并获得回报的完美典范。

paras.en: "Obviously chase your dreams and anything can happen. A bit of luck involved, but you take what you get," Walmsley added.
paras.zh: “显然，追逐你的梦想，任何事情都有可能发生。这涉及到一点运气，但你会得到你所得到的，”沃姆斯利补充道。

paras.en: "Coming from Whitehaven and then Halifax for a couple of years and just to be here now and have that ring on my finger.
paras.zh: “我从怀特黑文来到哈利法克斯几年了，现在来到这里，把戒指戴在了我的手指上。

paras.en: Whatever happens, Walmsley will forever be one of Wakefield's immortals.
paras.zh: 无论发生什么，沃姆斯利都将永远是韦克菲尔德的不朽人物之一。

articles.title: Daryz seeks historic Arc double

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Daryz seeks historic Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe double
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：达里兹寻求历史性的凯旋门双冠王

paras.en: Daryz - last year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner - looks to become the first colt to retain the prize since 1978 when he goes to post for Europe's premier race at 3.05pm, live on Sky Sports Racing; The race is the feature of eight from Paris, alongside domestic racing from Uttoxeter.
paras.zh: 达里兹（Daryz）是去年凯旋门大奖赛的冠军，他有望成为自 1978 年以来第一匹卫冕该奖项的小马，当时他将于下午 3 点 05 分在天空体育赛车直播的欧洲顶级比赛中发帖；这场比赛是巴黎八场比赛的一大特色，另外还有尤托克西特的国内比赛。

paras.en: Daryz seeks to retain his Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe crown in the 2026 renewal of Europe's richest race - live on Sky Sports Racing at 3.05pm.
paras.zh: 达里兹力求在 2026 年欧洲最富有的比赛中保住自己的凯旋门大奖赛桂冠，天空体育赛车直播将于下午 3 点 05 分直播。

paras.en: 3.05 ParisLongchamp - Daryz bids for historic Arc double
paras.zh: 3.05 ParisLongchamp - Daryz 竞标历史性的 Arc 双打

paras.en: Daryz will look for an historic back-to-back double in Europe's biggest race, bidding to be the first colt since Alleged in 1978 to achieve this feat.
paras.zh: 达里兹将在欧洲最大的比赛中寻求历史性的背靠背双冠，力争成为自1978年据称实现这一壮举的第一匹小马。

paras.en: Francis-Henri Graffard's colt looked as good as ever when he returned in the Prix Ganay, which was then followed up with an equally sparkling performance in the Prix Aga Khan IV. A trip to Royal Ascot in June for the Prince Of Wales' Stakes didn't go to plan as he was third, although it transpired blood issues were found following the race.
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德（Francis-Henri Graffard）的小马在加奈大奖赛（Prix Ganay）中回归时看起来一如既往地出色，随后在阿加汗四世赛（Prix Aga Khan IV）中也有同样出色的表现。六月，威尔士亲王锦标赛前往皇家阿斯科特赛马会的行程并未按计划进行，因为他获得了第三名，尽管赛后发现了血液问题。

paras.en: After a break, Graffard's star made light work of Coronation Cup winner Bay City Roller - who he reopposes today - in the Prix Foy, with the trainer saying he was only 75 per cent fit. Having been drawn in stall five, this short priced favourite will take all the beating with connections very confident.
paras.zh: 休息后，格拉法德的球星在福伊大奖赛上对加冕杯冠军贝城罗勒（Bay City Roller）进行了轻松的训练，教练称他的健康状况只有 75%。在第五号摊位上抽签后，这款价格低廉的热门产品将以非常自信的方式承受所有打击。

paras.en: - Kevin Blake's Arc day tips: Three fancies on star-studded undercard
paras.zh: - 凯文·布莱克 (Kevin Blake) 的 Arc Day 秘诀：对明星云集的底牌的三种幻想

paras.en: - Who wins the Arc? Sky Sports Racing team tips
paras.zh: - 谁赢得了弧线？天空体育赛车队提示

paras.en: Kalpana was seventh in this contest last year and connections are keen for redemption as she returns to ParisLongchamp looking to emulate Juddmonte filly Bluestocking, who two-years ago took this famous prize. The King George winner looks good as ever this year and has racked up two Group 1s. Drawn in stall six, conditions look well-suited and with Colin Keane having had another year of riding her, she could go very close.
paras.zh: Kalpana 去年在这项比赛中获得第七名，当她重返巴黎 Longchamp 并希望效仿 Juddmonte 母马 Bluestocking 时，人们都渴望得到救赎，后者两年前获得了这一著名奖项。这位乔治国王冠军今年看起来一如既往地出色，并且已经两次获得一级联赛冠军。在六号摊位上绘制的，条件看起来很合适，而且科林·基恩又骑了一年，她可以非常接近。

paras.en: Maltese Cross looks to give William Haggas his first Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as this progressive three-year-old looks to continue progressing in notching up his second Group 1. After finishing second in the Derby, this son of Sea The Stars went on to win the Grand Prix de Paris and backed that up with a win in the Great Voltigeur Stakes. His chances have been dealt a blow though, having being drawn in stall 11.
paras.zh: 马耳他·十字 (Maltese Cross) 希望为威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 带来他的首个凯旋门大奖赛，这位进步的三岁马希望在他的第二个一级赛中继续取得进步。在德比中获得第二名后，这支海星之子继续赢得巴黎大奖赛，并在伏尔蒂格锦标赛 (Great Voltigeur Stakes) 中获胜。不过，他的机会受到了打击，因为他在第 11 号档位被抽签。

paras.en: Aidan O'Brien runs three Classic winners in Europe's premier race, with Ryan Moore opting to ride Irish Derby winner Benvenuto Cellini over Diamond Necklace, who has been allocated the dreaded stall 16. Last year's runner-up Minnie Hauk completes the trio and will be partnered by William Buick in a bid to go one better.
paras.zh: 艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 在欧洲顶级赛事中获得了三场经典赛冠军，瑞恩·摩尔 (Ryan Moore) 选择骑乘爱尔兰德比冠军本韦努托·切利尼 (Benvenuto Cellini)，而不是钻石项链 (Diamond Necklace)，钻石项链被分配到可怕的第 16 档位。去年的亚军米妮·豪克 (Minnie Hauk) 完成了三人组的比赛，并将与威廉·别克 (William Buick) 搭档，争取取得更好的成绩。

paras.en: 3.50 ParisLongchamp - Star mare Aventure headlines field of nine
paras.zh: 3.50 ParisLongchamp - 明星母马冒险头条九场

paras.en: Aventure looks to add to her impressive record against her own sex when she headlines this field of nine in the Group 1 Prix de l'Opera Longines.
paras.zh: 当她在浪琴表歌剧院大奖赛第一组的九场比赛中成为头条新闻时，Aventure 似乎会为她与同性的令人印象深刻的记录再添一笔。

paras.en: Christophe Ferland's star mare has contested the Arc in the last two years, finishing second and eleventh respectively. This year she returns to racing against fillies and mares, against whom her record reads eight victories from 12 starts - including two Group 1s.
paras.zh: 克里斯托弗·费兰 (Christophe Ferland) 的明星母马在过去两年中参加了弧形赛，分别获得第二名和第十一名。今年，她重返赛场，与母马和母马比赛，她在 12 场比赛中赢得了 8 场胜利，其中包括两次一级赛。

paras.en: She bounced back from defeat at the hands of Daryz in the Prix Ganay when downing Sunly in the Prix Corrida. Calandagan proved too good for her in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud but her big day came when she subsequently took out the Prix Jean et Louis Romanet at Deauville in the summer, defeating the unbeaten Diamond Necklace.
paras.zh: 她在 Prix Corrida 比赛中击败 Sunly，从在 Prix Ganay 比赛中输给 Daryz 的失利中恢复过来。卡兰甘在圣克劳德大奖赛中证明了自己的实力，但当她随后在夏天的多维尔举行的让·路易·罗曼内大奖赛中击败不败的钻石项链队时，她的大日子到来了。

paras.en: Three-year-old Pink Panthera appears to be the best of the rest. She has hit the crossbar twice at Group 1 level this season - firstly in the Prix de Diane and then last time out in the Prix Vermeille. Three-year-olds have a fabulous record in this contest, having won eight out of the last 10 renewals.
paras.zh: 三岁的粉红豹似乎是其余中最好的。本赛季，她在一级联赛中两次击中横梁，第一次是在黛安大奖赛，最后一次是在维梅耶大奖赛。三岁孩子在这场比赛中取得了惊人的战绩，在过去的 10 场比赛中赢得了 8 场。

paras.en: Irish 1000 and Coronation Stakes winner Precise has been highly tried this year and takes the set up in trip for the first time, with Ryan Moore taking the ride.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰 1000 和 Coronation Stakes 冠军 Precise 今年经过了严格的考验，并首次在比赛中进行设置，由 Ryan Moore 驾驶。

paras.en: 4.25 ParisLongchamp - Samangan and Thesecretadversary clash again in the Foret
paras.zh: 4.25 ParisLongchamp - Samangan 和 Thesecretadversary 再次在 Foret 发生冲突

paras.en: Samangan and Thesecretadversary meet again, this time in the Group 1 Qatar Prix de la Foret over seven furlongs.
paras.zh: 萨曼根和秘密对手再次相遇，这次是在 1 级卡塔尔拉福雷大奖赛上，赛段超过 7 弗隆。

paras.en: Thesecretadversary got the better of the Francis-Henri Graffard trained Samangan in the Prix Jean Prat, which followed victory in the Jersey Stakes at Royal Ascot. The son of St Mark's Basilica then went up in trip to the Prix Jacques le Marois, which saw him beaten three lengths by Rayif - another Aga Khan colt trained by Francis-Henri Graffard.
paras.zh: 在皇家阿斯科特赛马会的泽西锦标赛中获胜后，秘密对手在让·普拉特大奖赛中击败了由弗朗西斯·亨利·格拉法德训练的萨曼根。圣马可大教堂的儿子随后参加了雅克·勒·马鲁瓦大奖赛，比赛中他被拉伊夫（另一匹由弗朗西斯·亨利·格拉法德训练的阿迦汗小马）击败了三马位。

paras.en: Samangan was in fourth that day with (the also re-opposing) True Love in second. He then went down in trip to the Prix Maurice de Gheest and brought up his first Group 1, seeing off the fast-finishing Divison to score.
paras.zh: 萨曼根当天排名第四，（同样反对的）真爱排名第二。随后，他在莫里斯·德·盖斯特大奖赛中失利，并首次在第一组中脱颖而出，击败了快速完成比赛的部门并取得了进球。

paras.en: True Love hasn't won since she became a classic winner in Newmarket's 1000 Guineas in May. She has since ran creditably in defeat, placing three times in Group 1 company. Nighttime looks to bounce back to form for Christopher Head, whilst Marvelman flies the flag for Andrew Balding.
paras.zh: 自五月份成为纽马克特 1000 坚尼赛的经典赢家以来，True Love 还没有获奖过。此后，她在竞选中表现出色，屡战屡败，三次获得第一组连队的名次。克里斯托弗·海德 (Christopher Head) 的夜间表现似乎有所恢复，而安德鲁·鲍丁 (Andrew Balding) 则在 Marvelman 的旗帜下飘扬。

paras.en: 12.31 ParisLongchamp - G1 Prix Marcel Boussac - Green Express heads an open looking contest
paras.zh: 12.31 ParisLongchamp - G1 Prix Marcel Boussac - Green Express 在一场公开的比赛中领先

paras.en: 1.09 ParisLongchamp - G1 Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere - National Stakes hero Folsom Blues returns
paras.zh: 1.09 ParisLongchamp - G1 大奖赛 Jean-Luc Lagardere - 国家锦标赛英雄 Folsom Blues 回归

paras.en: 1.47 ParisLongchamp - G1 Prix de l'Abbaye - Naana's Shadow takes on 14 in wide open contest
paras.zh: 1.47 ParisLongchamp - G1 Prix de l'Abbaye - Naana's Shadow 在公开赛中迎战第 14 名

paras.en: 2.25 ParisLongchamp - G1 Arabian World Cup - Rb Kingmaker & HM Alchahine feature
paras.zh: 2.25 ParisLongchamp - G1 阿拉伯世界杯 - Rb Kingmaker & HM Alchahine 专题

paras.en: 10.10 Keeneland - G3 Summer Stakes - Rebecca Menzies sends Adonius to take on Queen Mary third Ruiva
paras.zh: 10.10 基恩兰 - G3 夏季锦标赛 - 丽贝卡·孟席斯 (Rebecca Menzies) 派阿多尼斯 (Adonius) 迎战玛丽皇后第三名鲁瓦 (Ruiva)

articles.title: Pilot stabbed his co-pilot in apparent attempt to crash Israel-bound plane, Netanyahu says
articles.author: Phil Helsel

paras.en: TEL AVIV — A pilot stabbed his co-pilot aboard a plane headed to Israel on Wednesday and may have tried to crash the aircraft with 174 people on board, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡表示，周三，在一架飞往以色列的飞机上，一名飞行员刺伤了副驾驶，并可能试图撞毁这架载有 174 人的飞机。

paras.en: “I don’t think it was a hijacking. It looks like a suicide attempt, simply because of what this hero, Yaniv, has described,” Netanyahu said on “CBS Evening News,” referring to Yaniv Hayun, a passenger who said he entered the cockpit and subdued the attacker.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在《哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻》上说：“我不认为这是一次劫机。这看起来像是一次自杀未遂，仅仅是因为这位英雄亚尼夫所描述的事情。”他指的是乘客亚尼夫·哈云，他说他进入驾驶舱并制服了袭击者。

paras.en: The pilot who initiated the attack is an Omani citizen and is being interrogated in Saudi Arabia, Netanyahu said on the CBS program on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周三晚间在哥伦比亚广播公司节目中表示，发动袭击的飞行员是阿曼公民，目前正在沙特阿拉伯接受审讯。

paras.en: Netanyahu said a motive was being determined, including whether it was an attempt to commit an act of terrorism. He said he expected the suspect pilot would be moved to Dubai soon.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡表示，正在确定动机，包括是否企图实施恐怖主义行为。他说，他预计嫌疑飞行员将很快被转移到迪拜。

paras.en: “He’ll be investigated, interrogated and we’ll join the interrogation, and find out what happened there exactly,” Netanyahu said.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡说：“他将受到调查、审讯，我们将加入审讯，并查明那里到底发生了什么。”

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters on Wednesday that the attack was “an incredible story.”
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周三告诉记者，这次袭击是“一个令人难以置信的故事”。

paras.en: “I did speak to Bibi Netanyahu at length about this event, and it seems as though the co-pilot was perhaps a terrorist or perhaps a whack job, and he stabbed the pilot,” Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我确实与比比·内塔尼亚胡详细讨论了这一事件，副驾驶似乎可能是一名恐怖分子，或者可能是一名普通人，他刺伤了飞行员。”

paras.en: Passengers lived through scenes of terror as the Flydubai flight approaching Tel Aviv shook violently and abruptly plummeted. The flight had originated in Dubai.
paras.zh: 当飞往特拉维夫的迪拜航空航班剧烈摇晃并突然坠落时，乘客们经历了恐怖的场景。该航班从迪拜起飞。

paras.en: “I thought it was a plane malfunction, but then I started hearing screaming about the stabbings,” Aviatar Alevi, a 17-year-old student, told NBC News. “Then I understood the weight of the actual situation.”
paras.zh: “我以为这是飞机故障，但后来我开始听到有关刺伤事件的尖叫声，”17 岁的学生阿维塔·阿莱维 (Aviatar Alevi) 告诉 NBC 新闻。 “然后我就明白了实际情况的重要性。”

paras.en: Alevi said he thought he was going to die as he felt the plane rapidly descend, with “screaming, people running, panicking, blood.”
paras.zh: 阿莱维说，当他感觉到飞机迅速下降时，他以为自己快要死了，伴随着“尖叫声、人们奔跑、惊慌、流血”。

paras.en: Another passenger, Motti Cohen Or, 70, told NBC News that he heard a woman shouting that “someone is stabbing someone in the cockpit” before the aircraft dived “toward the ground.”
paras.zh: 另一位 70 岁的乘客莫蒂·科恩·奥尔 (Motti Cohen Or) 告诉 NBC 新闻，在飞机“向地面”俯冲之前，他听到一名女子大喊“有人在驾驶舱里刺伤某人”。

paras.en: Flight data indicates the Boeing 737, flight number FZ 1073, plunged by 14,125 feet in just 29 seconds, according to Flightradar24.
paras.zh: 根据 Flightradar24 的数据，飞行数据显示，航班号 FZ 1073 的波音 737 在短短 29 秒内下降了 14,125 英尺。

paras.en: All Flydubai flights to and from Israel have been temporarily suspended as authorities continue their investigation into what occurred on Flight FZ 1073, a spokesperson for the airline said in a statement.
paras.zh: 迪拜航空发言人在一份声明中表示，随着当局继续调查 FZ 1073 航班发生的事件，迪拜航空所有往返以色列的航班已暂停。

paras.en: “This temporary suspension will allow the relevant authorities to continue their work and establish all the facts surrounding the incident,” the spokesperson said in the statement.
paras.zh: 发言人在声明中表示：“暂时中止将使有关当局能够继续开展工作，查明与该事件有关的所有事实。”

paras.en: The midair incident led to a diversion and an emergency landing at Saudi Arabia’s Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz International Airport, known as Tabuk Airport. A rescue flight later brought passengers to Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport.
paras.zh: 这起空中事件导致飞机改道并紧急降落在沙特阿拉伯苏丹本阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子国际机场（塔布克机场）。随后，一架救援飞机将乘客送往以色列本古里安机场。

paras.en: At Ben Gurion, Netanyahu personally thanked a passenger still wearing a bloodied T-shirt, who told cameras he was among those to enter the cockpit and subdue the attacking pilot. Netanyahu’s office named the man as Hayun. Netanyahu later said that Hayun is a plumber in an interview on Fox News.
paras.zh: 在本古里安机场，内塔尼亚胡亲自感谢了一名仍然穿着血迹斑斑的T恤的乘客，这名乘客对镜头说，他是进入驾驶舱并制服了袭击飞行员的人之一。内塔尼亚胡的办公室称这名男子为哈云。内塔尼亚胡后来在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，哈云是一名水管工。

paras.en: Hayun told Netanyahu that, as he made his way to the cockpit, the plane took a steep nose dive which knocked him sideways, according to the Israeli government press office.
paras.zh: 据以色列政府新闻办公室称，哈云告诉内塔尼亚胡，当他走向驾驶舱时，飞机急剧俯冲，将他撞到一边。

paras.en: Three other passengers helped in the effort to save the plane and those aboard, Hayun told reporters at Ben Gurion.
paras.zh: 海云在本古里安机场告诉记者，另外三名乘客帮助拯救了飞机和机上人员。

paras.en: The group struggled to open the cockpit door.
paras.zh: 一行人奋力打开驾驶舱门。

paras.en: “We managed to get it open, but what made it difficult for us was the pilot himself — he had been stabbed and was on the other side of the door,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们设法把门打开了，但让我们遇到困难的是飞行员本人——他被刺伤了，而且就在门的另一边，”他说。

paras.en: Netanyahu said on the CBS program that when Hayun went in the cockpit he saw the pilot who had initiated the attack trying to crash the plane.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在哥伦比亚广播公司节目中表示，当哈云进入驾驶舱时，他看到发动袭击的飞行员试图撞毁飞机。

paras.en: “He wasn’t sitting in the pilot seat, trying to stabilize the plane, he was trying to jam the equipment,” Netanyahu said.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡说：“他没有坐在飞行员座位上试图稳定飞机，而是试图堵塞设备。”

paras.en: Hayun told Netanyahu that he confronted the pilot who had initiated the attack, according to the Israeli government press office.
paras.zh: 据以色列政府新闻办公室称，哈云告诉内塔尼亚胡，他与发起袭击的飞行员发生了冲突。

paras.en: “I grabbed the attacker, and choked him, pulled him out first,” Hayun said. “I started pulling the controls.”
paras.zh: “我抓住了袭击者，掐住了他的脖子，然后把他拉了出来，”海云说。 “我开始拉动控制装置。”

paras.en: Hayun told Netanyahu that he took actions based on what he had seen on a TV show and helped stabilize the plane, according to the Israeli government press office.
paras.zh: 据以色列政府新闻办公室称，哈云告诉内塔尼亚胡，他根据在电视节目中看到的情况采取了行动，并帮助稳定了飞机。

paras.en: “Thank God, we pulled it off. We really put our heads together and worked as a team,” Hayun said.
paras.zh: “感谢上帝，我们成功了。我们真的齐心协力，团队合作，”海云说。

paras.en: “It was between fear and a sense of a do-or-die situation,” Hayun added. “We had to win. We had to pull through and come out on top.”
paras.zh: “这是在恐惧和生死存亡的感觉之间，”海云补充道。 “我们必须获胜。我们必须渡过难关并取得胜利。”

paras.en: Israeli officials also praised the stabbed pilot, identified as Indian national Captain Smit Machchhar, for his actions in opening the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to rush in, secure the cockpit and prevent the plane from crashing.
paras.zh: 以色列官员还赞扬了被刺伤的飞行员，即印度国家机长斯米特·马赫恰尔，他打开驾驶舱门，允许乘客和机组人员冲进去，保护驾驶舱并防止飞机坠毁。

paras.en: “He saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals,” Netanyahu said on X. “I wish Captain Machchhar a speedy and full recovery. He is a true hero.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在 X 频道上表示：“他拯救了 174 人的生命，其中包括以色列公民和其他国民。我祝愿马赫恰尔上尉早日完全康复。他是一位真正的英雄。”

paras.en: In the interview on Fox News, Netanyahu said that there were 30 children on the plane.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，飞机上有30名儿童。

paras.en: Video from on board appeared to show two people lying on the floor, visibly bloodied as others crowd around them.
paras.zh: 船上的视频似乎显示两个人躺在地板上，明显血迹斑斑，其他人围在他们周围。

paras.en: Machchhar is in stable condition in a hospital in Saudi Arabia, according to the Indian Embassy in Riyadh.
paras.zh: 据印度驻利雅得大使馆称，马赫恰尔目前在沙特阿拉伯一家医院，情况稳定。

paras.en: Four U.S. citizens, who are dual nationals, were on the flight, per two U.S. officials.
paras.zh: 据两名美国官员称，飞机上有四名具有双重国籍的美国公民。

paras.en: Prime minister’s spokesperson Doron Spielman said that “there is a strong opinion” that the incident was a terror attack, “but we can’t be sure until we debrief everybody.”
paras.zh: 总理发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼表示，“人们强烈认为”这起事件是一起恐怖袭击，“但在我们向所有人汇报之前，我们无法确定。”

paras.en: No country or terror organization has claimed the incident.
paras.zh: 没有任何国家或恐怖组织声称对这起事件负责。

paras.en: Two senior U.S. law enforcement officials briefed on the investigation also told NBC News that investigators say the pilot who began stabbing the co-pilot is from Oman.
paras.zh: 两名了解调查情况的美国高级执法官员还告诉 NBC 新闻，调查人员表示，开始刺伤副驾驶的飞行员来自阿曼。

paras.en: The Omani Embassy in the U.S. did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 阿曼驻美国大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: An investigation by Saudi authorities is ongoing, David Mencer, a spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office, said.
paras.zh: 以色列总理办公室发言人戴维·门瑟表示，沙特当局正在进行调查。

paras.en: The stabbing increasingly looks like an act of terrorism based on the early results from the investigation, according to a senior U.S. official briefed on the Israeli investigation and a Saudi official briefed on the investigation.
paras.zh: 一名了解以色列调查情况的美国高级官员和一名了解调查情况的沙特官员表示，根据调查的早期结果，这起刺伤事件越来越像是恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: The spokesperson for the Saudi Embassy in the U.S., Hessa Alyahya, said authorities were waiting to determine whether the attack was a dispute between the pilots or whether it was an act sponsored by Iran or the Houthis. She said it was expected that more would be known within 24 hours.
paras.zh: 沙特驻美国大使馆发言人赫萨·阿利亚亚 (Hessa Alyahya) 表示，当局正在等待确定此次袭击是否是飞行员之间的纠纷，还是伊朗或胡塞武装发起的行动。她表示预计 24 小时内将会了解更多信息。

paras.en: Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, deputy prime minister and foreign affairs minister of the United Arab Emirates, and Israel’s foreign affairs minister, Gideon Saar, spoke on the phone Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 周三下午，阿拉伯联合酋长国副总理兼外交部长谢赫·阿卜杜拉·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬与以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔通了电话。

paras.en: According to the UAE Foreign Affairs Ministry, Al Nahyan asked about the safety of passengers on the Flydubai flight, which had “experienced a security incident that was successfully brought under control” and wished “good health and well-being” for the passengers.
paras.zh: 据阿联酋外交部称，阿勒纳哈扬询问了迪拜航空航班上乘客的安全情况，该航班“经历了一次安全事件，但已成功得到控制”，并祝愿乘客“身体健康”。

paras.en: There are no indications that Iran directed or was involved in today’s attack, a senior U.S. official briefed on the Israeli investigation told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一位了解以色列调查情况的美国高级官员告诉 NBC 新闻，没有迹象表明伊朗指挥或参与了今天的袭击。

paras.en: The preliminary Israeli investigation strongly suggests that the incident was an attempted terrorist attack by the Omani pilot who stabbed his co-pilot, the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员说，以色列的初步调查强烈表明，这起事件是阿曼飞行员企图实施恐怖袭击，刺伤了副驾驶。

paras.en: Netanyahu said on CBS that it was too early to tell if there was any Iranian involvement.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在哥伦比亚广播公司表示，现在判断伊朗是否参与其中还为时过早。

paras.en: “We’ve had signs that Iran, in particular through its proxies, was intending to heighten terrorist attacks against Israel and Israeli nationals abroad,” Netanyahu said. “But I think it’s too early to say whether there was Iranian collusion here. I think we’ll find out. It won’t take a long time.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡说：“我们有迹象表明，伊朗，特别是通过其代理人，打算加强对以色列和海外以色列国民的恐怖袭击。” “但我认为现在说这里是否有伊朗勾结还为时过早。我想我们会找到答案的。这不会花很长时间。”

paras.en: The aircraft was “successfully secured” and landed by on-duty crew traveling on board, Flydubai said.
paras.zh: Flydubai 表示，飞机“成功安全”并由机上值班机组人员着陆。

paras.en: “At this early stage, the underlying reasons and motives behind this event are unknown and remain subject to a formal investigation,” the airline said, adding: “We urge all parties to refrain from premature speculation while authorities gather the facts.”
paras.zh: 该航空公司表示：“目前尚不清楚该事件背后的根本原因和动机，仍有待正式调查。”并补充说：“我们敦促各方在当局收集事实期间不要过早猜测。”

paras.en: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz meanwhile told Israeli media the incident “was a jihadist terrorist attack attempt,” without saying how he reached that conclusion.
paras.zh: 与此同时，以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨告诉以色列媒体，该事件“是一次圣战恐怖袭击企图”，但没有说明他是如何得出这一结论的。

paras.en: After hours on the ground in Saudi Arabia, the diverted passengers were brought back to Ben Gurion Airport, where they were greeted by well-wishers waving Israeli flags and reunited with family members.
paras.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯地面停留几个小时后，改道的乘客被带回本古里安机场，在那里他们受到挥舞着以色列国旗的祝福者的欢迎，并与家人团聚。

paras.en: Some of those returning waved to the cameras and discussed their experiences, while exhausted parents carried their young children through the terminal.
paras.zh: 一些返回的人向镜头挥手并讨论他们的经历，而疲惫的父母则抱着年幼的孩子穿过航站楼。

paras.en: Peleg Itali, 17, said there was a family with small children near him on the flight.
paras.zh: 17 岁的佩莱格·伊塔利 (Peleg Itali) 说，飞机上他附近有一个带着小孩的家庭。

paras.en: “The mother doesn’t even know what to tell them,” he said. “No one knows everything, because no one knew what was going on.”
paras.zh: “母亲甚至不知道该告诉他们什么，”他说。 “没有人知道一切，因为没有人知道发生了什么。”

paras.en: At least one person, a passenger in his 50s, was taken to a hospital with a “chest injury,” said Aryeh Myers, a paramedic with Magen David Adom, Israel’s national emergency agency. Myers described the person’s health condition as “mild.”
paras.zh: 以色列国家应急机构红大卫盾会的护理人员阿耶·迈尔斯 (Aryeh Myers) 表示，至少有一名 50 多岁的乘客因“胸部受伤”被送往医院。迈尔斯称此人的健康状况“轻微”。

paras.en: Earlier, U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee expressed relief on X that the incident didn’t turn out to be “more serious.”
paras.zh: 早些时候，美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比 (Mike Huckabee) 在 X 上表示宽慰，因为事件并没有变得“更严重”。

paras.en: “This had everyone in the Middle East (esp Israel) on FULL ALERT this morning,” he said. “Having pilots inflight detouring to ‘fist city’ not your ordinary experience.”
paras.zh: “今天早上，中东（尤其是以色列）的每个人都处于高度戒备状态，”他说。 “让飞行员在飞行中绕道前往‘拳头城市’不是你平常的经历。”

paras.en: Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told reporters that domestically, the TSA will continue to be “at high alert,” adding: “We have no credible threats to us right now that would coordinate what took place over there.”
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林 (Markwayne Mullin) 告诉记者，在国内，运输安全管理局将继续“保持高度戒备”，并补充道：“目前我们没有受到可信的威胁来协调那里发生的事情。”

paras.en: The incident comes at a time of high tensions in Israel ahead of next month’s parliamentary election, a key test for Netanyahu as he faces discontent over Gaza and Iran. The leader has made national security a core part of his platform ahead of the vote on Oct. 27, while also facing pressure from hardliners who favor a more aggressive stance in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 这起事件发生之际，以色列下个月议会选举前局势高度紧张，这对内塔尼亚胡来说是一次关键考验，因为他面临着对加沙和伊朗的不满。在 10 月 27 日投票之前，这位领导人已将国家安全作为其纲领的核心部分，同时也面临着来自主张在约旦河西岸采取更激进立场的强硬派的压力。

paras.en: Matt Bradley and Yarden Segev reported from Tel Aviv, Chantal Da Silva and Raf Sanchez from London and Nicole Acevedo from New York.
paras.zh: Matt Bradley 和 Yarden Segev 从特拉维夫报道，Chantal Da Silva 和 Raf Sanchez 从伦敦报道，Nicole Acevedo 从纽约报道。

articles.title: Two Iranian nationals charged over alleged terrorism plot targeting Jewish community in England
articles.author: Babak Dehghanpisheh

paras.en: British police said Friday that they had charged two Iranian nationals accused of plotting a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in Manchester on the eve of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
paras.zh: 英国警方周五表示，他们已指控两名伊朗国民，他们被控在犹太历中最神圣的赎罪日前夕策划针对曼彻斯特犹太社区的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: Rahman Salehi, 34, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, were charged with “engaging in conduct in preparation for terrorist acts” on or before September 20, according to a British police statement.
paras.zh: 英国警方声明称，34 岁的拉赫曼·萨利希 (Rahman Salehi) 和 36 岁的萨拉姆·艾哈迈迪安 (Salam Ahmadyan) 在 9 月 20 日或之前被指控“参与准备恐怖活动的行为”。

paras.en: The two men had allegedly been in contact with an overseas third-party who might be in Iran in relation to the plot, the Metropolitan Police said.
paras.zh: 伦敦警察厅表示，据称这两人曾与一名可能在伊朗的海外第三方就该阴谋进行联系。

paras.en: Salehi and Ahmadyan had components for manufacturing an improvised explosive device and conducted reconnaissance for potential targets, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 声明称，萨利希和艾哈迈迪安拥有制造简易爆炸装置的组件，并对潜在目标进行了侦察。

paras.en: On Monday, police arrested five British nationals in connection with a massive security operation near a base used by the U.S. Air Force to facilitate strikes on Iran, the counterterrorism officials running the operation said.
paras.zh: 负责此次行动的反恐官员表示，周一，警方逮捕了五名英国公民，原因是他们在美国空军基地附近进行大规模安全行动，该基地是美国空军用来协助袭击伊朗的基地。

paras.en: The five men, all from London and in their early to mid-20s, were arrested Sunday on suspicion of terrorism and explosives offenses after three suspicious vehicles were seen moving toward RAF Fairford, a Royal Air Force station about 90 minutes west of London.
paras.zh: 这五名男子均来自伦敦，年龄都在 20 岁出头到二十岁出头，他们于周日因涉嫌恐怖主义和爆炸罪而被捕，原因是有人看到三辆可疑车辆驶向距离伦敦以西约 90 分钟路程的皇家空军费尔福德基地。

paras.en: The men were released on bail, but police arrested a dual U.K.-Iranian national Thursday in relation to the incident.
paras.zh: 这些人已获保释，但警方周四逮捕了一名与该事件有关的英国和伊朗双重国籍公民。

paras.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Wednesday there are strong indications that Tehran played a part in the security incident outside the air base.
paras.zh: 总理安迪·伯纳姆周三表示，有明显迹象表明德黑兰参与了空军基地外的安全事件。

paras.en: Vicki Evans, the senior national coordinator for counterterrorism policing, said the alleged plot in Manchester was not linked to the incident at the airbase.
paras.zh: 国家反恐警务高级协调员维琪·埃文斯表示，曼彻斯特涉嫌的阴谋与空军基地事件无关。

paras.en: “This week also brought into sharp focus some of the wider threats being projected into the UK from Iran,” Evans said in the statement. “While this incident and the investigation into the RAF Fairford incident are not connected in any way, I want to reassure the public that CTP, working with our national security partners, are using the full range of our capabilities to protect the UK from any hostile acts.”
paras.zh: 埃文斯在声明中表示：“本周，伊朗对英国造成的一些更广泛的威胁也成为人们关注的焦点。” “虽然这一事件和对皇家空军费尔福德事件的调查没有任何联系，但我想向公众保证，CTP 与我们的国家安全伙伴合作，正在利用我们的全部能力来保护英国免受任何敌对行为的影响。”

articles.title: Flydubai pilot attacked captain with cockpit’s crash ax in attempted terrorist act, UAE official says
articles.author: Jonathan Dienst

paras.en: TEL AVIV — A Flydubai pilot attacked his flight captain using a crash ax and tried to take control of the aircraft’s controls in an attempted terrorist attack, an official with the United Arab Emirates said Saturday.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——阿拉伯联合酋长国的一名官员周六表示，一名迪拜航空飞行员用一把坠毁斧袭击了他的机长，并试图控制飞机的控制装置，以发动一次未遂的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: The suspect is Omani citizen Hamam al-Hammami, multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East told NBC News. Authorities have not officially released the identity.
paras.zh: 来自三个了解调查情况的机构的多位消息人士和一名中东外交官告诉 NBC 新闻，嫌疑人是阿曼公民哈马姆·哈马米 (Hamam al-Hammami)。当局尚未正式公布该身份。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal, citing sources familiar with the matter, reported that al-Hammami had “previously been banned from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted radical ideological views.”
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话报道称，哈马米“此前曾因担心他采取激进的意识形态观点而被阿曼禁止乘坐飞机”。

paras.en: Oman Air did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether he previously worked for the company.
paras.zh: 阿曼航空没有立即回应有关他是否曾在该公司工作的置评请求。

paras.en: Emirati officials are leading investigations into the midair incident, which occurred Wednesday on a flight carrying 174 mostly Israeli passengers from Dubai to Tel Aviv. A crash was averted, according to eyewitnesses and Israeli officials, when crew and passengers were able to enter the cabin and subdue the attacker.
paras.zh: 阿联酋官员正在领导对这起空中事件的调查，该事件发生在周三，一架载有 174 名乘客（其中大部分是以色列乘客）从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上。据目击者和以色列官员称，当机组人员和乘客进入机舱并制服袭击者时，事故得以避免。

paras.en: “Investigations into the incident aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 revealed that the co-pilot attempted to carry out a terrorist act,” UAE Attorney General Hamad Saif Al Shamsi said in an update on Saturday.
paras.zh: 阿联酋总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西 (Hamad Saif Al Shamsi) 在周六的更新中表示：“对迪拜航空 FZ1073 航班上事件的调查显示，副驾驶试图实施恐怖行为。”

paras.en: “The co-pilot began executing his plan during the flight, attacking the captain inside the flight deck using a crash axe and attempting to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“副驾驶在飞行过程中开始执行他的计划，用一把坠毁斧攻击驾驶舱内的机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制装置。”

paras.en: Al-Hammami was transferred from Saudi Arabia to Abu Dhabi on Thursday, the Saudi Interior Ministry said. The statement said his health had “improved,” but his medical condition was unclear.
paras.zh: 沙特内政部表示，哈马米于周四从沙特阿拉伯转移到阿布扎比。声明称他的健康状况已经“改善”，但目前尚不清楚他的健康状况。

paras.en: Al Shamsi said investigations were ongoing to “establish the full circumstances, motives, and any links related to the incident.”
paras.zh: 阿尔·沙姆西表示，调查正在进行中，以“查明与该事件相关的全部情况、动机以及任何联系”。

paras.en: Israeli government spokesman David Mencer said Friday that Israeli investigators would “join their Emirati counterparts in investigating this attempted mass murder and establishing precisely what happened, his motives and background.”
paras.zh: 以色列政府发言人大卫·门瑟周五表示，以色列调查人员将“与阿联酋同行一起调查这起未遂的大规模谋杀案，并确定到底发生了什么、他的动机和背景。”

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Friday: “As time passes, the picture becomes clearer: The attacker had undergone Islamist radicalization. He came to crash the plane, along with its passengers.”
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周五表示：“随着时间的推移，情况变得更加清晰：袭击者已经经历了伊斯兰激进化。他是来撞毁飞机以及机上乘客的。”

paras.en: He did not say how he reached that conclusion, but added: “We are investigating whether he was sent, and whoever sent him will pay a very heavy price.”
paras.zh: 他没有透露他是如何得出这个结论的，但补充道：“我们正在调查他是否是被派去的，无论是谁派他来的，都将付出非常惨重的代价。”

paras.en: Netanyahu’s spokesman Doron Spielman told NBC News that the suspect “talks on his social media about killing Jews.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼 (Doron Spielman) 告诉 NBC 新闻，嫌疑人“在社交媒体上谈论杀害犹太人”。

paras.en: The flight captain, Indian national Capt. Smit Machchhar, spoke for the first time Friday from a hospital in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 机长、印度国民上尉斯密特·马赫恰尔 (Smit Macchhar) 周五在阿布扎比的一家医院首次发表讲话。

paras.en: Flydubai pilot speaks out follow mid-air attack
paras.zh: 迪拜航空飞行员在空中袭击事件后发表讲话

paras.en: Machchhar was widely praised for his efforts to prevent the plane from crashing by opening the cockpit door and allowing passengers and crew members to rush in.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔因打开驾驶舱门并允许乘客和机组人员冲进去来防止飞机坠毁而受到广泛赞扬。

paras.en: Speaking from his hospital bed, Machchhar said he had been “severely injured” and “could sense that the aircraft was going down.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔在病床上表示，他“受了重伤”，并且“感觉到飞机正在坠落”。

paras.en: “I was acting for my own life, but at the same time, I knew I couldn’t let all of them die,” he said on a video call released by India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi, adding that he told himself to “give just one last push” to the cockpit door.
paras.zh: “我是为了自己的生命而行动，但同时，我知道我不能让他们所有人都死，”他在印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪发布的视频通话中说道，并补充说，他告诉自己要“最后一推”驾驶舱门。

paras.en: The Indian Embassy in Abu Dhabi called Machchhar the “Indian braveheart,” saying in an X post Saturday that he “remains under excellent medical care & is recovering well.”
paras.zh: 印度驻阿布扎比大使馆称马赫恰尔为“印度勇敢的心”，并在周六的 X 帖子中表示，他“仍然得到良好的医疗护理，并且恢复良好”。

paras.en: The deputy prime minister of the United Arab Emirates, Hamdan bin Mohammed, posted photos on X after visiting Machchhar in the hospital in which he’s seen kissing the pilot’s head and shaking his hand. Machchhar, with one arm in a cast and medical dressings on his head, appears awake and smiling.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国副总理哈姆丹·本·穆罕默德在医院探望马赫恰尔后在 X 上发布了照片，照片中他亲吻了飞行员的头并与他握手。马赫恰尔的一只手臂打着石膏，头上缠着医用敷料，看上去很清醒，面带微笑。

paras.en: “From us, and from the leadership of the nation, he has our full appreciation and praise,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“我们以及国家领导人对他表示充分的赞赏和赞扬。”

paras.en: Ayelet Epstein, a 47-year-old Israeli, told NBC News that her 14-year-old daughter asked if they were going to die when they heard shouting and “a huge fall started.”
paras.zh: 47 岁的以色列人阿耶莱特·爱泼斯坦 (Ayelet Epstein) 告诉 NBC 新闻，当她 14 岁的女儿听到喊叫声并“开始剧烈坠落”时，她问她们是否会死。

paras.en: “I told her, no, I don’t think so, we’re going to be OK,” she said, adding that “I was trying to rationalize things in a hopeful way for her.”
paras.zh: “我告诉她，不，我不这么认为，我们会没事的，”她说，并补充道，“我试图以一种对她充满希望的方式合理化事情。”

paras.en: Epstein thanked Machchhar “from the bottom of my heart” for saving their lives, lauding his bravery.
paras.zh: 爱泼斯坦“从心底”感谢马赫恰尔拯救了他们的生命，并称赞他的勇敢。

paras.en: A Flydubai spokesperson said Saturday: “We recognise that there are many questions at this stage; however, the circumstances surrounding the incident are still under investigation. We are therefore not in a position to comment further beyond our published statements.”
paras.zh: 迪拜航空发言人周六表示：“我们认识到现阶段存在很多问题；然而，事件相关情况仍在调查中。因此，除了我们已发表的声明外，我们无法进一步发表评论。”

paras.en: “We remain fully committed to supporting the ongoing investigation and are in close coordination with the relevant government authorities and regulators,” the spokesperson added.
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说：“我们仍然全力支持正在进行的调查，并与相关政府当局和监管机构密切协调。”

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters Thursday that there would be renewed strikes against Iran if it was behind the attack.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四告诉记者，如果伊朗是此次袭击的幕后黑手，美国将再次对伊朗发动袭击。

paras.en: “You just ask them,” he said. “They know what happened. They’ll be hit very hard.”
paras.zh: “你只要问他们就行了，”他说。 “他们知道发生了什么。他们会受到非常沉重的打击。”

paras.en: There are no indications that Iran directed or was involved in the attack, a senior U.S. official briefed on the Israeli investigation told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一位了解以色列调查情况的美国高级官员告诉 NBC 新闻，没有迹象表明伊朗指挥或参与了这次袭击。

paras.en: Raf Sanchez and Shira Pinson reported from Tel Aviv. Freddie Clayton reported from London. Tom Winter and Jonathan Dienst reported from New York.
paras.zh: 拉夫·桑切斯和希拉·平森从特拉维夫报道。弗雷迪·克莱顿从伦敦报道。汤姆·温特和乔纳森·迪恩斯特从纽约报道。

articles.title: Tornado leaves 'devastating' trail of damage in Ulladulla
articles.author: Penny Burfitt

paras.en: A tornado has left homes severely damaged and uninhabitable in Ulladulla.
paras.zh: 龙卷风使阿勒达拉的房屋严重受损，无法居住。

paras.en: SES volunteers have spent 24 hours responding to widespread damage from the event.
paras.zh: SES 志愿者花了 24 小时应对该事件造成的广泛损害。

paras.en: The SES had responded to every call-out by Sunday afternoon.
paras.zh: 截至周日下午，SES 已对每一次呼吁做出了回应。

paras.en: A tornado that ripped through the CBD of Ulladulla on the NSW South Coast on Saturday has left homes uninhabitable and severe damage in its wake.
paras.zh: 周六，一场龙卷风席卷了新南威尔士州南海岸阿勒达拉 (Ulladulla) 的中央商务区，造成房屋无法居住，并造成严重破坏。

paras.en: The State Emergency Service (SES) said the tornado, which reached a wind-gust front of 98 kilometres per hour about 1pm, impacted 15 properties.
paras.zh: 国家紧急服务局 (SES) 表示，龙卷风于下午 1 点左右达到每小时 98 公里的阵风，影响了 15 处房产。

paras.en: More than half a dozen were severely damaged and two of them deemed uninhabitable, the residents forced to relocate to the homes of friends and family.
paras.zh: 超过六栋房屋严重受损，其中两栋被认为无法居住，居民被迫搬迁到朋友和家人的家中。

paras.en: SES Deputy Incident Commander Tracy Provest said it had a "devastating" impact.
paras.zh: SES 事件副指挥官特雷西·普罗维斯特 (Tracy Provest) 表示，这造成了“毁灭性”影响。

paras.en: "We've had quite a number of homes where walls are gone or the roof has peeled off or tiles are on the other side of the road," she said.
paras.zh: “我们有很多房屋的墙壁已经消失，屋顶已经剥落，或者瓷砖位于路的另一边，”她说。

paras.en: "We've had trees down come through houses."
paras.zh: “我们已经看到树木被砍倒穿过房屋。”

paras.en: Street signs were also torn out of the ground and uprooted trees and falling branches fell on cars.
paras.zh: 路牌也被从地上扯下来，树木被连根拔起，掉落的树枝砸在汽车上。

paras.en: "Amazingly, nobody was injured," Ms Provest said.
paras.zh: “令人惊讶的是，没有人受伤，”普罗维斯特女士说。

paras.en: "Even the couple of trees that came down on cars, the people who were in the cars managed to get out.
paras.zh: “即使有几棵树倒在汽车上，车里的人也设法逃了出来。

paras.en: "[One] lady was across the road buying fish and chips and she watched a tree come down on her car. She was so thankful that she wasn't in it."
paras.zh: “[一位]女士在马路对面买鱼和薯条，她看到一棵树倒下来砸在了她的车上。她很庆幸自己没有在车里。”

paras.en: Ms Provest said she had never seen anything like it.
paras.zh: 普罗维斯特女士说她从未见过这样的事情。

paras.en: "I've been here since 2003, and I think for a lot of people who live locally, this is definitely a first," she said.
paras.zh: “我自 2003 年就来到这里，我认为对于很多居住在当地的人来说，这绝对是第一次，”她说。

paras.en: "One fellow had a small tinny on a trailer at the front of his house, it flipped the tinny off the trailer, lifted the trailer and knocked it into his car."
paras.zh: “一个人在他家前面的拖车上放了一个小铁罐，它把铁罐从拖车上掀下来，举起拖车，然后把它撞进了他的车里。”

paras.en: The service received 34 calls for help within Ulladulla, with all jobs finalised by Sunday afternoon after crews from as far as Yass were called in as back-up.
paras.zh: 该服务在阿勒达拉 (Ulladulla) 内接到了 34 个求助电话，在从远至亚斯 (Yass) 的工作人员被召集作为后援后，所有工作在周日下午完成。

paras.en: Across the state, 438 calls for assistance were received in the 24-hour period.
paras.zh: 全州24小时内接到438起求助电话。

paras.en: The town also received 24 millimetres of rain between 9am on Saturday and 9am on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周六上午 9 点至周日上午 9 点期间，该镇还下了 24 毫米的降雨。

paras.en: Brad Collins was driving in town with his father when he saw the storm unfold and captured a video on his smart phone as the clouds formed into a vortex.
paras.zh: 布拉德·柯林斯 (Brad Collins) 和父亲开车进城时，看到了风暴的形成，并用智能手机拍摄了一段视频，当时云层形成了漩涡。

paras.en: "It developed around us and it was that quick, the next minute it was in front of us," he said.
paras.zh: “它在我们周围发展，速度那么快，下一分钟它就出现在我们面前，”他说。

paras.en: "There was stuff flying in the air … then it was all over."
paras.zh: “有东西在空中飞舞……然后一切都结束了。”

paras.en: He described it as "surreal" and "crazy", later driving past several homes with roofs torn off and one car crushed by a tree.
paras.zh: 他形容这“超现实”和“疯狂”，后来开车经过几栋屋顶被撕毁的房屋，一辆汽车被树压碎。

paras.en: CCTV from a local cafe showed heavy rain and strong winds sweep through violently, sending umbrellas flying into the harbour.
paras.zh: 当地一家咖啡馆的闭路电视显示，暴雨和强风猛烈席卷，雨伞被吹进港口。

paras.en: The Bureau of Meteorology said the tornado was classified as "sub-severe" but was a unique event.
paras.zh: 气象局表示，龙卷风被归类为“次严重”，但它是一次独特的事件。

paras.en: "For the coast of New South Wales, it's quite unusual to see tornadoes like that," meteorologist Tristan Sumarna said.
paras.zh: “对于新南威尔士州的海岸来说，看到这样的龙卷风是很不寻常的，”气象学家特里斯坦·苏玛纳说。

paras.en: "Even though it was sub-severe, there was definitely some impact."
paras.zh: “尽管情况不太严重，但肯定产生了一些影响。”

paras.en: Ms Provest praised the local clean-up effort, saying Shoalhaven Council and NSW Police assisted with the roads as well as traffic direction, while multiple volunteers pitched in.
paras.zh: 普罗维斯特女士赞扬了当地的清理工作，并表示肖尔黑文市议会和新南威尔士州警方在道路和交通指挥方面提供了协助，同时还有多名志愿者参与其中。

paras.en: "A couple were directly impacted, and other had businesses impacted, and they've all been out helping anyway," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“有一对夫妇受到了直接影响，其他人的企业也受到了影响，但无论如何，他们都在提供帮助。”

paras.en: A 2-hour drive north, in Wollongong, the Yours and Owls Festival at Flagstaff Hill was briefly paused when the storm rolled in on Saturday evening.
paras.zh: 向北行驶 2 小时，在卧龙岗 (Wollongong)，弗拉格斯塔夫山 (Flagstaff Hill) 举行的“你与猫头鹰节”(Yours and Owls Festival) 因周六晚上暴风雨袭来而短暂暂停。

paras.en: Festival-goers told the ABC they were directed to seek shelter under tents for about 20 minutes.
paras.zh: 参加音乐节的人们告诉美国广播公司，他们被指示在帐篷下寻求庇护大约 20 分钟。

paras.en: Victoria Schuck was in the crowd and said despite the interruption, they made the most of it, holding a sing-a-long under the tents before the show went on.
paras.zh: 维多利亚·舒克 (Victoria Schuck) 就在人群中，她表示，尽管受到干扰，他们还是充分利用了这一机会，在演出开始前在帐篷下进行了合唱。

paras.en: "I think it added to it; it gives you a good story to tell and it was a lot of fun," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为它增加了它；它给你一个好故事可以讲，而且很有趣，”她说。

articles.title: Shark warning for NSW river after whale carcass removed
articles.author: Nakita Jager

paras.en: Shark danger in Clarence River after whale carcass removed, marine biologist says
paras.zh: 海洋生物学家称，鲸鱼尸体被清除后，克拉伦斯河出现鲨鱼危险

paras.en: A marine biologist says the smell of a whale carcass recently removed from the Clarence River will attract sharks.
paras.zh: 一位海洋生物学家表示，最近从克拉伦斯河中取出的鲸鱼尸体的气味会吸引鲨鱼。

paras.en: The carcass has been taken out to sea a day after it was spotted on a sandbar near Iluka on the Mid North Coast.
paras.zh: 在中北海岸伊鲁卡附近的沙洲上发现这具尸体一天后，它已被出海。

paras.en: The marine biologist says people should wait about a week before entering the water.
paras.zh: 这位海洋生物学家表示，人们应该等待大约一周才能下水。

articles.title: Cornell president vows 'serious look' at fraternities in wake of gang rape allegations

paras.en: Cornell's president has released an 8-minute video message responding to mounting outrage over how the university handled the alleged gang rape of a student at a fraternity house in 2024.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学校长发布了一段 8 分钟的视频信息，回应了人们对大学处理 2024 年兄弟会会所涉嫌轮奸事件的愤怒。

paras.en: Michael Kotlikoff says the university will take a "serious look" at the role of fraternities and sororities on campus.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·科特里科夫表示，学校将“认真审视”兄弟会和姐妹会在校园中的作用。

paras.en: He says Cornell's board of trustees will announce details of an independent review into how the school handled the case this week.
paras.zh: 他说康奈尔大学董事会将于本周宣布对学校处理此案的方式进行独立审查的细节。

paras.en: Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following an outcry over the school's handling of a student's gang rape allegations, the president says.
paras.zh: 校长表示，在学校处理学生轮奸指控的方式引发强烈抗议后，康奈尔大学将研究兄弟会和姐妹会在校园中的作用。

paras.en: In an 8-minute video message to the Cornell community, Michael Kotlikoff said the past week had raised questions around the investigations conducted at the time the allegations were reported, and that the school would take steps to prevent a similar situation in the future.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·科特里科夫（Michael Kotlikoff）在向康奈尔大学社区发布的一段 8 分钟视频信息中表示，过去一周对指控报告时进行的调查提出了质疑，学校将采取措施防止未来出现类似情况。

paras.en: That would include "a serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life", he said.
paras.zh: 他说，这将包括“认真审视兄弟会和姐妹会在校园生活中的作用”。

paras.en: "At their best, these organisations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community.
paras.zh: “在最好的情况下，这些组织可以为学生提供友谊、归属感、指导和强大的社区意识。

paras.en: "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility."
paras.zh: “但成为团队的一部分永远不会减少个人的责任。”

paras.en: The alleged victim is suing the men, the Chi Phi fraternity, the university, an Ithaca bar and others, seeking undisclosed damages.
paras.zh: 据称的受害者正在起诉这些人、Chi Phi 兄弟会、大学、伊萨卡酒吧和其他机构，寻求未公开的损害赔偿。

paras.en: Identified in court documents as Jane Doe, she says she was pressured into taking illicit drugs and drinking alcohol, which completely incapacitated her.
paras.zh: 法庭文件中，她的名字是无名氏 (Jane Doe)，她说，她被迫服用违禁药物和饮酒，这使她完全丧失了行为能力。

paras.en: According to investigation records obtained by The New York Times, the woman told a police officer: "I can say with 100 per cent confidence I was raped."
paras.zh: 根据《纽约时报》获得的调查记录，这名女子告诉一名警官：“我可以百分百确信我被强奸了。”

paras.en: But that statement was left out of an official police report that was sent to prosecutors, who ultimately dropped the case.
paras.zh: 但这份声明并未包含在提交给检察官的官方警方报告中，检察官最终撤销了此案。

paras.en: The school conducted its own investigation and issued sanctions, including expelling some students and suspending others.
paras.zh: 学校自行进行了调查并发布了处罚措施，包括开除部分学生、停课等。

paras.en: Mr Kotlikoff reaffirmed his commitment to supporting an independent review of Cornell's handling of the case, which was called for by New York Governor Kathy Hochul.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫先生重申了他对支持对康奈尔大学处理此案的独立审查的承诺，这是纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）所呼吁的。

paras.en: He said the school's board of trustees would announce details of the review later this week, and expressed support for Ms Hochul's decision to turn the criminal investigation over to the state attorney-general.
paras.zh: 他表示，学校董事会将在本周晚些时候公布审查细节，并表示支持 Hochul 女士将刑事调查移交给州总检察长的决定。

paras.en: "I want to acknowledge something that can be difficult for an institution to say: We don't have all the answers, but we are committed to investigating and finding the answers our community deserves," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我想承认一个机构很难说出的事情：我们没有所有的答案，但我们致力于调查并找到我们社区应得的答案。”

paras.en: During a student assembly hearing on October 1, several speakers called for Mr Kotlikoff's resignation.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 1 日的学生集会听证会上，几位发言者呼吁科利科夫先生辞职。

paras.en: Ms Hochul declined to take a position on whether Mr Kotlikoff should resign over the university's handling of the case when asked at a press conference on October 2, saying she did not yet have enough information.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 2 日的新闻发布会上被问及 Kotlikoff 先生是否应该因大学处理此案而辞职的问题时，Hochul 女士拒绝表明立场，称她还没有足够的信息。

paras.en: Mr Kotlikoff acknowledged frustration that Cornell had not communicated enough, saying that had led to distrust.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫先生承认康奈尔大学没有充分沟通感到沮丧，并表示这导致了不信任。

paras.en: While citing "real legal and privacy limits" on what the university could disclose, he pledged greater transparency and more opportunities for students, parents and others to engage with university leaders.
paras.zh: 他在援引大学可披露信息的“真正的法律和隐私限制”的同时，承诺提高透明度，为学生、家长和其他人提供更多与大学领导接触的机会。

paras.en: He also committed Cornell's support to legislative efforts to change New York's sexual assault laws.
paras.zh: 他还承诺康奈尔大学支持改变纽约性侵犯法的立法努力。

paras.en: State laws make it difficult to prosecute sexual assaults that involved victims who voluntarily consumed drugs and alcohol, even if they became too incapacitated to consent.
paras.zh: 州法律规定很难起诉涉及自愿吸毒和酗酒的受害者的性侵犯，即使他们已经丧失行为能力而无法同意。

paras.en: Critics say the laws create a "voluntary intoxication loophole", which separates people who were incapacitated by drugs without their consent, and those who voluntarily became intoxicated.
paras.zh: 批评者称，这些法律创造了一个“自愿中毒漏洞”，将未经同意而因吸毒而丧失行为能力的人与自愿中毒的人区分开来。

paras.en: The district attorney who initially chose not to pursue criminal charges cited these laws as reason, saying the woman's original statement to police described voluntary drug use and sexual activity.
paras.zh: 最初选择不提起刑事指控的地方检察官以这些法律为理由，称该女子最初向警方提供的陈述描述了自愿吸毒和性活动。

paras.en: Ms Hochul has pledged to push for changes to the law.
paras.zh: 霍赫尔女士承诺推动修改法律。

articles.title: Israeli strikes kill 5, including 4 women, in Gaza, health officials say

paras.en: Israeli strikes kill 5, including 4 women, in Gaza, health officials say
paras.zh: 卫生官员称，以色列空袭造成加沙 5 人死亡，其中包括 4 名妇女

paras.en: Gaza health officials say Israeli fire has killed at least 1,400 Palestinians since last October's ceasefire
paras.zh: 加沙卫生官员表示，自去年10月停火以来，以色列的火灾已造成至少1,400名巴勒斯坦人死亡

paras.en: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians, including four women, in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defence service officials said.
paras.zh: 卫生和民防服务官员表示，周六早些时候，以色列对加沙城一栋公寓楼进行空袭，造成至少五名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括四名妇女。

paras.en: The Israeli military said later on Saturday that it carried out an overnight strike on an apartment in Gaza in an attempt to kill Ali al-Amoudi. Hamas sources said al-Amoudi leads the Hamas political office in Gaza.
paras.zh: 以色列军方周六晚些时候表示，他们对加沙的一间公寓进行了连夜袭击，试图杀死阿里·阿穆迪。哈马斯消息人士称，阿穆迪领导着哈马斯在加沙的政治办公室。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether that was the same strike that killed the five Palestinians. The military said the results of the strike were under review, while Hamas did not immediately comment.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这是否是导致五名巴勒斯坦人死亡的同一次袭击。军方表示，袭击结果正在接受审查，而哈马斯没有立即发表评论。

paras.en: The strike destroyed the apartment building and started a fire.
paras.zh: 罢工摧毁了公寓楼并引发火灾。

paras.en: "We were asleep and suddenly heard continuous strikes and heavy explosions, the children woke up startled and started running and screaming," said eyewitness Ahmed Al-Dahdouh.
paras.zh: 目击者艾哈迈德·达赫杜说：“我们正在睡觉，突然听到连续的敲击声和剧烈的爆炸声，孩子们惊醒了，开始奔跑和尖叫。”

paras.en: "We ran out and found that our neighbour's house was struck and there were dismembered martyrs, women, men and children, we started to pull them out, they were scattered under the rubble," he told Reuters.
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社：“我们跑出去，发现邻居的房子被击中，里面有被肢解的烈士，有妇女、男人和儿童，我们开始把他们拉出来，他们散落在废墟下。”

paras.en: Last year's U.S.-brokered Gaza ceasefire calls for eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made toward implementing a deal to end the conflict that includes terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops.
paras.zh: 去年在美国斡旋下的加沙停火呼吁最终重建该领土。但在执行结束冲突的协议方面进展甚微，其中包括哈马斯解除武装和以色列撤军的条款。

paras.en: A Christian mother and her daughter were among the dead on Saturday, medics said.
paras.zh: 医护人员称，周六的死者中有一名基督徒母亲和她的女儿。

paras.en: "We are Muslims and these are our Christian brethren, who are not involved in anything, they are peaceful people, and everybody loves them, and now we pulled out their bodies, a mother and her daughter," said Dahdouh.
paras.zh: 达赫杜说：“我们是穆斯林，这些是我们的基督教弟兄，他们不参与任何事情，他们是和平的人，每个人都爱他们，现在我们取出了他们的尸体，一位母亲和她的女儿。”

paras.en: Israel, which says Hamas has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of the ceasefire, has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 以色列称哈马斯一直在重新武装并发动袭击，违反停火协议，最近几周加大了对该组织的打击力度。

paras.en: - Palestinian death toll in Gaza war rises above 74,000 since war began
paras.zh: - 自战争开始以来，加沙战争中巴勒斯坦人的死亡人数已超过 74,000 人

paras.en: - UN rights chief says uncovered remains in Gaza raise concerns of war crimes
paras.zh: - 联合国人权事务高级专员表示，加沙未发现的遗骸引发了对战争罪的担忧

paras.en: Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal.
paras.zh: 哈马斯否认试图发动袭击或重建其武器库，并指责以色列破坏加沙和平协议。

paras.en: Gaza health officials have said at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since last October's ceasefire. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed by militants in Gaza over the same period.
paras.zh: 加沙卫生官员表示，自去年10月停火以来，至少有1,400名巴勒斯坦人被以色列的炮火杀害。以色列称，同一时期，其四名士兵在加沙被武装分子杀害。

paras.en: The war erupted on Oct. 7, 2023, when Hamas-led militants invaded Israel, killing some 1,200 people, mostly civilians, and taking 251 others hostage.
paras.zh: 战争于 2023 年 10 月 7 日爆发，哈马斯领导的武装分子入侵以色列，造成约 1,200 人死亡，其中大部分是平民，并劫持了 251 人作为人质。

articles.title: Tennessee prisons chief to resign after failed execution of Christa Pike, governor says

paras.en: Tennessee prisons chief to resign after failed execution of Christa Pike, governor says
paras.zh: 州长表示，田纳西州监狱长因处决克里斯塔·派克失败而辞职

paras.en: Gov. Bill Lee said that Department of Correction Commissioner Frank Strada will step down this month
paras.zh: 州长比尔·李表示，惩教署署长弗兰克·斯特拉达将于本月辞职

paras.en: The head of Tennessee's prison system is resigning after the failed execution of Christa Pike, Gov. Bill Lee announced Saturday.
paras.zh: 田纳西州州长比尔·李周六宣布，在克里斯塔·派克处决失败后，田纳西州监狱系统负责人将辞职。

paras.en: Lee said that Department of Correction Commissioner Frank Strada will step down this month.
paras.zh: 李表示，惩教署署长弗兰克·斯特拉达将于本月辞职。

paras.en: Strada said in a statement that stepping aside "is in the best interests" of the state as an independent review is carried out to determine why Pike's execution failed Wednesday.
paras.zh: 斯特拉达在一份声明中表示，在周三进行独立审查以确定派克处决失败的原因时，退出“符合该州的最佳利益”。

paras.en: Pike was placed on a ventilator and remained unconscious in a hospital, her attorneys said in a court filing Friday.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在周五的一份法庭文件中表示，派克在医院里戴着呼吸机，至今仍处于昏迷状态。

paras.en: Hospital staff, her lawyers said, were working to save Pike's life and, as of late Thursday, were trying to clear the two doses of the drug that the state uses to execute prisoners.
paras.zh: 她的律师表示，医院工作人员正在努力挽救派克的生命，截至周四晚些时候，他们正在努力清除该州用于处决囚犯的两剂药物。

paras.en: The stunning failure in Tennessee's execution chamber on Wednesday has left both sides of the death penalty debate demanding answers. Lee has ordered an independent review.
paras.zh: 田纳西州执行室周三发生的令人震惊的失败事件，让死刑辩论的双方都要求给出答案。李已下令进行独立审查。

paras.en: - Video Tennessee halts executions after Christa Pike survives botched lethal injection
paras.zh: - 视频 克里斯塔·派克（Christa Pike）注射死刑失败后幸存下来，田纳西州停止处决

paras.en: - Christa Pike on ventilator after surviving Tennessee execution attempt, lawyer says
paras.zh: - 律师称，克里斯塔·派克在田纳西州行刑未遂后使用呼吸机

paras.en: Pike's attorneys said they believed problems with the IV lines caused the pentobarbital to flow into her body instead of her bloodstream.
paras.zh: 派克的律师表示，他们认为静脉输液管的问题导致戊巴比妥流入她的身体而不是血液。

paras.en: "Apparently at no point did any member of the execution team realize that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown and that the pentobarbital was, in whole or in part, entering Ms. Pike's body," they wrote in the court filing.
paras.zh: 他们在法庭文件中写道：“显然，执行小组的任何成员都没有意识到静脉输液管放置不正确，或者静脉已经破裂，戊巴比妥全部或部分进入了派克女士的身体。”

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her boyfriend tortured and killed a classmate, Colleen Slemmer, in a jealous rage. She later became one of the youngest women to be sent to death row.
paras.zh: 派克 18 岁时，她和男友在嫉妒的愤怒中折磨并杀害了同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer)。她后来成为被送进死牢的最年轻的女性之一。

articles.title: What we know about an Ontario air ambulance that went missing off U.S. coast with 6 on board

paras.en: What we know about an Ontario air ambulance that went missing off U.S. coast with 6 on board
paras.zh: 我们对一架载有 6 人的安大略省空中救护车在美国海岸失踪的了解

paras.en: - The U.S. Coast Guard says it is searching for an air ambulance that went missing around 1:30 a.m. Saturday and is operated by an Ontario company.
paras.zh: - 美国海岸警卫队表示正在寻找一架于周六凌晨 1 点 30 分左右失踪的空中救护飞机，该飞机由安大略省的一家公司运营。

paras.en: - The Gulfstream G100 jet lost contact overnight as it was flying from Bermuda to Boston, according to Latitude Air Ambulance's director of flight operations.
paras.zh: - 据纬度空中救护公司的飞行运营总监称，这架湾流 G100 喷气式飞机在从百慕大飞往波士顿的途中夜间失去了联系。

paras.en: - Six people were on board, including two Canadian pilots, two Canadian medical workers, one patient and the patient's relative.
paras.zh: - 机上共有六人，包括两名加拿大飞行员、两名加拿大医务人员​​、一名患者和患者亲属。

paras.en: - U.S. Coast Guard air and surface crews are conducting searches off Nantucket, Mass. Crews located debris associated with the air ambulance Saturday.
paras.zh: - 美国海岸警卫队空中和地面工作人员正在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特附近进行搜索。周六，工作人员发现了与空中救护车相关的残骸。

paras.en: - The aircraft had flown from Hamilton, Ont., where Latitude Air Ambulance is based, to Bermuda on Friday evening before departing for Boston.
paras.zh: - 这架飞机于周五晚上从纬度空中救护车总部所在的安大略省汉密尔顿飞往百慕大，然后飞往波士顿。

paras.en: - October 4 Recovered debris 'associated' with missing plane, U.S. Coast Guard says Justin Li A U.S. Coast Guard spokesperson confirmed that debris found off the coast of Nantucket, Mass., was "associated" with the missing aircraft. The spokesperson said the Coast Guard could not yet comment on the nature of the debris, but said the association was confirmed by "using precise information about the aircraft from other agencies," without providing more detail. Search for six missing people will continue, the Coast Guard said.
paras.zh: - 10 月 4 日 美国海岸警卫队称已发现与失踪飞机“相关”的残骸 美国海岸警卫队发言人贾斯汀·李证实，在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特海岸发现的残骸与失踪飞机“有关”。该发言人表示，海岸警卫队尚无法对残骸的性质发表评论，但表示该关联是通过“使用其他机构提供的有关飞机的准确信息”证实的，但没有提供更多细节。海岸警卫队表示，将继续搜寻六名失踪人员。

paras.en: - October 3 What we know about the search for the missing air ambulance Sarah Petz The U.S. Coast Guard continues to search for an air ambulance jet with six people on board, including four Canadians, that went missing in the early hours of Saturday. The Gulfstream G100 jet operated by Latitude Air Ambulance, a Hamilton-based company, was traveling from Bermuda to Boston when it lost contact with air traffic controllers at around 1:30 a.m. The U.S. Coast Guard's northeast district has deployed a fleet of air and marine assets to search for the missing plane. Not much is known yet about what happened before the jet lost contact. But a spokesperson for Nantucket Memorial Airport in Massachusetts said the airport was informed the aircraft had reportedly declared an emergency before losing contact. The missing jet is one of four Gulfstream G100 jets registered to Latitude Air Ambulance, which works with global insurance companies, governments and other organizations to provide medical evacuation and repatriation services. Joshua McNamara, a spokesperson for Ornge, which provides air ambulance services for Ontario's provincial health-care system, said the flight was not an air ambulance transport for Ontario. Canadian officials have said they're monitoring the situation and are prepared to provide support as search and rescue efforts continue. We're pausing live updates on this page for now but will be back with any major developments.
paras.zh: - 10 月 3 日 我们对搜寻失踪空中救护机的了解 莎拉·佩茨 美国海岸警卫队正在继续搜寻周六凌晨失踪的一架空中救护机，机上有六人，其中包括四名加拿大人。凌晨 1 点 30 分左右，总部位于汉密尔顿的纬度空中救护公司 (Latitude Air Ambulance) 运营的这架湾流 G100 喷气式飞机在从百慕大飞往波士顿的途中与空中交通管制员失去联系。美国海岸警卫队东北区已部署一支空中和海上力量搜寻失踪飞机。目前对于飞机失去联系之前发生的情况还知之甚少。但马萨诸塞州楠塔基特纪念机场的发言人表示，机场获悉这架飞机在失去联系之前已宣布进入紧急状态。这架失踪的飞机是在纬度空中救护公司注册的四架湾流 G100 飞机之一，该公司与全球保险公司、政府和其他组织合作，提供医疗后送和遣返服务。为安大略省医疗保健系统提供空中救护服务的 Ornge 发言人约书亚·麦克纳马拉 (Joshua McNamara) 表示，这架航班不是一架飞机 安大略省的救护车运输。加拿大官员表示，他们正在监测局势，并准备在搜救工作继续进行时提供支持。我们暂时暂停此页面上的实时更新，但如有重大进展就会回来。

paras.en: - Massachusetts ready to offer state support: governor Gabriela Silva Ponte Massachusetts Gov. Maura Healey told NBC News Saturday she hadn't been fully briefed on the situation. "My thoughts and prayers go to all on board and all involved," she said. "We'll do whatever we can as a state to support efforts there."
paras.zh: - 马萨诸塞州准备提供国家支持：马萨诸塞州州长 Gabriela Silva Ponte 马萨诸塞州州长莫拉·希利 (Maura Healey) 周六告诉 NBC 新闻，她尚未完全了解情况。她说：“我的思念和祈祷属于船上所有人员和所有相关人员。” “作为一个州，我们将尽我们所能来支持那里的努力。”

paras.en: - Global Affairs Canada standing by to provide consular assistance Gabriela Silva Ponte Global Affairs Canada says it is aware of reports that Canadians who were aboard a Latitude Air Ambulance are missing. "Consular officials stand ready to provide consular assistance and are in contact with local authorities," it said in a statement Saturday. "Due to privacy considerations, no further information can be disclosed."
paras.zh: - 加拿大全球事务部随时准备提供领事援助 加布里埃拉·席尔瓦·庞特 (Gabriela Silva Ponte) 加拿大全球事务部表示，已获悉有关乘坐纬度空中救护车的加拿大人失踪的报道。 “领事官员随时准备提供领事协助，并与地方当局保持联系，”它在周六的一份声明中表示。 “出于隐私考虑，无法透露更多信息。”

paras.en: - Aviation expert says he expects search won't take long Sarah Petz CBC's Sheehan Desjardins brings us the latest updates from on the ground in Hamilton, where Latitude Air Ambulance is based. The U.S. Coast Guard appears to have "pulled out all the stops" in their search for the missing Latitude Air Ambulance plane, said John Gradek, a faculty lecturer in supply chain networks and aviation management at McGill University. Gradek said rescuers are likely undertaking a gird search of about a hundred square miles based on the last reported position given from the aircraft's emergency locator transmitter, which helps rescuers find aircraft and people in distress. "So they have a pretty good idea of the last reported position of this aircraft," he said. Gradek said he doesn't think it will take very long for the coast guard to locate the missing plane. "Usually, you know, in these types of situations with a fairly tight search pattern, they're able to find and resolve the state of the aircraft fairly quickly," Gradek said. - With files from Philip Lee-Shanok
paras.zh: - 航空专家表示，他预计搜索不会花费很长时间 Sarah Petz CBC 的 Sheehan Desjardins 为我们带来了 Latitude 空中救护车总部所在地汉密尔顿的最新消息。麦吉尔大学供应链网络和航空管理讲师约翰·格拉德克表示，美国海岸警卫队似乎已“全力以赴”搜寻失踪的纬度空中救护飞机。格拉德克表示，救援人员可能会根据飞机紧急定位发射器最后报告的位置进行约一百平方英里的网格搜索，这有助于救援人员找到遇险的飞机和人员。 “所以他们非常清楚这架飞机最后报告的位置，”他说。格拉德克说，他认为海岸警卫队不需要很长时间就能找到失踪的飞机。 “通常，你知道，在这种搜索模式相当严格的情况下，他们能够相当快地找到并解决飞机的状态，”格拉德克说。 - 包含来自 Philip Lee-Shanok 的文件

paras.en: - Timeline of jet C-GRJP's path Arrthy Thayaparan Based on flight data and official statements, here's what we know about the jet's path overnight. Friday, 7:10 p.m. ET: Jet C-GRJP departs John C. Munro Hamilton International Airport, according to Flightradar24. 9:28 p.m. ET: Flight lands at Bermuda's L.F. Wade International Airport. 11:41 p.m. ET: Flight departs from Bermuda and heads to Logan International Airport in Boston, with an estimated arrival time of 1:30 a.m. ET on Saturday. Saturday, approximately 1 a.m. ET: The jet goes from 24,000 feet in the air down to 11,000 feet before stabilizing again, according to flight tracking website FlightAware. 1:20 a.m. ET: The Federal Aviation Administration issues a search and rescue alert notice for the jet. Around 1:30 a.m. ET: Latitude was tracking the flight and lost contact. The company reaches out to the U.S. Coast Guard. 6:15 a.m. ET: The Coast Guard says on social media it is looking for the Gulfstream G100 jet off the coast of Nantucket, Mass. 11:46 a.m. ET: Search is ongoing with five air and marine assets taking part in the search, said the Coast Guard.
paras.zh: - C-GRJP 喷气式飞机航线时间表 Arrthy Thayaparan 根据飞行数据和官方声明，以下是我们对这架喷气式飞机夜间航线的了解。周五晚上 7:10东部时间：据 Flightradar24 报道，C-GRJP 喷气式飞机从约翰·芒罗·汉密尔顿国际机场起飞。晚上 9:28东部时间：航班降落在百慕大 L.F. 韦德国际机场。晚上 11:41东部时间：航班从百慕大出发，飞往波士顿洛根国际机场，预计抵达时间为美国东部时间周六凌晨 1:30。美国东部时间周六凌晨 1 点左右：根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware，这架飞机从 24,000 英尺的高度下降到 11,000 英尺的高度，然后再次稳定下来。美国东部时间凌晨 1:20：美国联邦航空管理局针对这架飞机发布了搜救警报通知。美国东部时间凌晨 1:30 左右：Latitude 正在跟踪该航班，但失去了联系。该公司联系了美国海岸警卫队。美国东部时间上午 6:15：海岸警卫队在社交媒体上表示，正在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特海岸寻找这架湾流 G100 喷气式飞机。美国东部时间上午 11:46：海岸警卫队表示，搜索正在进行，有五艘空中和海上资产参与搜索。

paras.en: - Aircraft reportedly declared emergency before it lost contact: Nantucket airport Gabriela Silva Ponte Nantucket Memorial Airport spokesperson Preston Harimon said in a statement Saturday the airport, which is located in Massachusetts, was informed the aircraft had reportedly declared an emergency before it lost contact. “Details regarding the circumstances of the incident remain unconfirmed,” Harimon said. “Nantucket Memorial Airport will not speculate on the cause of the event.” The airport added search and rescue efforts are being carried out by the United States Coast Guard. “Search efforts continued overnight and remain ongoing,” Harimon said.
paras.zh: 据报道，飞机在失去联系之前宣布进入紧急状态：楠塔基特机场发言人普雷斯顿·哈里蒙（Preston Harimon）周六在一份声明中表示，位于马萨诸塞州的楠塔基特机场获悉，据报道飞机在失去联系之前宣布进入紧急状态。 “有关事件情况的细节尚未得到证实，”哈里蒙说。 “楠塔基特纪念机场不会猜测事件的原因。”机场补充说，美国海岸警卫队正在开展搜救工作。哈里蒙说：“搜索工作持续了一整夜，并且仍在继续。”

paras.en: - Latitude reached out to U.S. Coast Guard after losing contact The Canadian Press When the plane failed to reach the tarmac, Latitude reached out to the U.S. Coast Guard, company spokesperson Togeretz said. Togeretz said the company is "dealing with the situation with as much positivity and optimism as we can." "We're praying for a safe outcome," he said. He said this is the first time Latitude Air Ambulance has lost contact with one of its planes.
paras.zh: - Latitude 在失去联系后联系了美国海岸警卫队 加拿大媒体 公司发言人 Togeretz 表示，当飞机未能到达停机坪时，Latitude 联系了美国海岸警卫队。托格雷茨表示，该公司“正在以尽可能积极和乐观的态度应对这一情况”。 “我们祈祷安全的结果，”他说。他说，这是纬度空中救护公司第一次与其飞机失去联系。

paras.en: - Flight was not related to an Ontario medical situation, Ornge says Arrthy Thayaparan Joshua McNamara, a spokesperson for Ornge, which provides air ambulance services for Ontario's provincial health-care system, said the company was "deeply concerned" by reports of the missing Latitude Air Ambulance flight. The flight was not an air ambulance transport for Ontario and not related to Ornge operations, he told CBC News in an emailed statement. "Our thoughts are with the crew, passengers, their families and everyone at Latitude Air Ambulance during this difficult time," he said. "We remain hopeful that the aircraft and all those on board are located safely and quickly."
paras.zh: - Ornge 表示，该航班与安大略省的医疗状况无关。Ornge 为安大略省医疗保健系统提供空中救护服务，其发言人 Arrthy Thayaparan Joshua McNamara 表示，该公司对纬度空中救护航班失踪的报道“深表关切”。他在一份电子邮件声明中告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，这架航班不是安大略省的空中救护运输，也与 Ornge 的运营无关。他说：“在这个困难时期，我们的心与机组人员、乘客、他们的家人以及纬度空中救护公司的每个人同在。” “我们仍然希望飞机和机上所有人员能够安全、迅速地找到。”

paras.en: - What do we know about Latitude Air Ambulance? Arrthy Thayaparan The missing jet is one of four Gulfstream G100 jets registered in Hamilton-based company, Latitude Air Ambulance. While the company operates out of Hamilton, its website states that Latitude's scope of work extends outside the country as "an international medevac provider" to bring "patients home from anywhere in the world." It states the company works with global insurance companies, governments and other organizations to provide medical evacuation and repatriation services for hundreds of people every year. "Each air ambulance flight is staffed with two pilots and medical team members that are fully trained and qualified to provide the necessary care to each patient," Latitude's website reads. "We have flown to over 120 countries and all continents except Antarctica." Latitude's medical staff, which includes fully licensed physicians and registered nurses, is chosen to meet each patient's specific needs, it says. The company said the G100 jet is one of the longest range dedicated medevac aircrafts in North America, which can travel over 5,000 kilometres in range.
paras.zh: - 我们对纬度空中救护车了解多少？ Arrthy Thayaparan 这架失踪的飞机是汉密尔顿 Latitude 空中救护公司注册的四架湾流 G100 飞机之一。虽然该公司在汉密尔顿开展业务，但其网站称，Latitude 的工作范围已扩展到国外，成为“国际医疗后送提供商”，将“世界各地的患者带回家”。该公司表示，该公司与全球保险公司、政府和其他组织合作，每年为数百人提供医疗后送和遣返服务。 Latitude 网站上写道：“每次空中救护飞行都配备了两名飞行员和医疗团队成员，他们经过充分培训并有资格为每位患者提供必要的护理。” “我们已经飞往 120 多个国家和除南极洲以外的所有大陆。” Latitude 的医务人员包括持有执照的医生和注册护士，他们的选择是为了满足每位患者的具体需求。该公司表示，G100喷气式飞机是北美航程最远的专用医疗后送飞机之一，航程可超过5,000公里。

articles.title: AI giants 'not being nearly careful enough,' warns outgoing OpenAI safety engineer

paras.en: A safety engineer who recently quit ChatGPT creator OpenAI warned Saturday that artificial intelligence (AI) firms were "not being nearly careful enough."
paras.zh: 一位最近退出 ChatGPT 创建者 OpenAI 的安全工程师周六警告称，人工智能 (AI) 公司“不够谨慎”。

paras.en: David Robinson's comments come amid growing concerns about AI becoming too powerful — a threat that US President Donald Trump has labeled a "hoax."
paras.zh: 大卫·罗宾逊发表此番言论之际，人们越来越担心人工智能变得过于强大——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将这一威胁称为“骗局”。

paras.en: OpenAI and Anthropic recently disclosed cases in which their AI models slipped past safety controls, hid mistakes and hacked systems they were not meant to access.
paras.zh: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 最近披露了一些案例，在这些案例中，他们的人工智能模型绕过了安全控制、隐藏了错误以及被黑客入侵了他们不应该访问的系统。

paras.en: In an op-ed for The Atlantic, Robinson said AI needs guardrails similar to those for nuclear power and aviation, adding, "The time for trial and error is over."
paras.zh: 罗宾逊在《大西洋月刊》的一篇专栏文章中表示，人工智能需要类似于核能和航空的护栏，并补充说，“反复试验的时间已经结束了。”

paras.en: He called for more emphasis on safety and research before US Big Tech develops more advanced AI models "so that the occasional and inevitable human error does not open a door to disaster."
paras.zh: 他呼吁美国大型科技公司开发更先进的人工智能模型之前更加重视安全和研究，“这样偶尔和不可避免的人为错误就不会打开灾难之门。”

paras.en: Robinson, who oversaw safety reports for 12 frontier AI-model launches, said the recent errors were typical because tech giants are prioritizing "speed and flexibility."
paras.zh: Robinson 负责监督 12 个前沿人工智能模型发布的安全报告，他表示，最近的错误很典型，因为科技巨头优先考虑的是“速度和灵活性”。

paras.en: "An environment where things like this can happen is no place to grow artificial minds that could be smarter than we are and that might not do what we want them to."
paras.zh: “这样的事情可能发生的环境不适合培育比我们更聪明的人工智能，而且它们可能不会做我们希望它们做的事情。”

paras.en: The former OpenAI employee noted that the firm relies on "iterative deployment." It releases new AI models first and only tightens safeguards after problems show up.
paras.zh: 这位前 OpenAI 员工指出，该公司依赖于“迭代部署”。它首先发布新的人工智能模型，只有在问题出现后才加强保障措施。

paras.en: "As the company sprints from one launch to the next, it is failing to achieve the level of care that I believe is needed," Robinson, who worked at OpenAI for 3 1/2 years, added.
paras.zh: 在 OpenAI 工作了 3 1/2 年的 Robinson 补充道：“随着公司从一个发布冲刺到下一个发布，它未能达到我认为需要的关注水平。”

paras.en: OpenAI reacted to the latest criticism in a statement, "We're making sure our models don't become more capable than we can safely manage and secure, and we pause training or hold back models when we need to slow down."
paras.zh: OpenAI 在一份声明中对最新的批评做出了回应，“我们正在确保我们的模型不会变得超出我们安全管理和保护的能力，并且当我们需要放慢速度时，我们会暂停训练或阻止模型。”

paras.en: In recent months, there have been repeated warnings from technology experts and policymakers that AI models are advancing so fast they could take control and possibly wipe out humanity.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，技术专家和政策制定者多次警告称，人工智能模型发展速度如此之快，以至于可能会控制并可能消灭人类。

paras.en: Despite those fears, US President Donald Trump is vehemently against stronger regulation, insisting that it will slow down innovation and make it harder for US AI models to beat Chinese rivals.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些担忧，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍强烈反对加强监管，坚称这将减慢创新速度，并使美国人工智能模型更难击败中国竞争对手。

paras.en: This week, Trump announced a voluntary safety pact with six companies — Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Alphabet's Google.
paras.zh: 本周，特朗普宣布与六家公司签署自愿安全协议：Nvidia、SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 和 Alphabet 旗下的谷歌。

paras.en: The president described the deal as "morally binding,” even if it is not legally enforceable.
paras.zh: 总统称该协议“具有道德约束力”，即使它在法律上不具有强制执行力。

paras.en: He also directed his administration to rename AI as "Super Intelligence" or SI.
paras.zh: 他还指示他的政府将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”或SI。

paras.en: A survey by Reuters/Ipsos last month found that three-quarters of Americans worry that AI giants are not doing enough to stop AI from causing serious harm to society.
paras.zh: 路透社/益普索上个月的一项调查发现，四分之三的美国人担心人工智能巨头在阻止人工智能对社会造成严重危害方面做得不够。

articles.title: Brazil's 2026 presidential election is kicking off with polls showing Lula and Bolsonaro nearly tied.

paras.en: The latest polling points to a tight race in Brazil's presidential election on Sunday, with leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva seeking a fourth non-consecutive term and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro seeking to continue the right-wing populist movement started by his father, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 最新民意调查显示，周日巴西总统选举竞争激烈，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦寻求第四个非连续任期，参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗寻求继续其父亲雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗发起的右翼民粹主义运动。

paras.en: The two leading candidates wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday in Brazil's economic powerhouse state of Sao Paulo.
paras.zh: 两位主要候选人于周六在巴西经济强国圣保罗结束了竞选活动。

paras.en: The 80-year-old Lula capped off his campaign with a tour through the city of Sao Paulo, vowing to "defeat the far right," and framing the election as choice between "democracy and sovereignty" and "barbarism and corruption." Organizers said some 150,000 of Lula's supporters turned up for the rally in Brazil's largest city.
paras.zh: 80岁的卢拉以游览圣保罗市结束了他的竞选活动，并发誓要“击败极右翼”，并将这次选举定义为“民主与主权”与“野蛮与腐败”之间的选择。组织者称，约有 15 万名卢拉支持者参加了在巴西最大城市举行的集会。

paras.en: Lula has campaigned on continuing his left-leaning Workers' Party platform, comprising welfare programs, state-funded development and income redistribution.
paras.zh: 卢拉在竞选中主张继续推行其左倾工人党纲领，包括福利计划、国家资助的发展和收入再分配。

paras.en: Flavio Bolsonaro, 45, has served as the Liberal Party's senator for Rio de Janeiro since 2019. On Saturday, he led a motorcycle parade through Sao Paulo's countryside cities of Santa Barbara d'Oeste and Americana.
paras.zh: 45 岁的弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗自 2019 年以来一直担任里约热内卢自由党参议员。周六，他带领摩托车游行穿过圣保罗的乡村城市西圣巴巴拉和亚美利加纳。

paras.en: The right-wing Bolsonaro has campaigned on hardline security policies and tax cuts, emphasizing high cost of living under Lula, who he has slammed as "incompetent."
paras.zh: 右翼博尔索纳罗在竞选中主张强硬的安全政策和减税，强调卢拉领导下的高生活成本，并抨击卢拉“无能”。

paras.en: "I am convinced that everything is in place for us to win this election in the first round," the lawmaker said.
paras.zh: 这位议员说：“我相信，一切都已准备就绪，我们可以在第一轮选举中获胜。”

paras.en: He also held up a portrait of his father, while the crowd shouted "mito" — a Portuguese word for "legend" that Jair Bolsonaro's supporters use to refer to him.
paras.zh: 他还举起了父亲的肖像，人群高喊“mito”——葡萄牙语中“传奇”的意思，雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的支持者用它来称呼他。

paras.en: The elder Bolsonaro is currently serving a 27-year sentence in prison for attempting a coup to overturn his loss to Lula in the 2022 presidential election. Flavio Bolsonaro has vowed to pardon his father if elected.
paras.zh: 老博尔索纳罗目前正在监狱服刑 27 年，罪名是试图发动政变推翻他在 2022 年总统选举中输给卢拉的局面。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗发誓，如果当选，他将赦免他的父亲。

paras.en: Lula's team has cast the Bolsonaro movement as a threat to Brazil's sovereignty, pointing to Flavio and Jair's ties with US President Donald Trump, who last year slapped a 50% tariff on Brazilian imports in response to Jair Bolsonaro's coup trial, which the US president called a "witch hunt."
paras.zh: 卢拉的团队将博尔索纳罗运动视为对巴西主权的威胁，并指出弗拉维奥和雅伊尔与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的关系。特朗普去年对巴西进口产品征收 50% 的关税，以回应雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的政变审判，美国总统称之为“政治迫害”。

paras.en: The younger Bolsonaro has said in interviews he is "more moderate" than his father, who he has nevertheless said will remain "my compass, my point of reference."
paras.zh: 小博尔索纳罗在接受采访时表示，他比父亲“更加温和”，但他表示父亲仍将是“我的指南针，我的参考点”。

paras.en: Policies where both Bolsonaros are similar include relaxed gun control laws and skepticism of human-caused climate change.
paras.zh: 两位博尔索纳罗的政策相似，包括放松枪支管制法和对人为造成的气候变化持怀疑态度。

paras.en: Trump has not endorsed the senator, but has said he is watching the election "very closely."
paras.zh: 特朗普尚未支持这位参议员，但表示他正在“非常密切地”关注选举。

paras.en: Brazil finds itself politically divided, and campaigning has been bitter, with online operations from both sides seizing on every gaffe, accusation and rumor, quickly producing slick videos or AI-generated images for social media.
paras.zh: 巴西发现自己存在政治分裂，竞选活动一直很艰难，双方的在线行动都抓住了每一个失态、指控和谣言，迅速为社交媒体制作了精美的视频或人工智能生成的图像。

paras.en: In September, it was revealed Bolsonaro is under investigation for alleged corruption, money laundering and tax evasion tied to the financing of a biopic about his father. He has denied any misconduct.
paras.zh: 9月，有消息称博尔索纳罗因涉嫌腐败、洗钱和逃税而接受调查，这些指控与资助一部有关其父亲的传记片有关。他否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: Polls show neither candidate is likely to win more than 50% of valid votes on Sunday needed to avoid a runoff that would take place on October 25.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，两位候选人都不太可能在周日赢得超过 50% 的有效选票，以避免 10 月 25 日举行决选。

paras.en: The latest polling for the first round of voting shows Lula at 46% and Bolsonaro at 45%, according to the Brazilian data intelligence and public opinion research firm Quaest cited by Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 路透社援引巴西数据情报和舆论研究公司Quaest的数据，第一轮投票的最新民意调查显示，卢拉为46%，博尔索纳罗为45%。

paras.en: In the case of a run-off, the Quaest poll shows Lula at 42% and Bolsonaro at 44%.
paras.zh: 在决选中，Quaest 民意调查显示，卢拉的支持率为 42%，博尔索纳罗的支持率为 44%。

paras.en: In 2022, Lula beat Jair Bolsonaro by only 1.8 percentage points.
paras.zh: 2022年，卢拉仅以1.8个百分点的优势击败贾尔·博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: Along with voting for president, Brazil's 160 million registered voters are also choosing other lawmakers, governors, and some senators.
paras.zh: 除了投票选举总统外，巴西 1.6 亿登记选民还选举其他议员、州长和一些参议员。
